&360 You're gonna spoil me.
&361 Gimme.
&362 This is nice.

Coffee and intimacy.

en: &167 So about this Silver Flare...
zh: &167 那么，关于这家银焰餐厅……

en: &1 My mouth is already watering. God, I've missed that place.
zh: &1 我已经在流口水了。天哪，我真想念那地方。

en: &2 I practically lived there, back in the day.
zh: &2 当年我几乎就住在那儿。

en: &3 Or rather, THIS day.
zh: &3 或者说，就住在这个年代。

en: &168 The food was that good?
zh: &168 那里的食物有那么好吃？

en: &4 You've never had a better burger. Made it with REAL beef.
zh: &4 你再也找不到比那更好的汉堡了。用的是真正的牛肉。

en: &5 Not that chemically flavored TVP stuff we have now.
zh: &5 不是我们现在吃的那种化学调味的大豆蛋白肉。

en: &6 Hey, you want to try one?

zh: &7 我以前从没一个人在那儿吃过饭。现在也没理由破例。

en: &169 Er. I'll pass. Thanks.

zh: &170 所以你以前常去那儿，嗯？

zh: &8 三个词：学生特价午餐。几乎支撑了我整个大二学年。

en: &9 God. Can you imagine what my cholesterol levels were back then? They're bad enough NOW.
zh: &9 天哪。你能想象我那时候的胆固醇水平吗？现在就已经够糟了。

en: &10 But back then... it didn't matter. Metabolism like a pencil sharpener. That was me.

en: &11 *Sigh*
&171 Are you sure you're all right?
&12 Just hungry. Let's get going!
&172 So that clothing you're wearing...
&13 Pretty perfect, huh? Figured I should blend in.
zh: &13 很完美，对吧？我想我应该融入这个时代。

en: &173 Blend in.
&14 I look like just another student, right?
zh: &14 我看起来就像个普通学生，对吧？

en: &174 You said you lived in this area?
zh: &174 你说过你住在这个地区？

en: &175 Bio-chemical engineering, wasn't it?
&16 You've done your research.
&17 I... owe a lot to the place.
&176 So. This is a bit awkward.

&7 Hey!

&9 Where'd you get that key!

en: &117 Fia? What's going on?
&11 You!

en: &188 Yes. I know him.
&189 I've got to get after him.

zh: &13 你他妈别想。他的账你来付。

en: &190 No time for that. I need to get after him.
&191 I apologize for my... friend. But I need to catch up to him.
zh: &191 我为我的……朋友道歉。但我得追上他。

en: &14 You can apologize by paying his bill.
zh: &14 你可以通过付他的账来道歉。

en: &15 Do you have any idea how much he owes us?
zh: &15 你知道他欠我们多少吗？

en: &192 I am... aware.
&193 Will this be enough?
&16 This is... more than enough. Lemme go get you change.
zh: &16 这……绰绰有余。我去给你找零。

en: &194 Keep it.
&17 Oh! Um, thanks I guess.
&18 I'll just go turn off the alarm.
&3011 Blast it.
&10 Blast it blast it blast it.
&195 I really thought this would be an easy one.
zh: &195 我真以为这次会很轻松。

en: &118 Fia? What happened?
&11 Joe Anderson did a runner!
&119 He did? That's odd.
&196 Odd is the word, yeah. You'd better track him.
zh: &196 奇怪就对了。你最好追踪他。

en: &120 Track him?
&197 Yeah. Using his PFE data?
&121 Sure, but...
&12 You CAN track him, right?
&13 You do know where he is?
&122 That's what I'm trying to say. He didn't GO anywhere.
zh: &122 我正要说这个。他哪儿也没去。

en: &123 He's right behind you, according to his PFE data.
zh: &123 根据他的PFE数据，他就在你身后。

en: &198 He's not here, Nozzo. You sure the system is working right?
zh: &198 他不在这儿，诺佐。你确定系统没出问题？

en: &124 It's working perfectly!
&125 Are you... wait. Oh blast it.
&3012 Nozzo?
&199 Nozzo. What's wrong?
&126 The PFE signal is decaying!
&200 That's... bad, is it?
&127 It's certainly not GOOD.
&128 Search the alley. It's got to be around there somewhere.
zh: &128 搜搜那条巷子。肯定就在那附近。

en: &201 I told you. He ran off!
&129 Priorities, Fia! SOMETHING in that alley is giving off a signal.
zh: &129 分清轻重，菲娅！那条巷子里有东西在发信号。

en: &130 Something that's not supposed to be in that era?
zh: &130 是不该出现在那个时代的东西？

en: &202 Right. I get it. Sorry.
&131 And SUBVOCALIZE!
&3021 Sorry.
&204 How did he get through the alley gate? Didn't you say it was locked?
zh: &204 他是怎么穿过小巷门的？你不是说锁了吗？

en: &19 Shows what I know. He swiped a spare key from behind the counter.
zh: &19 看来我知道的也不多。他从柜台后面偷了把备用钥匙。

en: &205 A spare key?
&20 Hidden in a pepper shaker! Been there for years. Even I'd forgotten it was there.
zh: &20 藏在胡椒瓶里！已经好几年了。连我都忘了它在那儿。

en: &21 No idea how he'd even know about that.
zh: &21 不知道他怎么会知道那个。

en: &206 I... can't imagine.
&207 Do you know the name Joe Anderson?
&22 Joe Anderson?
&208 Bio-chem student in the area. Around eighteen years old?
zh: &208 这附近的生化系学生。大概十八岁？

en: &23 Oh you mean ANDY!
&24 Your friend does look a bit like him. That his grandfather or something?
zh: &24 你朋友确实有点像他。那是他祖父还是什么？

en: &209 Or something.
&25 Well, Andy's always been a good kid. He must be worried.
zh: &25 嗯，安迪一直是个好孩子。他一定很担心。

en: &210 Can you tell me anything about Andy?
zh: &210 你能告诉我一些关于安迪的事吗？

en: &26 Didn't you say you already know him?
zh: &26 你不是说你已经认识他了吗？

en: &211 Not exactly.
&27 Then I'm not sure what I can tell you.
zh: &27 那我就不知道能告诉你什么了。

en: &28 He comes here a lot. We deliver to him at the Brittany House sometimes.
zh: &28 他经常来这里。我们有时会送到布列塔尼之家给他。

en: &29 You know. The NYU dorm? It's just a few blocks away.
zh: &29 你知道的。纽约大学宿舍？离这里就几个街区。

en: &213 Right. Thank you.
&214 Nozzo? Did you get that?
&132 Yep. Sending you the address now.
zh: &132 听到了。现在把地址发给你。

en: New location:[[Brittany Hall Dormitory
zh: 新地点：[[布列塔尼楼宿舍

en: &215 You can't tell me anything more about Andy?
zh: &215 关于安迪，你不能再多告诉我一些吗？

en: &30 Look. I'm grateful for that tip you gave me. With all the students around here, that never happens.
zh: &30 听着。我很感激你给我的小费。这附近学生这么多，从来没人给过。

en: &31 But I really don't like gossiping about people who aren't here.
zh: &31 但我真的不喜欢议论不在场的人。

en: &32 He comes here a lot and we deliver to him sometimes over at the Brittany House.
zh: &32 他经常来这里，我们有时会送到布列塔尼之家给他。

en: &33 That's it.
&216 You deliver to Andy's dorm?
&34 Students, you know. They're our bread and butter.
zh: &34 学生嘛，你知道的。他们是我们的衣食父母。

en: &35 And it's not like the Brittany House is far. It's just a block west of here.
zh: &35 而且布列塔尼之家也不远。就从这里往西一个街区。

en: &217 Do you know a Professor Foster?
&36 You mean Rhona Foster? The chem prof? Yeah. She comes in here sometimes.
zh: &36 你是说罗娜·福斯特？化学教授？认识。她有时会来。

en: &37 Super cool lady.
You're welcome, Mattie!
&218 So. This Rhona Foster woman...
zh: &218 那么，这位罗娜·福斯特女士……

en: &219 Can you tell me anything else about her?
zh: &219 你还能告诉我关于她的其他事吗？

en: &38 You already know she teaches chemistry. So you know as much as I do.
zh: &38 你已经知道她教化学了。所以你知道的和我一样多。

en: &39 And like I keep saying. I don't gossip about my customers.
zh: &39 而且就像我一直说的，我不议论我的顾客。

en: &220 Do you know anyone named Lisa?
&40 Um. You're gonna have to be a bit more specific than that.
&221 I believe she came here with Andy at least once.
zh: &221 我相信她至少和安迪来过一次。

en: &41 Oh yeah! I've seen them. Are those two finally together?
zh: &41 哦对！我见过他们。那两位终于在一起了？

en: &222 I don't know.
&42 Well they'd better be. They've been making starry eyes at each other for weeks.
zh: &42 他们最好在一起了。他们眉来眼去好几个星期了。

en: &223 Can you tell me about Lisa?
zh: &223 你能告诉我关于丽莎的事吗？

en: &43 I told you. I don't gossip about my customers.
zh: &43 我说过了。我不议论我的客人。

en: &44 Sorry.
&224 Andy lives in the Brittany Hall dormitory, correct?
zh: &224 安迪住在布列塔尼楼宿舍，对吗？

en: &45 Yeah. So?
&225 You mentioned that you send deliveries to him. Do you know what room?
zh: &225 你提到你给他送过货。你知道是哪个房间吗？

en: &46 Not offhand. Sorry.
&226 Thanks for your time. I need to find my... friend.
zh: &226 谢谢你的时间。我得找到我的……朋友。

en: &47 Sure.
&227 Could you tell me about this client again?
zh: &227 你能再跟我说说这位客户吗？

en: &133 Joe Anderson. He pioneered all the latest advances in robotic and laser surgeries.
zh: &133 乔·安德森。他开创了机器人和激光手术的所有最新进展。

en: &134 He's the reason why the average life expectancy is over 100 years old now.
zh: &134 他是现在平均预期寿命超过100岁的原因。

en: &228 Ah. So his timeline importance ranking is high?
zh: &228 啊。所以他的时间线影响评级很高？

en: &135 One of the highest.
&229 So where is this diner?
&136 A few blocks west of your landing point. You can't miss it.
zh: &136 你跃迁落点往西几个街区。你不会错过的。

en: &1827 There's no keyhole on this door.
&443 There isn't?
&444 Oh. Must be padlocked from the outside.
zh: &444 哦。一定是从外面用挂锁锁上了。

en: &1828 Didn't they think to check that before choosing this landing point?
zh: &1828 他们选这个跃迁落点之前就没想过检查一下吗？

en: &445 Do they ever?
&1829 *Sigh* Don't worry. I'll figure this out.
zh: &1829 *叹气* 别担心。我会想办法的。

en: &369 We always do.
&231 How do I access that archive of old lock combinations again?
zh: &231 我怎么再访问那个旧锁组合的档案？

en: &138 Just use the Historical Archive, Fia. All you need is the brand name.
zh: &138 用历史档案就行，菲娅。你只需要品牌名称。

en: &3214 You said it was "Rastar", right? Then you have everything you need.
zh: &3214 你说过是“拉斯塔”，对吧？那么你已经拥有所需的一切。

en: &232 Rust has completely covered the serial number.
zh: &232 锈迹完全盖住了序列号。

en: &139 Ah. Problem. Do you have anything to clean it with?
zh: &139 啊。麻烦了。你有什么东西能清理它吗？

en: &233 I'll try and find something.
&234 I got the serial number.
&140 So what are you waiting for?
&34 I admit, it is VERY strange talking like this.
zh: &34 我承认，这样说话非常奇怪。

en: &212 You know. Speaking with you without moving my lips or making any sound.
zh: &212 你知道的。就是不动嘴唇、不出声地跟你说话。

en: &604 I get it. But you can't deny it's useful. Besides, the brass insists.
zh: &604 我明白。但你不能否认这很有用。再说，公司高层坚持要这样。

en: &1811 Well I insist on a softer landing point next time.
zh: &1811 那我坚持下次换个更软的跃迁落点。

en: &605 That's fine. As long as you do it subvocally.
zh: &605 没关系。只要你默读就行。

en: Tutorializing subvocalization
&235 How are things from your end?
&141 I'm scanning all security camera footage and every archived photo taken in a three mile radius of your when and location.
zh: &141 我正在扫描你所在年代和地点方圆三英里内的所有监控录像和存档照片。

en: &142 He's been extremely careful. But if he slips up, we'll know.
zh: &142 他一直非常小心。但只要他露出马脚，我们就会知道。

en: &236 No ripples detected?
&143 Everything's marginal. So far.
&144 Whatever the client's doing, it hasn't set off any alarm bells yet.
zh: &144 不管客户在做什么，还没触发任何警报。

en: &237 So Joe's cluster-mate. This Lisa Sandman. Any thoughts on her?
zh: &237 那么乔的伴侣组成员。这个丽莎·桑德曼。对她有什么看法？

en: &145 Not really.
&146 The archive had next to nothing to say about her.
zh: &146 档案里关于她的信息几乎为零。

en: &147 Just her birthdate, her deathdate, her employment history, and little else.
zh: &147 只有她的出生日期、死亡日期、工作经历，其他几乎没有。

en: &148 She lived a short, simple, and rather unremarkable life.
zh: &148 她的一生短暂、简单，相当平淡。

en: &238 We can't all change the world, can we?
zh: &238 我们不可能都改变世界，对吧？

en: &149 No. Just with time travel.
&239 I need to gain Lisa's trust, Nozzo. She won't speak to me otherwise.
zh: &239 我需要赢得丽莎的信任，诺佐。否则她不会跟我说话。

en: &240 I think I need to help her.
&150 Do what you think is necessary. I'll keep an eye out.
zh: &150 做你认为必要的事。我会留意的。

en: &241 Stand by, Nozzo.
&151 I'll be here.
&242 His background checked out. We were careful enough.
zh: &242 他的背景查过了。我们够小心了。

en: &152 Obviously we weren't.
&243 I'm the one who let him get away. It's my fault.
zh: &243 是我让他跑掉的。是我的错。

en: &153 Did YOU break his PFE? No. The client did that all by himself.
zh: &153 是你弄坏了他的PFE吗？不是。是客户自己弄坏的。

en: &154 You're not getting the blame for this. I'll make sure of that.
zh: &154 这事不会怪到你头上。我保证。

en: &244 We're in this together, Nozzo. We'll fix this.
zh: &244 我们是一条绳上的，诺佐。我们会解决的。

en: &155 Well. Yeah. Who else is gonna do it?
&245 We can work out who's to blame later.
&246 What do we do now?
&156 Okay. I've been reading the protocols, and there IS a contingency plan for this situation.
zh: &156 好。我一直在读协议，这种情况确实有应急预案。

en: &247 I'm listening.
&157 You're not gonna like it.
&248 I said I'm listening.
&158 First things first. Get back to the landing point.
&159 I'm sending you an upgrade.
&249 A present? Oh goodie.
&160 Thank me later. Just... get to the construction site.
zh: &160 回头再谢我。先……到建筑工地去。

en: &161 I'll fill you in when you get there.
zh: &161 等你到了我再跟你细说。

en: &250 Are you sure? There is no other way?
zh: &250 你确定吗？没有别的办法了？

en: &162 I... don't know.
&251 I understand.
&163 Good. I wish there was another way.
zh: &163 好。我也希望有别的办法。

en: &252 I don't like this, Nozzo.
&164 I don't like it either, Fia.
&165 But he broke his Paradox Field Excluder. He is unsynced from our timeline.
zh: &165 但他的悖论场隔离器坏了。他已经和我们的时间线脱节了。

en: &166 We couldn't bring him back even if we wanted to.
zh: &166 就算我们想，也没法把他带回来。

en: &167 He crossed a line. And he needs to be stopped.
&254 Don't worry. I'll get it done.
&168 Right. Good. You know how to use that weapon?
zh: &168 好。很好。你知道怎么用那件武器吗？

en: &253 I said I'll get it done.
&169 Okay. I'll be here.
&170 Touch base when...
&171 Well, when you have something to touch base about.
zh: &171 嗯，等你有情况可以联系的时候。

en: &172 Good luck, Fia.
&3014 Yeah.
&255 Worth a try, but no.
&6211 Oh blast it.
&257 Nothing's ever easy, is it?
zh: &257 什么事都不会容易，对吧？

en: &32 Oh. Hey! You did it!
&258 That I did.
&33 Wow. We're really here.
&34 It's just like I remember!
&35 The air even smells...
&36 Urg.
&259 You all right?
&37 I'm fine.
&38 Maybe giving you that boost took more out of me than I thought.
zh: &38 也许托你翻过去消耗的体力比我想的多。

en: &260 Don't worry. Everyone gets a bit wobbly on their first jump.
zh: &260 别担心。第一次跃迁都会有点晕。

en: &261 That's why we told you to eat bland food before you came.
zh: &261 所以我们才让你来之前吃清淡点。

en: &39 Oh. Yeah. I didn't eat anything at all.
&40 I want to be HUNGRY. That's the whole point, isn't it?
zh: &40 我想饿着。这才是重点，不是吗？

en: &41 Speaking of... can we get going?
zh: &41 说到这个……我们能走了吗？

en: The door is now unlocked.
Like I said, he isn't here.
Okaay.
&300 I'm a student here. Like you.
zh: &300 我是这里的学生。跟你一样。

en: &1 You know there's no classes today, right?
&301 I am just visiting.
&2 Visiting what? An empty school building?
zh: &2 参观什么？一栋空教学楼？

en: &302 I am looking for someone.
&3 You're looking for someone. In an empty school building?
zh: &3 你在找人。在一栋空教学楼里？

en: &4 It's Spring Break. Nobody is supposed to be here.
zh: &4 现在是春假。没人应该在这里。

en: &303 Nobody? What about you?
&5 Well, YEAH. That's because...
&6 Hey wait a minute!
&7 Let me see your card.
&304 My card?
&8 Yeah!
&9 If you belong here, you'd have a school ID card.
zh: &9 如果你属于这里，你应该有学生证。

en: &10 So. Lemme see it.
&305 Ah. Well.
&306 Look. Lisa. I can explain.
&11 Oh. Can you?
&13 Wait. How do you know my name?
zh: &13 等等。你怎么知道我的名字？

en: &307 Oh. Blast it.
&14 It was you, wasn't it? You did this?
&308 Did what?
&309 I didn't do anything. I only just arrived.
zh: &309 我什么都没干。我才刚到。

en: &310 Please try and calm down. I don't mean you any harm.
zh: &310 请冷静一下。我不会伤害你。

en: &16 You serious?
&17 If you didn't send that email, then what are you doing here?
zh: &17 如果不是你发的那封邮件，那你在这里干什么？

en: &311 Email?
&18 Are you for real? Or are you just being cute?
zh: &18 你是认真的吗？还是你在装傻？

en: &312 Again. I have no idea.
&19 Right. Right. Fine. Fine. WHATEVER.
&20 You obviously don't belong here, but neither do I.
zh: &20 你显然不属于这里，但我也不属于。

en: &21 Tell nobody I was here, and I'll do the same.
zh: &21 别告诉任何人我来过这里，我也不会说出去。

en: &313 What, exactly, are you doing?
&22 Nothing! Nothing at all!
&314 It looks like you are trying to pick the lock of that door.
zh: &314 看起来你在撬那扇门的锁。

en: &23 No. Shut up. I'm not doing anything.
&315 You are literally doing it right now.
&24 Yeah. Well. We all see what we wanna see.
zh: &24 是啊。好吧。我们都只看到自己想看到的。

en: &316 Do you know Joe Anderson?
&317 You probably know him as "Andy?"
&26 Is that what this is about? Dating my lab partner?
zh: &26 这就是你来这里的原因吗？为了和我的实验搭档约会？

en: &318 I have no idea.
&27 Since you have no idea, neither do I.
zh: &27 既然你都不知道，那我更不知道了。

en: &319 So you are Andy's cluster-mate?
zh: &319 所以你是安迪的伴侣组成员？

en: &28 His what?
&320 Sorry. His... what's the word... girl friend?
zh: &320 抱歉。他的……那个词怎么说来着……女朋友？

en: &29 Uh. Well, I wouldn't go THAT far.
zh: &29 呃。好吧，我可不会说到那个地步。

en: &30 Not sure what we are yet.
zh: &30 还不确定我们是什么关系。

en: &321 So about Andy...
&31 Look I'm trying to FOCUS, here.
zh: &31 听着，我现在得集中注意力。

en: &32 You want me to help you? Help me get through this door.
zh: &32 你想让我帮你？那就帮我进这扇门。

en: &322 I am looking for an older gentleman. He was wearing an NYU hat and sweatshirt.
zh: &322 我在找一位老先生。他戴着纽约大学的帽子，穿着运动衫。

en: &33 Huh. I think I would've remembered seeing someone like that.
zh: &33 嗯。我觉得如果见过那样的人，我应该会记得。

en: &34 But I dunno for sure. I'm a bit... distracted right now.
zh: &34 但我也说不准。我现在有点……心烦意乱。

en: &323 So could you tell me about yourself?
zh: &323 那你能跟我说说你自己吗？

en: &35 Hey. Total stranger. Do I LOOK like I want to tell you my life story?
zh: &35 嘿。完全陌生的人。我看起来像是想跟你讲我的人生故事吗？

en: &324 Right. Right. Sorry.
&325 What exactly is on that computer?
zh: &325 那台电脑上到底有什么？

en: &36 None of your damn business!
&37 Will you shut up about Andy? I need to FOCUS!
zh: &37 你能不能别再说安迪了？我得集中注意力！

en: &326 What exactly is wrong?
&38 Sorry. Sorry. You helped me out. I shouldn't have snapped like that.
zh: &38 抱歉。抱歉。你帮了我。我不该那样发火。

en: &39 Someone hacked into my email account and sent my prof a nasty letter under my name.
zh: &39 有人黑了我的邮箱，以我的名义给我的教授发了一封恶心的信。

en: &40 I'm trying to get into her computer and delete it before she sees it.
zh: &40 我想进她的电脑，在她看到之前删掉它。

en: &41 So... you see why I'm freaking out a little bit here.
zh: &41 所以……你明白我为什么有点抓狂了吧。

en: &327 So your Andy knows about the roof as well?
zh: &327 所以你的安迪也知道屋顶的事？

en: &42 "My" Andy, huh?
&43 Yeah. He definitely knows about it.
&44 It's where we first...
&45 Hey you know what? Never mind.
&328 Soo. What was in this email?
zh: &328 那么。那封邮件里写了什么？

en: &46 Er, I really really really don't wanna say.
zh: &46 呃，我真的真的真的不想说。

en: &47 It got really... personal. Stuff I don't think is true, but maybe could be?
zh: &47 内容非常……私人。有些事我不认为是真的，但也许可能是真的？

en: &48 Don't know either way. I just don't want Professor Foster to see it.
zh: &48 不管怎样，我就是不想让福斯特教授看到。

en: &329 Do you know, um, who could have sent this email?
zh: &329 你知道，嗯，可能是谁发的这封邮件吗？

en: &49 No clue! I'm the bottom of the totem pole around here.
zh: &49 毫无头绪！我在这里是最底层的人。

en: &50 Why would anyone do this to ME?
zh: &50 为什么会有人对我做这种事？

en: &330 Maybe I can help?
&51 You think you know the password? Feel free to give it a try.
zh: &51 你觉得你知道密码？尽管试试。

en: &331 I really need to learn more about Andy.
zh: &331 我真的需要多了解安迪一些。

en: &52 Yeah, I get that impression.
&53 But I don't have the bandwidth to handle your questions right now.
zh: &53 但我现在没精力回答你的问题。

en: &54 Sorry.
&332 Have you been clustered, er, I mean dating him long?
zh: &332 你们结为伴侣，呃，我是说约会，很久了吗？

en: &55 Not long. Just two weeks.
&56 Or maybe one week? Not sure if Spring Break week counts.
zh: &56 也许一个星期？不确定春假那周算不算。

en: &57 Eh, whatever. I say it counts.
&200 Two weeks!
&333 The roof?
&58 Yeah. Our lab group did some atmospheric analysis tests up there. We need to be high up.
zh: &58 对。我们实验小组在那上面做了一些大气分析测试。我们需要在高处。

en: &334 And that's against the rules?
&59 Technically? Yeah.
&60 We're not supposed to use that fire escape unless there's an actual fire.
zh: &60 除非真的发生火灾，否则我们不应该使用那个消防梯。

en: &61 But do you know how many students live in a building with roof access?
zh: &61 但你知道有多少学生住在有屋顶通道的大楼里吗？

en: &62 None in my lab group, that's for sure.
zh: &62 反正我们实验小组里一个都没有。

en: &335 Well, I won't say anything if you won't.
&63 Like I said, everybody does it.
zh: &63 就像我说的，大家都这么做。

en: &336 Can you tell me anything about Joe? Or, Andy rather?
zh: &336 你能告诉我一些关于乔的事吗？或者，应该说安迪？

en: &64 Um. Why? You said neither of us were in trouble, right?
zh: &64 呃。为什么？你说过我们俩都没事的，对吧？

en: &337 That is correct. Neither of you are in trouble... right now.
zh: &337 没错。你们俩都没事……目前。

en: &65 Wait. Is this about the roof?
zh: &65 等等。是因为屋顶的事吗？

en: &66 Because EVERYBODY does that. You shouldn't single him out.
zh: &66 因为大家都那么做。你不应该只针对他。

en: &338 Thank you, Lisa. You've been a great help.
zh: &338 谢谢你，丽莎。你帮了大忙。

en: &67 Thank YOU. I probably owe you my future diploma. Heck, my future PERIOD.
zh: &67 谢谢你。我可能欠你未来的文凭。见鬼，我未来的整个人生。

en: &339 Your... future. Of course.
&68 I'm gonna head out now. I just wanna get drunk and forget this happened.
zh: &68 我现在要走了。我只想喝个烂醉，忘掉这件事。

en: &69 You want to join? I'll buy. It's the least I can do.
zh: &69 你想一起吗？我请客。这是我至少能做的。

en: &340 That's all right. You take care.
&70 Back atcha. Thanks again!
&3017 Yeah.
&341 You're welcome.
&342 Well, I'll be going.
&71 Sure. Whatever.
&174 She seems friendly.
&343 She's ignoring me and ignoring the rules.
zh: &343 她在无视我，也无视规定。

en: &344 No wonder she and Joe Anderson get along so well.
zh: &344 难怪她和乔·安德森那么合得来。

en: &345 Hello. Joe.
&346 Got you.
&347 Turn around. Slowly.
&43 I knew you'd find me. I mean, you HAD to find me.
zh: &43 我就知道你会找到我。我是说，你不得不找到我。

en: &44 I just needed a bit of time. And that's what I got.
zh: &44 我只是需要一点时间。而我得到了。

en: &348 I'd really suggest that you stop talking.
zh: &348 我真的建议你别再说了。

en: &45 Sure. Sure. It doesn't really matter anyway.
zh: &45 当然。当然。反正也无所谓了。

en: &46 I did... what I needed to do.
&349 Do what, exactly?
&47 I saved her.
&350 You've broken every rule we have. You know that, right?
zh: &350 你违反了我们的每一条规定。你知道的，对吧？

en: &48 I don't care. I had to save her.
&351 You should have stayed with me.
&49 I couldn't. I had to save her.
&352 By "her" I assume you mean Lisa?
zh: &352 你说的“她”，我猜是指丽莎？

en: &50 You know about Lisa? How?
zh: &50 你知道丽莎？怎么知道的？

en: &51 There was almost nothing in the historical archive about her. I checked. Many times.
zh: &51 历史档案里几乎没有她的任何记录。我查过。很多次。

en: &52 It's like... history forgot all about her.
zh: &52 就好像……历史完全把她遗忘了。

en: &353 You didn't hire us just for a meal, did you?
zh: &353 你雇我们不只是为了吃顿饭吧？

en: &53 Oh, that was part of it. Going back to the Flare was... nice.
zh: &53 哦，那只是其中一部分。回到银焰餐厅的感觉……很好。

en: &354 Yes. It was nice, wasn't it?
&355 Especially when you ran off and put my entire department on high alert.
zh: &355 尤其是你跑掉之后，害得我整个部门高度戒备。

en: &356 What were you hoping to achieve here?
zh: &356 你在这里到底想达成什么？

en: &54 What do you THINK?
&55 I've spent my entire life taking advantage of every opportunity.
zh: &55 我这辈子都在抓住每一个机会。

en: &56 I couldn't waste this one. I just couldn't.
zh: &56 我不能浪费这次机会。我就是不能。

en: &357 You took advantage all right. Of me and my entire department.
zh: &357 你确实抓住了机会。利用我和我整个部门。

en: &358 Of course we know about her.
&359 We are very good at our jobs.
zh: &359 我们非常擅长自己的工作。

en: &57 Yes. That is... obvious.
&58 I'm... sorry. I'm sorry I put you through all this. I really am.
zh: &58 我……很抱歉。很抱歉让你经历了这一切。真的很抱歉。

en: &59 But it doesn't matter now.
&60 I got her kicked out. I got her away from here. That's...that's the important thing.
zh: &60 我让她被开除了。我让她离开了这里。那……那才是最重要的。

en: &360 You hacked her email.
&61 You know about that too? Yes. It was me.
zh: &61 这你也知道？是的。是我干的。

en: &62 She gave me her password once. To grab some files when her phone died.
zh: &62 她给过我一次密码。她手机没电时让我帮忙取文件。

en: &63 I still remember it, after all this time.
&361 Well. She'll be happy to know that her trust wasn't misplaced.
zh: &361 好吧。她要是知道自己的信任没有被辜负，会很高兴的。

en: &64 You don't understand! I HAD to do it!
zh: &64 你不明白！我不得不这么做！

en: &65 Lisa DIED. Will die. In a chemical explosion. Right here in this building.
zh: &65 丽莎死了。将会死。死在一场化学爆炸里。就在这栋楼里。

en: &66 But not anymore! I changed it!
zh: &66 但现在不会了！我改变了这一切！

en: &67 There's no way Professor Foster will hire Lisa now. Not after she reads that email. Lisa won't be here when it happens.
zh: &67 福斯特教授现在绝不会雇用丽莎了。她读完那封邮件之后就不会了。事情发生时丽莎不会在这里。

en: &68 She'll be safe.
&362 There was a better way to do this.
&363 You could've done this legally.
zh: &363 你本可以合法地做这件事。

en: &364 Why all the lies, Joe?
&365 We receive requests to save people from death all the time. Why didn't you make one yourself?
zh: &365 我们一直都会收到拯救他人免于死亡的请求。你为什么自己不提交一个？

en: &69 You think I didn't try that?
&70 My request was REJECTED.
&366 Rejected?
&367 Why? Her timeline importance rating was low enough.
zh: &367 为什么？她的时间线影响评级已经足够低了。

en: &71 Sure. Her LIFE wasn't important, according to your precious board of directors.
zh: &71 没错。按照你们那宝贵的董事会所说，她的生命不重要。

en: &72 But her death? No. That had to be set in stone.
zh: &72 但她的死亡？不。那必须板上钉钉。

en: &73 They couldn't take the risk that Lisa surviving wouldn't affect MY life.
zh: &73 他们不能冒险让丽莎活下来影响我的人生。

en: &74 My life and all my precious ACCOMPLISHMENTS.
zh: &74 我的人生和我所有宝贵的成就。

en: &368 I'm sorry.
&369 I truly am.
&370 But the board considers these things very carefully.
zh: &370 但董事会非常仔细地考虑过这些事。

en: &371 Your accomplishments WERE important. Or will be.
zh: &371 你的成就确实重要。或者说，将会很重要。

en: &372 I understand your anger, but we have these rules for a reason.
zh: &372 我理解你的愤怒，但我们制定这些规则是有原因的。

en: &373 Your medical advances saved millions of lives.
zh: &373 你的医学进步拯救了数百万人的生命。

en: &374 That's a legacy worth preserving. It MUST be preserved.
zh: &374 那是一份值得保留的遗产。必须保留。

en: &75 And shouldn't *I* be the one who determines that?
zh: &75 难道不应该由*我*来决定吗？

en: &76 Why should MY legacy come at the price of HER life?
zh: &76 为什么我的遗产要以她的生命为代价？

en: &77 I... loved her, you know. We were only together for a handful of years, but...
zh: &77 我……爱过她，你知道的。我们在一起只有短短几年，但……

en: &78 My whole life. It was always her.
&79 I've never stayed clustered with anyone for very long. I was always too busy.
zh: &79 我从来没有和任何人长久地结为伴侣。我总是太忙。

en: &80 Too busy changing the world. Too busy making a fortune.
zh: &80 忙着改变世界。忙着赚大钱。

en: &81 But none of it. Not a single minute of it...
&82 None of it held a candle to being with her.
zh: &82 这一切都比不上和她在一起。

en: &83 Whatever happens now? Saving her. It was... worth it.
zh: &83 不管现在发生什么？救她。这一切……值得。

en: Adding the closeups.
&84 You don't need to shoot. I'll go back quietly.
zh: &84 你不必开枪。我会乖乖回去。

en: &85 Um. I said I'll go back quietly.
zh: &85 呃。我说了我会乖乖回去。

en: &375 I'm sorry, Joe.
&376 This is the way it has to be, Joe.
&377 I don't want to do this, Joe. But I have to.
zh: &377 我不想这么做，乔。但我不得不。

en: &378 You broke your PFE. I couldn't bring you back even if I wanted to.
zh: &378 你弄坏了你的PFE。就算我想，也没法带你回去了。

en: &87 Ah. I see. Well, yes. That makes sense.
zh: &87 啊。我明白了。好吧，是的。这说得通。

en: &88 I don't suppose you could just... leave me here?
zh: &88 我想你不能……就把我留在这里？

en: &89 I'll be dead in six months anyway. Can you at least give me that?
zh: &89 反正我六个月后就会死。你至少能给我这六个月吗？

en: &379 After everything you've done, do you really think that's an option?
zh: &379 在你做了这一切之后，你真的觉得那是个选项吗？

en: &90 No. I... No. I suppose it's not.
&91 Do it, then.
&92 Lisa is safe. That's all that matters.
zh: &92 丽莎安全了。这才是最重要的。

en: &93 She... IS safe, right?
&94 Could you check that for me, before you... do it?
zh: &94 你能在我……动手之前帮我确认一下吗？

en: &175 There's been no change, Fia. Just do what you need to do.
zh: &175 没有任何变化，菲娅。做你该做的事吧。

en: &380 Sure, Joe. She's safe.
&95 You answered awfully fast.
&381 Did I?
&96 Yes. Check for real. Please.
&382 She is safe. As I said.
&97 I know flippancy when I hear it.
&98 What really happened?
&383 We managed to delete that email in time.
zh: &383 我们及时删掉了那封邮件。

en: &384 We snuck into Professor Foster's office. We deleted it. It's gone.
zh: &384 我们溜进了福斯特教授的办公室。删掉了邮件。已经没了。

en: &100 That's... no. No you didn't!
&385 We've found no changes in the historical record.
zh: &385 我们在历史记录里没有发现任何变化。

en: &386 If history deems that she dies here, she will die here.
zh: &386 如果历史认定她死在这里，她就会死在这里。

en: &101 You MONSTER.
&102 I have to go back and try again.
&103 Get out of my way. Let me go back.
&104 Please!
&387 There's very little information about her in the historical record, remember?
zh: &387 历史记录里关于她的信息非常少，记得吗？

en: &388 We can't know for sure.
&105 But there IS a record of her dying in the explosion.
zh: &105 但确实有记录显示她死于爆炸。

en: &106 If she doesn't die, then her record would have changed.
zh: &106 如果她没死，那她的记录应该会改变。

en: &107 You call it a "ripple", right? Can't you check for a ripple?
zh: &107 你们管那叫“涟漪”，对吧？你们不能查一下有没有涟漪吗？

en: &176 There are no ripples, Fia. Please don't drag this out any longer than you have to.
zh: &176 没有涟漪，菲娅。请别再拖延了。

en: &101 You okay?
&389 I'm dandy, Nozzo.
&390 Just tickety-boo.
&177 You didn't tell him?
&391 What would've been the point?
&178 You think it was right to tell him?
&392 I didn't see the harm in it.
&179 You did what you had to do, Fia.
zh: &179 你做了你该做的事，菲娅。

en: &180 The brass is going to be happy, for whatever that's worth.
zh: &180 公司高层会很高兴的，不管这值不值得。

en: &393 At least somebody will be.
&394 Ready to come home.
&181 Right. Stand by.
&3019 I'm sorry, Joe.
&108 No. You don't call me Joe. Not anymore.
zh: &108 不。你别叫我乔。再也不要。

en: &109 If me being a doctor is so important, than you call me DOCTOR ANDERSON.
zh: &109 如果我是医生这件事这么重要，那你就叫我安德森博士。

en: &395 I really am sorry, Dr. Anderson.
zh: &395 我真的很抱歉，安德森博士。

en: &110 Spare me.
&111 Lisa is going to die. Again.
&112 This isn't right. This is evil. And you know it.
zh: &112 这是不对的。这是邪恶的。你心里清楚。

en: &113 If you really are "sorry," you'll let me try again.
zh: &113 如果你真的“抱歉”，就让我再试一次。

en: &457 Worrying about you is our literal job.
zh: &457 担心你正是我们的本职工作。

en: &114 Hah. All part of the service package, huh?
zh: &114 哈。都是服务套餐的一部分，是吧？

en: &115 Well worry not. I'm enjoying myself immensely.
zh: &115 那就别担心了。我正玩得开心呢。

en: &458 Sit tight. I'll get you out of there.
zh: &458 坐稳了。我会把你弄出来的。

en: &116 Take your time! I'm enjoying myself immensely.
zh: &116 慢慢来！我正玩得开心呢。

en: &459 You're... having a great time?
&117 Yes! I'm enjoying myself immensely.
&460 You're... enjoying yourself.
&118 We used to come here, you know. Some friends and I from class.
zh: &118 我们以前常来这里，你知道的。我和班上的一些朋友。

en: &119 We'd sneak in with some beers and... well, you can imagine.
zh: &119 我们会偷偷带些啤酒进来，然后……嗯，你可以想象。

en: &461 A bit of a rebel, were you?
&120 Rebel? Hah. We were just drinking beer below the legal age.
zh: &120 叛逆？哈。我们只是在法定年龄以下喝啤酒而已。

en: &121 But it WAS fun. And we DID feel pretty cool doing it.
zh: &121 但确实很有趣。而且我们当时觉得自己酷毙了。

en: &122 So... sure! Let's go with rebel.
zh: &122 所以……行吧！就说是叛逆吧。

en: &462 How did you and your friends get inside?
zh: &462 你和你的朋友们是怎么进去的？

en: &123 I don't know the combination to that lock, if that's what you're getting at.
zh: &123 我不知道那把锁的密码，如果你是想问这个的话。

en: &124 Back in the day, we all climbed over!
zh: &124 那时候，我们都是翻过去的！

en: &463 You climbed? How?
&125 We were YOUNG. And some of us did actual SPORTS. They helped the nerds like me.
zh: &125 我们年轻啊。而且有些人真的搞体育。他们帮了我这样的书呆子。

en: &126 Youth may be wasted on the young, but it does have its advantages. Sometimes.
zh: &126 青春也许被年轻人浪费了，但它确实有它的好处。有时候。

en: &200 *Sigh*
&464 Are you sure you're okay in there?
zh: &464 你确定你在里面没事吗？

en: &127 A bit hungry, but that's fine.
&128 It will only make my meal at the Silver Flare even better.
zh: &128 这只会让我在银焰餐厅的那顿饭更香。

en: &129 So you go do what you need to do.
&465 I'm going to leave you for a bit, Dr. Anderson.
zh: &465 我要离开你一会儿，安德森博士。

en: &466 I'll find a way to get that lock open.
zh: &466 我会想办法把锁打开的。

en: &130 Take your time. I'll just stay here, on Memory Lane.
zh: &130 慢慢来。我就待在这儿，在回忆巷里。

en: &131 God, they were such good friends, you know?
zh: &131 天哪，他们真是好朋友，你知道吗？

en: &132 I wish I could remember their names...
zh: &132 真希望我能记得他们的名字……

en: &1833 Dr. Anderson? You all right in there?
zh: &1833 安德森博士？你在里面还好吗？

en: &156 Hey! I'm doing great! Don't worry about me.
&1834 Dr. Anderson? You holding up all right?
&157 Stop WORRYING. I'm fine!
&1835 Okay. Just checking.
&448 If only all our clients were as easily satisfied as him.
zh: &448 要是所有客户都像他一样容易满足就好了。

en: &449 Our jobs would be so much easier.
zh: &449 我们的工作会轻松得多。

en: &594 Wait! Everybody STOP!
&73 Jeeze. What is it?
&595 He's going for a gun!
&39 This guy? He doesn't have the stones.
&13 Listen to her. I'm a total coward!
zh: &13 听她的。我完全是个胆小鬼！

en: &14 Nerves like jelly!
&596 Just break the glass open and take what you need!
zh: &596 直接砸开玻璃，拿你需要的东西！

en: &41 Don't you know nothing? The glass is attached to an alarm! You want the cops to show up?
zh: &41 你什么都不懂吗？玻璃连着警报器！你想把警察招来？

en: &597 I know what you're about to do.
zh: &597 我知道你接下来要做什么。

en: &15 Oh? And what would that be?
&598 *Sigh* Never mind.
&599 Well, it's now or never.
&600 Let's... rob this joint.
&42 Gimme my ring back first.
&601 Oh. Of course. Here.
&43 Okay! It's about darn time!
&44 It's about darn time!
&602 This isn't going to end the way you think it will.
zh: &602 这事不会像你想的那样结束。

en: &74 The power of love is stronger than bullets!
zh: &74 爱的力量比子弹更强大！

en: &603 You know that's not true.
&45 Yap yap yap. Let's get in there!
&604 The shop owner? He has a gun in his jacket pocket.
zh: &604 店主？他外套口袋里有一把枪。

en: &75 Danny? I bet he found it in a Crackerjack box.
zh: &75 丹尼？我打赌他是在爆米花盒子里找到的。

en: &605 It's real. And he will use it.
&46 You worry too much. Danny's a total pussycat. A pushover.
zh: &46 你担心太多了。丹尼完全是个软蛋。好欺负得很。

en: &47 Soon as we flash these heaters, he'll roll and do whatever we say.
zh: &47 等我们一亮家伙，他就会乖乖听话。

en: &606 He won't.
&76 Trust us will you?
&77 We know what we're doing.
zh: &77 我们知道自己在做什么。

en: &607 I'm fine. But you won't be.
&608 You need to stop what you're doing.
zh: &608 你必须停止你正在做的事。

en: &78 Whaddaya mean?
&49 Whaddaya mean?
&609 You are about to rob this shop. Aren't you?
zh: &609 你打算抢劫这家店。不是吗？

en: &50 Whaat makes you think that?
&79 Aw, what's the harm in her knowing? It was her idea.
zh: &79 啊，让她知道又有什么坏处？本来就是她的主意。

en: &610 MY idea?
&80 Yeah. Don't you remember?
&81 You said we need to think about our future.
zh: &81 你说过我们得想想我们的未来。

en: &51 And make sure this little one is provided for.
zh: &51 还要确保这个小家伙有人照顾。

en: &82 So that's what we're doing.
zh: &82 所以我们现在就在做这件事。

en: &52 Once we pull this job, we're set. Forever.
zh: &52 只要干完这一票，我们就有着落了。永远。

en: &611 This isn't what I meant at ALL!
&83 Seemed pretty clear to me.
zh: &83 我觉得已经说得很清楚了。

en: &53 Me too.
&612 This is all wrong.
&54 So wrong it's gotta be right?
&613 You IDIOTS.
&84 Who're you calling an idiot?
&55 Yeah. We're the ones who're gonna be rich.
zh: &55 是啊。我们才是要发财的人。

en: &614 I want to look around first.
&85 You wanna case the joint? Smart.
&56 Yeah. Danny knows the two of us. He'll catch wise.
zh: &56 是啊。丹尼认识我们俩。他会看出来的。

en: Danny
&615 I won't let you do this.
zh: &615 我不会让你们这么做的。

en: &86 And how're you gonna stop us?
zh: &86 那你打算怎么阻止我们？

en: &57 Yeah didn't think so.
&616 Have you ever robbed anything before? Shot anyone?
zh: &616 你以前抢过东西吗？开枪打过人吗？

en: &87 Not as SUCH, no...
&58 But you gotta start someplace.
&617 And this is the place you choose to do it?
&618 You are going to die in there.
&59 And my daddy always said *I* was overdramatic.
zh: &59 我老爸还总说*我*太夸张呢。

en: &619 What would your mother say if she knew about this, Arthur?
zh: &619 亚瑟，要是你妈妈知道这件事，她会怎么说？

en: &88 My ma? Well, she'd join us if she could.
zh: &88 我妈？嗯，要是她能来，她也会加入我们的。

en: &89 Maybe she'll paint a picture commemorating our daring escape.
zh: &89 也许她会画一幅画来纪念我们的大胆逃脱。

en: &60 Maybe we'll set her up in a proper gallery? One with fancy windows and stuff.
zh: &60 也许我们会给她开一家像样的画廊？有漂亮橱窗的那种。

en: &90 You know my ma. Even if we did, she'd just go back to that dingy shoebox on Thompson.
zh: &90 你了解我妈。就算我们开了，她也会回到汤普森街那个又小又破的鞋盒子里去。

en: &61 Yeah. Probably.
&620 What would your father say, Liz?
&62 Who cares what that old man thinks.
zh: &62 谁在乎那个老头子怎么想。

en: &621 And your mother?
&63 She doesn't think at all. She's DEAD.
zh: &63 她什么都不想。她已经死了。

en: &64 My momma did all the right things her whole life, and what did it get her?
zh: &64 我妈一辈子都做对了所有事，结果得到了什么？

en: &65 A husband who worked too much and then an early grave.
zh: &65 一个工作狂丈夫，然后早早进了坟墓。

en: &66 No. That ain't happening to me.
zh: &66 不。那种事不会发生在我身上。

en: &67 Me and Arty? We're gonna enjoy life. No matter what.
zh: &67 我和阿蒂？我们要享受生活。无论如何。

en: &68 And I'm gonna teach this one to do the same.
zh: &68 而且我要教这个孩子也这么做。

en: &69 Look. My daddy owned this joint. I know the whole layout of the place.
zh: &69 听着。我爸以前是这儿的老板。这地方的整个布局我都清楚。

en: &70 Alarms, locks, combinations, everything.
zh: &70 警报器、门锁、密码，所有一切。

en: &91 See? My girl's got it covered.
zh: &91 瞧见没？我的姑娘全都搞定了。

en: &92 It'll be so easy, you can tag along. See how it's done.
zh: &92 会很容易的，你可以跟着来。看看是怎么做的。

en: &622 Tag along?
&71 Sure, why not? The more the merrier.
zh: &71 当然，为什么不呢？人越多越热闹。

en: &93 Whaddaya say? You want in?
zh: &93 你觉得怎么样？想加入吗？

en: &623 You are... determined, aren't you?
zh: &623 你还真是……铁了心啊，对吧？

en: &72 Like you said, it's our future.
zh: &72 就像你说的，这是我们的未来。

en: &624 You won't reconsider? At all?
zh: &624 你不会再考虑一下？一点都不？

en: &94 Why should we? You see an opportunity, you grab it.
zh: &94 我们为什么要考虑？看到机会，就要抓住。

en: &73 These weapons fell into our lap. Then we met you.
zh: &73 这些武器自己送上门来。然后我们遇到了你。

en: &95 It's like fate is telling us we need to do this.
zh: &95 就像是命运在告诉我们，我们必须这么做。

en: &625 Fate. Right.
&626 Fine. I'm in.
&627 They aren't going to listen to reason, Nozzo.
&628 The least I can do is make sure they survive.
zh: &628 我至少能确保他们活下来。

en: &96 For real?
&629 Yes. For real.
&630 What could possibly go wrong?
&74 I'm liking this broad more and more.
zh: &74 我越来越喜欢这娘们儿了。

en: &97 Me too. Just give word when you're ready.
zh: &97 我也是。你准备好了就说一声。

en: &75 Hot dog! We're really doing this.
&631 Let's... take a moment. Consider our plan.
zh: &631 我们……先缓一缓。考虑一下计划。

en: &98 Sure. Fine. But hurry up.
&76 Yeah. I wanna get in there.
&651 Anyway, you were saying?
&609 Oh. Right.
&610 What was it you were saying?
&652 Huh? Oh yeah.
&632 We need to stop this. We're getting nowhere.
zh: &632 我们得停下。这样毫无进展。

en: &99 Stop what? We haven't STARTED yet.
zh: &99 停下什么？我们还没开始呢。

en: &77 We're only nowhere because we aren't IN THERE.
zh: &77 我们毫无进展是因为我们还没进去。

en: &78 So can we get goin?
&633 This is insane! You keep rushing in. You don't THINK!
zh: &633 这太疯狂了！你总是冲进去。你根本不动脑子！

en: &79 We thought plenty. We know what we're doing.
zh: &79 我们想得够多了。我们知道自己在做什么。

en: &100 We're the masterminds here. You're just the Janey-Come-Lately.
zh: &100 我们才是主谋。你只是个后来者。

en: &101 So have a little trust, huh?
zh: &101 所以给我们一点信任，好吗？

en: &634 I need a piece of jewelry.
&102 You need a what?
&635 Anything will do. Do either of you have one?
&80 I mean, there's my wedding ring...
&103 Don't you dare.
&81 What do you need it for, anyway?
&636 Just trust me. I will give it back. I promise.
zh: &636 相信我。我会还的。我保证。

en: &82 Well... what do you think, Arty?
&104 I don't like it. What if she loses it?
zh: &104 我不喜欢。万一她弄丢了怎么办？

en: &83 We'll just grab a bigger one when we're inside.
zh: &83 等我们进去后拿个更大的就行了。

en: &105 Huh. Put like that, why not?
zh: &105 哈。这么说的话，为什么不呢？

en: &84 Here you go.
&637 Thanks.
&664 I think Danny should open the safe. Keep him in front of you. That's Robbery 101.
zh: &664 我觉得丹尼应该开保险箱。让他站在你前面。这是抢劫入门第一课。

en: &85 Fine. I suppose that makes sense.
&86 Get back over here first.
&87 Move it, Danno!
&106 And watch the painting! My ma painted that.
zh: &106 小心那幅画！那是我妈画的。

en: &46 Don't move!
&88 Oh you CRUMB.
&665 How many bloody guns do you OWN?
zh: &665 你到底有多少把该死的枪？

en: &47 Just enough.
A heavy-duty combination safe. The dial is currently set to 23
zh: 一个重型密码保险箱。刻度盘当前设置为 23

en: &666 Very well. Liz, you open the safe.
zh: &666 很好。莉兹，你来开保险箱。

en: &89 Darn tootin'.
&90 Get back over here.
&667 I agree. Liz should open the safe.
zh: &667 我同意。应该让莉兹开保险箱。

en: &92 The first number is...
A heavy-duty combination safe. The dial is currently set to 09
zh: 一个重型密码保险箱。刻度盘当前设置为 09

en: &93 And the second number is...
&95 The second is...
&612 Oh applesauce.
&668 I'll give it one more go.
&97 Jeeze hurry it up.
&98 My arm's getting tired.
&669 You know what? I'll open the bloody safe.
zh: &669 你知道吗？我来打开这该死的保险箱。

en: &99 For real?
&671 You can use my surname. Quinn.
&100 Quinn?
&108 Doesn't really roll off the tongue, does it?
&101 I knew a tailor named "Quentin" once. That's kinda close.
zh: &101 我以前认识一个裁缝叫“昆廷”。差不多。

en: &109 Quentin. Hm.
&672 You can use my name. Fia.
zh: &672 你可以用我的名字。菲娅。

en: &102 Er. That's not exactly a LAST name, is it?
&110 And using your name isn't exactly gonna lower the heat on us any.
zh: &110 用你的名字也不会让我们少受点关注。

en: &103 How about... Finley? Had an English teacher named Finley. I liked her.
zh: &103 那……芬利怎么样？我有个英语老师叫芬利。我喜欢她。

en: &111 Finley. Hm.
&673 What do you think of... Nozzo?
&104 Nozzah? What kinda name is that?
&112 Sounds like something you screw into a sink.
zh: &112 听起来像是拧在水槽里的东西。

en: &235 Hey I didn't CHOOSE that nickname, thank you.
zh: &235 嘿，这外号又不是我自己选的，谢谢。

en: &105 How about... Nash? That's close enough.
zh: &105 那……纳什怎么样？够接近了。

en: &113 Nash. Hm.
&114 I like it!
&106 Well, Mr. Quentin. Let's scram.
zh: &106 好了，昆廷先生。我们撤吧。

en: &115 After you, Mrs. Quentin.
&107 Well, Mr. Nash. Let's scram.
zh: &107 好了，纳什先生。我们撤吧。

en: &116 After you, Mrs. Nash.
&108 Well, Mr. Finley. Let's scram.
zh: &108 好了，芬利先生。我们撤吧。

en: &117 After you, Mrs. Finley.
&6032 You're welcome?
&674 So how's it look, Nozzo?
&236 You did it, Fia.
&237 The spike is gone. Everything seems to be back the way it was.
zh: &237 尖峰消失了。一切似乎都恢复原样了。

en: &238 The paradox reverted. Imani exists again. And the Pie Sycamore paintings.
zh: &238 悖论逆转了。伊曼妮又存在了。还有派·西卡莫尔的画。

en: &675 No changes at all?
&239 Nothing above marginal.
&676 And Imani?
&240 Her PFE cooled down as soon as the spike disappeared. She's sleeping.
zh: &240 她的PFE在尖峰消失后冷却下来了。她正在睡觉。

en: &241 *deep exhale*
&242 This was... a close one, Fia. I don't mind saying so.
zh: &242 这次真是……千钧一发，菲娅。我不介意这么说。

en: &677 I know. But we fixed it. As always.
zh: &677 我知道。但我们修好了。一如既往。

en: &243 The job's not completely finished yet.
&678 I know.
&837 I don't have time for this!
&53 Shoulda thought of that before you joined forces with those two hoods.
zh: &53 在你跟那两个混混联手之前就该想到这个。

en: &838 I'm not the one you want.
&54 I'll be the judge of that, you dumb dora.
zh: &54 这得由我来判断，蠢女人。

en: &839 Art and Liz went that way.
zh: &839 亚特和莉兹往那边走了。

en: &55 Well shucks. Maybe I'll just get in my car and chase after them.
zh: &55 哦，见鬼。也许我该上车去追他们。

en: &56 Oh wait. I can't.
&840 Oh bloody hell. Not again.
&57 You mean you've done this BEFORE?
zh: &57 你是说你以前干过这种事？

en: &841 Not exactly-
&842 Oh look. The bad penny.
&58 Make it a nickel, because it's the least of what you're getting.
zh: &58 那就当是五分钱吧，因为这是你最少会得到的。

en: &843 Look-
&844 Just shoot me again and get it over with.
zh: &844 再给我一枪，了结这事吧。

en: &59 You're off your nut, you know that?
&845 This is getting ridiculous.
&60 You think this is FUNNY?
&846 I mean... a little.
&3010 You don't wanna test me, sister.
&61 You don't wanna tes-
&62 What the hell?
&63 Oh you think you're funny?
&64 Give me one good reason not to pull this trigger. Just ONE.
zh: &64 给我一个不扣扳机的理由。就一个。

en: &847 Didn't you come the other way last time...?
zh: &847 你上次不是从另一边来的吗……？

en: &65 What are you talking about?
&66 Jesus. Nothing you do makes any sense at all.
zh: &66 天哪。你做的事没一件是合理的。

en: &67 You don't wanna test me, sister. Not tonight.
zh: &67 你最好别惹我，小妞。今晚不行。

en: &68 Give me one good reason not to pull this trigger. Just ONE.
zh: &68 给我一个不扣扳机的理由。就一个。

en: &848 Listen to reason. You can't shoot innocent civilians.
zh: &848 讲点道理。你不能射杀无辜平民。

en: &69 Innocent! You lure me away with that bogus phone call, and now I find you at the scene of the crime?
zh: &69 无辜！你用那通假电话把我引开，现在我又在犯罪现场逮到你？

en: &70 You're in this up to your ears. Shooting you is a public service.
zh: &70 你深陷其中。毙了你就是为民除害。

en: &849 You're a police officer. Surely you know this is wrong?
zh: &849 你是个警察。你肯定知道这是错的吧？

en: &71 I'm a police officer who was deceived and robbed. By YOU.
zh: &71 我是个被你欺骗、被你抢劫的警察。

en: &72 If you did it to me, you'll do it to others. Shooting you is a public service.
zh: &72 你能对我下手，也会对别人下手。毙了你就是为民除害。

en: &850 Don't do anything stupid.
&73 Stupid? I'm not the one who ROBBED A FEDERAL OFFICER.
zh: &73 傻事？抢劫联邦警官的又不是我。

en: &74 You did it once. You'll do it again. Shooting you is a public service.
zh: &74 你干过一次，还会再干。毙了你就是为民除害。

en: &851 This isn't like you, Officer Mitchell.
&75 You're a criminal who steals from cops. Shooting you is a public service.
zh: &75 你是个偷警察东西的罪犯。毙了你就是为民除害。

en: &76 And don't tell me what I'm like. You don't know me at all!
zh: &76 还有，别跟我说我是什么样的人。你根本不了解我！

en: &852 Let me guess. "You're doing a public service?"
zh: &852 让我猜猜。“你是在为民除害？”

en: &77 Now you're on the trolley.
&853 Killing is not a public service.
&78 It's not like I have a choice, do I?
&854 Why shoot me then? Why not just arrest me.
zh: &854 那为什么非要开枪？为什么不直接逮捕我。

en: &79 You think I have a choice?
&855 You'd kill me over this?
&856 I know your record is exemplary.
zh: &856 我知道你的履历无可挑剔。

en: &81 No. It WAS exemplary.
&82 That's all going kablooey, thanks to you.
&83 How can I face the chief again? How can I face my FAMILY again?
zh: &83 我还怎么面对局长？怎么面对我的家人？

en: &84 You have any idea what's gonna happen to me if this gets out? That I was fooled by a bim like you?
zh: &84 你知道这事要是传出去我会怎样吗？被一个你这样的骗子耍了？

en: &85 I'll be a laughingstock. My career will be dust.
zh: &85 我会成为笑柄。我的职业生涯就完了。

en: &86 Backup is on its way. If they take you in alive, they'll question you. Then everybody knows.
zh: &86 增援马上就到。要是他们活捉你，会审问你。然后所有人都会知道。

en: &87 But if I kill you in self defense? Nobody bats an eye. Nobody asks questions. Everyone moves on.
zh: &87 但如果我出于自卫杀了你？没人会眨眼。没人会多问。大家都当没事发生。

en: &88 Sorry, lady. It's nothing personal, but I gotta do what I gotta do.
zh: &88 抱歉，女士。不是针对你，但我必须这么做。

en: &857 Public service my arse.
&858 You're just worried about being humiliated by your peers.
&89 Hey. When you humiliate one of us, you humiliate ALL of us.
zh: &89 嘿。你羞辱我们中的任何一个，就是羞辱我们所有人。

en: &90 There's not a single cop who wouldn't do the same.
zh: &90 没有一个警察不会这么做。

en: &859 I'm afraid you may be right.
&860 Let me guess. "You don't have a choice?"
&91 No. I don't.
&861 Let me guess. "It's nothing personal?"
&92 It's not. I just gotta do what I gotta do.
zh: &92 不是。我只是必须这么做。

en: &93 Sorry.
&834 Wait!
&862 Hold on!
&863 I won't tell. I promise!
&865 Here we go again.
&866 Just make it quick this time.
&867 And now you pull the trigger.
&94 Gee. It's like you can see the future.
zh: &94 天哪。就像你能预见未来一样。

en: &868 Imagine that.
&869 What about your family!
&870 What you said about facing your family. Can you really face them after doing something like this?
zh: &870 你说面对家人。做了这种事，你真的还能面对他们吗？

en: &96 What the hell do you know about my family?
zh: &96 你他妈对我的家人了解什么？

en: &872 Your wife. Can you face your wife again after murdering someone?
zh: &872 你的妻子。杀了人之后，你还能面对你的妻子吗？

en: &97 You know nothing about my wife!
zh: &97 你根本不了解我的妻子！

en: &873 I know enough. And she probably wouldn't like what you're doing.
zh: &873 我了解得够多了。而且她很可能不会喜欢你正在做的事。

en: &98 What do you mean?
&874 Your children. Can you face them after doing something like this?
zh: &874 你的孩子。做了这种事，你还能面对他们吗？

en: &99 You leave my kids out of this! They're gonna be fine!
zh: &99 别把我的孩子扯进来！他们会没事的！

en: &100 I'm doing this for THEM.
&875 Murdering me is for their benefit?
&101 Yes. For their future!
&876 No. This will ruin their future.
zh: &876 不。这会毁掉他们的未来。

en: &102 What the hell does that mean?
&877 Yourself. Your family is important, but think about YOURSELF.
zh: &877 你自己。你的家人很重要，但想想你自己。

en: &103 That's the whole point!
&104 I'm doing this FOR myself.
zh: &104 我这么做是为了我自己。

en: &878 Are you? Are you really?
&879 Think about all you are giving up. All your dreams for the future will disappear.
zh: &879 想想你放弃的一切。你对未来的所有梦想都会消失。

en: &105 What the hell do you know about my dreams?
zh: &105 你他妈对我的梦想了解什么？

en: &880 All that charity work she does. Does it count for nothing?
zh: &880 她做的那些慈善工作。难道就一文不值吗？

en: &881 What does it all mean, if her husband is a murderer?
zh: &881 如果她的丈夫是个杀人犯，这一切又有什么意义？

en: &106 Charity work? What in blazes are you talking about?
zh: &106 慈善工作？你到底在说什么？

en: &9 Blast it.
&882 Her... job at the library. If it gets out that her husband is a murderer, she'll lose it.
zh: &882 她……在图书馆的工作。如果她丈夫是杀人犯的事传出去，她会丢掉工作的。

en: &107 Job at the library? You don't know what you're talking about.
zh: &107 图书馆的工作？你根本不知道自己在说什么。

en: &883 Who'll read her novels, eh? With a murderer for a husband?
zh: &883 谁还会读她的小说，嗯？有个杀人犯丈夫？

en: &108 Her novels? She hasn't written a thing yet!
zh: &108 她的小说？她还什么都没写呢！

en: &109 She wants to write. When she has the time. Maybe when the kids are grown.
zh: &109 她想写。等有时间的时候。也许等孩子们长大了。

en: &110 Just a dream of hers, really.
zh: &110 其实只是她的一个梦想。

en: &885 It could happen. One day.
&886 But if you kill me? And she finds out? It might not.
zh: &886 但如果你杀了我？而她发现了？那可能就不会了。

en: &111 You... you can't know that!
&887 She'll leave you if she finds out.
zh: &887 她要是发现了，会离开你的。

en: &112 Well, I guess I'll have to make sure that doesn't happen.
zh: &112 好吧，我想我得确保那不会发生。

en: &888 They dream of becoming officers, like you. Don't they?
zh: &888 他们梦想成为像你一样的警官。不是吗？

en: &113 That's... well, yeah. What's wrong with that?
zh: &113 那……嗯，是的。那有什么不对？

en: &889 Don't you want to teach them to be the best officers they can be.
zh: &889 你难道不想教他们成为最优秀的警官吗。

en: &114 Of course I do!
&890 And is murdering me, just to avoid embarrassment, the best way to do that?
zh: &890 而为了免于难堪就谋杀我，是做到那点的最好办法吗？

en: &115 I... I don't know. But neither do you!
zh: &115 我……我不知道。但你也不知道！

en: &891 They will hate you forever, if you do this.
zh: &891 如果你这么做，他们会永远恨你。

en: &892 No child can love a father who commits murder.
zh: &892 没有孩子会爱一个杀人的父亲。

en: &116 You may be right.
&117 So I'll have to make sure they never find out.
zh: &117 所以我得确保他们永远不会发现。

en: &893 Doing this will make you miserable. And it will make them miserable too.
zh: &893 这么做会让你痛苦。也会让他们痛苦。

en: &894 Is that what you want for them?
zh: &894 那是你希望他们得到的吗？

en: &118 No. But the alternative is worse.
&895 Children become their parents. It happens time and again.
zh: &895 孩子会变成父母那样。这种事一再发生。

en: &896 You want your children to become murderers too?
zh: &896 你也想让你的孩子变成杀人犯吗？

en: &119 That's a big what-if, lady.
zh: &119 女士，那可是个大大的假设。

en: &120 Not saying that couldn't happen, but it can only happen if they find out.
zh: &120 不是说那不可能发生，但只有他们发现了才会发生。

en: &121 So I'm gonna make sure that doesn't happen.
zh: &121 所以我要确保那不会发生。

en: &897 You want to stay an officer, right?
&122 What? Stay like THIS? Hell no.
zh: &122 什么？像这样继续？见鬼，不。

en: &123 You're talking bushwa, lady.
&124 You don't know a damn thing about me!
&898 You want to retire early? Put in your twenty years?
zh: &898 你想提前退休？干满二十年？

en: &125 Pull the pin? You kidding?
&126 I may not want to stay on the beat my whole life, but I love this gig.
zh: &126 我可能不想一辈子巡逻，但我热爱这份工作。

en: &127 Retiring's a mug's game.
&128 And speaking of mugs, sorry to ruin yours.
zh: &128 说到傻瓜，抱歉毁了你的脸。

en: &899 You want to travel? See the world?
&129 Leave the city? Hell no.
&900 You want to teach one day, is that correct?
&130 Well, yeah. One day. Passing on my experience to young cadets.
zh: &130 嗯，是的。有一天。把我的经验传授给年轻学员。

en: &131 I loved the academy when I was starting out. Want to pay it back.
zh: &131 我刚入行时很爱警校。想回报它。

en: &132 What's that to you?
&901 Do you really think you're in a position to teach young officers later, if you murder me now?

zh: &401 这些派·西卡莫尔的画。你喜欢吗？

&403 Any idea who this police officer is?
&404 Any idea who that police officer is?

zh: &189 嗯。你试过连接纽约警局的档案吗？

en: &190 Records from that when are sparse, but they may have something.

zh: &405 那对夫妇。他们看到了伊曼妮的跃迁！

zh: &406 如果系统检测到当地人看见，不是会自动关闭吗？

en: &194 But those two were so drunk that it probably didn't register.
zh: &194 但那两个人醉得太厉害，系统可能没识别出来。

en: &47 Can I speak to Imani?
&1314 Sure. Patching you through.
&601 You rang?
&407 Right Nozzo. I'm off.
&195 Standing by, Fia.
&416 Officer Mitchell?
&9 That's Officer Santina to you.

en: &417 Ah. Apologies. Officer Santina.
&10 And don't you forget it.
&11 Gotta have respect for the law. Society will crumble otherwise.
zh: &11 必须尊重法律。否则社会就会崩溃。

en: &6002 Understood, Officer Santina.
&418 I have a message from your... what's the word... wife?
zh: &418 我有一条来自你……那个词怎么说……妻子的消息？

en: &12 My wife?
&419 Yes. Your wife... Mary.
&206 MURIAL.
&420 ...al. Mary-al. Yes. She wants you to call her.
zh: &420 ……丽尔。玛丽尔。对。她想让你给她打电话。

en: &13 Is she okay?
&421 I am not sure. You should give her a call as soon as possible.
zh: &421 我不确定。你应该尽快给她打个电话。

en: &14 Yeah. I suppose I better.

en: &15 Thanks for passing that along, Miss...
&422 Quinn. Fia Quinn.
&16 Right. Thanks Ms. Quinn. I'll tell Murial hi for you.
zh: &16 好的。谢谢奎因女士。我会替你向穆丽尔问好。

en: &423 Er, about that...
It's a weak puzzle, I know...
zh: 这是个蹩脚的谜题，我知道……

en: &864 There you are.
&2804 I've done what you wanted.
zh: &2804 我已经按你的要求做了。

en: &600 Nice work, demon lady.
&650 Guess it's time to... collect what we came for.
zh: &650 看来是时候……去取我们要的东西了。

en: &2814 Yes. The officer is gone. I can't promise your father will be happy to see you, but...
zh: &2814 是的。那个警官走了。我不能保证你父亲见到你会高兴，但是……

en: &2824 What are you...!
&2825 That wasn't the blasting deal!
zh: &2825 这他妈可不是说好的交易！

en: &2826 Gahhh.
&17 Oh for the love of-
&18 YOU!
&19 No, President Harding. Yes, YOU.
&20 Start talking. Now.
&426 Do you know anything about this building you're guarding?
zh: &426 你了解你守卫的这栋楼吗？

en: &21 Guarding? I ain't guarding it.
&22 It's just a place on my rounds.
zh: &22 它只是我巡逻路线上的一个地方。

en: &427 If you are on your rounds, shouldn't you be... moving?
zh: &427 如果你在巡逻，难道不应该……走动吗？

en: &428 You know, aROUND?
&23 Lady, I've been doing my rounds for the last two hours.
zh: &23 女士，过去两个小时我一直在巡逻。

en: &24 If I wanna stop for a cup of joe to fuel up, that's what I'm gonna do.
zh: &24 如果我想停下来喝杯咖啡补充能量，那我就会这么做。

en: &429 Are you going to be here long?
&25 Dunno. Why d'ya ask?
&430 Oh... no reason. Just making conversation.
zh: &430 哦……没什么。只是随便聊聊。

en: &26 Well, it's a free country. Despite what that Ness guy says.
zh: &26 嗯，这是个自由的国家。不管那个尼斯家伙怎么说。

en: &431 You don't smell anything either?
&27 Depends, doesn't it? The streets always smell of something.
zh: &27 看情况，不是吗？街上总是有各种味道。

en: &2 This is not your usual city smell. It's like... *sniff*
zh: &2 这不是你平常的城市气味。就像……*嗅*

en: &3 Spoiled milk. Mixed with gasoline.
&4 Urg. It's vile.
&5 You're seriously telling me that neither of you can smell that?
zh: &5 你们俩真的都闻不到吗？

en: &432 I can't. Sorry.
&28 Yeah. You're smelling things that aren't there.
zh: &28 是啊。你在闻不存在的东西。

en: &433 Do you know "Pie Sycamore"?
&29 Is that a name?
&434 Not officially. He's an artist, if that helps.
zh: &434 不是正式名字。他是个艺术家，这么说有帮助吗？

en: &30 It doesn't. Sorry. Never heard of him.
zh: &30 没有。抱歉。从没听说过他。

en: &435 Drinking anything nice?
&31 It's just coffee. Not that it's any of your business.
zh: &31 只是咖啡。不过这不关你的事。

en: &32 I know the law.
&439 Are you familiar with Jackson Grant?
zh: &439 你熟悉杰克逊·格兰特吗？

en: &34 Should I be?
&440 You are in front of his home.
&35 Am I now.
&441 Yes. You are.
&36 Sorry. Was there a point you wanted to make?
zh: &36 抱歉。你是想表达什么吗？

en: &442 I suppose not.
&443 This... wasn't supposed to happen.
&37 No kidding.
&444 I had nothing to do with this. I swear.
zh: &444 我跟这事毫无关系。我发誓。

en: &38 Nothing to do with WHAT?
&39 Exactly.
&446 This isn't what it looks like.
&40 Oh yeah? What does it look like, exactly?
zh: &40 哦，是吗？那到底看起来像什么？

en: &41 Yeah. As I thought.
&42 You in cahoots with the Grant girl?
zh: &42 你跟格兰特家那丫头是一伙的？

en: &447 Look. I can explain.
&43 I'll bet.
&44 Inside. NOW.
&448 Thanks for your time. I'll be going.
zh: &448 多谢你的时间。我该走了。

en: &45 Sure.
&2 *deep heavy conversation of emotional angst*
&515 Can you tell us anything about the painting?
zh: &515 你能告诉我们关于那幅画的任何事吗？

en: &7 There's not much to tell. My daughter brought two of them home one day. She insisted I hang them up.
zh: &7 没什么可说的。有一天我女儿带了两幅回家。她坚持要我把它们挂起来。

en: &8 I can't say they do much for me, but my Elizabeth adored them.
zh: &8 我不能说它们对我有多大意义，但我的伊丽莎白很喜欢。

en: &6 So you hung the first one here, and the second one in your...
zh: &6 所以你把第一幅挂在这里，第二幅挂在你的……

en: &7 Yeech. Excuse me.
&8 In your shop?
&9 Yes. My former shop. You're well informed.
zh: &9 是的。我以前的店。你消息很灵通。

en: &10 And are you sure you're all right?
&516 Why is the second painting still in the shop?
zh: &516 为什么第二幅画还在店里？

en: &11 It's still there? I assumed the new owner got rid of it ages ago.
zh: &11 还在那里？我以为新店主早就把它处理掉了。

en: &10 He said he was waiting for your kid to pick it up.
zh: &10 他说他在等你孩子来取。

en: &12 Ah. Well. He may be waiting a long while.
zh: &12 啊。好吧。他可能要等很久了。

en: &13 Elizabeth is... well, she is Elizabeth.
zh: &13 伊丽莎白她……唉，她就是伊丽莎白。

en: &14 If you knew her, you'd understand.
zh: &14 你要是认识她，就明白了。

en: &517 Do you know where your daughter got the paintings?
zh: &517 你知道你女儿是从哪儿弄到那些画的吗？

en: &15 No. I'm afraid not.
&11 You didn't think to ask?
&2848 You never asked her?
&16 You don't know my daughter, do you?
&17 If you did, you'd know it's pointless to ask her anything.
zh: &17 你要是了解她，就会知道问她什么都没用。

en: &518 Do you know anything about the artist?
zh: &518 关于那个画家，你知道些什么吗？

en: &18 Pie Sycamore? It's an... unusual name, I'll give it that.
zh: &18 派·西卡莫尔？这名字……确实不寻常，我承认。

en: &19 I doubt it's his real name. Whoever it is.
zh: &19 我怀疑那不是他的真名。不管他是谁。

en: &519 Are you aware there is a police officer outside?
zh: &519 你知道外面有个警察吗？

en: &20 Yes. I am aware.
&520 Could you tell me why?
&21 Why do the police do anything?
zh: &21 警察做事哪有什么为什么？

en: &22 Officer Mitchell has nothing to do with me.
zh: &22 米切尔警官跟我没有任何关系。

en: &521 Can we speak to your daughter?
zh: &521 我们能和你女儿谈谈吗？

en: &23 If you can find her? Sure.
zh: &23 你们要是能找到她？当然可以。

en: &522 Didn't you say she lived here?
zh: &522 你不是说她住在这里吗？

en: &24 This is her official address, if that's what you mean.
zh: &24 这是她的正式住址，如果你指的是这个的话。

en: &25 But she rarely comes-
&12 URRRG.
&523 Imani?
&13 No. I'm sorry. I can't take this anymore.
zh: &13 不。抱歉。我实在受不了了。

en: &26 Excuse me?
&14 That SMELL. It's terrible!
&27 I don't smell anything.
&15 It's you, Mr. Grant. It's coming from you!
zh: &15 是你，格兰特先生。是你身上的味儿！

en: &16 You absolutely REEK.
&17 I... I'm sorry. I have to get out of here.
zh: &17 我……对不起。我得离开这儿。

en: &29 I... reek?
&30 What the devil was wrong with her?
&112 Fia? Fia!
&524 What is it, Noz? What's wrong with her?
&229 It's Precursor Syndrome.
&6003 Oh. Blast it.
&525 That means Jackson Grant is...
zh: &525 那意味着杰克逊·格兰特是……

en: &230 Yeah.
&231 Bring her back to the landing point. As soon as possible.
zh: &231 把她带回跃迁落点。尽快。

en: &6004 You don't know the policeman outside, but you do know his name?
zh: &6004 你不认识外面的警察，但你知道他的名字？

en: &31 I never said I didn't know him. Just that I don't know why he's there.
zh: &31 我从没说过不认识他。只是不知道他为什么在那里。

en: &6005 Can you tell me anything about him?
zh: &6005 你能告诉我关于他的事吗？

en: &32 No. Sorry.
&2982 I met your daughter.
&33 You did? Where abouts?
&2985 Er. The junkyard.
&34 Of course you did.
&6006 Thank you for your time, Mr. Grant.
zh: &6006 谢谢你的时间，格兰特先生。

en: &35 Yes yes. Have a good evening.
&527 Can I come in?
&528 Please may I come in?
&1 Get lost. Don't come back, please.
&5308 Hello?
&5309 Hm. I suppose I need some kind of password.
zh: &5309 嗯。我想我需要某种密码。

en: &529 Blue Maddy sent me.
&4 You sure?
&530 Blue. Maddy. Sent. Me.
&5 Yeah. Um. You may want to rethink saying that.
zh: &5 是啊。嗯。你也许该重新考虑说那句话。

en: &531 Can I enter or not?
&6 Sure. Sure. Just... well, don't say I didn't warn you.
zh: &6 当然。当然。只是……好吧，别说我没警告你。

en: &532 I'll be going, then?
&533 I'M rude? You're the one who keeps ditching me.
zh: &533 我粗鲁？你才是那个一直甩掉我的人。

en: &19 Hey, not everything is about you.
zh: &19 嘿，不是所有事都围着你转。

en: &20 This is our wedding night. It's gotta be perfect.
zh: &20 这是我们的新婚之夜。必须完美。

en: &21 Don't ruin it.
&534 Maybe you should turn down the lights?
&535 The lights. With the house lights off and the spotlight on, you can see Liz much better.
zh: &535 灯。把室内灯关掉，聚光灯打开，你就能更清楚地看到莉兹。

en: &23 Huh. You know, you're right.
&24 Hey! Bartie! Get that spotlight on, will ya?
zh: &24 嘿！巴蒂！把聚光灯打开，好吗？

en: &25 Make her sparkle.
&100 Um. Right away!
&536 Tell me what I want to know, and I'll leave.
zh: &536 告诉我我想知道的，我就走。

en: &26 Sure. Sure.
&27 I'll tell you all about my ma's paintings, soon as Lizzie's finished.
zh: &27 等莉兹一结束，我就告诉你关于我妈妈画作的一切。

en: &537 Did you say your mother created those paintings?
zh: &537 你是说你母亲创作了那些画？

en: &28 I also said we'll talk when my Lizzie's finished!
zh: &28 我还说了等我的莉兹唱完再谈！

en: &29 So shush your mouth.
&538 When will she be finished?
&30 Dunno. Can you put a deadline on perfection?
zh: &30 不知道。完美能设期限吗？

en: &31 Just listen to that voice!
&32 It's like being touched by heaven itself.
&33 No offense.
&539 What are you doing here?
&34 What does it look like? Listening to the voice of an angel.
zh: &34 看不出来吗？听天使唱歌。

en: &35 Can't you just bathe in it?
&540 Officer Santina is looking for you.
&36 Pff. That guy's a total pushover.
&541 Pushover? He nearly shot me!
zh: &541 好对付？他差点开枪打我！

en: &37 Shot you? With what?
&38 Liz and me took all the weapons from his car.
zh: &38 莉兹和我把他车里的武器全拿走了。

en: &6009 You... what?
&39 So nice of that flattie to give us a wedding present.
zh: &39 那个条子真好，送我们结婚礼物。

en: &542 You stole weapons. From a police car.
zh: &542 你们偷了武器。从警车里。

en: &40 Where do you think we got these fancy heaters from? Gimbels?
zh: &40 不然你以为这些漂亮家伙哪来的？金贝尔百货？

en: &41 Figured a demon like yourself would approve.
zh: &41 我猜你这种恶魔应该会赞成。

en: &543 *Sigh* Nevermind.
&544 Shot?
&102 Yeah. I don't know about you, but I want to survive the night.
zh: &102 是啊。我不知道你怎么样，但我想活过今晚。

en: &545 What is going on here?
&103 Trying to survive the night.
&546 Who are you?
&104 Just a guy trying to survive the night.
zh: &104 只是个努力活过今晚的人。

en: &105 That screwball on stage keeps shooting up the place!
zh: &105 台上那个疯子一直朝这儿开枪！

en: &106 She's lucky she didn't kill anyone.
&547 Where is everyone?
&107 You think people were gonna stick around after those two started shooting up the place?
zh: &107 你觉得那俩开始开枪后，大家还会留下来吗？

en: &8 I would've ran out with them, but they grabbed me before I could.
zh: &8 我本来也要跟他们一起跑，但还没跑就被他们抓住了。

en: &9 Said I needed to keep the gin and whiskey flowing.
zh: &9 说让我继续供应金酒和威士忌。

en: &10 So that's what I'm doing.
&548 Does she often perform here?
&11 She's a regular, sure. But she never got on stage before.
zh: &11 她确实是常客。但以前从没上过台。

en: &12 Tonight, she... well, let's just say she insisted.
zh: &12 今晚她……呃，这么说吧，她非要上台。

en: &549 How long has she been up there?
&13 They burst in about two hours ago.
zh: &13 他们大概两小时前闯进来的。

en: &14 Didn't even bother getting the stage lights up.
&550 And she's been singing ever since?
zh: &550 然后她就一直唱到现在？

en: &15 Yes. The same song. Over and over.
zh: &15 是的。同一首歌。一遍又一遍。

en: &551 Any way to get her to stop?
zh: &551 有什么办法让她停下来吗？

en: &16 No. She's up there until that mic gives out, or she does.
zh: &16 没有。她会一直在上面，直到麦克风坏掉，或者她倒下。

en: &552 Do you know the man she's with? Arthur?
zh: &552 你认识和她在一起的那个男人吗？亚瑟？

en: &17 Sure, I know him. He comes here a lot.
zh: &17 当然，我认识他。他常来这里。

en: &18 Never saw him like this. What the heck got into him?
zh: &18 从没见过他这样。他到底怎么了？

en: &553 He's becoming a father.
&19 Ah. Well, I guess that'll make any man go nuts for a bit.
zh: &19 啊。好吧，我想这会让任何男人发疯一阵子。

en: &554 Is there any way to call the police?
&20 You kidding? This place isn't exactly legal in the first place.
zh: &20 你在开玩笑吗？这地方本来就不太合法。

en: &21 I don't need that kinda trouble.
&555 What did you mean, she didn't want the stage lights up?
zh: &555 你说她不想让舞台灯亮起来，是什么意思？

en: &22 Normally I'd dim the house lights and turn on a spotlight, see?
zh: &22 通常我会调暗观众席的灯，打开聚光灯，明白吗？

en: &23 But she just rushed up there so fast.
&556 How do you control the lights?
&24 The controls are right here behind the bar.
zh: &24 控制开关就在吧台后面。

en: &25 But I don't dare touch them.
&26 I don't dare MOVE.
&557 Could you dim the house lights for me?
zh: &557 你能帮我把观众席的灯调暗吗？

en: &27 No offense or nothing, lady, but you're not in charge here.
zh: &27 无意冒犯，女士，但这里不是你说了算。

en: &28 Them folks with the guns? They're the ones calling the shots.
zh: &28 那些拿枪的人？他们才是发号施令的。

en: &558 Any chance of a drink?
&29 No. I just want to live.
&559 I'll leave you alone.
&30 THANK you. Just find a spot and stay still until this is all over.
zh: &30 谢谢。找个地方待着别动，直到这一切结束。

en: &560 I want what you promised me.
&19 Promise? Did we promise something?
zh: &19 答应？我们答应过什么吗？

en: &20 I don't remember you ever saying the word "promise," Arty.
zh: &20 我不记得你说过“答应”这个词，阿蒂。

en: &42 Neither did you. If you did, I'd remember.
zh: &42 你也没说过。如果你说过，我会记得的。

en: &43 How could I forget anything spoken by those beautiful lips of yours?
zh: &43 你那美丽的嘴唇说出的任何话，我怎么会忘记？

en: &21 Oh you. Stop.
&44 Never.
&561 You are both terrible, selfish people.
zh: &561 你们两个都是糟糕又自私的人。

en: &45 Who're you calling selfish, lady?
&22 Yeah. You don't see us ruining YOUR wedding night.
zh: &22 是啊。我们可没毁了你的新婚之夜。

en: &46 You don't like it, you can take a powder.
&562 No. I don't want an autograph.
&563 I want you to bloody listen to me.
&47 "Bloody?" What's this about being bloody?
zh: &47 “他妈的？”你这是要跟我们动手的意思？

en: &23 You lay a finger on us, YOU'LL be the one who's bloody.
zh: &23 你敢动我们一根手指，流血的就是你。

en: &564 So about your mother...
&48 You leave my ma alone.
&565 Anything at all will be helpful. Just her name, even.
zh: &565 任何信息都会有帮助。哪怕只是她的名字。

en: &24 Ugh. Who wants to think about their mother on their wedding night?
zh: &24 呃。谁会在新婚之夜想自己的老妈？

en: &49 I only have room for one woman in my thoughts tonight, and you're it.
zh: &49 今晚我心里只装得下一个女人，那就是你。

en: &566 You need to listen to me or... or I'll damn you!
zh: &566 你得听我说，不然……不然我诅咒你！

en: &25 You'll what?
&567 You heard. Send you straight to the abyss.
zh: &567 你听见了。直接把你送进深渊。

en: &568 Demons do that. I can do that.
zh: &568 恶魔做得到。我也做得到。

en: &569 Because I'm a demon.
&26 Pff ahahahahaha!
&50 hahahahaha!
&570 What about the... incident you witnessed in the junkyard?
zh: &570 那你在废车场目击的那件事呢？

en: &51 Don't know. Don't care.
&52 The only thing I want to witness tonight is my bride's shining eyes.
zh: &52 今晚我唯一想见证的，是我新娘闪亮的眼睛。

en: &27 You're awful.
&53 You love it.
&571 What on earth is so funny?
&28 Listen to this bim!
&54 Lady, we were just messing around.
zh: &54 女士，我们刚才只是闹着玩。

en: &29 How dumb do you think we are?
&572 You... do not want me to answer that.
zh: &572 你……不会想让我回答这个问题的。

en: &573 You both need to both grow up.
&55 Grow up? We're married and having a KID.
zh: &55 成熟点？我们都结婚了，还要有孩子了。

en: &574 You are going to be PARENTS.
&56 Yeah. "Going to" being the operative word.
zh: &56 是啊。“就要”这个词才是关键。

en: &575 This is no way for people in your position to behave.
zh: &575 你们这种身份的人不该这样行事。

en: &57 You're the one going all red in the face.
zh: &57 脸涨得通红的人可是你。

en: &30 Oh I know her game.
&31 You think you're better than us, don't you?
zh: &31 你觉得自己比我们强，是不是？

en: &576 Of course not.
&577 It's just...
&578 Your future has so much potential. You don't even see it.
zh: &578 你们的未来有那么多可能。你们自己却看不到。

en: &579 To have what you have? What you are GOING to have?
zh: &579 拥有你们所拥有的？拥有你们即将拥有的？

en: &580 Most can only dream of that. Of having the life you will build together.
zh: &580 大多数人只能梦想这些。梦想你们将要共同建立的生活。

en: &58 You think I don't know how lucky I am?
zh: &58 你以为我不知道自己有多幸运吗？

en: &59 I count my lucky stars every day.
zh: &59 我每天都觉得自己福星高照。

en: &581 You don't understand.
&582 The future is... fragile. Things can change. Instantly.
zh: &582 未来是……脆弱的。事情可能瞬间改变。

en: &583 And you won't ever even know it.
zh: &583 而你甚至永远不会知道。

en: &60 Lady? You've been drinking too much bathtub gin.
zh: &60 女士？你喝了太多私酿金酒了。

en: &584 Arg! You are impossible.
&32 Hey, Arty?
&61 What?
&33 Maybe she... has a point?
&34 I think we COULD stand to make some, you know, actual plans?
zh: &34 我觉得我们确实可以制定一些，你知道，真正的计划？

en: &62 You mean, right now?
&35 Why not?
&63 Yeah. Yeah. Okay.
&64 I guess we do need to think a bit about tomorrow for once, rather than just today.
zh: &64 我想我们确实需要偶尔想想明天，而不只是今天。

en: &65 You wanna take a walk, Mrs. Camron?
zh: &65 想散个步吗，卡姆伦太太？

en: &66 It's a lovely night to talk about the future.
zh: &66 这是个谈论未来的美好夜晚。

en: &36 I would be delighted to, Mr. Camron.
&67 After you, Mrs. Camron.
&585 *Cough*
&586 Aren't we forgetting something?
&587 Don't leave just yet.
&37 Your momma's paintings, Arty.
&68 Oh. Those.
&69 My ma lives over on 43 Thompson.
&588 So your mother is really Pie Sycamore?
zh: &588 所以你妈妈真的是派·西卡莫尔？

en: &70 That's what she signs her pictures with.
zh: &70 那是她签在画上的名字。

en: &71 Don't ask me why. My ma's always done what she wants.
zh: &71 别问我为什么。我妈一向我行我素。

en: New Location:["Pie Sycamore"[43 Thompson Street
zh: 新地点：["派·西卡莫尔"[汤普森街43号

en: &31 Oh thank God. They're finally gone.
zh: &31 哦谢天谢地。他们终于走了。

en: &32 You get outta here too. I gotta get home.
zh: &32 你也快走吧。我得回家了。

en: &33 My wife is gonna kill me.
&589 Right. That's it.
&590 I've had just about enough from the both of you!
&591 You've been messing me about all night. I have a job to do and I'm FED UP.
zh: &591 你们整晚都在耍我。我还有工作要做，我受够了。

en: &72 Hey, steady now.
&38 Yeah. What's your beef?
&592 My beef? Here's my beef.
zh: &592 我的不满？这就是我的不满。

en: &593 *Sigh* Forget it.
&638 We're looking for a painting.
&16 A painting? No disrespect or nothing but you're tooting the wrong ringer.
zh: &16 一幅画？无意冒犯，但你找错地方了。

en: &17 No paintings for sale here, as you can see just by looking around.
zh: &17 这里没有画作出售，你四处看看就知道了。

en: &639 The painting we're looking for. We believe it hung on that wall behind you.
zh: &639 我们找的那幅画。我们相信它曾挂在你身后的那面墙上。

en: &640 It is called "View From Mount Tom" I believe?
zh: &640 我记得它叫《汤姆山远眺》？

en: &18 Never heard of it. Like I said, I'm not selling any paintings here.
zh: &18 从没听说过。我说了，我这儿不卖画。

en: &641 About the painting we are looking for...
zh: &641 关于我们在找的那幅画……

en: &19 For the last time, lady. We don't sell paintings here.
zh: &19 最后说一次，女士。我们这儿不卖画。

en: &642 Lovely shop you have.
&20 You think so? Funny coincidence. I think so too.
zh: &20 你这么觉得？真巧。我也这么觉得。

en: &21 Been a bit dicey since I bought the place, but I'll be hitting on all eight any day now.
zh: &21 自从我盘下这地方，日子一直有点紧，不过很快就能时来运转了。

en: &22 Speaking of, can I help you with anything?
zh: &22 说到这个，有什么能帮你的吗？

en: &643 Do you recognize the man in the picture?
zh: &643 你认识照片里的这个男人吗？

en: &23 No. Sorry.
&644 Do you see the painting in the picture?
zh: &644 你看到照片里的那幅画了吗？

en: &645 It's behind the window. On the wall. Your wall, to be precise.
zh: &645 就在窗户后面。墙上。准确地说，是你店里的墙上。

en: &24 Oh yeah. I guess that could be a painting. Kinda. If you squint.
zh: &24 哦，对。那可能算是一幅画吧。勉强算。眯着眼看的话。

en: &646 Do you recognize it?
&25 I dunno. Maybe it's the painting we've got in the back room?
zh: &25 不知道。也许是我们后屋的那幅画？

en: &647 You have a painting in the back room? Why didn't you say?
zh: &647 你们后屋有幅画？你怎么不早说？

en: &26 Like I said, we don't have any paintings for sale.
zh: &26 我说了，我们这儿没有画要卖。

en: &18 We don't want to buy it. We just want to look at it.
zh: &18 我们不是要买。我们只是想看看。

en: &27 Then you shoulda said.
&648 So may we LOOK at the painting? The one in the back room?
zh: &648 那我们可以看看那幅画吗？后屋的那幅？

en: &28 *Sigh*. Sorry. No can do.
&19 Oh you SOCKET. Why not?
&29 That's my OFFICE back there, lady. I can't let just anybody waltz through.
zh: &29 那后面是我的办公室，女士。我不能随便让人进去。

en: &30 Not unsupervised anyway.
&649 So about the painting in the back room...
&31 I already told you where I stand on that.
zh: &31 我已经说过我的立场了。

en: &650 Are you familiar with the name "Pie Sycamore"?
zh: &650 你听说过“派·西卡莫尔”这个名字吗？

en: &32 That's a name?
&651 Of a sort.
&33 Well I never heard it before. Sorry.
&652 I couldn't help but notice that microscope behind you.
zh: &652 我不禁注意到你身后的那台显微镜。

en: &34 Oh yeah?
&653 What's it for?
&35 Assessment, mainly. Some folks want to sell something, I use it to determine if it's genuine.
zh: &35 主要是鉴定。有些人想卖东西，我用它来判断是不是真品。

en: &654 So you buy jewelry as well as sell it?
zh: &654 所以你既卖珠宝，也收购珠宝？

en: &36 Sure. You got something? I'd be happy to take a look.
zh: &36 当然。你有东西要卖？我很乐意看看。

en: &655 So if I wanted to sell a piece of jewelry, you could assess its value for me?
zh: &655 所以如果我想卖一件珠宝，你可以帮我评估它的价值？

en: &37 Sure.
&656 Using that microscope.
&38 Common tool of the trade, lady.
zh: &38 干这行的常用工具，女士。

en: &657 Thank you. I'll keep that in mind.
&658 You are about to be robbed.
&39 What's that?
&659 Two armed robbers are outside. They are about to come in.
zh: &659 外面有两个持枪劫匪。他们马上就要进来了。

en: &40 Oh yeah? Well, I'm ready for 'em.
&660 No. You can't harm them. Please.
zh: &660 不。你不能伤害他们。求你了。

en: &41 You kidding? Anyone tries to rob ME, they're getting one right between the eyes.
zh: &41 你在开玩笑吗？谁想抢我，我就给他眉心一枪。

en: &42 Law of the jungle. Get them before they get you.
&43 And you can tell them that.
zh: &43 你可以把这话告诉他们。

en: &661 Soo. This place is secure? No weaknesses you're aware of?
zh: &661 那么。这地方安全吗？有没有你知道的薄弱点？

en: &44 Just why do you want to know?
&662 No reason at all.
&663 Thank you. We'll keep looking.
&3639 Well, I'd best be off.
&45 Just give a whistle if you need help with anything.
&679 You look nice.
&20 Honey, I look INCREDIBLE.
zh: &20 亲爱的，我看起来棒极了。

en: &21 You, on the other hand, need to change right now.
&680 It's better than the jump suit.
&22 Honey, a burlap sack would be better than the jump suit.
zh: &22 亲爱的，麻袋都比时空防护服强。

en: &23 Speaking of, can you do something about... that?
zh: &23 说到这个，你能不能处理一下……那个？

en: &681 Perfect. You fit right in.
zh: &681 完美。你完全融入这个时代了。

en: &24 With this face in this era? Honey, that's debatable.
zh: &24 在这个年代顶着这张脸？亲爱的，这可不好说。

en: &25 Now you change. You're giving me an eyesore.
zh: &25 现在你去换。你让我眼睛疼。

en: &26 I've shown you mine, after all.
&27 Now THAT'S what I'm talking about!
&682 Thank you.
&28 Look at us. Like kids playing dress up.
zh: &28 看看我们。就像玩换装游戏的小孩。

en: &29 Suppose we should focus, huh?
zh: &29 我想我们该集中注意力了，嗯？

en: &683 Did you handle the trip all right?
&684 Some new travellers can feel a bit... wonky upon arrival.
zh: &684 有些新旅客到达后会感觉有点……晕乎。

en: &30 Well don't worry. I feel as good as I look. Which is amazing.
zh: &30 别担心。我感觉和看起来一样好。好极了。

en: &31 Besides. I'm on the trail of Pie Sycamore! How could I feel anything but?
zh: &31 再说，我正在追踪派·西卡莫尔！我怎么可能感觉不好？

en: &685 You said you had a lead?
&32 Yes. Feast those green eyes on this.
zh: &32 是的。用你那双绿眼睛好好看看这个。

en: &686 You're absolutely sure the painting in the photo is the painting you mentioned?
zh: &686 你确定照片里的画就是你提到的那幅？

en: &33 "View from Mount Tom?" Absolutely.
&687 How can you tell for sure? It's quite... grainy and blurry.
zh: &687 你怎么能肯定？这照片挺……模糊的。

en: &34 I know my Pie Sycamores from my Ben Chandlers, honey.
zh: &34 亲爱的，我分得清派·西卡莫尔和本·钱德勒。

en: &35 I've studied them for too long to mistake them for anything else.
zh: &35 我研究它们太久了，不可能认错。

en: &688 I'm impressed you found this photo. How'd you manage it?
zh: &688 你居然能找到这张照片，真厉害。怎么找到的？

en: &36 A lot of time, a lot of patience, and the best image search algorithm a research grant can afford.
zh: &36 大量时间、大量耐心，以及研究经费能负担得起的最好的图像搜索算法。

en: &37 We had a lot of false positives, but that's technology isn't it?
zh: &37 我们有很多误报，但技术不就是这样吗？

en: &38 Computers don't know squat. There's just some things you need a human for.
zh: &38 电脑什么都不懂。有些事情就是需要人来做。

en: &689 What about the warehouse where you found the paintings?
zh: &689 你发现那些画的那个仓库呢？

en: &690 Did they have any clue to Pie Sycamore's identity?
zh: &690 他们有没有关于派·西卡莫尔身份的线索？

en: &39 Of course we checked, but their records don't go back far enough.
zh: &39 我们当然查过了，但他们的记录不够久远。

en: &691 It's a simple matter to travel back to when they were deposited there.
zh: &691 回到它们被存放在那里的年代，这是很简单的事。

en: &40 Great idea, but we have no idea when that actually was.
zh: &40 好主意，但我们不知道那到底是什么时候。

en: &41 And besides, the painting we're trying to authenticate wasn't found in that warehouse.
zh: &41 而且，我们要鉴定的那幅画并不是在那个仓库里找到的。

en: &42 So no. This is where we need to be.
zh: &42 所以不行。这里才是我们需要待的地方。

en: &692 I'm not fond of them either, to be honest.
zh: &692 说实话，我也不喜欢它们。

en: &693 Sometimes I feel like I'm cosplaying an unripe apple. Or a pear.
zh: &693 有时候我觉得自己在扮演一个没熟的苹果。或者梨。

en: &694 You get used to it.
&43 Oh I certainly HOPE not.
&695 I kind of like it, myself.
&696 Simple. Functional. Achieves what it needs to.
&44 Honey, so does plywood. Which, incidentally, is what I look like wearing it.
zh: &44 亲爱的，胶合板也一样。顺便说一句，我穿上它就像胶合板。

en: &244 Those suits absorb 99.8% of the radiation from the timestream.
zh: &244 那些防护服能吸收时间流中99.8%的辐射。

en: &245 Without them you'd arrive as a pile of ashes.
zh: &245 没有它们，你到达时会变成一堆灰烬。

en: &45 Either way...
&46 THERE we go.
&47 What do you think?
&697 We should keep going.
&48 Yes. We have a painter to find.
zh: &48 是的。我们有个画家要找。

en: &698 You think this man is Pie Sycamore?
zh: &698 你觉得这个人就是派·西卡莫尔？

en: &49 Not sure. Maybe. But that's not the clue.
zh: &49 不确定。也许吧。但这不是线索。

en: &699 What am I supposed to be noticing here?
&700 This looks like a jewelry shop.
zh: &700 这看起来像一家珠宝店。

en: &50 Most likely. But that's only part of the clue.
zh: &50 很可能。但这只是线索的一部分。

en: &51 Look at the wall behind the window.
&52 Recognize that painting? That's "View From Mount Tom", by Pie Sycamore.
zh: &52 认得那幅画吗？那是派·西卡莫尔的《汤姆山远眺》。

en: &701 And that's a clue?
&53 I'd say. He's a complete unknown in this era! So how did it get there?
zh: &53 要我说，他在这个时代完全默默无闻！那它怎么会出现在那里？

en: &54 Either Pie put it there himself, or he sold it to the person who did.
zh: &54 要么是派自己放在那里的，要么是他卖给了放画的人。

en: &702 It's not a lot to go on, but we've accomplished more with less.
zh: &702 线索不多，但我们用更少的线索也做成过事。

en: &55 My career lives and dies on foundation grants. I know how to do a lot with a little.
zh: &55 我的职业生涯就靠基金会拨款了。我知道怎么用很少的资源做很多事。

en: &56 So let's get moving, shall we?
&703 This location is ten blocks north of here.
zh: &703 这个位置在这里以北十个街区。

en: &704 Well. Let's go track down an artist, shall we?
zh: &704 好吧。我们去追踪一位艺术家，好吗？

en: &57 Took the words right out of my mouth.
New Location:[215 47th Street
&705 Please. It is a matter of some urgency.
&48 I don't see how that's my problem.
zh: &48 我看不出这跟我有什么关系。

en: &49 Like I already told you. That's not my problem.
zh: &49 我已经告诉过你了。那不关我的事。

en: &706 Fine. Accompany us, then.
zh: &706 好吧。那就跟我们走一趟。

en: &50 In case you haven't noticed, I'm running a BUSINESS here?
zh: &50 你没注意到吗，我这儿正做着生意呢？

en: &51 Like I already told you, I'm running a business here.
zh: &51 我已经告诉过你了，我这儿正做着生意呢。

en: &52 What if I'm back there and a customer comes in?
zh: &52 万一我去了后面，有顾客进来怎么办？

en: &53 No. I stay right here. Sorry.
zh: &53 不行。我就待在这儿。抱歉。

en: &707 Maybe one of us can watch the shop...?
zh: &707 也许我们可以留一个人看店……？

en: &54 I'm not going to dignify that suggestion with a response.
zh: &54 我不打算回应这个建议。

en: &55 That suggestion didn't deserve a response before, and it doesn't deserve one now.
zh: &55 那个建议之前不值得回应，现在也不值得。

en: &708 We'll only take a moment. I promise.
zh: &708 我们只需要一小会儿。我保证。

en: &56 I have no way of knowing that.
&57 Like I said, I have no way of knowing that.
zh: &57 我说过了，我没办法知道。

en: &709 Fine. Never mind.
&58 Good girl. Glad we understand each other.
zh: &58 好姑娘。很高兴我们达成共识。

en: &710 This is silly, Imani.
&58 Please humor me. I never get this opportunity.
zh: &58 请迁就我一下。我难得有这种机会。

en: &59 What are you feeling right NOW?
&2503 This again?
&59 What are you feeling right now?
&712 *Sigh* Fine. I feel...
&713 Kind of happy? I think?
&714 Kind of sad? I think?
&715 A bit angry, actually.
&716 Lonely.
&717 Confused, honestly.
&718 Scared.
&719 I don't feel much of anything.
&720 Is that all right?
&61 Doesn't matter. There's no wrong answer.
&62 This piece always brings out intense emotions in people. None alike.
zh: &62 这幅画总是能激起人们强烈的情绪。各不相同。

en: &63 Whatever this scene meant to Pie Sycamore, he had tremendous mixed feelings about it.
zh: &63 不管这个场景对派·西卡莫尔意味着什么，他对它有着极其复杂的感情。

en: &64 And they all came through on canvas. Clear as a bell. Every one.
zh: &64 而这些感情都透过画布传达了出来。清清楚楚。每一种。

en: &65 Thank you for sharing. I mean it.
zh: &65 谢谢你的分享。我是认真的。

en: &59 So. Er. You gals okay? This everything you wanted to see?
zh: &59 那么。呃。你们这些姑娘还好吗？这是你们想看的全部吗？

en: &66 Yes. Very much so. Thank you. Thank you... very very much.
zh: &66 是的。非常喜欢。谢谢。谢谢……非常非常感谢。

en: &60 Er. Yeah. It was nothing. You don't need to get all weepy on me.
zh: &60 呃。是啊。没什么。你不用对我哭哭啼啼的。

en: &61 Please don't get all weepy on me.
&721 Do you know about this painting? Anything at all?
zh: &721 你知道这幅画吗？任何信息都行？

en: &62 Nope.
&722 How did this painting end up back here?
zh: &722 这幅画怎么又回到这里了？

en: &63 No idea.
&723 Where did the painting come from?
&64 It was always here.
&65 Like I said, it was up there when I bought the place.
zh: &65 我说过了，我买下这地方的时候它就在那儿。

en: &67 But it used to be proudly displayed out front. Why shove it back here?
zh: &67 但它以前可是骄傲地摆在前面。为什么把它塞到后面来？

en: &66 Dunno. Wasn't me who did it, but if you want my opinion...
zh: &66 不知道。不是我干的，不过你要问我的看法……

en: &68 Yes?
&67 Well, it's kind of hideous, isn't it?
&69 Hideous.
&68 Yeah. It's like a box of crayons melted. Or exploded.
zh: &68 是啊。就像一盒蜡笔融化了。或者爆炸了。

en: &70 Crayons.
&69 Could YOU shop with that eyesore on the wall? I know I couldn't.
zh: &69 墙上挂着那么个碍眼的东西，你还能在那儿买东西吗？我反正是不能。

en: &71 Eyesore.
&72 Is this guy important to the timeline? Can I punch him? Can I choke him on his own aquamarines?
zh: &72 这家伙对时间线重要吗？我能揍他吗？我能用他自己的海蓝宝石把他掐死吗？

en: &246 Um. Maybe Fia should do the talking.
