zh: &246 呃。也许应该让菲娅来说。

en: &724 Yes. Maybe Fia should.
zh: &724 是的。也许应该让菲娅来。

en: &725 If you hate the painting so much, why is it still here?
zh: &725 既然你这么讨厌这幅画，为什么它还在这里？

en: &70 The old owner said his kid wants it. But they haven't picked it up yet.
zh: &70 原来的店主说他的孩子想要。但他们还没来取。

en: &71 They'd better hurry up. I want to chuck it into the street.
zh: &71 他们最好快点。我想把它扔到街上去。

en: &73 Don't. You. Dare.
&72 Jeeze, lady. Don't get hysterical.
zh: &72 天哪，女士。别这么歇斯底里。

en: &73 I said I WANT to. Not that I'm gonna.
zh: &73 我说的是我想。又不是我要那么做。

en: &726 Who is the former owner of this place?
zh: &726 这地方原来的店主是谁？

en: &74 That'd be... oh whatshisname. Jackson Grant.
zh: &74 那是……哦，他叫什么来着。杰克逊·格兰特。

en: &727 Grant. As in "Granted Gems?"
zh: &727 格兰特。就是“格兰特珠宝”的那个格兰特？

en: &75 Yeah. A real wise head. Bet it took him a whole minute to think that one up.
zh: &75 是啊。真是个聪明人。我打赌他花了整整一分钟才想出那个名字。

en: &728 Do you know where we can find this Jackson Grant?
zh: &728 你知道我们在哪儿能找到这位杰克逊·格兰特吗？

en: &76 Yeah. We signed the paperwork at his place. He lives over on Sutton Place.
zh: &76 知道。我们在他家签的文件。他住在萨顿广场那边。

en: &77 Big brownstone on the corner of 57th. You can't miss it.
zh: &77 57街拐角处的大褐石房子。你不会错过的。

en: &729 I think that's everything we need.
zh: &729 我想我们需要的信息都有了。

en: &78 Okay then. Pleasure doing business.
&79 You ever want to spend money on something you can walk out with, you lemme know.
zh: &79 你要是想花钱买点能直接带走的东西，告诉我一声。

en: &730 It's Precursor Syndrome.
&731 You're not going to like it, Imani.
&74 Come on. Spill it.
&732 We're going to have to send you home. I'm sorry.
zh: &732 我们得送你回家了。抱歉。

en: &75 Home. Why?
&733 Because those were symptoms of Precursor Syndrome.
zh: &733 因为那些是前兆综合征的症状。

en: &76 Precursor what?
&734 We shouldn't discuss this here. Come. Let's take a walk.
zh: &734 我们不该在这里谈。来，我们走走。

en: &735 Jackson Grant is an ancestor of yours.
zh: &735 杰克逊·格兰特是你的祖先。

en: &77 It seems impossible, but I certainly... smelled the evidence.
zh: &77 似乎不可能，但我确实……闻到了证据。

en: &736 You didn't know that Jackson Grant was your ancestor?
zh: &736 你不知道杰克逊·格兰特是你的祖先？

en: &78 No. I had no idea.
&738 You're not the first in your family to own a Pie Sycamore?
zh: &738 你不是家里第一个拥有派·西卡莫尔的人？

en: &79 Heh. Runs in the family. Good to know.
zh: &79 呵。家族遗传。知道这个挺好。

en: &80 I just gotta process this.
&81 Jackson would be my... great grandfather?
zh: &81 杰克逊会是我的……曾祖父？

en: &737 Great-great grandfather, if my maths is correct.
zh: &737 高祖父，如果我没算错的话。

en: &82 All my living grandparents died before I was ten.
zh: &82 我所有在世的祖父母都在我十岁前去世了。

en: &83 So I barely know THEM, let alone the generations before that.
zh: &83 所以我连他们都不太了解，更别说之前的几代了。

en: &84 Jesus. I just told my great-great grandfather that he REEKED.
zh: &84 天哪。我刚跟我的高祖父说他臭烘烘的。

en: &85 Should I go apologize?
&739 No. I'm sorry.
&86 Why not? I'm feeling better.
zh: &86 为什么不？我感觉好多了。

en: &740 Our rules are very clear on this point.
zh: &740 我们的规定在这一点上非常明确。

en: &741 We... need to send you home now.
&87 What? Why?
&742 Do you really want to go through all that again?
zh: &742 你真的想再经历一遍那些吗？

en: &88 I don't mind feeling a little sick, now that I know I'm not REALLY sick.
zh: &88 我不介意有点不舒服，既然我知道自己不是真的病了。

en: &6007 You don't understand.
&743 Your ancestors are connected to our mission. That means you can't be here.
zh: &743 你的祖先和我们的任务有关。这意味着你不能留在这里。

en: &744 You DO like your life, don't you? Your life as it is?
zh: &744 你喜欢你的生活，对吧？你现在的生活？

en: &745 Interacting with your ancestors is the fastest way to destroy it irrevocably.
zh: &745 与你的祖先互动是彻底毁掉它的最快方式。

en: &89 I thought this bracelet thing protected me from all that. You call it a PFE, right?
zh: &89 我以为这个手环能保护我免受那些影响。你们叫它PFE，对吧？

en: &746 The PFE only protects your existence. Not everything connected to it.
zh: &746 PFE只保护你的存在。不是所有与之相关的东西。

en: &747 You won't change. But anything connected to your family? Your childhood? That all can.
zh: &747 你不会改变。但任何与你家人有关的东西？你的童年？那些都可能改变。

en: &90 And if I said that was okay? I'm willing to take the risk?
zh: &90 如果我说那没关系呢？我愿意承担风险？

en: &748 Pie Sycamore's artwork is connected to your family now. Do you want to risk that as well?
zh: &748 派·西卡莫尔的艺术品现在和你的家人有关了。你连那个也想冒险吗？

en: &91 Okay. I get it. I get it.
zh: &91 好吧。我明白了。我明白了。

en: &749 Don't worry. I'll continue the mission on your behalf.
zh: &749 别担心。我会替你继续任务。

en: &750 I'll find Pie Sycamore and authenticate that painting.
zh: &750 我会找到派·西卡莫尔并鉴定那幅画。

en: &92 I don't see why YOU are less likely to wreck up my timeline than I am.
zh: &92 我不明白为什么你比我更不可能毁掉我的时间线。

en: &751 This is my job, Imani. I am quite good at it.
zh: &751 这是我的工作，伊曼妮。我很擅长。

en: &752 But if you feel uncomfortable, we can abort right now and we'll reimburse you.
zh: &752 但如果你觉得不舒服，我们可以马上中止，费用会退还给你。

en: &93 No. We didn't come all this way just to stop now.
zh: &93 不。我们大老远来，不能现在停下。

en: &94 Tell Mr. Nozzarelli that I'm ready to go.
zh: &94 告诉诺扎雷利先生，我准备好了。

en: &95 You find Pie Sycamore, Agent Quinn. Please.
zh: &95 请你找到派·西卡莫尔，奎因特工。拜托了。

en: &96 I know it seems silly and trivial in the grand scheme of things, but...
zh: &96 我知道在大局面前这显得愚蠢又琐碎，但……

en: &753 That's not for me to say. It's important to you.
zh: &753 这不该由我来说。它对你很重要。

en: &97 The customer is always right, huh?
&754 If you like.
&98 Then before I go...
&99 Update these damn jumpsuits, will you?
zh: &99 把这该死的时空防护服改一改，行吗？

en: &100 Precursor Syndrome doesn't make me half as sick as this color does.
zh: &100 前兆综合征都没这颜色让我恶心。

en: Sending Imani away.
Woman's voice
Man
&109 Holy Toledo!
Kissing couple
&118 Well don't that beat all.
&110 You saw that, right?
&119 Yeah. That lady just got dragged down to blazes!
zh: &119 是啊。那位女士刚被拖下地狱了！

en: They're terrible, but could I make them worse?
zh: 他们很糟糕，但我能让情况更糟吗？

en: &757 You... saw that, did you?
&758 I don't know what you saw, but you are mistaken.
zh: &758 我不知道你看到了什么，但你弄错了。

en: &120 We both saw it. No point in denying it.
zh: &120 我们俩都看到了。否认也没用。

en: &121 Think she's a demon or something?
zh: &121 你觉得她是恶魔还是什么？

en: &111 What else could she be?
&112 You stay away from us!
&113 It's our wedding night. You can't send us to hell on our wedding night.
zh: &113 今晚是我们的新婚之夜。你不能在新婚之夜把我们送进地狱。

en: &122 Baby, it's heaven as long as we're together. You know that.
zh: &122 宝贝，只要我们在一起，哪里都是天堂。你知道的。

en: &114 Oh YOU.
&761 Excuse me...?
&762 If you could just...
&763 Right. Don't mind me or anything.
&764 So, I need to get past.
&765 You know. If it's not too much trouble?
zh: &765 你知道的。如果不麻烦的话？

en: &766 If I could just squeeze through...
&767 EXCUSE ME!
&123 Hey, demon broad. We're BUSY here.
zh: &123 嘿，恶魔婆娘。我们这儿忙着呢。

en: &115 Go torture damned souls or whatever. Leave us alone.
zh: &115 去折磨那些该死的灵魂还是干什么的。别烦我们。

en: &768 I am not a demon. As you can plainly see.
zh: &768 我不是恶魔。你明明看得出来。

en: &116 Course you'd say that. You're a demon.
zh: &116 你当然会这么说。你就是恶魔。

en: &124 Telling people you're not a demon is what I'd say too, if I were a demon.
zh: &124 如果我是恶魔，我也会跟人说我不是恶魔。

en: &769 You are both extremely drunk.
&125 Not yet, but we're working on it!
zh: &125 还没呢，不过我们正在努力！

en: &126 You gonna drop a dime on us? Tell the cops?
zh: &126 你要告发我们吗？告诉警察？

en: &117 Let the demon broad try. They'll throw HER in the jug. Not us.
zh: &117 让那个恶魔婆娘试试。他们会把她关进大牢，不是我们。

en: &127 Right. On account of her being a demon.
&770 What exactly did you see here?
zh: &770 你们到底在这里看到了什么？

en: &118 You banished some old lady to the underworld!
zh: &118 你把一个老太太放逐到了阴间！

en: &128 Maybe she deserved it.
&129 Did she deserve it?
&771 Why are you here, anyway?
zh: &771 话说回来，你们为什么在这里？

en: &772 Or do you make a habit of visiting junkyards?
zh: &772 还是说你们有逛垃圾场的习惯？

en: &131 Oh. That. We followed you.
zh: &131 哦。那个啊。我们跟踪了你。

en: &119 Yeah. Saw your running outta daddy's place.
zh: &119 对。看见你从我老爸家跑出来。

en: &120 Wondered what was up.
&773 You mean Jackson Grant is your father?
zh: &773 你是说杰克逊·格兰特是你父亲？

en: &121 Yeah.
&132 You making deals with him? Is that why you were there?
zh: &132 你跟他做交易了？所以你才去那里？

en: &122 Figures. He wants to control me so bad he makes a deal with the devil.
zh: &122 果然。他太想控制我了，居然跟魔鬼做交易。

en: &133 Don't worry. Not even the forces of hell can tear us apart.
zh: &133 别担心。就算是地狱的力量也拆不散我们。

en: &123 Pff. I'd like to see 'em try.
zh: &123 切。我倒想看看他们试试。

en: &774 So you are the one who brought home the Pie Sycamore paintings?
zh: &774 所以你就是把派·西卡莫尔的画带回家的人？

en: &124 Yeah? What of it? You want them?
&125 Well you can't have 'em!
&134 Come on, Liz. It's the DEVIL.
zh: &134 别这样，莉兹。她可是魔鬼。

en: &126 I don't care. You gave them to me.
zh: &126 我不管。你把它们送给我了。

en: &127 She takes them away over my dead body.
zh: &127 除非我死了，否则她休想拿走。

en: &775 I don't want to take them. I just want to know more about them.
zh: &775 我不想拿走。我只是想多了解它们。

en: &128 Well I just want you to scram. How about that?
&135 Now hang on. Hang on.
&136 If you're really a demon, maybe we can make a deal.
zh: &136 如果你真是恶魔，也许我们可以做个交易。

en: &137 You want information? We want something in return.
zh: &137 你想要情报？我们也要回报。

en: &776 Again. Not a demon. But let's hear what you have in mind.
zh: &776 再说一次，我不是恶魔。不过说说你们想要什么。

en: &138 That flatfoot in front of her house. Get rid of him. Then we can talk.
zh: &138 她家门口那个条子。把他弄走。然后我们再谈。

en: &129 Oooh yeah. Eighty-six the copper!
&777 You want me to kill a police officer?
&139 Jeeze, you really are a demon. NO!
&130 We can't kill a cop on our wedding night. That's bad luck!
zh: &130 我们不能在新婚之夜杀警察。那会倒霉的！

en: &140 Just... get him out of the way.
&778 Just why do you want me to do this?
zh: &778 你到底为什么想让我这么做？

en: &141 Cuz it's our wedding night! And we're skipping town!
zh: &141 因为这是我们的新婚之夜！而且我们要离开这座城市！

en: &131 I need to go home and pick up some stuff before we go.
zh: &131 我们走之前我得回家拿点东西。

en: &132 And we don't need any fuzz getting in our business.
zh: &132 我们可不想让条子掺和进来。

en: &779 What sort of business?
&133 Never you mind, demon broad.
&780 Tell me what I want to know, first.
&142 Get a load of her. She thinks we're a pair of saps.
zh: &142 瞧瞧她。她以为我们是两个傻瓜。

en: &134 Get the flattie out of the way. Then we'll talk.
zh: &134 把那个条子弄走。然后我们再谈。

en: &781 Fine. I'll do as you ask.
&143 All right! We have a deal!
&135 We'll head over. Keep watch from down the block.
zh: &135 我们过去。在街区那头盯着。

en: &144 Just remember, this is just for information. Not our souls or nothin'.
zh: &144 记住，这只是为了情报。不是我们的灵魂什么的。

en: &782 Yes. I am aware.
&145 Just checking.
&783 A demon. Really.
Woman
&784 I can explain everything.
&785 I have nothing to do with this. I swear.
zh: &785 我跟这事毫无关系。我发誓。

en: &786 This is all just a misunderstanding.
&46 Shut your trap!
&47 She's in league with the pair of them!
&48 Figured you'd want to talk to her before I drag her downtown.
zh: &48 我想在我把她拽去警局之前，你会想跟她谈谈。

en: &36 Ah. So you plan on arresting her?
&49 Darn tootin' I am.
&37 You have proof of her... involvement?
&50 Nothing direct, no.
&38 Then I would advise against it.
&39 Your stolen car is already going to make you a laughingstock. Why add more fuel to the fire?
zh: &39 你被偷的车已经够让你成为笑柄了。何必再火上浇油？

en: &51 Gah! Why'd I ever agree to this bunk!
zh: &51 啊！我当初怎么会同意这种破事！

en: &52 Good luck with your kid, Grant. You're gonna need it.
zh: &52 祝你的孩子好运，格兰特。你会需要的。

en: &787 Thank you, Mr. Grant. I don't know why you intervened, but thank you.
zh: &787 谢谢你，格兰特先生。我不知道你为什么要干预，但还是谢谢你。

en: &40 You don't need to thank me. You didn't do anything. Not really.
zh: &40 你不用谢我。你什么都没做。真的。

en: &41 But sadly... neither did I.
zh: &41 但遗憾的是……我也什么都没做。

en: &6012 Pardon?
&788 I am appreciative, don't get me wrong, but I can't help but wonder... why?
zh: &788 我很感激，别误会，但我忍不住想知道……为什么？

en: &42 Why? Why does anybody do anything?
zh: &42 为什么？人做任何事都有为什么吗？

en: &43 *Sigh* That's just it, isn't it?
&789 Are you all right, Mr. Grant?
&44 Honestly? I'm not sure.
&45 If I was sick, it would help explain it. Something. Anything.
zh: &45 如果我病了，那倒能解释这一切。随便什么理由都行。

en: &46 But that's just it.
&47 I didn't *do* anything. And that's the problem.
zh: &47 我什么都没做。而这就是问题所在。

en: &48 *Sigh*
&49 I DO blame myself, you know.
zh: &49 我确实怪自己，你知道的。

en: &50 You spend your whole life believing you've got the bull by the horns, and then one day...
zh: &50 你一辈子都以为自己掌控着局面，然后有一天……

en: &51 Pssh. All gone.
&52 You never really had anything in the first place.
zh: &52 你其实从一开始就什么都没有。

en: &790 I'm afraid I don't quite follow.
&53 That's all right. I stopped trying to make sense of it myself.
zh: &53 没关系。我自己也早就不去想了。

en: &791 Perhaps you should go easy on the wine.
&54 I'm in my own home. I'm not going anywhere.
zh: &54 我在自己家里。我哪儿也不去。

en: &55 I'm harming nobody except myself.
zh: &55 我除了自己，没伤害任何人。

en: &792 Maybe you should call it a night, Mr. Grant?
zh: &792 也许你该去休息了，格兰特先生？

en: &56 So I can wake up and face another day of... this?
zh: &56 然后醒来面对又一天……这样的日子？

en: &57 No. I am fine where I am.
&793 Could you tell me about your daughter. Her name's Elizabeth, right?
zh: &793 能跟我说说你女儿吗？她叫伊丽莎白，对吧？

en: &58 What's to tell? I don't really know her.
zh: &58 有什么好说的？我并不真正了解她。

en: &59 I knew a sweet little girl once, but that isn't who she is now.
zh: &59 我认识的那个可爱小姑娘早就不在了，现在的她不是那样。

en: &60 I've... lost her.
&61 No. No. That's not true.
&62 She's a grown woman now. Responsible for her own choices.
zh: &62 她现在是个成年女人了。要为自己的选择负责。

en: &63 That's what you do when your children grow up, isn't it? You let go? Let them be themselves?
zh: &63 孩子长大后不就是这样吗？放手，让他们做自己？

en: &64 So why can't I do that?
&794 What do you mean by "letting go?"
zh: &794 你说的“放手”是什么意思？

en: &65 You've met her, haven't you? It's obvious she's being led on a path to ruin.
zh: &65 你见过她，对吧？很明显她正被引上一条毁灭之路。

en: &66 No. Not led. She's racing along it. Eyes wide open.
zh: &66 不。不是被引。她自己在路上狂奔。眼睛睁得大大的。

en: &67 Her mother could've talked some sense into her, but Olivia passed away several years ago.
zh: &67 她母亲也许能劝醒她，但奥利维娅几年前去世了。

en: &68 And me? Well.
&69 She won't listen to me. I'm just a toothless old lion.
zh: &69 她不会听我的。我只是一头没牙的老狮子。

en: &70 It will end badly for her. I know it.
zh: &70 她不会有好下场的。我知道。

en: &71 How do I just... let that go? How does any father?
zh: &71 我怎么能……就这么放手？哪个父亲能做到？

en: &795 Can you tell me about this young man of Elizabeth's?
zh: &795 能跟我说说伊丽莎白那个年轻人吗？

en: &72 You mean Arthur? Curse his name.
zh: &72 你是说亚瑟？诅咒他的名字。

en: &73 Seducing my daughter. Turning her into... this.
zh: &73 引诱我女儿。把她变成……这样。

en: &74 No. No. That's not fair.
&75 She was like this long before she met him.
zh: &75 她认识他之前就已经这样了。

en: &76 But they bring out the worst in each other. That's for sure.
zh: &76 但他们俩在一起只会让彼此更糟。这是肯定的。

en: &796 About Arthur...
&77 I admit, I liked him at first. He can be charming when he wants to be.
zh: &77 我承认，一开始我喜欢他。他愿意的时候可以很有魅力。

en: &78 He reminded me of myself, you know.
zh: &78 他让我想起我自己，你知道的。

en: &79 I was a handsome man once. And charming. Much like him.
zh: &79 我曾经也是个英俊的男人。而且有魅力。很像他。

en: &80 And like him, it opened opportunities I would not have found otherwise.
zh: &80 和他一样，这为我打开了原本不会有的机会。

en: &81 But I knew I had to SEIZE those opportunities. Make something with them.
zh: &81 但我知道我必须抓住那些机会。用它们做点什么。

en: &82 That Arthur boy? He thinks the world just owes him.
zh: &82 那个亚瑟小子？他觉得世界都欠他的。

en: &83 You can get by on good looks and charm only for so long. His will run out, and then where will he be?
zh: &83 光靠好看和魅力只能撑一阵子。他的会耗尽，到那时他怎么办？

en: &84 Perhaps like me. A broken man with a broken heart, and only a glass of wine for company.
zh: &84 也许像我一样。一个心碎的人，只有一杯酒作伴。

en: &85 But what do I know?
&86 I really don't want to talk about him any more.
&87 I've told you all I know.
zh: &87 我把知道的都告诉你了。

en: &797 Why did you have a police officer stationed outside?
zh: &797 你为什么在外面安排了一名警察？

en: &88 A foolish notion.
&89 I knew Arthur was wanted for some petty crimes, so I paid the officer to stand outside while off duty.
zh: &89 我知道亚瑟因一些轻罪被通缉，所以我付钱让那名警察下班后站在外面。

en: &90 I hoped his presence would keep Arthur away.
zh: &90 我希望他的出现能让亚瑟远离。

en: &798 Did it work?
&91 Yes. It made Elizabeth move out. So Arthur never came by again.
zh: &91 有用。这让伊丽莎白搬了出去。所以亚瑟再也没来过。

en: &799 Your daughter said that the paintings were a gift from Arthur.
zh: &799 你女儿说那些画是亚瑟送的礼物。

en: &92 Yes. She said as much.
&93 It's why she refused to let me take them down.
zh: &93 所以她不肯让我把它们取下来。

en: &800 And yet you still haven't?
&94 She loved them. And they are nice enough.
zh: &94 她喜欢它们。而且它们确实不错。

en: &95 And one day she will want to collect them.
zh: &95 而且总有一天她会想把它们收走的。

en: &801 You still have no idea who "Pie Sycamore" may be?
zh: &801 你还是不知道“派·西卡莫尔”可能是谁吗？

en: &96 I have no idea, I'm afraid.
&802 I think your daughter will be fine.
zh: &802 我觉得你女儿会没事的。

en: &803 I really do think your daughter will be fine.
zh: &803 我真的觉得你女儿会没事的。

en: &97 You don't believe that. You CAN'T believe that.
&98 How can you be so certain?
&815 Are you familiar with the Contis Cafe?
zh: &815 你熟悉康蒂斯咖啡馆吗？

en: &99 Yes, I know it.
&100 Elizabeth met that Camron boy there. That's when everything went wrong.
zh: &100 伊丽莎白就是在那里遇见那个卡姆伦小子的。一切就是从那时开始变糟的。

en: &101 "Camron"? Did he say Camron?
&816 Yes. Is that significant?
&102 That's MY name, remember? Imani Camron.
zh: &102 那是我的姓，记得吗？伊曼妮·卡姆伦。

en: &103 So it's true. Arthur and Liz are my great grandparents.
zh: &103 所以是真的。亚瑟和莉兹是我的曾祖父母。

en: &552 So it's true.
&104 God. My DNA must be half whiskey and gin.
zh: &104 天哪。我的DNA一半是威士忌一半是金酒。

en: &817 Do you remember the password to enter the Contis Cafe?
zh: &817 你还记得进入康蒂斯咖啡馆的密码吗？

en: &101 Maybe. It's hard to think clearly.
zh: &101 也许吧。现在很难想清楚。

en: &818 Can't imagine why.
&102 Don't get smart. I've got a lot on my mind.
zh: &102 别耍小聪明。我脑子里事情很多。

en: &103 I don't like thinking of that place. I already explained why.
zh: &103 我不喜欢想那个地方。我已经解释过原因了。

en: &819 About the Contis Cafe password...
zh: &819 关于康蒂斯咖啡馆的密码……

en: &104 I told you. I can't think about that right now.
zh: &104 我告诉过你。我现在没法想那件事。

en: &105 I've got too much on my mind.
&106 Oh. Yes. I remember the password.
&107 Funny, the things you recall when a weight is lifted from your mind.
zh: &107 真有意思，当心里的石头放下后，你会想起一些事情。

en: &108 I believe the phrase was... "Blue Maddy sent me?" Yes. That was it.
zh: &108 我记得那句话是……“蓝玛蒂让我来的？”对。就是这句。

en: &820 Blue Maddy?
&109 "Blue Maddy sent me."
&110 Don't ask me what it means. I'm sure it has meaning to somebody.
zh: &110 别问我是什么意思。我相信对某些人来说它有意义。

en: &821 I'd better be off, Mr. Grant. Thank you again.
zh: &821 我得走了，格兰特先生。再次感谢您。

en: &111 No need for thanks. I enjoy the company.
zh: &111 不用谢。我喜欢有人作伴。

en: &822 Oh come ON.
&823 We had a deal!
&824 For the love of god. Please stop.
zh: &824 看在上帝的份上。请停下。

en: &825 The painting, remember?
&137 Oh, that thing.
&146 Nah. Who wants to talk about THAT, tonight of all nights?
zh: &146 不。今晚这种日子，谁想谈那个？

en: &138 We're celebratin'!
&826 Your wedding. I know.
&147 Not just that! Liz just spilled the beans.
zh: &147 不止这个！莉兹刚刚说漏嘴了。

en: &139 Well, I was waiting for just the right moment...
zh: &139 嗯，我一直在等合适的时机……

en: &148 I'm gonna be a dad!
&827 You're... what?
&140 Yep! Got a bun in the oven.
&828 Congratulations?
&829 You two. Are going. To be parents.
&830 Does your father know?
&149 He better not. She only just told ME.
zh: &149 他最好不知道。她刚刚才告诉我。

en: &143 Arty was SO surprised.
&150 Darn right I was. Made me crash the car.
zh: &150 我当然惊讶。害我把车撞了。

en: &144 What's one cop car? There's a million of 'em.
zh: &144 一辆警车算什么？警车多的是。

en: &145 But there's only one of you and you're mine!
zh: &145 可你只有一个，而且你是我的！

en: &151 To us!
&146 To the three of us!
&831 Maybe you should take it easy on the drink?
&96 Oh applesauce.
&147 I'm outta whiskey.
&148 How can I celebrate becoming a wife and mom without WHISKEY?
zh: &148 没有威士忌，我怎么庆祝自己成了妻子和妈妈？

en: &152 Don't worry. I know just the place where we can get more.
zh: &152 别担心。我知道有个地方能再弄到。

en: &149 Ohhh. You mean...
&153 Yeah. Let's ankle.
&833 Stop!
&835 Get back here!
&836 Your... demon commands you!
Liz
&902 I could check into a hotel and come back tomorrow. Maybe it will be done by then?
zh: &902 我可以先住酒店，明天再来。也许到那时就修好了？

en: &247 Seems like the best option.
&105 But... tomorrow will be the 19th.
&903 You could send me to another date. Say... a week from now?
zh: &903 你可以把我送到另一个日期。比如……一周后？

en: &248 We could, but we'd have to charge Ms. Camron for it.
zh: &248 可以，但那样的话我们得向卡姆伦女士收费。

en: &106 Out of the question. Getting the grant money for THIS trip was like pulling tiger's teeth.
zh: &106 绝对不行。为这趟行程弄到拨款简直像拔老虎牙一样难。

en: &107 Besides...
&904 Is there a way we can compare the two canvasses? This one here and the one you have?
zh: &904 有没有办法比较这两幅画？这里的这幅和你那幅？

en: &249 We can do that. Just take a small chip from the middle of the canvas.
zh: &249 可以。只要从画布中间取一小块样本就行。

en: &108 No. Don't you dare butcher that canvas. Don't BREATHE near it.
zh: &108 不行。你敢糟蹋那幅画试试。靠近它呼吸都不行。

en: &109 The date on the painting says the 18th of August.
zh: &109 画上的日期写的是8月18日。

en: &110 That means it is going to be created tonight.
zh: &110 也就是说它会在今晚被创作出来。

en: &905 People can get dates wrong.
&906 And things can change.
&111 Change? What do you mean, change?
&907 Ah. Er.
&909 Sorry. I... think I got off on the wrong floor?
zh: &909 抱歉。我……我好像走错楼层了？

en: &910 Sorry. I was just leaving. Yeah.
&6014 You wouldn't be Pie Sycamore, by any chance?
zh: &6014 你该不会是派·西卡莫尔吧？

en: &3 It's... you?
&4 Is it really you?
&6015 Sorry?
&5 It IS you. I can tell.
&6 Your clothes are different, but the eyes...
zh: &6 你的衣服不一样了，但眼睛……

en: &7 The face...
&8 Even the smell...
&9 It is exactly the same.
&911 You... know me?
&10 Of course.
&11 In so much as anyone COULD know someone like you.
zh: &11 就像任何人都能认识你这样的人一样。

en: &912 You must have confused me with someone else.
zh: &912 你一定是把我跟别人搞混了。

en: &12 Impossible.
&13 How could I mistake anyone else for someone like you?
zh: &13 我怎么可能把别人错认成你这样的人？

en: &913 A bit of personal space, please.
&14 Sorry. I should know better.
&15 One should never get too close to someone like you.
zh: &15 永远不该离你这样的人太近。

en: &914 ...someone like me?
&16 Yes!
&17 When you encounter an angel, it leaves you changed forever.
zh: &17 当你遇到一位天使，它会永远改变你。

en: &915 An angel.
&18 Yes.
&916 A what?
&19 You heard what I said. An angel.
zh: &19 你听到我说什么了。一位天使。

en: &917 You're speaking... metaphorically of course?
&20 No. Of course I'm not.
&21 My angel. My guardian angel.
zh: &21 我的天使。我的守护天使。

en: &22 I always wondered if you'd come back.
zh: &22 我一直在想你会不会回来。

en: &23 After that day, when you saved me.
zh: &23 从那天起，你救了我之后。

en: &24 I know it's been over fifty years, but...
zh: &24 我知道已经过去五十多年了，但……

en: &25 You really don't remember?
&918 Wait.
&919 Paula?
&6016 Paula Inman?
&6017 I couldn't just leave you there, Paula.
zh: &6017 我不能就把你留在那里，葆拉。

en: &933 Not while I was in a position to help.
&26 So it was a kindness?
&934 Does it need to be anything more than that?
&27 No. No I suppose it doesn't.
&922 Your brother needed you.
&6018 Your death... would've sent him on a very bad path.
zh: &6018 你的死……会让他走上一条非常糟糕的路。

en: &28 Simon...
&29 He died thirty years ago.
&30 He doesn't need me anymore.
&923 It's complicated, Paula. Too much to explain right now.
zh: &923 这很复杂，葆拉。现在没时间解释。

en: &31 I... am disappointed, but I understand.
&32 I don't need to know why you did it. I am just happy that it was done.
zh: &32 我不需要知道你为什么要这么做。我很高兴你做了。

en: &33 It's Paula Camron now, but yes!
zh: &33 现在叫葆拉·卡姆伦了，不过没错！

en: &34 I knew you'd remember.
&35 I... was too young to understand it, but I do now.
zh: &35 我……当时太年轻，不懂，但现在我明白了。

en: &36 I was supposed to die, wasn't I? Before you intervened?
zh: &36 我本来会死的，对吧？在你干预之前？

en: &37 Before you poured light from your hands and saved me?
zh: &37 在你从手中放出光芒救我之前？

en: &925 No. Nothing is written in stone like that.
&38 Maybe not to you, but I know it. I felt it. It was destiny.
zh: &38 也许对你来说不是，但我知道。我感觉到了。那就是命运。

en: &926 "Destiny" doesn't really exist.
&927 It was likely, but I don't know for sure.
zh: &927 那很可能发生，但我不能确定。

en: &39 You may not know, but I do. I felt it. It was destiny.
zh: &39 你可能不知道，但我知道。我感觉到了。那就是命运。

en: &928 There's no such thing as "destiny."
zh: &928 根本没有“命运”这种东西。

en: &929 It's more... complex than that, Paula.
&40 Not to me. You saved my life. Saved me from that fate.
zh: &40 对我来说不是。你救了我的命。把我从那种命运中救了出来。

en: &930 "Fate" doesn't really exist.
&931 Not like that.
&41 Then why did you save me?
&42 Why didn't you leave me under that tree?
zh: &42 你为什么没把我留在那棵树下？

en: &935 I... I can't answer that, Paula.
&936 I am nowhere near qualified to make such a judgement.
zh: &936 我远没有资格做这种判断。

en: &937 If you feel you used your time wisely, then you did.
zh: &937 如果你觉得自己善用了时间，那就是善用了。

en: &43 I... I don't know if I did.
&938 That only one who can answer that is you, Paula.
zh: &938 只有你能回答这个问题，葆拉。

en: &939 Yes, Paula.
&6019 You helped your brother. And your paintings will touch millions.
zh: &6019 你帮助了你的兄弟。你的画作将触动数百万人。

en: &44 Really.
&940 Your work will be seen the world over.
zh: &940 你的作品将被全世界看到。

en: &45 Funny. I believe you. And yet, I feel nothing.
zh: &45 有意思。我相信你。但我什么感觉都没有。

en: &46 I suppose it doesn't matter now.
&941 What do you mean?
&47 Isn't that why you're here?
zh: &47 这不就是你来的原因吗？

en: &48 My time is finally... up?
&49 I did try, you know.
&50 I tried to make use of the extra time you gave me.
zh: &50 我试着好好利用你给我的额外时间。

en: &51 Tried to make it all... worth it. Worthy of you.
zh: &51 试着让这一切……值得。配得上你。

en: &52 Did I?
&53 Did I... use the time well?
&942 You have the wrong idea of why I'm here.
zh: &942 你误会了我来这里的原因。

en: &943 I don't know. I don't think so.
zh: &943 我不知道。我不这么认为。

en: &944 That's... not up to me.
&54 Either way, I have very little holding me here.
zh: &54 不管怎样，这里已经没什么能留住我了。

en: &55 My brother and husband are long dead. My son is grown.
zh: &55 我的哥哥和丈夫早已去世。儿子也长大成人了。

en: &56 He just got married, you know.
&2218 I am... aware.
&57 My next piece was going to be a present for them. Do you think...
zh: &57 我的下一件作品本来是打算送给他们的。你觉得……

en: &945 What?
&58 Could I have a few more hours? To finish the painting.
zh: &58 我能不能再多待几个小时？把这幅画完成。

en: &59 Just one more. Before I go. Please.
zh: &59 就再多待一会儿。在我走之前。求你了。

en: &112 There are Sycamore paintings dated as late as the mid-1930s! This won't be her last. Not by a long shot.
zh: &112 有西卡莫尔的画作一直标注到20世纪30年代中期！这不会是她最后一幅。远远不是。

en: &946 Take all the time you need.
&60 I won't drag this out. I promise.
zh: &60 我不会拖太久的。我保证。

en: &947 You are not dying tonight.
&948 Of course, Paula.
&61 Thank you.
&62 You can... stay for awhile. If you want.
zh: &62 你可以……待一会儿。如果你愿意的话。

en: &63 I normally don't like being watched, but since it's you...
zh: &63 我通常不喜欢被人看着，不过既然是你……

en: &64 Well, I think I can handle it.
&949 So... how've you been?
&65 You mean after you saved my life?
zh: &65 你是说自从你救了我的命之后？

en: &950 We can start there, sure.
zh: &950 我们可以从那时说起，当然。

en: &66 I... lived. Lived to see my childhood home destroyed.
zh: &66 我……活了下来。活到亲眼看着童年的家被毁掉。

en: &67 Blown up and dug up and paved over with concrete.
zh: &67 被炸掉、挖开，然后铺上了混凝土。

en: &68 The lake. The forest. My precious sycamore trees...
zh: &68 那片湖。那片森林。我心爱的西卡莫尔树……

en: &69 All sacrificed for the city's precious street grid.
zh: &69 全都为这座城市宝贵的街道网格牺牲了。

en: &70 *Sigh*
&6021 I'm sorry.
&71 There is not a single wild forest left on this island now.
zh: &71 这座岛上现在连一片野生的森林都没有了。

en: &72 There's barely anybody alive who remembers them.
zh: &72 几乎没有人还记得它们了。

en: &73 So it's up to me, isn't it?
zh: &73 所以这责任就落在我身上了，不是吗？

en: &951 What do you mean, it's "up to you?"
zh: &951 你说“落在你身上”是什么意思？

en: &74 I'm the only one who remembers, let alone cares.
zh: &74 我是唯一还记得它们的人，更别说在乎了。

en: &75 My husband got bored of me talking about them.
zh: &75 我丈夫早就听腻了我谈论它们。

en: &76 And my son? Well. He loves the city as it is.
zh: &76 而我儿子呢？唉。他喜欢这座城市现在的样子。

en: &77 So that means it falls to me.
zh: &77 所以这就意味着责任落到了我身上。

en: &78 To recreate them. The forests of New York. The way they USED to be.
zh: &78 去重现它们。纽约的森林。它们曾经的样子。

en: &79 So others can remember them too.
zh: &79 这样其他人也能记住它们。

en: &952 Sounds difficult.
&80 It is, but I'm grateful.
&81 Grateful to be the one chosen to do this. Grateful every day.
zh: &81 感激被选中来做这件事。每天都感激。

en: &82 So... thank you.
&953 Er. You're welcome.
&954 Your paintings are lovely, Paula.
&83 That's nice, I suppose. I'm glad. For you.
zh: &83 那挺好，我想。我很高兴。为你高兴。

en: &84 But I didn't FEEL particularly lovely when I painted them.
zh: &84 但我画它们的时候，并不觉得自己特别美好。

en: &955 Why? What did you feel?
zh: &955 为什么？你当时什么感觉？

en: &85 I don't know, but that's just it. Isn't it?
zh: &85 我不知道，但正是这一点。不是吗？

en: &86 I do this to try and make sense out of it all.
zh: &86 我画画是为了试图理清这一切。

en: &87 What anyone else thinks is irrelevant to me.
&956 I met your son today.
&88 Oh? My son met an angel? On his wedding day?
zh: &88 哦？我儿子见到了一位天使？在他婚礼当天？

en: &89 A good omen, I hope.
&957 He called me a demon, actually.
&90 Hah. Angel or demon, I'll bet he found a way to make it benefit himself.
zh: &90 哈。天使也好，恶魔也罢，我打赌他总能想办法让自己受益。

en: &958 You are... not wrong.
&91 Oh good. Good for him.
&92 So proud of him.
&959 You approve of your son's... behavior?
&93 Why wouldn't I?
&94 I suppose I can see why an angel wouldn't approve, but I'm his mother.
zh: &94 我想我能理解天使为什么不认可，但我是他母亲。

en: &95 I see a man living life the way he wants to, with no compromises.
zh: &95 我看到的是一个按自己意愿生活、毫不妥协的男人。

en: &96 I can get behind that. Heck, look at me.
zh: &96 我支持。见鬼，看看我自己。

en: &97 Anyone who says we shouldn't live the way we want can go hang.
zh: &97 谁要说我们不能按自己的方式生活，就让他见鬼去吧。

en: &98 Sorry. Any MORTAL. You can say whatever you want, of course.
zh: &98 抱歉。任何凡人。你当然可以随便说。

en: &960 So you met Liz? Arthur's cluster-mate?
zh: &960 那你见过莉兹了？亚瑟的伴侣组成员？

en: &961 I mean wife?
&99 I have. She's the best thing that ever happened to him.
zh: &99 见过了。她是他这辈子遇到的最好的事。

en: &962 You... like her?
&100 What's not to like?
&101 Some rich kids? They choke on that silver spoon.
zh: &101 有些富家子弟？他们会含着金汤匙噎死。

en: &102 But Liz? She'd melt it down and make bullets out of it, if she could.
zh: &102 但莉兹？如果可以，她会把它熔了做成子弹。

en: &963 I think you may be right.
&964 Just so we're clear? I'm not an angel.
&103 You're not entirely normal though, are you?
zh: &103 但你也不完全正常，对吧？

en: &965 I am. Although our definitions of the word "normal" may... diverge.
zh: &965 我正常。尽管我们对“正常”这个词的定义可能……有分歧。

en: &104 So what does it matter?
&105 You've been an angel to me my entire life.
zh: &105 你一辈子都是我的天使。

en: &106 I'm not going to stop just because you tell me otherwise.
zh: &106 我不会因为你说不行就停下来。

en: &966 Nevertheless. It's a fact.
&107 I'm an artist. Who has time for facts?
zh: &107 我是个艺术家。谁有时间管事实？

en: &967 How's the painting coming along?
&108 A few hours, like I said.
&109 Please? Just a few.
&110 I told you. It's finished. See for yourself.
zh: &110 我告诉过你了。已经完成了。你自己看吧。

en: &968 So why the name "Pie Sycamore?"
zh: &968 那为什么叫“派·西卡莫尔”？

en: &111 Do you remember the trees near my childhood home?
zh: &111 你还记得我童年家附近的树吗？

en: &112 They were sycamore trees. Almost every single one.
zh: &112 那些是西卡莫尔树。几乎每一棵都是。

en: &969 You named yourself after the trees near your old house?
zh: &969 你用老房子附近的树给自己起名？

en: &113 It felt right.
&970 And "Pie?" Is that because it starts with a "P"? Like Paula?
zh: &970 那“派”？是因为它以“P”开头吗？像葆拉？

en: &114 Huh? No. I just like pie.
&115 Who doesn't like pie?
&971 Why bother with the false name at all?
&116 I... am not sure. I think I was ashamed.
zh: &116 我……不确定。我想我当时觉得羞愧。

en: &972 Ashamed? Why?
&117 Well, look around? Is this how a woman is supposed to spend her golden years?
zh: &117 嗯，看看周围？一个女人该这样度过她的黄金岁月吗？

en: &118 It felt foolish. And selfish. So I hid behind a name.
zh: &118 感觉又蠢又自私。所以我躲在一个名字后面。

en: &119 But the more time I spent here... the less I wanted to do anything else.
zh: &119 但我在这里待得越久……就越不想做别的事。

en: &120 Now I'm ashamed of being ashamed. Wish I'd done this thirty years earlier.
zh: &120 现在我为自己曾经羞愧而羞愧。真希望我三十年前就这么做了。

en: &121 Should I start using my real name, do you think?
zh: &121 你觉得我该开始用真名吗？

en: &973 No. Please keep it. It suits you.
zh: &973 不。请保留它。它很适合你。

en: &122 I agree.
&6022 How did your brother fare, Paula?
zh: &6022 你哥哥后来怎么样了，葆拉？

en: &123 Simon? He was always... sad. He never showed it, but it was there. Deep inside.
zh: &123 西蒙？他总是……悲伤。他从不表现出来，但它就在那里。内心深处。

en: &124 I think it ate away at him. The sadness. I think that's what got him, in the end.
zh: &124 我觉得悲伤在侵蚀他。我觉得最终就是悲伤害了他。

en: &125 The doctors said it was cholera. But I know. It was sadness.
zh: &125 医生说是霍乱。但我知道。是悲伤。

en: &126 It's important to let the sadness out, you know. Create something beautiful with it.
zh: &126 把悲伤释放出来很重要，你知道。用它创造美丽的东西。

en: &127 I wish Simon understood that.
zh: &127 我希望西蒙能明白这一点。

en: &6023 Can you tell me anything more about Simon's life?
zh: &6023 你能再告诉我一些西蒙的生平吗？

en: &128 Can we... not?
&129 Please?
&6024 Very well, Paula.
&974 I'll leave you alone now, Paula.
zh: &974 我现在不打扰你了，葆拉。

en: &130 Thank you.
&131 Just a few hours, I promise.
&3867 That's all for now, I suppose.
&132 You... do want to look at my painting, right?
zh: &132 你……确实想看看我的画，对吧？

en: &133 I would understand if you didn't.
zh: &133 如果你没有，我也会理解。

en: &975 Impressed or disappointed?
&113 I'm ELATED!
&114 I always knew that there was an explosion of feelings behind those brushstrokes.
zh: &114 我一直都知道那些笔触背后隐藏着情感的爆发。

en: &115 Trying to recreate your lost childhood?
zh: &115 试图重现你失去的童年？

en: &116 That's a well that can never be filled.
zh: &116 那是一口永远无法填满的井。

en: &117 But the TRYING. Making the attempt. It can result in such tremendous works of beauty.
zh: &117 但尝试。做出努力。它可以产生如此伟大的美。

en: &976 She's your great-great grandmother.
&118 That... hasn't quite sunk in yet.
&119 Paula Camron. She even shares my name.
zh: &119 葆拉·卡姆伦。她甚至和我同名。

en: &120 Do you think that explains why I was so drawn to her work?
zh: &120 你觉得这能解释为什么我如此被她的作品吸引吗？

en: &121 Is it possible, somehow, that I knew?
zh: &121 有没有可能，我其实知道？

en: &977 I saved her life when she was a little girl.
zh: &977 她小时候我救过她的命。

en: &122 And she immortalized you as a reward.
zh: &122 于是她把你画进画里作为报答。

en: &6026 Pardon?
&123 "Deliverer of Innocence?" The painting in Jackson's study?
zh: &123 “纯真救主”？杰克逊书房里的那幅画？

en: &124 An angelic figure reaching out to a child on the ground?
zh: &124 一个天使般的身影向地上的孩子伸出手？

en: &978 Oh my god.
&125 How's it feel to have sold for half a billion in a silent auction last year?
zh: &125 去年在无声拍卖会上以五亿成交，感觉如何？

en: &979 Yes, I meant it. Although not in the way you may think.
zh: &979 是的，我是那个意思。不过可能不是你想的那样。

en: &980 No. Although not in the way you may think.
zh: &980 不。不过可能不是你想的那样。

en: &981 I don't know if there is an all-governing force or not. But...
zh: &981 我不知道是否存在主宰一切的力量。但是……

en: &982 There's only one power that decides what may or may not happen in the past, and that's our board of directors.
zh: &982 只有一个力量能决定过去可能发生什么，那就是我们的董事会。

en: &126 Okay, fair enough.
&127 But you saved her life. I discovered her paintings. She's my ANCESTOR.
zh: &127 但你救了她的命。我发现了她的画。她是我的祖先。

en: &128 And here we are, together. Connected.
zh: &128 而现在我们在这里，在一起。彼此相连。

en: &129 Doesn't that imply some kind of, oh I dunno.
zh: &129 这难道不意味着某种，哦，我不知道。

en: &130 Some kind of...
&6027 What?
&6028 Imani?
&983 Some kind of what?
&984 Hello? Imani?
&985 Nozzo? Is Imani all right?
&250 No. She's convulsing!
&986 Convulsing? Is it Precursor Syndrome?
&251 Worse. She's paradoxing!
&252 Something in her past has changed. She doesn't exist anymore!
zh: &252 她过去有什么东西改变了。她已经不存在了！

en: &987 Is the PFE holding?
&253 Yes. It's holding.
&254 Fia, what did you do?
&988 What changed?
&255 No idea! This came out of nowhere!
zh: &255 不知道！这完全是突然发生的！

en: &989 I'll fix this. Tell her not to worry.
zh: &989 我会解决的。告诉她别担心。

en: &256 She's unconscious!
&990 Nothing! You're the one who is supposed to be monitoring this kind of thing!
zh: &990 什么都没有！你才是应该监控这种事情的人！

en: &257 I WAS.
&991 Nozzo. Calm down and help me!
&258 I'm calm. I'm totally calm.
&259 *deep breath*
&992 Focus, Nozzo. Did you call the medical team?
zh: &992 集中精神，诺佐。你叫医疗队了吗？

en: &260 Yes. They are with her now.
zh: &260 叫了。他们现在和她在一起。

en: &261 I don't see how this could've happened. The monitor showed a straight line. Solid as a rock. No ripples at all.
zh: &261 我不明白这怎么会发生。监控器显示一条直线。坚如磐石。一点波动都没有。

en: &262 Then they just... spiked.
&263 To cause this, someone would have to veer off their timeline's path so rashly, so impulsively, that the monitor wouldn't have time to catch it.
zh: &263 要造成这种情况，必须有人如此鲁莽、如此冲动地偏离自己的时间线路径，以至于监控器来不及捕捉。

en: &993 Rash and impulsive, huh?
&994 Could this hypothetical someone, or someones, also be heavily intoxicated?
zh: &994 这个假设中的某人，或者某些人，会不会还酩酊大醉？

en: &265 Oh. Blast it.
&266 Arthur and Elizabeth Camron. They're about to rob the Granted Gems jewelry shop.
zh: &266 亚瑟和伊丽莎白·卡姆伦。他们正要抢劫“格兰特珠宝”店。

en: &995 On my way.
&996 Of course they are.
&997 They... WHAT?
&267 They going to get shot during the robbery. Pronounced dead at the scene.
zh: &267 他们会在抢劫中被枪杀。当场宣布死亡。

en: &268 You have thirty... no, twenty-nine minutes!
zh: &268 你有三十……不，二十九分钟！

en: &269 Hurry!
&998 Nobody has ever done anything like this before. Not for me.
zh: &998 从来没有人做过这样的事。不是为了我。

en: &134 Never? Masters have been painting angels since the fourth century.
zh: &134 从来没有？大师们从四世纪起就一直在画天使。

en: &135 And in all that time you've never been put to canvas? Not once?
zh: &135 这么长时间里，你从未被画到画布上？一次都没有？

en: &136 So I'm your first. I am honored.
zh: &136 所以我是你的第一个。我很荣幸。

en: &1000 I thought you were going to paint someone else.
&137 Well, my intention was to paint my daughter-in-law. As a present.
zh: &137 嗯，我本来打算画我的儿媳。作为礼物。

en: &138 But then I had this feeling...
&139 They're gone, aren't they?
&1002 Arthur and Liz had to leave town. They send their love.
zh: &1002 亚瑟和莉兹不得不离开城里。他们向您问好。

en: &140 Got themselves in trouble, did they?
zh: &140 他们自己惹上麻烦了，是吗？

en: &1003 No. They avoided it.
&141 They always do. I assume you had something to do with that?
zh: &141 他们总是这样。我猜你与此有关？

en: &1004 Yes. But they are on their own from now on.
zh: &1004 是的。但从现在起他们得靠自己了。

en: &142 I have a feeling they'll be fine.
zh: &142 我有种感觉，他们会没事的。

en: &143 It feels good. Knowing that.
&1005 I've never seen myself quite this way before.
&1006 I look so... so...
&1007 Well, like an angel.
&144 I don't know how you see yourself. I can only paint what I see.
zh: &144 我不知道你如何看待自己。我只能画出我所看到的。

en: &1008 You really see me like this?
&145 After all you've done, can you really think otherwise?
zh: &145 在你做了这一切之后，你还能有别的想法吗？

en: &1009 It's time for me to go.
&146 I understand. I'm ready.
&147 Will it hurt?
&1010 Will what hurt?
&148 You know. Dying?
&1011 You are not dying, Paula. Your time isn't over quite yet.
zh: &1011 你不会死，葆拉。你的时间还没到。

en: &149 You're allowing me to live?
&1012 I'm not here to kill you, if that's what you mean.
zh: &1012 我不是来杀你的，如果你是这个意思的话。

en: &150 Will I see you again?
&1013 I don't believe so.
&151 So, what am I supposed to do now?
&1014 Anything you wish.
&1015 Anything at all.
&1016 Good bye, Pie Sycamore.
&4143 She... enjoys life. A lot.
zh: &4143 她……很享受生活。非常享受。

en: &4144 Anyone who enjoys life that much will always find a way to be happy.
zh: &4144 如此享受生活的人，总能找到快乐的方式。

en: &112 Happiness won't put food on the table. Or a roof over your head.
zh: &112 快乐不能当饭吃，也不能给你遮风挡雨。

en: &113 Or stop the police from arresting you when you take one step too far.
zh: &113 也不能阻止警察在你越界时逮捕你。

en: &114 Which she definitely will, the way she's going.
zh: &114 照她这样下去，她肯定会越界。

en: &4145 She's a woman who certainly... knows what she wants.
zh: &4145 她是个……很清楚自己想要什么的女人。

en: &4146 That quality will serve anyone well in life.
zh: &4146 这种品质对任何人的人生都有好处。

en: &115 What she WANTS is to leave a trail of chaos with that boy.
zh: &115 她想要的是和那个男孩留下一片混乱。

en: &116 If she ever decides she wants anything else... it'll be too late.
zh: &116 如果她哪天想要别的……那就太晚了。

en: &4147 She'll settle down eventually. Everyone does.
zh: &4147 她最终会安定下来的。每个人都会。

en: &117 She's not just "sowing her wild oats" here. She's lucky she's not in jail. Or worse.
zh: &117 她可不只是“放纵青春”那么简单。她没进监狱就算走运了。或者更糟。

en: &118 Maybe she'll get it out of her system eventually, but it will be too late by then.
zh: &118 也许她最终会改掉，但到那时就太晚了。

en: &4148 I can envision their future. They are going to be fine.
zh: &4148 我能预见他们的未来。他们会没事的。

en: &119 Oh really? What exactly do you "envision."
zh: &119 哦，是吗？你具体“预见”到了什么？

en: &4149 She'll figure it out eventually. Everyone does, sooner or later.
zh: &4149 她最终会想明白的。每个人迟早都会。

en: &120 Does she seem like someone who is going to "figure it out" soon?
zh: &120 她看起来像是很快就会“想明白”的人吗？

en: &121 If she ever gets there, it will be too late. She'll have gone too far.
zh: &121 就算她哪天想明白了，也太晚了。她已经走得太远了。

en: &122 I just know it.
&6235 He doesn't seem SO bad...
&4150 Arthur doesn't seem SO bad...
&123 You don't believe that. I can hear it in your voice.
zh: &123 你不信。我从你的声音里听得出来。

en: &4151 Well, perhaps. But he may surprise us.
zh: &4151 嗯，也许吧。但他可能会让我们意外。

en: &124 Oh I pray every night that he doesn't.
zh: &124 哦，我每晚都祈祷他不会。

en: &4152 On second thought...
&125 Yes. Exactly.
&4153 They are going to have a successful life. I'm sure of it.
zh: &4153 他们会过上成功的生活。我确信。

en: &804 I do. I'm sure of it.
&126 I can hear it in your voice. You're a terrible liar.
zh: &126 我从你的声音里听得出来。你是个糟糕的骗子。

en: &805 *Sigh* I know.
&127 I don't care if they are successful. I just want to know my Elizabeth will be OKAY.
zh: &127 我不在乎他们是否成功。我只想知道我的伊丽莎白会没事。

en: &128 That not knowing? It keeps me up every night.
zh: &128 那种未知？它让我每晚都睡不着。

en: &4154 They are going to be safe. Their whole lives, they'll be safe.
zh: &4154 他们会安全的。他们的一生都会安全。

en: &129 You can't believe that for sure. Nobody is safe their whole lives.
zh: &129 你不可能确定。没有人一辈子都安全。

en: &4155 Things have always worked out for them so far. They are the luckiest people I ever met.
zh: &4155 到目前为止，他们的事情总是很顺利。他们是我见过最幸运的人。

en: &130 You can't tell me honestly that their luck will last forever.
zh: &130 你没法老实告诉我他们的运气会永远持续。

en: &4156 If I'm honest? Er...
&131 I thought not. This is what keeps me up night.
zh: &131 我想也是。这就是让我每晚睡不着的原因。

en: &4157 They are going to be happy. All of their lives.
zh: &4157 他们会幸福的。一辈子都幸福。

en: &132 Nobody can be happy ALL the time. What happens then?
zh: &132 没有人能一直幸福。那到时候怎么办？

en: &133 Can you honestly tell me that they are going to be happy all their lives?
zh: &133 你能老实告诉我他们一辈子都会幸福吗？

en: &7025 Er. Yes?
&134 I didn't think so. This is why I worry myself to sleep every night.
zh: &134 我想也是。这就是我每晚忧心忡忡入睡的原因。

en: &807 I... can picture them. Forty, fifty years from now. Retired. Happy. Dancing.
zh: &807 我……能想象他们。四五十岁以后。退休了。幸福。跳舞。

en: &808 Children. Grandchildren. Great grandchildren. Surrounded by the love that brought them together.
zh: &808 孩子。孙子。曾孙。被让他们走到一起的爱包围着。

en: &135 You sound so certain. You really believe that, don't you?
zh: &135 你听起来很确定。你真的相信，是吗？

en: &809 I know that. Sometimes... you just know things.
zh: &809 我知道。有时候……你就是知道一些事。

en: &136 You mean, like having faith?
&279 Something like that.
&137 So I should have faith in my daughter? Faith in her choices?
zh: &137 所以我应该对我的女儿有信心？对她的选择有信心？

en: &138 Faith that she'll find her way in the end?
zh: &138 相信她最终会找到自己的路？

en: &810 Yes. It will happen. I believe it's meant to happen.
zh: &810 是的。会发生的。我相信这是注定的。

en: &139 God. Listening to you, it sounds like it could be true.
zh: &139 天哪。听你这么说，听起来像是真的。

en: &811 You said it yourself. I'm a terrible liar.
zh: &811 你自己说的。我是个糟糕的骗子。

en: &140 You're right about that.
&141 *Sigh* They are so very much in love, aren't they?
zh: &141 *叹气* 他们非常相爱，不是吗？

en: &812 That's one word for it.
&142 That's how you build a future. That's how you build a family.
zh: &142 那就是建立未来的方式。那就是建立家庭的方式。

en: &143 I was penniless when I met Olivia, you know. Yet she chose to believe in me.
zh: &143 我遇见奥利维娅的时候身无分文，你知道。但她选择相信我。

en: &144 So I... will choose to believe in Elizabeth.
zh: &144 所以我……会选择相信伊丽莎白。

en: &813 I'm glad.
&145 Thank you. I know you barely know me, but you've given me a bit of hope.
zh: &145 谢谢你。我知道你几乎不认识我，但你给了我希望。

en: &814 You saved me from getting arrested. Consider us even.
zh: &814 你让我免于被捕。我们扯平了。

en: &146 Hah! Fair enough.
&4158 They are going to have a family. A child will stabilize them, for sure.
zh: &4158 他们要有孩子了。孩子肯定会让他们稳定下来。

en: &147 They are having a CHILD?
&4159 Yes? Isn't that good news?
&148 Can you honestly tell me that it IS?
zh: &148 你能诚实地说这是好消息吗？

en: &4160 Er, maybe?
&149 That poor child. This just adds to my worries.
zh: &149 那个可怜的孩子。这只会让我更担心。

en: &150 What a mess.
&4161 They'll have a life of ups and downs. Just like anybody else.
zh: &4161 他们会像其他人一样，经历人生的起起落落。

en: &151 Like "anybody else?"
&152 You HAVE met them, haven't you?
&153 Can you honestly tell me that they can handle life's downswings like anybody else?
zh: &153 你能诚实地说他们能像其他人一样应对人生的低谷吗？

en: &4162 Er. Well...
&154 No. Neither can I. This is why I worry.
zh: &154 不。我也不能。所以我担心。

en: &4163 Never mind. It was just a passing notion.
&155 I understand. I think about her future all the time.
zh: &155 我理解。我一直在想她的未来。

en: &68 Any thoughts?
&251 You're the experts. I'll let you decide what's best.
zh: &251 你们是专家。我让你们决定什么最好。

en: &252 But if you have an art question? I'm all yours.
zh: &252 但如果有艺术问题？我随叫随到。

en: &4851 I'm getting closer to finding Pie Sycamore.
zh: &4851 我快找到派·西卡莫尔了。

en: &4852 I've just hit a couple of... snags.
&253 Snags. Yeah. That's one word for those two.
zh: &253 麻烦。是啊。那两个人确实可以用这个词。

en: &254 Oh, it's great to be young and in love.
&255 Seriously. It's great. I never stopped, myself.
zh: &255 说真的。真好。我自己从未停止过。

en: &4853 Liz and Art are your great-grandparents.
zh: &4853 莉兹和亚特是你的曾祖父母。

en: &256 So it would seem.
&4854 You didn't know about them?
&257 If they were a painting, I could trace them back to the resin they made the paint from.
zh: &257 如果他们是一幅画，我能追溯到制作颜料的树脂。

en: &258 But genealogy was never my thing.
zh: &258 但家谱从来不是我的强项。

en: &4855 Did you get a good look at that woman?
&4856 Did you get a good look at Liz?
&259 Why? How close were you looking?
zh: &259 为什么？你看得有多仔细？

en: &4857 Close enough to see she is the subject of that painting we're looking for.
zh: &4857 仔细到能看出她就是我们找的那幅画的主题。

en: &260 Really. That's her?
&261 I'm amazed the alcohol on her breath didn't vaporize the paint on the spot.
zh: &261 我很惊讶她呼吸中的酒精没有当场把颜料蒸发掉。

en: &262 But good. We're getting closer.
zh: &262 但很好。我们越来越近了。

en: &4858 What do you think of Pie's studio?
zh: &4858 你觉得派的画室怎么样？

en: &263 It's... fine. I just wish I could fight my own instincts.
zh: &263 还行……只是我希望自己能克制住本能。

en: &4859 Instincts?
&264 As a curator! It's all wrong.
zh: &264 作为策展人的本能！全都不对劲。

en: &265 The larger pieces should take up the same amount of wall as the smaller pieces, to give each one an equal amount of attention.
zh: &265 大幅作品应该和小幅作品占据同样多的墙面，让每件作品都得到同等的关注。

en: &266 The more vibrant ones should be placed evenly throughout, to catch your eye and entice you to move through the room bit by bit.
zh: &266 色彩更鲜艳的作品应该均匀分布，吸引你的目光，让你一步步在房间里移动。

en: &267 And don't get me started on the frames, or lack thereof.
zh: &267 更别提画框了，或者说根本没有画框。

en: &268 *Sigh*
&269 Never meet your heroes.
&4860 You're not the first to say that.
zh: &4860 你不是第一个这么说的人。

en: &270 Well, it's evergreen advice.
zh: &270 嗯，这是永不过时的忠告。

en: &4861 Are you feeling better?
&271 Physically? A hundred and ten percent!
&4862 And mentally?
&272 I may punch the wall. I haven't decided yet.
zh: &272 我可能会捶墙。还没决定。

en: &4863 Talk soon, Imani.
&273 Ciao.
&1075 I didn't know you could just change a ranking like that.
zh: &1075 我不知道你还能那样改评级。

en: &276 It's not exactly easy. It requires several layers of brass approval.
zh: &276 这可不容易。需要好几层高层的批准。

en: &19 And a Fuji-sized mountain of paperwork to go through.
zh: &19 还有富士山一样高的文书工作要处理。

en: &20 You need to prove historical significance, impact to the timeline, blah blah the usual.
zh: &20 你得证明历史意义、对时间线的影响，等等等等，老一套。

en: &1076 And how'd you manage that?
&21 I made it clear that allowing agents a stable place to drink was vital to our mental health.
zh: &21 我明确表示，让特工有个稳定的地方喝酒对我们的心理健康至关重要。

en: &1077 I won't argue there.
&22 Plus these margaritas. No place else gets the salt quite right.
zh: &22 再加上这里的玛格丽特。别处的盐边都不对味。

en: &1078 Duffy, have you ever had to kill a client before?
zh: &1078 达菲，你以前杀过客户吗？

en: &23 Oh boy.
&24 Let's get one thing straight. What you did wasn't "murder".
zh: &24 先把话说清楚。你做的不是“谋杀”。

en: &25 He didn't leave you a choice.
&26 Sometimes a client can be so blinded by the possibilities of time travel that they can't get out of their own way.
zh: &26 有时候客户会被时间旅行的可能性冲昏头脑，结果自己挡了自己的路。

en: &1079 What do you mean? A client who can't get out of their own way?
zh: &1079 什么意思？客户自己挡自己的路？

en: &27 Okay. Take my last client. This actress. A big influencer type back in the day.
zh: &27 好吧。就拿我上一个客户来说。一个女演员，当年是个大网红。

en: &28 Was convinced she was robbed of an audition that went to Maggie Fielding.
zh: &28 她坚信自己被人抢走了一个试镜机会，那个机会给了玛吉·菲尔丁。

en: &1080 That was the "Water Under the Bridge" remake, right? She won an award for that.
zh: &1080 就是《桥下流水》翻拍版，对吧？她凭那个得了奖。

en: &277 Not anymore. Duffy changed it.
zh: &277 现在不是了。达菲把它改了。

en: &1081 So. I've been chrono-shifted into a cluster.
zh: &1081 所以，我被时空改写进了一个伴侣组。

en: &29 Oh that's always awkward.
&30 They cute, at least?
&1082 A son, as well.
&31 Oof. Never mind.
&278 That's the San Francisco branch.
&32 Really.
&279 Yep. The oscillation is just a few points south of London's. It's like a fingerprint.
zh: &279 对。振荡只比伦敦低几个点。就像指纹一样。

en: &1083 What do you mean, "You're welcome?" You're responsible for getting this place chrono-locked?
zh: &1083 你说“不客气”是什么意思？是你让这地方时空锁定的？

en: &33 Yeah. Ten years ago, now.
&34 I petitioned to get this bar's ranking upgraded. Took awhile, but I got approved.
zh: &34 我申请提升这家酒吧的评级。花了不少时间，但批准了。

en: &35 So relax. This place isn't going anywhere.
zh: &35 所以放松。这地方哪儿也不会去。

en: &36 And again, you're welcome.
&1084 I'll just wait it out. As usual.
zh: &1084 我就等着它过去。跟往常一样。

en: &1085 Be out of their lives by the next chrono adjustment. Probably.
zh: &1085 在下一次时空校正前离开他们的生活。大概吧。

en: &280 Funny, how that happens.
zh: &280 真有意思，事情总是这样。

en: &281 You always lose what you want, and then get what you don't.
zh: &281 你总是失去想要的，然后得到不想要的。

en: &6001 Sorry?
&282 Nothing. Sorry.
&283 Jesus. These drinks should come with a warning label.
zh: &283 天哪。这些饮料应该贴上警告标签。

en: &37 You've only been drinking soda, Nozzo.
&284 Really? Then they definitely should.
&1086 Well gents. I believe it's time I call it a night.
zh: &1086 好了，先生们。我想我该回去了。

en: &285 *Sigh* Yeah. Me too. Duffy?
&38 Nah. You two go ahead.
&39 Gonna see what the night or the next chrono-adjustment will bring.
zh: &39 我要看看今晚或下一次时空校正会带来什么。

en: &1087 That's too bad. I liked that movie.
zh: &1087 那太糟了。我喜欢那部电影。

en: &286 Which version? That film's been chrono-shifted by accident at least four times.
zh: &286 哪个版本？那部电影至少被意外时空改写过四次。

en: &40 Well THIS time it was done on purpose.
&41 Wasn't that hard, either.
&1088 How'd you manage it?
&42 Still want to learn from your mentor, I see?
zh: &42 还想跟你的导师学，是吧？

en: &1089 It's not like you're NOT going to tell us.
zh: &1089 反正你也不会不告诉我们。

en: &43 You got me there.
&1090 The original film was better anyway.
&287 Which original? The 2042 version or the 2009 version?
&1091 There was a 2009 version?
&288 Yeah. It's got a high timeline impact ranking. Never could figure out why.
zh: &288 对。它的时间线影响评级很高。一直搞不懂为什么。

en: &1092 Anyway, what happened next, Duffy?
zh: &1092 总之，接下来发生了什么，达菲？

en: &44 I just made sure Maggie's regular hairdresser was delayed that day.
zh: &44 我只是确保玛吉的固定理发师那天被耽搁了。

en: &45 I stepped in and gave her a haircut she'll never forget.
zh: &45 我顶替上去，给她剪了个她永远忘不了的发型。

en: &46 Maggie never auditioned. Our client got the part. Mission complete.
zh: &46 玛吉没去试镜。我们的客户拿到了角色。任务完成。

en: &1093 How was she in the movie?
&47 Oh. Terrible. She paradoxed her career into oblivion.
zh: &47 哦。糟透了。她把职业生涯悖论到了湮灭。

en: &48 Hey. Could we have another round, Mx. Mix?
zh: &48 嘿。能再来一轮吗，米克斯？

en: &1 Right away.
&1094 You can't possibly sense that, Nozzo.
zh: &1094 你不可能感觉得到，诺佐。

en: &49 I didn't believe it either.
&1095 They don't feel like anything to me.
&50 You and everyone else.
&1096 You're making that up.
&51 I thought the same thing!
&52 But he's been doing that trick for 20 years and he's never been wrong once.
zh: &52 但他这手已经玩了20年，从没出过错。

en: &289 It's not a "trick," Duffy.
&5140 Blast it. Getting a call. Hold on a tick.
zh: &5140 该死。来电话了。稍等一下。

en: &24 Fia!
&25 Where ARE you?
&1097 Who's this?
&26 Who is...? It's Jonnie!
Jonnie
&1098 Jonnie. Yes. Jonnie... who?
&27 The Jonnie you've been clustered with for eight years?
zh: &27 就是和你结为伴侣八年的那个乔尼？

en: &1099 Right. Of course you are.
&28 Are you... are you at a bar?
&1100 Yeah. Is that a problem?
&29 You're supposed to pick up Nick from soccer practice!
zh: &29 你该去接尼克下足球训练课！

en: &1101 Nick. Right. And Nick would be...
&30 Our SON? He's been waiting in the rain for over an hour.
zh: &30 我们的儿子？他在雨里等了一个多小时了。

en: &1102 Ah. Sorry.
&31 This is beyond irresponsible. I-
&32 And what's with the accent?
zh: &32 还有你的口音是怎么回事？

en: &1103 What accent?
&33 Never mind. Just pick him up. Please?
&34 We'll talk about this later.
&5252 Right. Bye, then.
&5310 He's apparently been waiting for his mum - me - for an hour.
zh: &5310 他显然等了他妈妈——也就是我——一个小时。

en: &5311 Should I... go?
&3201 Indulging in your alternate selves' lives is... not recommended, Fia.
zh: &3201 沉浸在你另一个自己的生活里……不建议这么做，菲娅。

en: &3202 But it's up to you.
&5312 I should go deal with this.
&3203 Suit yourself.
&5313 Now let's see. What school district does my alternate cluster live in...
zh: &5313 让我看看。我另一个伴侣组住在哪个学区……

en: &3204 Lemme guess. They were chronoshifted away?
zh: &3204 我猜猜。他们被时空改写了？

en: &5315 There we go. Ethical dilemma solved.
&467 It is difficult to say, one way or the other.
zh: &467 这很难说，无论从哪方面看。

en: &468 I suppose I am. For now.
&469 That's not a question I can answer.
zh: &469 这不是我能回答的问题。

en: &470 Nothing is really definite, as far as I'm concerned.
zh: &470 就我而言，没有什么是真正确定的。

en: &471 It always depends.
&1 Depends? On what?
&472 On ripples. Or variables.
&473 Or ripples within variables.
&474 Sorry. I must not be making any sense.
zh: &474 抱歉。我肯定说得让人摸不着头脑。

en: &2 No. I think I get it.
&3 You're talking about time travel, right? You work for ChronoZen?
zh: &3 你在说时间旅行，对吧？你为 ChronoZen 工作？

en: &475 Am I real enough for you to buy me a drink?
zh: &475 我够真实吗？真实到能让你请我喝一杯？

en: &4 I think I can manage that.
&5 Two Wellard Cocktails, please.
zh: &5 请来两杯韦拉德鸡尾酒。

en: &476 Am I real enough to buy you a drink?
zh: &476 我够真实吗？真实到能请你喝一杯？

en: &6 If you are real, it would be rude to say no.
zh: &6 如果你是真的，拒绝就太失礼了。

en: &477 Two Wellard Cocktails, please.
zh: &477 请来两杯韦拉德鸡尾酒。

en: &478 Am I real enough to share a drink with?
zh: &478 我够真实吗？真实到能和你共饮一杯？

en: &7 I can't think of anything I'd rather do more.
zh: &7 我想不出比这更想做的事了。

en: &8 A Wellard cocktail, please.
zh: &8 请来一杯韦拉德鸡尾酒。

en: &479 Same for me.
&1 Right away!
&480 So what's your name?
&9 Jonnie. What's yours?
&10 Jonnie. Nice to meet you.
&482 Here's to being real.
&11 To being real!
&483 Well. Blast it.
&484 Could've waited for me to finish my drink first.
zh: &484 就不能等我先把酒喝完。

en: &485 Could I have another?
&2 Another what? You haven't ordered anything yet, miss.
zh: &2 再来一杯什么？小姐，您还没点东西呢。

en: &486 Right.
&487 Never mind.
Compressing everything you need to know.
zh: 压缩你需要知道的一切。

en: &488 Probably for the best, anyway.
&3 I believe that's a sign of flirtation, sir.
zh: &3 先生，我相信那是调情的信号。

en: &489 If you have something to say to me, you should come a bit closer.
zh: &489 如果你有话对我说，应该靠近一点。

en: &4 I believe she would like you to speak to her, sir.
zh: &4 先生，我相信她希望您跟她说话。

en: &5 I believe she is "playing hard to get", sir.
zh: &5 先生，我相信她是在“欲擒故纵”。

en: &12 THANK you. I wasn't sure.
&13 Right.
&14 Um. Hi?
&15 I'm new to town. Don't know anyone here. You alone?
zh: &15 我刚来这个城市，谁也不认识。你一个人吗？

en: &490 Alone?
&16 Yeah.
&491 You're pretty sharp. Was I that obvious?
zh: &491 你挺敏锐的。我表现得那么明显吗？

en: &17 I'm good at reading people. Part of being in sales.
zh: &17 我擅长观察人。做销售的一部分。

en: &492 That must be nice. Knowing what you are.
zh: &492 那一定很好。知道自己是什么。

en: &18 You're saying you don't?
&493 Yes and no.
&494 I'd rather not talk about work, if it's all the same.
zh: &494 如果可以的话，我不想谈工作。

en: &19 Fair enough. I get it. We're both off the clock. Work doesn't exist.
zh: &19 没问题。我理解。我们都下班了。工作不存在。

en: &495 You may be right about that in a minute or two.
zh: &495 一两分钟后你可能就说对了。

en: &20 What do you mean?
&496 What's real or not is always changing, right?
zh: &496 什么是真实的、什么不是，总是在变，对吧？

en: &497 You've heard of us?
&21 Only what I've seen on the vids.
&22 Scientists going on about what's real and what isn't. Is all that true?
zh: &22 科学家们一直在讨论什么是真实的、什么不是。那些都是真的吗？

en: &498 Every word, I'm afraid. It's always changing.
zh: &498 恐怕每个字都是真的。它总是在变。

en: &499 I may not even exist right now.
zh: &499 我现在甚至可能不存在。

en: &23 I'm not sure I understand. You seem real enough to me.
zh: &23 我不太明白。在我看来你挺真实的。

en: &1106 Just doing what you taught me, Duffy.
zh: &1106 只是照你教我的做，达菲。

en: &1107 "When timeline malaise hits, focus on the work."
zh: &1107 “时序倦怠袭来时，专注于工作。”

en: &1108 So here I am.
&1109 You really think this is the right thing?
&1110 Well it's not like I had anything else to do tonight.
zh: &1110 反正我今晚也没别的事可做。

en: &54 Still. It's just like I taught you, way back when.
zh: &54 不过，这就像我很久以前教你的那样。

en: &55 Focusing on a job. It's the best way to get through the timeline malaise.
zh: &55 专注于工作。这是度过时序倦怠的最好方法。

en: &1111 Oh you think I'm malaised, do you?
zh: &1111 哦，你觉得我时序倦怠了，是吗？

en: &1112 What "right thing" is that?
&56 The thing I taught you, way back when.
zh: &56 我很久以前教你的那件事。

en: &57 Focusing on a job. It's the best way to get through the timeline malaise.
zh: &57 专注于工作。这是度过时序倦怠的最好方法。

en: &58 Who, me? I try not to think at all. Better that way.
zh: &58 谁，我吗？我尽量什么都不想。那样更好。

en: &59 Anyway, say hi to Nozzo for me, and break a leg out then.
zh: &59 总之，替我向诺佐问好，祝你在那边好运。

en: &1113 Yeah. See you later.
&6050 Yes. Chloe Seetar. Of course.
zh: &6050 是的。克洛伊·西塔尔。当然。

en: &60 SADAR. Chloe SADAR.
&6051 All right. I don't know her.
&6052 I can't say I've heard of her. Sorry.
&6053 I don't pay attention to boxing much, or any sport.
zh: &6053 我不太关注拳击，也不关注任何运动。

en: &6054 Shifting timelines make it hard to keep track of these things. You know that.
zh: &6054 时间线不断变动，很难追踪这些事。你知道的。

en: &61 Normally I'd agree with you, but Chloe's something special.
zh: &61 通常我会同意你，但克洛伊很特别。

en: &6055 Special as in a high timeline ranking?
zh: &6055 特别是指时间线评级很高？

en: &62 No. Special as in she's one of the best fighters in the sport!
zh: &62 不。特别是指她是这项运动中最优秀的拳手之一！

en: &63 Or at least she was. She retired recently.
zh: &63 至少她曾经是。她最近退役了。

en: &6056 I'm surprised at you, Duffy.
&6057 Duffy, you know better.
&6058 Duffy, be careful.
&6059 This goes against everything you taught me.
zh: &6059 这违背了你教给我的一切。

en: &65 And what's that?
&6060 "Don't get attached. Be prepared to let everything go."
zh: &6060 “不要投入感情。做好放下一切的准备。”

en: &6061 She could be paradoxed out of existence tomorrow.
zh: &6061 她明天就可能因悖论而消失。

en: &66 Fine. Fine. You're right. I get it.
zh: &66 好吧。好吧。你说得对。我明白了。

en: &67 *Sigh*
&68 Just don't let anything happen to her, okay?
zh: &68 只是别让她出任何事，好吗？

en: &6062 I know the rules. She will be fine. As long as she doesn't pull another Joe Anderson...
zh: &6062 我知道规矩。她会没事的。只要她别再搞出另一个乔·安德森……

en: &69 She won't.
&3104 I didn't know you were a fan.
zh: &3104 我不知道你是她的粉丝。

en: &70 Everyone's a fan. Besides you, apparently.
zh: &70 人人都是粉丝。显然除了你。

en: &1854 Maybe that'll change after tonight. Meet you at Jay V's later?
zh: &1854 也许今晚之后会改变。待会儿杰伊V见？

en: &71 Definitely. See you there... slugger.
&1118 You go anywhen interesting tonight?
zh: &1118 你今晚要去什么有趣的时代吗？

en: &72 Huh? Oh. Yeah. Grant City Trust in 2018.
zh: &72 嗯？哦。是的。2018年的格兰特城市信托。

en: &1119 A bit of corporate espionage? Sounds exciting.
zh: &1119 有点商业间谍的味道？听起来很刺激。

en: &73 Not quite. A fire broke out on the 14th floor.
zh: &73 不完全是。14楼发生了火灾。

en: &74 Nobody was hurt, but an intern lost his comic collection in the blaze.
zh: &74 没人受伤，但一个实习生的漫画收藏在火灾中烧毁了。

en: &75 He hired us to rescue it before the fire started.
zh: &75 他雇我们在火灾发生前把收藏救出来。

en: &1120 He must've really loved that collection.
&76 He thought he did. Amounts to the same thing.
zh: &76 他自认为很爱。结果都一样。

en: &1121 What're you having?
&77 No idea. I set Mx. Mix to random.
zh: &77 不知道。我把米克斯设成随机了。

en: &79 You want to try your luck?
&7026 You all right?
&80 This version of me? Sure.
&1127 Version of you... ?
&1128 Oh Duffy, you didn't.
&81 Yeah. I checked my Personic profile.
&82 I died of Skimein's syndrome two weeks ago.
zh: &82 我两周前死于斯凯曼综合征。

en: &83 A moment of weakness. I swear.
&1129 I admit, I check it too. Sometimes.
zh: &1129 我承认，我也查过。有时候。

en: &84 I know. I never gave you grief for it.
zh: &84 我知道。我从没为这事怪过你。

en: &1130 I don't see why either of us should.
zh: &1130 我不觉得我们俩谁该怪谁。

en: &1131 I won't snitch to the brass if you won't, Duff.
zh: &1131 你不告发我，我就不向高层打小报告，达菲。

en: &85 Heh. Well, it's not a rule, is it? Just some general advice.
zh: &85 嘿。不过，这又不是什么规定，对吧？只是一般性建议。

en: &1132 Exactly. I never saw the harm in it.
zh: &1132 没错。我从来不觉得这有什么坏处。

en: &1133 I believe you told me never to do that?
zh: &1133 我记得你告诉过我永远别那么做？

en: &86 And I believe you never actually LISTENED to that advice?
zh: &86 而我也记得你从来没真正听过那条建议？

en: &1134 Well, no. I don't see the harm. And neither do you, obviously.
zh: &1134 嗯，没有。我不觉得有什么坏处。显然你也不觉得。

en: &1135 After all, isn't that the benefit of this job? To see all the paths not taken?
zh: &1135 毕竟，这不就是这份工作的好处吗？看看所有没走过的路？

en: &1136 To remain fully ourselves even when everything changes around us?
zh: &1136 即使周围一切都在变，我们依然完全做自己？

en: &87 It's... a benefit. Yeah.
&88 Fia, did you ever wonder why we were recruited?
zh: &88 菲娅，你有没有想过我们为什么会被招募？

en: &7027 What do you mean?
&89 This isn't a job you apply for. We were FOUND. And brought into the fold.
zh: &89 这可不是你能申请的工作。我们是被找到的，然后被带进了这个圈子。

en: &90 Why, do you think?
&1137 I always assumed it was because we were orphans.
zh: &1137 我一直以为是因为我们是孤儿。

en: &1138 It's because we don't know where we came from, isn't it?
zh: &1138 是因为我们不知道自己从哪儿来，对吧？

en: &1139 Something about our psych profile?
zh: &1139 跟我们的心理档案有关？

en: &91 How do you mean?
&1140 Well, we have no real past. No real family. Nothing holding us to the here and now.
zh: &1140 嗯，我们没有真正的过去，没有真正的家人。没有什么能把我们拴在此时此地。

en: &1141 So when things change, it doesn't hurt us the way it would others.
zh: &1141 所以当事情发生变化时，它不会像伤害别人那样伤害我们。

en: &1142 Makes us ideal candidates.
zh: &1142 这让我们成了理想人选。

en: &92 I figured the same. But the world's full of orphans.
zh: &92 我也这么想。但这世上到处都是孤儿。

en: &93 And yet there are only 33 active time agents like us worldwide.
zh: &93 然而全世界像我们这样的现役时间特工只有33个。

en: &94 And monitors like Nozzo? Even fewer.
zh: &94 而像诺佐那样的监控员？更少。

en: &95 Why is that, do you think?
&96 Why are there only a handful of us who can do this job?
zh: &96 为什么能干这行的只有我们这么一小撮人？

en: &1143 I'm just happy to be one of them, Duffy.
zh: &1143 能成为其中一员我就很开心了，达菲。

en: &97 Yeah. Same. Happy every day.
zh: &97 是啊。我也是。每天都开心。

en: &98 Maybe that's part of it. We really *enjoy* this kind of work.
zh: &98 也许这也是原因之一。我们真的很*享受*这种工作。

en: &1144 What's not to enjoy?
&1145 I never really thought much about it.
zh: &1145 我从来没怎么想过这事。

en: &99 Yeah. You've always gone with the flow, haven't you? I'm the same.
zh: &99 是啊。你一向随遇而安，对吧？我也一样。

en: &100 Maybe that's part of it. We adjust easily to the whims of the timestream changes.
zh: &100 也许这也是原因之一。我们很容易适应时间流变化的反复无常。

en: &1146 I can't imagine living any other way.
zh: &1146 我无法想象还有别的活法。

en: &1147 Maybe we're special, Duff. You think of that?
zh: &1147 也许我们很特别，达菲。你想过这个吗？

en: &101 Hah. Maybe. But are we special because we were chosen? Or chosen because we were special?
zh: &101 哈。也许吧。但我们是因被选中而特别，还是因特别而被选中？

en: &1148 Does it matter?
&1149 We're not like other people. Their lives can be changed or erased in a moment. But not us.
zh: &1149 我们跟别人不一样。他们的生活可能瞬间被改变或抹去。但我们不会。

en: &1150 We're beyond all that.
&102 Yeah. Maybe.
&1151 Only if I can come with.
&103 Of course. Goes without saying.
&1152 Brilliant. We just need to get there before-
zh: &1152 太好了。我们只需要在那之前赶到——

en: &1153 That sounds like a very bad idea.
zh: &1153 这听起来是个非常糟糕的主意。

en: &104 No. It's a TERRIBLE idea. That's why I'm gonna do it.
zh: &104 不。这是个糟糕透顶的主意。所以我才要去做。

en: &105 I just have to get there before-
zh: &105 我只需要在那之前赶到——

en: &301 *Sigh*
&1154 Another round?
&302 Yeah.
&1105 Same again, Mx. Mix!
&21 Another round? Coming right up!
&1155 What's this "maybe" stuff? I'm only telling you what you taught me.
zh: &1155 这“也许”是什么意思？我只是在说你教我的东西。

en: &107 Focus on the job. Yeah yeah. I know.
zh: &107 专注于任务。是是。我知道。

en: &1156 Remember what you taught me? Focus on the job?
zh: &1156 记得你教我的吗？专注于任务？

en: &108 Yeah yeah. I know.
&1157 This isn't like you, Duffy.
&109 I know. I need to "Focus on the job."
zh: &109 我知道。我需要“专注于任务”。

en: &110 Blasted Timeline Malaise. Gets to all of us sometimes. Even me.
zh: &110 该死的时序倦怠。有时候我们都会这样。连我也不例外。

en: &1158 Reading about your own funeral can do that.
zh: &1158 读到自己的葬礼就会这样。

en: &300 Yeah.
&111 There's a memorial service scheduled for next week. It'll be full of family. Loved ones. People I never knew. All mourning me.
zh: &111 下周安排了一场追悼会。会有一堆家人。亲人。我从不认识的人。都在哀悼我。

en: &1159 They aren't mourning YOU, Duffy.
zh: &1159 他们哀悼的不是你，达菲。

en: &112 I know that. Course I know that.
&113 God this is DUMB. I'm acting like a total socket.
zh: &113 天哪，这太蠢了。我表现得像个十足的傻瓜。

en: &114 I should book a flight. Crash the memorial. Give them the scare of their lives.
zh: &114 我应该订张机票。闯进追悼会。吓他们一大跳。

en: &115 What do you think? Should I do it?
&1160 Sure. Surprise me.
&116 Another for my friend, Mx. Mix!
zh: &116 再给我的朋友来一杯，米克斯！

en: &22 One Inferno Elixir! Coming right up.
zh: &22 一杯地狱灵药！马上就来。

en: &1161 Bleh. Spicy.
&117 Heh. Well. Sometimes it's nice to NOT know what's gonna happen.
zh: &117 嘿。好吧。有时候不知道会发生什么也挺好的。

en: &1162 No. I think I'll stick with what I know.
zh: &1162 不。我想我还是坚持我所知道的。

en: &1163 The usual, Mx Mix!
&23 One usual. Straight away!
&118 I see why Nozzo likes working with you.
zh: &118 我明白诺佐为什么喜欢和你一起工作了。

en: &119 He doesn't like to be surprised much, either.
&1164 Ahem?
&26 Nozzo!
&292 Oh. Fia. You made it. Good.
A happy accident.
&293 Me? Sure. I'm fine.
&806 Just... thinking about the last time I was here.
zh: &806 只是……在想我上次来这儿的时候。

en: &1165 When were you here last?
zh: &1165 你上次是什么时候来的？

en: &294 Fifteen, twenty years?
&295 Used to come here all the time. With my old cluster. Looked different then.
zh: &295 以前常来。和我的旧伴侣组一起。那时候看起来不一样。

en: &1166 Didn't take you for an art lover, Noz.
zh: &1166 诺佐，没想到你还是个艺术爱好者。

en: &296 There's lots you don't know about me.
&297 Used to come here quite often. Back in the day. With my old cluster. Before ChronoZen.
zh: &297 以前经常来。那时候。和我的旧伴侣组一起。在加入ChronoZen之前。

en: &298 Looks completely different now.
zh: &298 现在看起来完全不同了。

en: &1167 Came here often, did you?
&299 Often enough.
&300 Back in the day, you know. With my old cluster. Before ChronoZen.
zh: &300 那时候，你知道的。和我的旧伴侣组一起。在加入ChronoZen之前。

en: &301 The place looks so different.
zh: &301 这地方看起来太不一样了。

en: &1168 Is that possible?
&1169 I thought you said this place had a maximum ranking?
zh: &1169 我以为你说过这地方有最高评级？

en: &302 It does. Doesn't matter. Some things just... change.
zh: &302 确实有。没关系。有些事就是……变了。

en: &303 Anyway. Can't let the malaise get me. The client's waiting. Exhibit room 4.
zh: &303 总之。不能让自己陷入时序倦怠。客户在等着。4号展厅。

en: &304 After you, Fia.
&1170 I don't know much about art, but it is very well done.
zh: &1170 我不太懂艺术，但画得很好。

en: &131 The quality is unquestionable, but irrelevant.
zh: &131 质量毋庸置疑，但那无关紧要。

en: &1171 Pretty girl. Who is she?
&132 She is, isn't she? I don't know who she is, but that's not important.
zh: &132 她确实漂亮，不是吗？我不知道她是谁，但那不重要。

en: &1172 It was painted on August 18th, 1923.
&133 Hah. Naturally the time traveller sees the date before anything else. But no.
zh: &133 哈。时间旅行者自然先看日期。但不是。

en: &1173 What am I looking for?
&134 There's no SIGNATURE!
&1174 So there isn't.
&1175 But I'm afraid I don't see the relevance.
zh: &1175 但恐怕我看不出这有什么关联。

en: &305 There's no signature and yet it's in the Pie Sycamore exhibit.
zh: &305 没有签名，却挂在派·西卡莫尔的展览里。

en: &306 I assume that's what you're getting at?
zh: &306 我想这就是你的意思吧？

en: &135 There's no signature, but I KNOW it's a genuine Pie Sycamore. I'm SURE of it.
zh: &135 没有签名，但我知道这是派·西卡莫尔的真迹。我确定。

en: &1176 Ah. Yes. Pie Sycamore. Of course.
zh: &1176 啊。是的。派·西卡莫尔。当然。

en: &1177 That's a painter, I assume?
&1178 And who is that?
&136 Is... is she serious?
&307 We're time travellers, Imani. We juggle several timelines in our heads at once.
zh: &307 我们是时间旅行者，伊曼妮。我们脑子里同时处理好几条时间线。

en: &137 Right. Of course. But you've heard of Van Gogh, I assume? Matisse?
zh: &137 对。当然。不过你总听说过梵高吧？马蒂斯呢？

en: &138 Progz Wykstrom? Claude Urdin? Benjamin Chandler?
zh: &138 普罗格兹·威克斯特罗姆？克劳德·乌尔丁？本杰明·钱德勒？

en: &1179 Are they painters too?
&139 Give me strength. YES.
&1180 They do ring a bell.
&140 Oh. Good. Some things transcend timelines.
zh: &140 哦。好。有些东西能超越时间线。

en: &1181 Maybe one or two sound familiar.
zh: &1181 也许有一两个听着耳熟。

en: &1182 And Pie Sycamore is on their level?
zh: &1182 那派·西卡莫尔跟他们是一个级别的？

en: &308 Even higher.
&309 His work has been known all over the world since his paintings were discovered in a warehouse auction 30 years ago.
zh: &309 自从30年前他的画作在一次仓库拍卖会上被发现，他的作品就闻名世界了。

en: &141 Yes. By ME.
&142 So believe me. I know a Sycamore when I see one.
zh: &142 所以相信我。我一眼就能认出西卡莫尔的画。

en: &143 And THIS painting? It's a Sycamore. And we're going to prove it.
zh: &143 而这幅画？就是西卡莫尔的。我们会证明这一点。

en: &1183 The plan seems straightforward enough.
zh: &1183 这个计划似乎够直截了当的。

en: &1184 I believe I understand.
&1185 The plan seems simple enough.
zh: &1185 这个计划似乎够简单的。

en: &1186 We go back to the date this was painted, and confirm Sycamore is the one who painted it.
zh: &1186 我们回到这幅画绘制的日期，确认西卡莫尔就是画它的人。

en: &310 Normally, yes. That's exactly what we would do.
zh: &310 通常来说，是的。我们正是要这么做。

en: &311 Only... "Pie Sycamore" is a pseudonym. We have no idea who he is.
zh: &311 只不过……“派·西卡莫尔”是个化名。我们不知道他是谁。

en: &144 You came prepared.
&312 I read the brochure.
&313 There's no record of anyone with that name existing at anytime, anywhere.
zh: &313 没有任何记录显示有叫这个名字的人在任何时间、任何地点存在过。

en: &145 You, me and every art historian knows this. And believe me, we LOOKED.
zh: &145 你、我，还有每一位艺术史学家都知道这一点。而且相信我，我们找过了。

en: &146 It's been one of the art world's greatest mysteries for decades.
zh: &146 几十年来，这一直是艺术界最大的谜团之一。

en: &147 But now we're gonna solve this once and for all.
zh: &147 但现在我们要一劳永逸地解开这个谜。

en: &1187 You know where to look, then?
zh: &1187 那你知道该去哪儿找吗？

en: &148 You get me to the "when". Then we'll deal with the "where."
zh: &148 你把我送到那个“年代”。然后我们再处理“地点”的问题。

en: &149 So? We going or not?
&2402 A bit, maybe.
&2403 Honestly? It feels kind of nice.
&2404 I'm not quite sure WHAT to feel yet.
zh: &2404 我还不太确定该有什么感觉。

en: &120 I get it. It's a new paradigm.
zh: &120 我明白。这是一种新范式。

en: &121 You. This painting. It shouldn't happen. Not to us.
zh: &121 你。这幅画。这种事不该发生。不该发生在我们身上。

en: &2405 What do you mean, "it shouldn't happen?"
zh: &2405 你说“不该发生”是什么意思？

en: &122 Because it's a distraction from the job. Timeline malaise, Fia. It...
zh: &122 因为这会让人从任务中分心。时序倦怠，菲娅。它……

en: &123 You know what? Never mind.
&124 That painting is beautiful. And you should enjoy beautiful things while they last.
zh: &124 那幅画很美。你应该在美好的事物还在的时候好好享受。

en: &2406 While they last?
&125 Yeah. This painting changed once. It can change again.
zh: &125 是啊。这幅画已经变过一次了。它还可能再变。

en: &7029 Right. Of course.
&2407 I know that.
&2408 Has anything like this ever happened before?
zh: &2408 以前发生过这样的事吗？

en: &126 Kind of. One of my first jobs. I accidentally put myself into a Gene Kelly movie.
zh: &126 有点。我最早的一个任务。我不小心把自己弄进了一部吉恩·凯利的电影里。

en: &2409 Really.
&127 "On the Town". The subway scene. You can see my right foot.
zh: &127 《锦城春色》。地铁那场戏。你能看到我的右脚。

en: &2410 That's not quite the same, is it?
&128 No. Not quite the same.
&2411 Am I in trouble?
&129 No! It's not like you ASKED to model for this thing.
zh: &129 不！又不是你主动要求给这东西当模特的。

en: &130 The brass'll understand that.
&2412 So. To Jay V's, then?
&131 Assuming you can stop admiring yourself.
zh: &131 前提是你能别再自我欣赏了。

en: &2413 I will manage.
&132 I can bring along a full-length mirror, if it'll help.
zh: &132 如果有帮助，我可以带一面全身镜。

en: &2414 Please don't trouble yourself.
&133 That costume shop on 4th is still around. I'm sure they have some feathered wings...
zh: &133 第四大道那家戏服店还在。我肯定他们有羽毛翅膀……

en: &2415 Pub. Now.
&134 Right behind you, Fia.
&2443 I thought I'd check in? See how you were?
zh: &2443 我想着来看看你？看看你怎么样？

en: &150 You couldn't keep away from me, huh?
&2444 Something like that. No ill-effects from Precursor Syndrome?
zh: &2444 差不多吧。没有前兆综合征的后遗症？

en: &151 Nope. Full recovery, as far as I can tell.
zh: &151 没有。就我所知，完全康复了。

en: &2445 I'm glad to hear that, Miss Camron.
zh: &2445 很高兴听到这个，卡姆伦小姐。

en: &2446 I wanted to look at the paintings again.
&152 Paintings? Or painting?
&2447 I don't know what you mean, Miss Camron.
zh: &2447 我不明白你的意思，卡姆伦小姐。

en: &2448 I was in the area. I thought I'd pop in.
zh: &2448 我正好在附近。我想着顺便进来。

en: &153 Pop in, huh? That's all?
&2449 Yes, Miss Camron. That's all.
zh: &2449 是的，卡姆伦小姐。就这样。

en: &154 Heh. It's "Ms. Nash" now, actually.
zh: &154 呵。其实现在是“纳什女士”了。

en: &155 Heh. It's "Ms. Finley" now, actually.
zh: &155 呵。其实现在是“芬利女士”了。

en: &156 Heh. It's "Ms. Quentin" now, actually.
zh: &156 呵。其实现在是“昆廷女士”了。

en: &157 Or should I say, it always has been.
&2450 Um. Yes. Sorry about that.
&158 No need to apologize. It could've been worse. I mean, I still EXIST.
zh: &158 不用道歉。本来可能更糟。我是说，我还存在。

en: &2451 Hm. Yes.
&2452 Existing is good.
&159 Pie Sycamore left quite a legacy behind, didn't she?
zh: &159 派·西卡莫尔留下了相当大的遗产，不是吗？

en: &160 These paintings. These bits of her soul.
zh: &160 这些画。这些她灵魂的碎片。

en: &161 She may be gone, but we'll always remember her.
zh: &161 她也许不在了，但我们会永远记得她。

en: &162 It feels good, to be a part of that.
zh: &162 能成为其中的一部分，感觉真好。

en: &163 And now you're a part of that, too.
zh: &163 现在你也是其中的一部分了。

en: &164 Partners in Time, as it were.
zh: &164 可以说是时间中的搭档。

en: &2453 Talk about what?
&165 Anything you want.
&2454 As I said, I'm fine.
&166 Okay. You're fine.
&2455 I was just about to leave.
&167 All right.
&2456 I'm glad you are well, Miss Camron. Sorry. Nash.
zh: &2456 你没事就好，卡姆伦小姐。抱歉。纳什。

en: &2457 I'm glad you are well, Miss Camron. Sorry. Quentin.
zh: &2457 你没事就好，卡姆伦小姐。抱歉。昆廷。

en: &2458 I'm glad you are well, Miss Camron. Sorry. Finley.
zh: &2458 你没事就好，卡姆伦小姐。抱歉。芬利。

en: &168 I believe I told you to call me Imani?
zh: &168 我记得我让你叫我伊曼妮？

en: &2459 Of course. Imani.
&3297 I... have to go.
&169 So soon? Well, come back anytime.
&170 I mean it. Any time.
&2461 Yes. Thank you.
&2462 I'm not part of anything. Not really.
zh: &2462 我不属于任何东西。真的。

en: &171 I don't think you believe that.
&2463 I didn't mean for this to happen.
zh: &2463 我没想让事情变成这样。

en: &172 Whether you meant it or not, I'm glad you did.
zh: &172 不管你有没有想，我都很高兴你来了。

en: &2464 I shouldn't keep coming here.
&173 And yet, you do!
&174 Time travel or not, we're only alive for a short while.
zh: &174 不管有没有时间旅行，我们活着的时间都很短。

en: &175 It's only natural to want to make your mark on the world.
zh: &175 想在世界上留下自己的印记，这很自然。

en: &176 To leave proof that you existed. That you mattered.
zh: &176 留下你存在过的证据。证明你很重要。

en: &177 And you can't get stronger proof than this painting right here.
zh: &177 而眼前这幅画，就是最有力的证据。

en: &2465 While it lasts, anyway.
&178 Are you all right?
&2466 Me? Yes. I'm dandy.
&179 Do you... want to talk about it?
&2494 If you must know, it was Camron.
zh: &2494 如果你非要知道，是卡姆伦。

en: &180 Cam. Ron.
&182 Nope. All wrong. Makes my tongue all itchy.
zh: &182 不。全不对。让我的舌头直发痒。

en: &2495 That is probably for the best.
&2496 The struggle to remember can be painful. And futile.
zh: &2496 努力回忆可能很痛苦。而且徒劳。

en: &183 Struggling against futility is what art curation is all about.
zh: &183 与徒劳抗争，正是艺术策展的全部意义。

en: &184 But that's neither here nor there.
&2498 That name never existed. It's best to remember that.
zh: &2498 那个名字从未存在过。最好记住这一点。

en: &185 You're the expert.
&186 I am Imani Nash.
&187 I am Imani Quentin.
&188 I am Imani Finley.
&189 Always was, always will be.
&190 And that painting always had your face.
zh: &190 那幅画上一直都有你的脸。

en: &191 And that tech company was always called...
&192 Blast it. I've forgotten the name already.
&2499 Pasamon Industries.
&193 Right! It was on the tip of my tongue.
&2500 It's not important.
&194 It was to your client.
zh: &194 对你的客户来说很重要。

en: &2501 You're not alone.
&195 It's not very memorable, is it?
&196 But not all legacies can be hanging in a world-famous museum, can they?
zh: &196 但并非所有遗产都能挂在世界闻名的博物馆里，对吧？

en: &197 Can I ask you something?
&2502 Sure?
&198 What are you feeling? Right at this moment?
&199 Yes "this again."
&200 Don't overthink it. Top of your head. What are you feeling?
zh: &200 别想太多。脱口而出。你感觉如何？

en: &2505 Like I have nowhere else to be. Nowhere else to go.
zh: &2505 好像我没有别的地方可去。无处可去。

en: &2506 Nothing else to do but stare at this thing.
zh: &2506 除了盯着这东西，没别的事可做。

en: &201 This is one of the largest art galleries in the tri-state area. It is hardly "nowhere".
zh: &201 这是三州地区最大的艺术画廊之一。这可不是“无处”。

en: &2507 Obsessive?
&2508 It's like an addiction.
&2509 I just... stare at this thing.
&202 As addictions go, I can think of several that are worse.
zh: &202 就上瘾而言，我能想到几种更糟的。

en: &2510 Narcissistic?
&2511 Staring at a painting of myself. Who does that?
zh: &2511 盯着自己的画像。谁会这么做？

en: &203 Don't sell yourself short. You're more than worth staring at.
zh: &203 别小看自己。你完全值得被盯着看。

en: &3897 Please.
&204 And besides. You're staring at a masterpiece of Pie Sycamore. There's a difference.
zh: &204 而且，你盯着的可是派·西卡莫尔的杰作。这不一样。

en: &2512 Happy?
&2513 Looking at this painting makes me feel good. It shouldn't.
zh: &2513 看着这幅画让我感觉很好。但本不该如此。

en: &205 You sound almost ashamed of that.
zh: &205 你听起来几乎为此感到羞愧。

en: &206 And I've studied that painting much longer than you. Believe me.
zh: &206 我研究那幅画的时间比你长得多。相信我。

en: &550 For work of course.
&551 *cough*
&2514 How many times have I come here this week?
zh: &2514 这周我来这里多少次了？

en: &207 Four? Maybe five? I can only count the times I've been here as well.
zh: &207 四次？也许五次？我只能数出我也来过的次数。

en: &208 You have your own reasons for coming here. Reasons aside from my sparkling company.
zh: &208 你来这里有自己的理由。除了我迷人的陪伴之外的理由。

en: &209 Even if you don't know what they are yet.
zh: &209 即使你还不知道那些理由是什么。

en: &210 Your reasons will come. Or not. Give it time.
zh: &210 你的理由会出现的。或者不会。给它点时间。

en: &211 Heh. "Give it time." Sorry. Forgot who I was talking to.
zh: &211 呵。“给它点时间。”抱歉。忘了我在跟谁说话了。

en: &652 Hey Fia?
&2515 Sorry I need to take this.
&212 Sure. Busy busy. I get it.
&2516 What's up, Noz?
&653 We, um, have a client.
&2517 Another one already?
&654 Yes and no. It's complicated.
zh: &654 是也不是。情况有点复杂。

en: &2518 You're being very cagey.
&655 Trust me. It will make sense when you get here.
zh: &655 相信我。你到了就明白了。

en: &2519 Fair enough. Be there as soon as I can.
&213 Duty calls?
&2520 Yes. Sorry.
&214 See you soon?
&2536 Well. Good for her.
&215 She had a good life, based on everything I read about her.
zh: &215 根据我读到的关于她的一切，她过得很好。

en: &2537 Is she any good?
&2538 When I heard her sing in 1923, she was... well, not good. At all.
zh: &2538 1923年我听到她唱歌时，她……嗯，唱得不好。一点也不好。

en: &216 Her songs are exquisite. She must've practiced.
zh: &216 她的歌很优美。她一定练习过。

en: &2539 Timelines change. It happens.
&217 Yes, well. I'm living proof of that.
zh: &217 是啊，嗯。我就是活生生的证明。

en: &218 Look at you. Barely any reaction at all.
zh: &218 看看你。几乎没什么反应。

en: &219 This is just another Tuesday for you, isn't it?
zh: &219 这对你来说只是又一个普通的星期二，对吧？

en: &2540 It's my job.
&2541 Sorry. It's not personal.
&2542 I'm used to it.
&2543 My personal timeline changes several times a day.
zh: &2543 我的个人时间线一天要变好几次。

en: &220 Either way. You did a good thing.
zh: &220 不管怎样。你做了一件好事。

en: &221 You created a legacy of music for Liz. A legacy of art for Pie Sycamore.
zh: &221 你为莉兹留下了一份音乐遗产。为派·西卡莫尔留下了一份艺术遗产。

en: &2544 I didn't intend to do either of those things.
zh: &2544 这两件事都不是我有意做的。

en: &222 So what? It still happened.
zh: &222 那又怎样？事情还是发生了。

en: &223 Heck, by saving Pie's life as a child, you created all of us.
zh: &223 见鬼，你救了派小时候的命，才创造了我们所有人。

en: &224 In a way, we're YOUR legacy.
zh: &224 从某种意义上说，我们是你的遗产。
