en: &48 We roomed together in college. Hofstra.
zh: &48 我们大学时是室友。霍夫斯特拉大学。

en: &49 I wasn't happy there, but she was nice. We got along.
zh: &49 我在那儿过得不开心，但她人很好。我们相处得不错。

en: &50 Even when I dropped out the first year and enrolled in the academy, she kept in touch.
zh: &50 即使我第一年就退学，进了警校，她也一直和我保持联系。

en: &51 Emailed me every week. Making sure I was okay.
zh: &51 每周都给我发邮件，确认我一切都好。

en: &52 Annoying as hell, but... anyway.
&3313 I know that the murder wasn't investigated, but surely you looked into it yourself?
zh: &3313 我知道那起谋杀案没有立案调查，但你自己肯定查过吧？

en: &53 I was a fresh-faced beat cop. You think I had the clout to go off on my own?
zh: &53 我当时只是个初出茅庐的巡警。你觉得我有本事自己去查？

en: &54 By the time I rose through the ranks, the case was too cold. And the world had... changed.
zh: &54 等我一步步升上去，案子早就凉透了。而且这个世界已经……变了。

en: &55 *Sigh*
&2612 Do you have any theories about why Yvonne was killed?
zh: &2612 关于伊冯娜被杀的原因，你有什么推测吗？

en: &56 So many you have no idea. There's no evidence for any of them.
zh: &56 太多了，你都想不到。但没有一个能找到证据。

en: &57 But the "why" doesn't matter anymore.
zh: &57 不过“为什么”已经不重要了。

en: &58 I just care about IF.
&2613 What was this alley like when you found it?
zh: &2613 你发现这条巷子时，它是什么样子？

en: &2614 What was the alley like when you found it?
zh: &2614 你发现这条巷子时，它是什么样子？

en: &59 About the same. Aside from Yvonne's body. And the... smell.
zh: &59 差不多还是那样。除了伊冯娜的尸体。还有那股……气味。

en: &60 Yvonne had her wallet. About 80 bucks in it. A few credit cards.
zh: &60 伊冯娜的钱包还在。里面大约有80美元，还有几张信用卡。

en: &61 She was wearing a silver necklace. And her wedding ring.
zh: &61 她戴着一条银项链，还有结婚戒指。

en: &2616 So Nick Chord's motive wasn't robbery.
zh: &2616 所以尼克·科德的动机不是抢劫。

en: &62 Sure. We know that NOW, thanks to his confession. We didn't know it then. Not for certain.
zh: &62 当然。我们现在知道了，多亏了他的供词。但当时我们不知道，没法确定。

en: &2617 How did you get inside the house the first time?
zh: &2617 你第一次是怎么进到房子里的？

en: &2618 The door was locked. Did you break in that time as well?
zh: &2618 门是锁着的。那次你也是破门而入的吗？

en: &64 Oh. Honestly? I don't remember.
&65 I think the door was unlocked?
&2619 It was?
&66 Yeah that must've been it. And it makes sense, doesn't it?
zh: &66 对，肯定是这样。而且这也说得通，不是吗？

en: &67 Afer all, we unlocked it ourselves.
zh: &67 毕竟，是我们自己开的锁。

en: &2620 It doesn't quite work like that, but it's probably not important.
zh: &2620 事情不是这么运作的，不过那可能也不重要。

en: &3314 Why did Yvonne feel the need to check in on you?
zh: &3314 伊冯娜为什么觉得需要关心你的情况？

en: &68 Because I was a New York cop in the 90s, that's why.
zh: &68 因为我是90年代的纽约警察，这就是原因。

en: &69 And not just any cop. Back then you could count the officers who looked like me on one hand.
zh: &69 而且不是一般的警察。那时候，像我这样的警官一只手就数得过来。

en: &70 Yvonne worried that the pressure would get to me.
zh: &70 伊冯娜担心压力会把我压垮。

en: &3315 And did it?
&71 I've made it to retirement age, so I'm gonna say no.
zh: &71 我都活到退休年龄了，所以我会说没有。

en: &3316 What about Yvonne's husband? Dion, you said?
zh: &3316 那伊冯娜的丈夫呢？你说他叫迪翁？

en: &72 I know what you're thinking. That's a dead end. Dion's a good dude.
zh: &72 我知道你在想什么。那是条死胡同。迪翁是个好人。

en: &73 Or... maybe he WAS? I have no idea if he's still alive.
zh: &73 或者……也许他曾经是？我不知道他是不是还活着。

en: &74 Anyway, I talked to him. Unofficially. At Yvonne's funeral and stuff. He was clean.
zh: &74 总之，我和他谈过了。非正式地。在伊冯娜的葬礼上之类的。他很清白。

en: &75 But it's not like I've been right about anything so far.
zh: &75 但到目前为止，我还没对过任何事。

en: &76 Damn it. They always say you shouldn't work cases you're personally involved in. This is why.
zh: &76 该死。他们总说你不该接自己牵涉其中的案子。这就是原因。

en: &3317 What did Nick Chord's confession actually say?
zh: &3317 尼克·科德的供词到底说了什么？

en: &77 Here. I have a copy handy. You should probably read it.
zh: &77 给。我手边有份副本。你最好读一下。

en: &3318 Nick Chord was a killer for hire?
&3319 What did your friend get mixed up in?
zh: &3319 你的朋友卷进了什么事？

en: &78 Don't know. Doesn't matter.
&79 We stop Nick, Yvonne doesn't die.
zh: &79 我们阻止尼克，伊冯娜就不会死。

en: &3320 Can you tell me anything else about Yvonne?
zh: &3320 关于伊冯娜，你还能告诉我什么吗？

en: &80 She moved here to the city when she graduated. We met for drinks every Friday.
zh: &80 她毕业后搬到了这座城市。我们每周五都见面喝酒。

en: &81 Even after she got married to Dion, she always made the time.
zh: &81 即使她嫁给迪翁之后，也总是抽出时间。

en: &82 She was... good to me. More than I deserved, probably.
zh: &82 她……对我很好。可能比我应得的还要好。

en: &83 She didn't deserve what happened to her.
&3321 So. You and Yvonne. In college.
zh: &3321 那么。你和伊冯娜。在大学里。

en: &84 What about it?
&3322 You didn't think to volunteer that information?
zh: &3322 你没想到主动提供这个信息？

en: &85 It's personal. And not relevant.
&86 Look, it was a one time thing. We were both high as hell. I barely remember it.
zh: &86 听着，那只是一次性的事。我们当时都嗨得不行。我几乎不记得了。

en: &87 I never mentioned it again, and neither did she.
zh: &87 我再也没提过，她也没有。

en: &88 I can't believe she told DION.
zh: &88 真不敢相信她告诉了迪翁。

en: &3323 So. Thoughts on Dion?
zh: &3323 那么。对迪翁有什么看法？

en: &89 I... don't know if I trust my thoughts anymore.
zh: &89 我……不知道还能不能相信自己的想法。

en: &90 I didn't even know they were having problems. If I'd known, maybe I would've...
zh: &90 我甚至不知道他们之间有问题。如果我知道，也许我会……

en: &91 I dunno. Talked to her or something. Been a better friend.
zh: &91 我不知道。跟她谈谈什么的。做个更好的朋友。

en: &3324 You are trying to save her life. I call that being a good friend.
zh: &3324 你在努力救她的命。我称之为好朋友。

en: &92 Yeah. Maybe.
&93 Yeah yeah. No sense woolgathering.
zh: &93 是啊是啊。胡思乱想没意义。

en: &2621 Yes. Amazing.
&4 I am aware.
&5 But the question is...
&6 Am I amazing enough for you to buy me a drink?
zh: &6 我够不够棒，让你请我喝一杯？

en: &7 Am I amazing enough for me to buy you a drink?
zh: &7 我够不够棒，让我请你喝一杯？

en: &8 Am I amazing enough for us to share a drink?
zh: &8 我够不够棒，让我们共饮一杯？

en: &2622 I am not entirely sure what just happened.
zh: &2622 我不太确定刚才发生了什么。

en: &9 How about you buy me a drink and we can find out?
zh: &9 不如你请我喝一杯，我们就能知道了？

en: &10 How about I buy you a drink and we can find out?
zh: &10 不如我请你喝一杯，我们就能知道了？

en: &11 How about we  share a drink and we can find out?
zh: &11 不如我们共饮一杯，我们就能知道了？

en: &2623 Are you... are you all right?
&12 I'm fine.
&13 You want to know HOW fine, you can buy me a drink.
zh: &13 你想知道我有多好，可以请我喝一杯。

en: &14 You want to know HOW fine, you'll let me buy you a drink.
zh: &14 你想知道我有多好，就让我请你喝一杯。

en: &15 You want to know HOW fine, you'll share a drink with me.
zh: &15 你想知道我有多好，就和我共饮一杯。

en: &16 Too strong?
&2624 I've been worse, believe me.
zh: &2624 相信我，我经历过更糟的。

en: &17 Well then. To being worse!
&2625 You... caught me by surprise, is all.
&18 And yet you're still talking to me.
&19 To being caught by surprise.
&2626 A bit, perhaps.
&20 To you still talking to me!
zh: &20 为你还在跟我说话干杯！

en: &21 My name is Em Nash, by the way.
zh: &21 顺便说一句，我叫埃姆·纳什。

en: &22 My name is Em Quentin, by the way.
zh: &22 顺便说一句，我叫埃姆·昆廷。

en: &23 My name is Em Finley, by the way.
zh: &23 顺便说一句，我叫埃姆·芬利。

en: &2628 ... Quentin?
&2629 ... Finley?
&24 Yeah. Like the old singer.
&25 Aaand poof. Now you know me, too.
zh: &25 然后——噗。现在你也认识我了。

en: &26 God, your face. They can see your blush from the other tower.
zh: &26 天哪，你的脸。另一座塔都能看见你脸红了。

en: &2630 I am not blushing.
&27 Course you're not.
&28 Look, I'll make this easy for you.
&29 If you want to sit and join me, I'd like that very much.
zh: &29 如果你想坐下来和我一起，我会非常高兴。

en: &30 If not... hey, I tried.
zh: &30 如果不想……嘿，至少我试过了。

en: &31 No pressure.
&2631 Nozzo, is that...?
&808 The Park Gallery curator? Could be. I'm not sure.
zh: &808 帕克画廊的策展人？有可能。我不确定。

en: &809 But either way, her voice matches the one on the Lozzotti's answering machine.
zh: &809 但不管怎样，她的声音和洛佐蒂家答录机里的声音吻合。

en: &810 So you should find out what she knows.
zh: &810 所以你应该弄清楚她知道些什么。

en: Windows on the World
&2632 Is this seat taken?
&32 No, but maybe you can do something about that.
zh: &32 没有，不过也许你可以改变这一点。

en: &2633 I'm back.
&33 I can see that.
&2634 I need to ask you some questions, if that's all right.
zh: &2634 如果可以的话，我需要问你几个问题。

en: &34 Not the line I expected, but I'm down.
zh: &34 不是我预想的那句话，但我愿意。

en: &35 You had me worried. I wasn't sure if you were gonna bail or not.
zh: &35 你让我担心了。我不确定你会不会放我鸽子。

en: &36 Getting rejected twice in one evening. Not sure I could take it.
zh: &36 一个晚上被拒绝两次。我不确定自己受不受得了。

en: &2635 You are very... forward.
&37 Does that bother you?
&2636 I didn't say that.
&38 Well, I got stood up tonight. Again. I don't want to mope.
zh: &38 嗯，我今晚又被放鸽子了。又一次。我不想闷闷不乐。

en: &39 Gotta carpe diem while you can, you know?
zh: &39 得趁还能抓住今天的时候抓住今天，你懂吧？

en: &40 So I saw you walk in, and well, here we are.
zh: &40 所以我看见你走进来，然后，我们就到这一步了。

en: &2637 Your surname. Finley?
&2638 Your surname. Quentin?
&2639 Your surname. Nash?
&41 What about it?
&2640 You said it was like the old singer.
&2641 Do you mean Lizzie Finley?
&2642 Do you mean Lizzie Quentin?
&2643 Do you mean Lizzie Nash?
&42 The one and only. You a fan?
zh: &42 独一无二的那位。你是她的歌迷？

en: &2644 I'm... familiar with her work.
&43 I have the best story about her. Bet you can't guess what it is.
zh: &43 我有个关于她的最棒的故事。我打赌你猜不到是什么。

en: &2645 Are you familiar with Pie Sycamore?
&2646 Or a Paula Camron?
&44 Who?
&2647 An artist. I think you would like her paintings very much.
zh: &2647 一位艺术家。我想你会非常喜欢她的画。

en: &46 You know I studied art history, too?
zh: &46 你知道我也学过艺术史吗？

en: &47 Just how much do you know about me?
&48 I studied art history in college, but I never heard of her.
zh: &48 我大学学过艺术史，但从没听说过她。

en: &49 You'll have to show me sometime.
&2648 You were here to meet Yvonne Lozzotti, weren't you?
zh: &2648 你是来见伊冯娜·洛佐蒂的，对吧？

en: &51 Okay. What's going on?
&52 How did you know that?
&2649 I'm looking for her.
&53 Yeah. You and me both.
&54 She stood me up three nights in a row.
zh: &54 她连续三个晚上放我鸽子。

en: &55 Who are you anyway?
&2650 Fia Quinn. As I said.
&56 Sure. And I'm Tyra Banks.
zh: &56 当然。那我就是泰拉·班克斯。

en: &57 *Sigh*
&58 Aaand poof.
&59 Turns out we don't know each other after all.
&2651 Are you familiar with Dion Lozzotti?
&60 No. Is that Yvonne's brother? Father?
zh: &60 不。那是伊冯娜的兄弟？父亲？

en: &2652 Her husband.
&61 Her what?
&2653 Her husband?
&62 I see.
&63 This just gets better and better.
zh: &63 事情真是越来越有意思了。

en: &2654 So you don't know him.
&64 No I don't know him.
&2655 Can you tell me anything about Yvonne?
zh: &2655 你能告诉我一些关于伊冯娜的事吗？

en: &65 Like what?
&2656 How did you meet?
&66 She came to my office one day. Wanted to interview me about the company I work for.
zh: &66 有一天她来到我的办公室。想就我工作的公司采访我。

en: &2657 What company is that?
&67 Some little nothing import/export company. Just a few floors down.
zh: &67 一家不起眼的小进出口公司。就在楼下几层。

en: &68 We talked, we had a few drinks, we ended up at my apartment...
zh: &68 我们聊了聊，喝了几杯，最后到了我的公寓……

en: &69 Three weeks later, she won't give me the time of day.
zh: &69 三周后，她连理都不理我了。

en: &70 I wasn't ready to call the U-haul yet, but I thought...
zh: &70 我还没准备好叫搬家公司，但我想……

en: &71 Whatever. Nothing. Not gonna mope. Look where I am.
zh: &71 算了。没什么。不会闷闷不乐。看看我在哪儿。

en: &72 On top of the goddamn world.
&2658 So you work here? In the World Trade Center?
zh: &2658 所以你在这里工作？在世贸中心？

en: &73 Yeah. As do five thousand other people.
zh: &73 是啊。和其他五千人一样。

en: &2659 And you plan to come to work tomorrow.
&74 I get paid under the table and I have New York rent to pay. So yeah.
zh: &74 我拿的是现金工资，还得付纽约的房租。所以是的。

en: &2660 I... see. That explains it.
zh: &2660 我……明白了。这就说得通了。

en: &75 Explains what?
&2661 I'm going to offer some advice. And I suggest you listen.
zh: &2661 我要给你一些建议。我建议你听好。

en: &76 What?
&811 Fia? Be careful.
&2662 I know, Nozzo. But I have to try.
zh: &2662 我知道，诺佐。但我必须试试。

en: &2663 Don't come to work tomorrow.
&2664 Find a reason to sleep in.
&77 A reason to stay in bed, huh?
&78 Now who's being forward?
&2665 What? Oh! No I didn't mean THAT...
zh: &2665 什么？哦！不，我不是那个意思……

en: &79 Sorry, Fia. Or whoever you are.
zh: &79 抱歉，菲娅。或者不管你是谁。

en: &80 That ship has sailed.
&81 Poof. Gone. At least for now.
&7113 Right.
&2666 Forget I said anything.
&2667 Do you have any idea where Yvonne might be?
zh: &2667 你知道伊冯娜可能在哪儿吗？

en: &82 No idea. And I don't care. I follow baseball rules. Three strikes and you're out.
zh: &82 不知道。我也不在乎。我遵循棒球规则。三振出局。

en: &2668 You said Yvonne interviewed you. So she's a journalist?
zh: &2668 你说伊冯娜采访过你。那她是记者？

en: &83 That's what she told me.
&84 But then again, she told me a lot of things.
zh: &84 不过话说回来，她跟我说过的事多了去了。

en: &2669 I... probably should go.
&85 If that's what you want.
&2670 Look. Imani. For what it's worth?
&2671 It was really nice to see you.
&86 How'd you know that?
&2672 Er. Know what?
&87 That my name is Imani?
&2673 Ah. Isn't that what "Em" is short for?
zh: &2673 啊。“埃姆”不就是这个名字的简称吗？

en: &88 Maybe for you. But most people assume it's "Emily."
zh: &88 对你来说也许吧。但大多数人会以为那是“艾米丽”。

en: &2675 Well... I'm not most people!
zh: &2675 这个嘛……我可不是大多数人！

en: &89 Yeah. I get that feeling.
&90 Well, leave if you're gonna.
&91 This view isn't gonna enjoy itself.
zh: &91 这风景可不会自己欣赏自己。

en: &2676 Ugh. Smooth, Quinn. Reeeeal smooth.
zh: &2676 唉。真行啊，奎因。你可真行。

en: &3325 Nozzo, I don't suppose you could hit the rewind button so I can try that again?
zh: &3325 诺佐，你能不能按个倒带键，让我重来一次？

en: &905 You know that it only activates if the system thinks you're dead. Or almost dead.
zh: &905 你知道的，只有系统认为你死了，或者快死了，它才会启动。

en: &906 Almost dying of embarrassment doesn't count. Sorry.
zh: &906 快尴尬死了可不算。抱歉。

en: &3326 Right. Thanks for that.
&907 Any time.
&2677 No idea. How about you tell me?
&92 Lizzie and me? We're related!
&2678 You're related?
&93 Er. Yeah.
&2679 She was a jewel thief.
&94 Huh? No. Not that I know of.
&95 She's my great-grandmother.
&96 It's obvious, right? I mean, I look just like her.
zh: &96 很明显，对吧？我是说，我长得跟她一模一样。

en: &97 Huh.
&98 Usually people think I'm joking when I tell 'em we're related, but not you.
zh: &98 通常我跟人说我们是亲戚，他们都以为我在开玩笑，但你没有。

en: &2680 And are you joking?
&99 No. It's all true.
&100 Just don't ask me to sing. I did NOT inherit that.
zh: &100 只是别叫我唱歌。我可没遗传到那个。

en: &3348 So. Do you have anything to say for yourself?
zh: &3348 那么，你有什么要为自己辩解的吗？

en: &101 I'm... sorry.
&3349 How did you see this going for you, exactly?
zh: &3349 你觉得自己会有什么下场？

en: &102 Honestly, I'm not sure.
&3350 What were you thinking?
&103 I wasn't. Not really.
&104 I just saw my chance, and I took it.
zh: &104 我只是看到了机会，就抓住了。

en: &3351 A chance for what?
&105 To do what I need to do.
&3352 You're not really in much of a position to do anything.
zh: &3352 你现在这个处境，可做不了什么。

en: &106 I have to do SOMETHING.
&107 If I raise a ruckus? Tell everyone what's about to happen?
zh: &107 如果我大闹一场呢？告诉所有人接下来会发生什么？

en: &108 Cause enough of a stink, maybe word will work its way up the food chain.
zh: &108 闹得够大，说不定消息就能传到上面去。

en: &109 Then maybe they'll call off the hit, just for a little while.
zh: &109 然后他们也许就会取消暗杀，哪怕只是暂时。

en: &110 All we need is a day. Not even that. Twelve hours. Time enough for the towers to fall.
zh: &110 我们只需要一天。甚至用不了一天。十二个小时。足够让双子塔倒塌。

en: &111 Then... it won't matter anymore.
&3353 That's a lot of maybes and ifs.
zh: &3353 这有太多“也许”和“如果”了。

en: &112 It's all I have now. And you can't stop me. Not while I'm in here.
zh: &112 我现在只有这些了。而且你阻止不了我。只要我还在这里面。

en: &3354 You want to turn your younger self in?
zh: &3354 你想把年轻时的自己交出去？

en: &113 Turn myself in for what? Doing something every cop was doing?
zh: &113 把我自己交出去？为什么？做了每个警察都在做的事？

en: &114 It won't stop what's going to happen.
zh: &114 那也阻止不了即将发生的事。

en: &3355 Why won't it matter tomorrow?
zh: &3355 为什么明天就无所谓了？

en: &115 Because Winera will be DUST. Buried at ground zero.
zh: &115 因为维内拉会化为灰烬。被埋在归零地。

en: &116 There'll be no reason to expose Winera, because there'll be no Winera.
zh: &116 就没有理由去揭露维内拉了，因为维内拉已经不存在了。

en: &3356 You are sure about this?
&117 I know I stopped getting checks after the towers fell.
zh: &117 我知道双子塔倒塌后，我就再没收到过钱。

en: &118 I was never asked to compromise my integrity ever again.
zh: &118 再也没人要求我出卖自己的良心。

en: &3357 You covered up a murder, Hanna.
zh: &3357 你掩盖了一起谋杀，汉娜。

en: &3358 That goes a bit beyond "compromising your integrity".
zh: &3358 这可不只是“出卖良心”那么简单。

en: &119 You think I don't know that?
&120 I spent the next 60 years trying to make up for it.
zh: &120 我花了之后六十年试图弥补。

en: &121 Burying myself in my work. Volunteering for the worst cases. The most terrible bad guys you can think of.
zh: &121 埋头工作。主动接手最糟糕的案子。你能想到的最可怕的坏人。

en: &122 The shit I've seen... the shit I STOPPED.
zh: &122 我见过的那些烂事……我阻止过的那些烂事。

en: &123 I hoped the scales would balance out. But they never did. Not in my mind, anyway.
zh: &123 我希望天平能平衡。但从来没有。至少在我心里没有。

en: &124 Every night. The same nightmare. Her blood on the concrete...
zh: &124 每天晚上。同样的噩梦。她的血溅在水泥地上……

en: &125 I just... want it to have never happened.
zh: &125 我只是……希望这一切从未发生过。

en: &3359 What exactly happened that night, Hanna?
zh: &3359 那晚到底发生了什么，汉娜？

en: &126 You know enough. I'm not going to say anything. Not without my lawyer present.
zh: &126 你知道的够多了。我什么都不会说。除非我的律师在场。

en: &3360 You lied to us from the beginning.
zh: &3360 你从一开始就在骗我们。

en: &127 What was I supposed to do? Tell the truth?
zh: &127 那我该怎么办？说实话吗？

en: &128 There's no statute of limitations on murder. Even being an accessory to murder. I would've been arrested on the spot.
zh: &128 谋杀没有追诉时效。哪怕是谋杀从犯。我当场就会被逮捕。

en: &129 Then I'd have no hope of changing things.
zh: &129 那我就没有希望改变这一切了。

en: &130 So what else could I have done?
&3361 Did you really think we wouldn't find out?
zh: &3361 你真的以为我们查不出来吗？

en: &131 I hoped so.
&132 I thought we could stop Nick and that would be the end of it.
zh: &132 我以为我们能阻止尼克，然后一切就结束了。

en: &133 Then I could return home to a life where it never happened. Where nobody even KNEW it happened.
zh: &133 然后我就能回家，回到一个从未发生过这件事的生活。一个甚至没人知道它发生过的生活。

en: &134 But that's no longer possible, is it?
zh: &134 但那已经不可能了，对吗？

en: &3362 Do you know when you'll be released?
zh: &3362 你知道你什么时候会被释放吗？

en: &135 They haven't said. It's really up to the officer I punched out.
zh: &135 他们还没说。这真的取决于我揍的那个警官。

en: &136 She's the one who is going to press charges.
&3363 Hanna. You committed a felony. There's no bail.
zh: &3363 汉娜。你犯了重罪。没有保释。

en: &138 I'm going to have to serve my sentence I assume? You'll pick me up when I'm done?
zh: &138 我猜我得服完刑期？我服完你会来接我吗？

en: &3364 That is protocol. Yes.
&7119 I'm sorry, Hanna.
&139 Then HELP me!
&3366 You brought this on yourself.
&140 I had no choice!
&3367 Rules are rules, Hanna.
&141 There are rules, and then there are RULES.
&3368 It's not up to me.
&142 So that's that?
&3369 That's that.
&143 Fia! Agent Quinn!
&144 Please don't do this!
&145 Please...
&3719 Hanna? I'm going to have to leave you now.
zh: &3719 汉娜？我现在得离开你了。

en: &3371 I'll travel forward to when you're released and pick you up.
zh: &3371 我会前往你被释放的时间点接你。

en: &909 One more thing.
&910 We obviously can't trust you to behave until your sentence is over.
zh: &910 显然，在你的刑期结束之前，我们不能相信你会安分守己。

en: &911 So the retro-resonance field will remain active.
zh: &911 所以回溯共振场会保持激活。

en: &147 You mean I'll be talking gibberish until I'm let out?
zh: &147 你是说在我被放出来之前，我会一直胡言乱语？

en: &912 I'll supply you with a list of authorized phrases you can speak. Otherwise, yeah.
zh: &912 我会给你一份授权短语清单。否则，是的。

en: &3372 Nozzo, is this necessary?
&913 I mean, yes? Obviously yes.
&148 But there's still time! I can still prevent it!
zh: &148 但还有时间！我还能阻止它！

en: &149 Can't you at least let me TRY.
&914 Maybe you should have "tried" sixty years ago.
zh: &914 也许你六十年前就该“试试”。

en: &915 But now? Not an option. Not anymore.
zh: &915 但现在？不行了。再也不可能了。

en: &916 Come on, Fia. We're done here.
zh: &916 走吧，菲娅。我们这里完事了。

en: &150 So that's it?
&151 You're just going to... let it happen? All over again?
zh: &151 你就打算……让它发生？再一次？

en: &3373 Are you familiar with the Village Eye?
&2 You mean the newspaper? Sure I know it.
zh: &2 你是说那份报纸？我当然知道。

en: &3 Never read it, but I know it.
&3374 Do you know Yvonne Lozzoti?
zh: &3374 你认识伊冯娜·洛佐蒂吗？

en: &4 Nah. Sorry. Is she local?
&3375 No. She works for the newspaper.
zh: &3375 不是。她为那家报纸工作。

en: &3376 We are trying to find her.
&5 Hey, I'm just a greenhorn. You want to file a missing persons report, just walk into any station.
zh: &5 嘿，我只是个新手。你想报失踪人口，直接去任何一间警局就行。

en: &3377 She's not missing. We just need to find her.
zh: &3377 她没失踪。我们只是需要找到她。

en: &6 Not my beat. Sorry.
&3378 Hypothetically speaking, what if I told you a murder is going to take place later tonight?
zh: &3378 假设一下，如果我告诉你今晚晚些时候会发生一起谋杀案呢？

en: &7 I'd ask who your hypothetical source was, number one.
zh: &7 首先，我会问你的假设性消息来源是谁。

en: &3379 Right. Then never mind.
&8 Already forgotten.
&7114 Are you going to be here long?
&9 Have no idea. Why do you ask?
&3380 It's taking you a long time to write one ticket, is all.
zh: &3380 只是你开一张罚单花了很长时间。

en: &11 Not that it's any of your business, but these things weren't designed with rain in mind.
zh: &11 虽然不关你的事，但这些玩意儿设计时没考虑下雨。

en: &12 You try filling out these tiny forms when they keep getting wet.
zh: &12 你试试在这些小表格不断被淋湿的时候填写。

en: &3381 You're quite persistent, I'll give you that.
zh: &3381 你挺执着的，这点我承认。

en: &13 Yeah. I'm like a dog with a bone.
zh: &13 是啊。我就像条咬着骨头的狗。

en: &14 Why you wanna know so much, anyway?
zh: &14 话说回来，你为什么想知道这么多？

en: &3382 No reason.
&16 Sure. Have a good night.
&3384 Hanna!
&3385 What are you doing?!
&3386 Don't be an idiot.
&152 You gonna take that, PIG?
zh: &152 你打算就这么算了，死条子？

en: &17 The law says I gotta. Freedom of speech, yadda yadda.
zh: &17 法律说我得忍着。言论自由，巴拉巴拉。

en: &153 So you're not going to do anything about it?
&18 Listen. It's getting late. It's raining. Neither of us wants this.
zh: &18 听着。天晚了。还下着雨。我们都不想这样。

en: &19 So I'm just gonna pretend I heard nothing. Okay?
zh: &19 所以我就当没听见。行吗？

en: AGH!
&20 What the everlasting FUCK, lady?!
zh: &20 你他妈到底怎么回事，女士？！

en: &154 I'll ask again:
&155 Are you gonna take that?
&21 Gah! I don't BELIEVE this.
&156 You want another black eye?
&22 Turn around! Hands behind your head. NOW.
zh: &22 转过身去！双手抱头。马上。

en: &3387 Wait! Just... hang on a moment.
&23 Sure, I'll get right on that.
&3388 She's with me.
&25 Is she now? You put her up to this?
zh: &25 是吗？是你指使她这么干的？

en: &3389 Please, don't do this!
&26 Pretty sure I don't have a choice.
&3390 No, you don't understand.
&27 I understand perfectly.
&28 She assaulted a POLICE OFFICER.
&29 When it comes to obeying the law? That's one of the big no-nos.
zh: &29 说到守法？那可是大忌之一。

en: &157 Come on! Hurry up.
&3391 It's absolutely vital that she comes with me.
zh: &3391 她必须跟我走，这至关重要。

en: &30 Well, it's absolutely vital that I get some ice on this shiner.
zh: &30 好吧，那给我的眼睛敷点冰块也至关重要。

en: &31 So neither of us are getting what we want.
zh: &31 所以咱俩都得不到想要的。

en: &3392 She's under my care. She requires... special supervision.
zh: &3392 她由我照看。她需要……特殊监管。

en: &32 Well I gotta say. You're doing a bang-up job supervising her.
zh: &32 那我得说，你这监管工作干得可真出色。

en: &3393 Hanna. Why are you doing this?
zh: &3393 汉娜。你为什么要这么做？

en: &158 Huh? Who are you?
&159 Officer, I've never seen this woman before in my life.
zh: &159 警官，我这辈子从没见过这个女人。

en: &7116 What?
&33 Look, this is none of my business. I got a job to do.
zh: &33 听着，这不关我的事。我有公务在身。

en: &34 Unless you want me to take you in for obstruction of justice?
zh: &34 除非你想让我以妨碍司法罪逮捕你？

en: &3394 No, that's... not necessary.
&35 Then I suggest you get out of my way.
zh: &35 那我建议你别挡我的路。

en: &36 As for you? You gonna cooperate? I trust I don't need the handcuffs?
zh: &36 至于你？你愿意配合吗？我想我不需要手铐吧？

en: &160 No. I'll cooperate. Just... get me processed. Now.
zh: &160 不。我会配合。只是……赶紧给我办手续。现在。

en: &37 Good.
&38 I don't get it, but I don't have to.
zh: &38 我不明白，但我也没必要明白。

en: &39 Station's thataway. Now move.
&161 I know the way.
&7117 Nozzo?
&917 I heard.
&3395 What is she DOING?
&918 Preventing us from pulling her to the present.
zh: &918 阻止我们把她拉回现在。

en: &3396 Right, but why?
&919 I... have no idea.
&3397 I thought the brass upgraded the vetting process?
zh: &3397 我以为高层升级了审查程序？

en: &920 They did. They examined her left, right, and center.
zh: &920 他们升级了。他们把她查了个底朝天。

en: &921 Psych profile, personal history, everything. It all checked out.
zh: &921 心理档案、个人历史，所有一切。全都通过了。

en: &922 What was that?
&3398 A scream.
&923 Ah. The subvocalization module must have muted it.
zh: &923 啊。默声模块肯定把它静音了。

en: &3399 Well trust me. It was loud. And satisfying.
zh: &3399 相信我。那声音很大。而且很解气。

en: &3400 So I hate to ask... but are there any ripples?
zh: &3400 虽然不想问……但有没有产生涟漪？

en: &924 Yes, but they haven't stabilized yet.
&925 All I can see with any certainty is that a "Hanna Tanaka" was booked on September 10th, 2001.
zh: &925 我唯一能确定的是，一个叫“汉娜·田中”的人在2001年9月10日被登记在案。

en: &7118 That's all?
&926 That's all. Until she decides on a course of action, and commits to it, I can't see what consequences this might have.
zh: &926 就这些。在她决定行动方案并付诸实施之前，我看不出这会带来什么后果。

en: &3401 So what do we do?
&927 She's going to prison, Fia.
&928 That means she's going to be indoors and being monitored at all times, so I can't pull her back remotely.
zh: &928 这意味着她会一直待在室内并受到监控，所以我没法远程把她拉回来。

en: &3402 There's a protocol for this, I assume?
&929 Yes. If an agent or client gets incarcerated, there's only two options.
zh: &929 有。如果特工或客户被监禁，只有两个选择。

en: &930 We either have to bail them out, or we jump forward to when they are released.
zh: &930 要么保释他们，要么跃迁到他们获释之后。

en: &3403 How much would it cost to bail her out?
&931 For assaulting a police officer? That's a felony charge. There's no bail.
zh: &931 袭警？那是重罪指控。不能保释。

en: &3404 Fan-blasting-tastic.
&3405 How long until she's released?
&6019 Checking...
&932 There's no record of it.
&3406 No record?
&933 Like I said, the ripples haven't stabilized yet. Could be anywhere between six months to two years.
zh: &933 我说了，涟漪还没稳定。可能六个月到两年不等。

en: &934 Or more, if she doesn't behave.
zh: &934 如果她不老实，可能更久。

en: &3407 I'm tempted just to leave her. Can we leave her?
zh: &3407 我真想干脆不管她。我们能不管她吗？

en: &935 Only if she's booked for life, which is doubtful.
zh: &935 除非她被判终身监禁，但可能性不大。

en: &3408 Hannah? Ms. Tanaka?
&3409 Nozzo, is her comm working all right?
zh: &3409 诺佐，她的通讯器工作正常吗？

en: &936 It's working perfectly.
&3905 Hanna! I know you can blasting hear me!
zh: &3905 汉娜！我知道你他妈的能听见我！

en: &937 It's working perfectly, but she doesn't have a subvocalization module.
zh: &937 通讯器完全正常，但她没有默声模块。

en: &3411 No module?
&938 She said she never learned how to use one.
zh: &938 她说她从来没学过怎么用。

en: &939 So even if she wanted to respond, she couldn't.
zh: &939 所以就算她想回应，也做不到。

en: &3412 Well, nothing for it. I'll go over to the prison and speak to her. Find out what's what.
zh: &3412 那没办法了。我去监狱找她谈谈，看看情况。

en: &3413 Do you know where she was booked?
zh: &3413 你知道她被关在哪儿吗？

en: &940 The Manhattan Detention Complex, locally known as "The Tombs".
zh: &940 曼哈顿拘留中心，当地人称“坟墓”。

en: &941 I'll send you the address.
New location:[The Tombs prison[125 White St
zh: 新地点：[坟墓监狱[白街125号

en: &3414 Thanks, Noz. Heading over.
&942 Standing by.
&40 Yeah just peachy. I just got my bell rung by someone's grandma.
zh: &40 是啊，好得很。我刚被某人的奶奶打了一拳。

en: &41 Your friend has a mean jab. I hope I'm half as tough as she is when I'm that age.
zh: &41 你朋友那一拳可真狠。希望我到她那个年纪能有她一半硬朗。

en: &3415 You're being very understanding. You're not upset that she hit you?
zh: &3415 你倒是很通情达理。她打了你，你不生气吗？

en: &42 Upset's got nothing to do with it. She did the crime. She's doing the time.
zh: &42 生气不生气无所谓。她犯了事，就得承担后果。

en: &43 As far as I'm concerned, justice is served.
zh: &43 在我看来，正义已经得到伸张。

en: &44 Ow. Damn it.
&3416 Can I see my friend?
&45 That Tanaka lady? Sure. She's all processed. You wanna talk to her, just ask at the front desk.
zh: &45 那个田中女士？当然可以。她的手续都办完了。想跟她说话，去前台问就行。

en: &3417 Are you going to press charges?
&46 Against an old lady? Jesus. I dunno.
zh: &46 起诉一个老太太？天哪。我不知道。

en: &47 Law says she should get six months at minimum, but she clearly needs help.
zh: &47 法律规定她至少得判六个月，但她显然需要帮助。

en: &48 So I'm thinking of recommending a bit of, you know, leniency.
zh: &48 所以我在考虑建议从轻处理，你懂的。

en: &3418 You mean you're letting her go?
&49 Hah. No. She punched a cop. Even if I wasn't feeling vindictive, which I'm not, the department can't just look away.
zh: &49 哈。不是。她袭警了。就算我没有报复心——我确实没有——局里也不能视而不见。

en: &50 But that doesn't mean we gotta throw the book at her.
zh: &50 但这不意味着我们非得从严惩处。

en: &51 You seem to know her. What would you recommend?
zh: &51 你好像认识她。你有什么建议？

en: &3419 I'm here to bail out my friend.
&52 Er. Sorry to tell you this, but bail doesn't happen when you assault a police officer.
zh: &52 呃。很抱歉告诉你，袭警是不能保释的。

en: &3420 Right. I figured as much. Thought I'd check, in any case.
zh: &3420 好吧。我也想到了。不过还是想确认一下。

en: &53 I get it. Do what you gotta.
zh: &53 我理解。该怎么做就怎么做吧。

en: &3421 Two months?
&54 Yeah, I'm thinking the same.
&3422 If the law says six months, that's what she should get.
zh: &3422 如果法律规定六个月，那她就该判六个月。

en: &55 You're not the only one to think that.
&56 But me? I'm thinking two.
zh: &56 不过我呢，我觉得两个月。

en: &3423 What's the maximum penalty? Two years? You should give her that.
zh: &3423 最高刑罚是多少？两年？你应该判她两年。

en: &57 Jeeze. Someone's vindictive about something.
zh: &57 天哪。有人对什么事怀恨在心啊。

en: &58 Don't tell me. I don't wanna know.
&59 Either way, since it's up to me, I'm thinking two months.
zh: &59 不管怎样，既然由我决定，我觉得两个月。

en: &60 Long enough to send a message, short enough to show we're not total assholes.
zh: &60 长到足以传达信息，短到表明我们不是彻头彻尾的混蛋。

en: &61 Yeah. Two months. I'll recommend that when I fill out the paperwork later.
zh: &61 对。两个月。我晚点填文件时会这么建议。

en: &3424 Are you familiar with an officer named Hanna Tanaka?
zh: &3424 你认识一位叫汉娜·田中的警官吗？

en: &62 Same name as the lady we just arrested?
zh: &62 跟我们刚逮捕的那位女士同名？

en: &3425 Yes. Although she'd be much younger. Mid to late 20s.
zh: &3425 是的。不过她年轻得多，二十五六到快三十岁。

en: &63 Sorry. Never heard of her.
&64 It's not like all cops know each other.
zh: &64 又不是所有警察都互相认识。

en: &3426 Does the name "Tanner" mean anything to you?
zh: &3426 “坦纳”这个名字对你有意义吗？

en: &65 Should it?
&3427 No. It was a long shot. Never mind.
zh: &3427 没有。本来就是碰运气。算了。

en: &3428 Do you know an officer named Hanna Tanner?
zh: &3428 你认识一位叫汉娜·坦纳的警官吗？

en: &66 Sounds familiar, but that's about all.
zh: &66 听着耳熟，但也就这样了。

en: &3429 So you wouldn't know where she is?
&67 After the knock I took, I barely know where *I* am.
zh: &67 挨了那一下之后，我连自己在哪儿都快不知道了。

en: &68 Sorry.
&3430 I'll head off now. And good luck with that eye.
zh: &3430 我先走了。祝你那只眼睛早点好。

en: &69 You know, normally I'd say something like "You should see the other guy," but considering who the "other guy" IS...
zh: &69 你知道，通常我会说“你该看看另一个家伙”，但考虑到那个“另一个家伙”是谁……

en: &70 I'll just say "Thanks" instead.
&3431 Good bye, Officer.
&71 See ya round.
&943 Okay. The ripples are still unstable, but... yes. I see a release date in an archived report.
zh: &943 好。涟漪还不稳定，不过……是的。我在一份存档报告里看到了释放日期。

en: &944 November 10th, 2001. Two months from your current when.
zh: &944 2001年11月10日。离你现在的年代还有两个月。

en: &945 Head back to the landing point. I'll make a tunnel.
zh: &945 回到跃迁落点。我来开一条隧道。

en: &3432 I assume we're using her security deposit to pay for this?
zh: &3432 我猜我们是用她的保证金来付这笔钱？

en: &946 When the brass is finished suing the pants off her, she'll be paying a lot more than that.
zh: &946 等公司高层把她告到倾家荡产，她要付的可不止这些。

en: &3433 Vindictive is a good look on you, Nozzo.
zh: &3433 诺佐，你报复心重的样子还挺好看。

en: &947 Just get her back here, Fia.
&3466 Hanna? Is something wrong?
&162 Is "something" wrong? No. Everything is wrong.
&163 Turns out everything's been wrong since that night.
zh: &163 原来从那一夜起，所有事都不对了。

en: &3467 Hanna? Are you... all right?
&164 No. Obviously not.
&165 I haven't been all right since that night.
zh: &165 从那一夜起，我就一直不好。

en: &3468 Hanna. Talk to me. I can't help you unless you tell me what's going on.
zh: &3468 汉娜。跟我说说。你不告诉我怎么回事，我没法帮你。

en: &166 Talking. I can't talk. I never could. Do you understand?
zh: &166 说。我没法说。从来都说不出。你明白吗？

en: &167 Not since that night.
&168 I thought I was free. But it was all my fault.
zh: &168 我以为我自由了。可那全是我的错。

en: &948 Fia? The names on that list. Known criminals, mafia types, government officials.
zh: &948 菲娅？名单上的那些名字。已知罪犯、黑帮分子、政府官员。

en: &949 Winera was a money laundering operation.
&169 I was a good cop, you know.
zh: &169 你知道，我以前是个好警察。

en: &170 Despite... everything. I was good at my job.
zh: &170 尽管……发生了那些事。我工作很出色。

en: &3469 Hanna. What are you not telling us?
zh: &3469 汉娜。你有什么事瞒着我们？

en: &171 They sent me there on PURPOSE.
zh: &171 他们是故意派我去那儿的。

en: &172 They wanted to rub my FACE in it.
&950 Fia. The printouts. Page three.
&951 Tenth from the bottom.
&3470 Hanna. Your name is here.
&173 Amazing detective work.
&3471 Why is your name here?
zh: &3471 你的名字为什么会在这里？

en: &174 Why do you THINK?
&3472 You were a criminal?
&175 No. Absolutely not.
&3473 You took bribes?
&176 Yeah. Get the self-rightousness out of the way.
zh: &176 对。先把你的道德优越感放一边。

en: &3474 I'm not playing games. Tell me. Now.
zh: &3474 我没在跟你闹。告诉我。现在。

en: &177 You think it was easy? Being a cop in 2001? Looking like I do?
zh: &177 你以为容易吗？2001年当警察？长我这样？

en: &178 I had to play ball. I had to fit in.
&179 I couldn't act like I was better than everyone else.
zh: &179 我不能表现得好像自己比别人高一等。

en: &180 So I did what I was told. I cashed my check like everybody else.
zh: &180 所以我照吩咐办事。跟其他人一样拿钱。

en: &3475 A check from Winera.
&181 Must've been. All I knew it was from a shell company. Never bothered learning which one.
zh: &181 想必是。我只知道来自一家空壳公司。从没费心去查是哪家。

en: &182 Half my precinct was involved!
zh: &182 我半个分局都卷进去了！

en: &183 It's just how things were done.
&184 Taking money to look the other way...
zh: &184 拿钱然后睁一只眼闭一只眼……

en: &185 Occasionally. Not all the time. Just... occasionally.
zh: &185 偶尔。不是一直。只是……偶尔。

en: &3476 And Yvonne was investigating these bribes?
zh: &3476 伊冯娜当时在调查这些贿赂？

en: &3477 Is that why she was killed?
&3478 You should have told us about this.
&3479 If Yvonne was investigating these bribes, that could be why she was killed.
zh: &3479 如果伊冯娜在调查这些贿赂，那可能就是她被杀的原因。

en: &3480 There's more, isn't there?
&186 It wasn't relevant! This was supposed to be about Nick Chord and NOBODY ELSE.
zh: &186 那不相干！这事本该只跟尼克·科德有关，不涉及其他人。

en: &187 It wasn't supposed to lead to... this.
zh: &187 本不该发展到……这个地步。

en: &3481 Lead to what? Us finding out?
zh: &3481 发展到什么地步？被我们发现？

en: &188 She... confronted me. Told me what she found.
zh: &188 她……找我对质。告诉我她查到了什么。

en: &189 I tried to warn her off. Begged her to stop.
zh: &189 我试着警告她别查了。求她收手。

en: &190 Then they sent me to the alley. Told me to mark it as unsolved and keep it that way.
zh: &190 然后他们派我去那条巷子。让我把它标为悬案，并且保持那样。

en: &191 They didn't tell me it was... her.
&3483 What.
&3485 You knew why she was killed this whole time?
zh: &3485 你一直都知道她为什么被杀？

en: &192 I never said I didn't know. I said there was no evidence.
zh: &192 我从没说过我不知道。我说的是没有证据。

en: &3486 Blasting semantics.
&952 Jesus Christ. Fia, don't bother.
&953 The mission is scrubbed. Bring her back to the landing point.
zh: &953 任务取消。带她回跃迁落点。

en: &193 Huh? Wait a second-
&954 I don't want to hear it.
&955 You lied to us, Ms. Tanaka. You abused our time, our resources, and our patience.
zh: &955 你骗了我们，田中女士。你浪费了我们的时间、资源和耐心。

en: &956 We're done.
&194 No. You can't do that. Yvonne is going to die!
zh: &194 不。你们不能这样。伊冯娜会死的！

en: &957 She's already dead.
&958 Get back here. Now.
&3487 The door is that way.
&3488 You heard the man.
&3489 Out. Now.
&196 Please. You don't understand.
&3490 We don't have to. Let's go.
&3504 Remember. No killing.
&219 Jesus. I'm not some trigger-happy greenhorn.
zh: &219 天哪。我又不是个爱开枪的菜鸟。

en: &3505 How much do you know about him, anyway?
zh: &3505 话说回来，你对他了解多少？

en: &220 Enough to know I want to stay here for as little as possible.
zh: &220 足够让我想在这儿尽量少待。

en: &3506 Be careful, Hanna.
&221 You're forgetting who you're talking to.
&222 Just let me do the talking, okay?
&2 Yeah?
&223 Good evening, sir. Are you Nick Chord?
zh: &223 晚上好，先生。你是尼克·科德吗？

en: &3 That's me.
&224 Good to know.
&3507 I thought you said you'd be TALKING.
&225 My fist said plenty.
&3508 Are you satisfied?
&226 Bastard went down like a sack of bricks.
zh: &226 那混蛋像一袋砖头一样倒下了。

en: &227 Who knew he had such a glass jaw?
&3509 Was that... a bit extreme?
&228 Considering what this guy's gonna spend the next fifty years doing?
zh: &228 想想这家伙接下来五十年要干的事？

en: &230 Now get in here before someone sees us.
zh: &230 趁没人看见我们，快进来。

en: &231 And find something to restrain him with.
zh: &231 再找点东西把他绑起来。

en: &232 There. All tucked in.
&233 He's not going anywhere.
&3510 Well Noz? What's the verdict?
&6017 Checking...
&234 Well?
&961 It looks like there were a few ripples, but only marginal ones.
zh: &961 看起来有几道涟漪，但都很轻微。

en: &235 Marginal?
&962 Meaning nothing worth mentioning has changed.
zh: &962 意思是没什么值得一提的变化。

en: &963 Yvonne Lozzotti is still found murdered in that alley.
zh: &963 伊冯娜·洛佐蒂还是被发现死在那条小巷里。

en: &964 I'm sorry to tell you this, Detective, but we might have the wrong guy.
zh: &964 很抱歉告诉你，警探，我们可能抓错人了。

en: &236 That's... that's impossible.
&237 I don't understand.
&3511 Are you absolutely sure that we have the right man?
zh: &3511 你绝对确定我们抓对人了吗？

en: &239 Positive.
&240 He CONFESSED. He knew Yvonne's name. He knew the alley where she was killed. He knew exactly where on the body the bullets were...
zh: &240 他认罪了。他知道伊冯娜的名字。他知道她遇害的那条小巷。他甚至知道子弹打在身体的哪个位置……

en: &241 But... he was over 80 years old when he made that confession. People get confused at that age, even with the Anderson treatments.
zh: &241 可是……他招供时已经八十多岁了。就算有安德森疗法，那个年纪的人也会犯糊涂。

en: &3512 Maybe there was another killer? An accomplice?
zh: &3512 会不会有另一个凶手？共犯？

en: &242 It's... possible?
&243 He always bragged about working alone, but maybe he was lying?
zh: &243 他总吹嘘自己单干，但也许是在撒谎？

en: &3513 Maybe Nick escapes after we leave here?
zh: &3513 也许尼克在我们离开后逃走了？

en: &244 It's... possible. Old t-shirts aren't exactly police-issue restraints.
zh: &244 这……有可能。旧T恤可不是警用约束带。

en: &3514 Easy enough to make sure. We stay here. Make sure he doesn't go anywhere.
zh: &3514 要确认很简单。我们留在这里，确保他哪儿也去不了。

en: &245 But if we're wrong? And someone else kills Yvonne instead?
zh: &245 可万一我们错了呢？结果另有人杀了伊冯娜？

en: &246 Blast it all. There's only one way to be completely sure.
zh: &246 真该死。只有一个办法能彻底确认。

en: &247 We need to kill him.
&248 Come ON. If we kill him and Yvonne lives, we know we've got the right guy.
zh: &248 拜托。如果我们杀了他，伊冯娜还活着，就说明我们抓对了人。

en: &966 And if she doesn't, we killed an innocent man.
zh: &966 可如果她没活下来，我们就杀了一个无辜的人。

en: &249 Innocent? Please. Don't tell me history is better off with this guy breathing.
zh: &249 无辜？得了吧。别告诉我历史留着这家伙喘气会更好。

en: &967 That's not up to us. We are not killing him.
zh: &967 那不由我们决定。我们不能杀他。

en: &250 Then what do you SUGGEST?
&968 Let me check the ripples. Maybe there's a clue there.
zh: &968 让我查查涟漪。也许那里有线索。

en: &969 Stand by.
&4 Grooooaaaaann.
&5 What the...
&6 Hey! Who the hell are you? What's going on?
zh: &6 嘿！你们他妈是谁？怎么回事？

en: &7 Help! Somebody help!
&251 Oh for-
&252 Shut your mouth or I'll shut it for you.
zh: &252 闭上你的嘴，不然我帮你闭。

en: &253 Don't worry. I'm not gonna fire. YET.
zh: &253 别担心。我还没打算开枪。暂时。

en: &254 Figure out if we've got the right guy. Quickly. Before I forget my years of training.
zh: &254 快确认我们有没有抓对人。趁我还没忘掉多年的训练。

en: Nick Chord's apartment
&3515 Not tonight at least.
&255 Blast it.
&3516 Not tonight at least. He sleeps until morning, according to his future self.
zh: &3516 至少今晚不会。据未来的他说，他会一觉睡到天亮。

en: &256 We can't wait that long.
&3517 We better hope so.
&257 Yeah yeah. Impact Rankings.
&258 Grah.
&259 What's the god damn POINT.
&260 Even if we catch this second guy, what if there's a third?
zh: &260 就算我们抓到了这第二个家伙，万一还有第三个呢？

en: &261 This is pointless.
&970 Ms. Tanaka, if I may?
zh: &970 田中女士，能让我说一句吗？

en: &971 You're treating this like a murder to be solved. You're forgetting something important.
zh: &971 你把这当成一桩待破的谋杀案。你忘了一件重要的事。

en: &972 There's no murder yet. Yvonne isn't dead. Why don't you focus on HER?
zh: &972 现在还没有谋杀。伊冯娜还没死。你为什么不多关注她本人？

en: &263 Huh? What do you mean?
&3518 We can find her and warn her of what's going to happen.
zh: &3518 我们可以找到她，警告她即将发生的事。

en: &264 If she doesn't call the looney bin on us.
zh: &264 除非她不把我们当疯子送进精神病院。

en: &3519 We can protect her. Stop the murderer when he attacks.
zh: &3519 我们可以保护她。在凶手动手时阻止他。

en: &265 If she'd even let us.
zh: &265 如果她肯让我们保护的话。

en: &3520 We can hide her. Get her out of town.
zh: &3520 我们可以把她藏起来，带她离开这座城市。

en: &266 Make her leave Manhattan? That girl wouldn't even go to Brooklyn.
zh: &266 让她离开曼哈顿？那姑娘连布鲁克林都不肯去。

en: &267 But... if we could stop it just for tonight...
zh: &267 可是……如果我们能阻止今晚的事……

en: &268 Yeah. Yeah that will work. Just for tonight. Tomorrow it won't matter.
zh: &268 对。对，那样就行。就今晚。明天就无所谓了。

en: &3521 Won't matter?
&269 You DO know what's gonna happen tomorrow, right?
zh: &269 你确实知道明天会发生什么，对吧？

en: &270 Anyway, Yvonne lives with her husband over on Jane Street.
zh: &270 总之，伊冯娜和她丈夫住在简街。

en: &271 Let's go save her ass.
New location:[Lozzotti Residence[Jane Street
zh: 新地点：[洛佐蒂住所[简街

en: Female voice
Em
&101 Hey Yvonne. It's Em. Haven't heard from you but I assume we're still having drinks tonight? Windows on the World. 8pm. I'll be there with bells on.
zh: &101 嘿，伊冯娜，我是埃姆。一直没收到你的消息，不过我想我们今晚还是照旧去喝一杯吧？世界之窗餐厅，晚上8点。我会准时到。

en: &272 Huh. Yvonne was at Windows on the World the night before she was killed?
zh: &272 嗯。伊冯娜被杀前一晚去世界之窗餐厅了？

en: &273 As last meals go, she could've done worse.
zh: &273 作为最后一餐，她本可以选个更差的地方。

en: &3224 You didn't know about this already?
&274 No. Should I have?
&3225 You said you came here looking for clues after the murder. You didn't play these messages then?
zh: &3225 你说过案发后来这里找过线索。当时你没听这些留言吗？

en: &275 Honestly? I don't remember.
&277 It's not like it would've mattered. Windows on the World was on the top floor of the North Tower.
zh: &277 反正也无所谓。世界之窗餐厅就在北塔顶层。

en: &3226 Fair point.
New Location:[World Trade Center[North Tower
&13 Leave. Winera. Alone. This is not a joke. Leave. Winera. Alone.
zh: &13 离维内拉远点。这不是玩笑。离维内拉远点。

en: &278 Winera?
&279 Who the hell is Winera?
&3690 Well, there's good news and bad news.
zh: &3690 嗯，有好消息也有坏消息。

en: &3691 Which would you like to hear first?
&280 It's painfully clear that you don't give a damn what I think.
zh: &280 你显然根本不在乎我怎么想。

en: &3692 Something we did changed history. Your history.
zh: &3692 我们做的事改变了历史。你的历史。

en: &281 Stop dancing and get to the point.
&3693 Have you done anything since I left you?
zh: &3693 我离开你之后，你做过什么吗？

en: &3694 Anything at all that could have changed history?
zh: &3694 任何可能改变历史的事情？

en: &282 No. I can barely TALK, thanks to you.
zh: &282 不。托你的福，我几乎说不出话了。

en: &283 Something happened, I assume?
&284 Spit it out already.
&3695 Your friend Yvonne. She will survive the night after all.
zh: &3695 你的朋友伊冯娜。她终究会活过今晚。

en: &285 She... does?
&286 You're SURE?
&3697 I spoke to her myself. Or rather, I WILL speak to her. Two months from today.
zh: &3697 我亲自跟她谈过。或者说，我将会跟她谈。就在两个月后的今天。

en: &287 Okay. OKAY.
&288 That's... something.
&289 The rest of it? Not so good. But... I'm okay with it. It's for the best.
zh: &289 其他的？就不怎么样了。不过……我能接受。这样最好。

en: &290 That's... that's good. Isn't it?
&292 Whatever. Doesn't matter.
&293 Thank you. Whatever you did to save her, thank you.
zh: &293 谢谢你。不管你做了什么救了她，谢谢你。

en: &3698 There's no way to put this delicately.
&3699 Your younger self is going to die tomorrow.
&3700 And because of the date in question, your PFE isn't going to stop the... effects.
zh: &3700 而且因为那个特殊的日子，你的PFE无法阻止……那些影响。

en: &294 She's... I'm... what? How?
&3701 I'm sorry. Somehow, you end up in the World Trade Center when... it happens.
zh: &3701 我很抱歉。不知怎的，你最后会出现在世贸中心，当……事情发生时。

en: &295 That makes no sense. I wasn't anywhere near downtown that morning.
zh: &295 这说不通。那天早上我根本不在市中心附近。

en: &296 Am I on a list of official victims?
zh: &296 我在官方遇难者名单上吗？

en: &1018 Checking... no. No, you're not.
&297 Then maybe your source is wrong. Maybe I die somewhere else. Like Yvonne did.
zh: &297 那也许你的消息来源有误。也许我死在别处。就像伊冯娜那样。

en: &298 Jesus. Listen to me. "Maybe I die somewhere else."
zh: &298 天哪。听听我说的。“也许我死在别处。”

en: &299 Sorry. This is a lot to process.
&300 At least Yvonne lives. I think... it's for the best.
zh: &300 至少伊冯娜活下来了。我想……这样最好。

en: &3702 I didn't save Yvonne. Not intentionally.
zh: &3702 我没有救伊冯娜。不是有意的。

en: &3703 The truth is, I have no idea how it happened.
zh: &3703 说实话，我也不知道是怎么回事。

en: &301 So what? It still happened. Or should I say, it isn't going to happen?
zh: &301 那又怎样？反正已经发生了。或者我该说，不会发生了？

en: &302 Anyway sometimes a case just solves itself.
zh: &302 反正有时候案子自己就解决了。

en: &303 Someone has to take the credit. Might as well be you.
zh: &303 总得有人领功。不如就你吧。

en: &3704 Just what do you mean by "it's for the best?"
zh: &3704 你说“这样最好”是什么意思？

en: &304 I mean... Yvonne lives. I die. It's a fair trade. I'm okay with that.
zh: &304 我是说……伊冯娜活下来。我死。公平交易。我能接受。

en: &3705 Hanna. We're going to do everything in our power to save you.
zh: &3705 汉娜。我们会尽一切努力救你。

en: &305 You are? But I thought... because I...
zh: &305 你们会吗？但我以为……因为我……

en: &306 I lied to you. Screwed everything up.
zh: &306 我骗了你。把一切都搞砸了。

en: &307 Why would you help me?
&3706 Do you know the name "Tanner"?
zh: &3706 你知道“坦纳”这个名字吗？

en: &308 Tanner? Why?
&3707 Nick Chord's confession changed again. He mentioned the name as someone who was given his assassination job.
zh: &3707 尼克·科德的供词又变了。他提到这个名字，说暗杀任务交给了这个人。

en: &309 Tanner...?
&310 It couldn't be...
&311 Could it?
&3708 Couldn't be who?
&312 Tanner. It was MY name. Or at least, the name I used back then.
zh: &312 坦纳。那是我的名字。至少，是我当时用的名字。

en: &3709 You used a false name?
&313 Not officially. It was just the name I used sometimes. It just made things easier, you know?
zh: &313 不算正式的。只是我有时会用那个名字。这样会方便一些，你懂吧？

en: &3710 Easier.
&314 It was hard enough being the only female Asian cop around. Correcting everyone who mispronounced my name was a hassle I didn't need.
zh: &314 作为当时唯一的亚裔女警，已经够难了。还要纠正每个念错我名字的人，我可不想找那个麻烦。

en: &315 So I used the whitest name I could think of that was similar to my own.
zh: &315 所以我就用了一个我能想到的、跟我本名最像的最白人化的名字。

en: &316 Everyone did it back then. At least, you did if you looked like me.
zh: &316 那时候大家都这么干。至少，长得像我这样的人会这么干。

en: &3711 You didn't think to tell us this before now?
zh: &3711 你之前怎么没想过告诉我们这件事？

en: &1019 Again?
&317 I swear, I'd forgotten all about it. I only used that for my first year or two as a beat cop.
zh: &317 我发誓，我早就忘得一干二净了。我只在当巡警的头一两年用过那个名字。

en: &318 When I made detective, I decided that it could be everyone ELSE'S problem from now on. Not mine.
zh: &318 等我升了警探，我就决定，从今往后，这该是别人的问题了。不是我的。

en: &319 Haven't thought about it since.
zh: &319 从那以后就再也没想过。

en: &3712 Is Nick referring to you in this confession?
zh: &3712 尼克在这份供词里指的是你吗？

en: &320 No chance in hell. I didn't even KNOW Nick.
zh: &320 绝无可能。我根本不认识尼克。

en: &321 Unless... that somehow changed too?
&322 No. I was asked to do a lot of things. But kill? Never. They wouldn't.
zh: &322 不。他们让我做过很多事。但杀人？从来没有。他们不会的。

en: &323 And even if they did, I never would have agreed to kill HER. Not Yvonne.
zh: &323 就算他们真让我杀，我也绝不会同意杀她。伊冯娜不行。

en: &3713 What about killing someone else?
&3714 This confession doesn't refer to killing Yvonne, but Imani.
zh: &3714 这份供词说的不是杀伊冯娜，而是伊曼妮。

en: &324 I don't even know this Imani person.
zh: &324 我根本不认识这个叫伊曼妮的人。

en: &325 And is she even dead? That confession only says she was a target. Not that she was killed.
zh: &325 而且她真的死了吗？那份供词只说她是目标，没说她已经死了。

en: &326 Get your facts straight before accusing me of anything!
zh: &326 在指责我之前，先把事实搞清楚！

en: &3715 We're not accusing YOU, Hanna. At least, not this version of you.
zh: &3715 我们不是在指责你，汉娜。至少，不是这个版本的你。

en: &327 Semantics. Come back with proof.
&3716 You don't remember anything? Anything at all that can help us?
zh: &3716 你什么都不记得了吗？任何能帮到我们的事？

en: &328 I remember lots of things. Apparently none of them actually happened.
zh: &328 我记得很多事。但显然，它们都没真正发生过。

en: &1020 As you get closer to midnight, your PFE will get weaker. There may be some memory bleedthrough.
zh: &1020 越接近午夜，你的PFE就会越弱。可能会出现一些记忆渗透。

en: &329 So we wait until midnight?
&1021 We could, but the longer we wait, the less likely we'll be able to stop this from happening.
zh: &1021 可以，但我们等得越久，就越不可能阻止这件事发生。

en: &330 Good. Being proactive is always the best way.
zh: &330 好。主动出击永远是最好的办法。

en: &331 But if I get any... whaddayacallit, memory bleedthrough? I'll tell you.
zh: &331 但如果我出现……那叫什么来着，记忆渗透？我会告诉你们的。

en: &3717 Do you remember where your younger self is right now?
zh: &3717 你记得你年轻时的自己现在在哪里吗？

en: &332 I would've just come on shift, so...
&333 Somewhere in Chelsea?
zh: &333 是在切尔西的某个地方吗？

en: &3718 That's over twenty square blocks. Any way to narrow that down?
zh: &3718 那可是二十多个街区。有办法缩小范围吗？

en: &334 Jesus. It's been 60 years.
&335 It's not like I kept a minute by minute breakdown of every shift I went on.
zh: &335 我又不是每次出任务都记了逐分钟的详细记录。

en: &1022 And even if she did, things have obviously changed. We can't trust her memory of events.
zh: &1022 就算她记了，事情显然已经变了。我们不能相信她对事件的记忆。

en: &336 Sure. Come see me whenever. I'm not going anywhere.
zh: &336 当然。随时来找我。我哪儿也不去。

en: give hanna archive.
&337 Oh. One thing...
&338 Could you give me archive access while I'm in here?
zh: &338 我在这里的时候，能给我档案访问权限吗？

en: &339 I'd like to do some research. See if anything changed that I don't remember.
zh: &339 我想做些研究。看看有没有什么我不记得的变化。

en: &1023 You think that'll help?
&340 Couldn't hurt. It's not like I'm good for much else right now.
zh: &340 没坏处。反正我现在也做不了别的。

en: &1024 I don't know...
&341 You really think I'm going to screw you over? With my entire EXISTENCE at stake?
zh: &341 你真觉得我会坑你？在我整个存在都岌岌可危的时候？

en: &1025 Put like that? Fair enough.
&1026 Giving you archive access now.
zh: &1026 现在给你档案访问权限。

en: &342 Got it. I'll get to work.
&343 And... thanks.
&344 Wait. Sorry. One more question?
zh: &344 等等。抱歉。还有一个问题？

en: &345 Yvonne. What happens to her?
zh: &345 伊冯娜。她后来怎么样了？

en: &346 Does she have a good life?
&1027 I can't say one way or the other.
&1028 But she's still alive.
&1029 Currently living in the south of France with a cluster of four.
zh: &1029 目前住在法国南部，和一个四人伴侣组一起。

en: &347 So she had a whole life. And I wasn't around for any of it.
zh: &347 所以她过了一辈子。而我完全没参与。

en: &348  *Sigh*
&349 God. What a mess.
&3720 We still don't know why this happened.
zh: &3720 我们还是不知道为什么发生这种事。

en: &3721 It could be our fault.
&3722 Do you really think so little of us?
zh: &3722 你真就这么看不起我们？

en: &3723 We're not going to leave you like this. Not while we can still save you.
zh: &3723 我们不会就这样丢下你。只要还能救你，我们就不会放弃。

en: &3724 You made a mistake. A big one. No question.
zh: &3724 你犯了个错。大错。毫无疑问。

en: &350 But what I did...
&1030 Was wrong.
&1031 But the punishment should fit the crime. And this isn't it.
zh: &1031 但惩罚应该与罪行相称。而这并不是。

en: &351 I was pretty great at my job, you know? Despite everything.
zh: &351 我工作其实很出色，你知道吗？尽管发生了那些事。

en: &352 I did a lot of good. Stopped a lot of nasty people.
zh: &352 我做了很多好事。阻止了很多坏人。

en: &353 The thought of all of that just... never happening.
zh: &353 一想到这一切……从未发生过。

en: &354 I don't want that. So whatever it takes, I'll do it.
zh: &354 我不想要那样。所以无论需要付出什么，我都会去做。

en: &809 But either way, her voices matches the one on the Lozzotti's answering machine.
zh: &809 但不管怎样，她的声音和洛佐蒂家答录机里的那个声音一样。

en: &199 Okay. What's going on.
&2669 I probably should go.
&2672 Know what?
&2673 Isn't that what "Em" is short for?
zh: &2673 “埃姆”不就是那个名字的简称吗？

en: &2675 Well, I'm not most people.
&200 Look, leave if you're gonna.
&201 I've got a drink to finish.
&2676 Smooth, Quinn. Reeeeal smooth.
&209 Oh hi there.
&3952 Could I sit down?
&210 That's pretty bold.
&3953 Can we try again?
&211 Again? You mean you were trying the first time?
zh: &211 再试一次？你是说第一次你是在尝试？

en: &3954 Buy you another drink?
&212 And here I thought I was the forward one.
zh: &212 我还以为我才是主动的那个。

en: &7129 Right. Sorry.
&213 Oh will you RELAX.
&214 That chair is in need of someone's butt. Yours fits as well as any.
zh: &214 那把椅子正需要个屁股坐上去。你的屁股跟别人的一样合适。

en: &3955 Yes. Well. Thanks. I think.
&215 So. What drew you back?
zh: &215 那么，是什么把你又吸引回来的？

en: &216 Last time you were here, you were more interested in Yvonne.
zh: &216 上次你来的时候，你对伊冯娜更感兴趣。

en: &3956 Ah. Sorry about that.
&217 Heh. I bet you are.
&3957 I'm more interested in you.
&218 That right? What changed?
&3958 It might've started that way, but things changed.
zh: &3958 可能一开始是那样，但后来变了。

en: &219 Changed, huh?
&220 Let me guess. You found her.
&3959 Sort of.
&221 I knew it. And she wouldn't give you the time of day.
zh: &221 我就知道。而她根本不搭理你。

en: &222 And now you're here, settling for second best.
zh: &222 所以现在你来了，退而求其次。

en: &3960 That's not it at all.
&223 Then what is it, then?
&3961 Yvonne's not all that great.
&224 That right?
&3962 Isn't me being here with you enough?
zh: &3962 我在这里跟你在一起，还不够吗？

en: &225 I dunno.
&226 Last time, you wouldn't stop talking about her.
&227 So now I can't stop thinking about her.
zh: &227 所以现在我不停地想着她。

en: &228 Who am I fooling. I'm sorry to waste your time.
zh: &228 我在骗谁呢。抱歉浪费你的时间。

en: &229 Before you got here, I was about ten seconds from going back to the office.
zh: &229 你来之前，我差十秒就要回办公室了。

en: &230 I should do that. Bury myself in the grind.
zh: &230 我应该回去。把自己埋进工作里。

en: &231 Okay. I wasn't expecting that.
&7130 That would be a very bad idea.
zh: &7130 那会是个非常糟糕的主意。

en: &233 My boss might say otherwise.
&234 But why?
&3963 Let's stay here.
&235 You want to keep this going?
&3964 Your company is a money laundering operation.
zh: &3964 你的公司是个洗钱组织。

en: &236 Operating on the 80th floor of the World Trade Center?
&237 Seems a bit far fetched, doesn't it?
zh: &237 听起来有点牵强，不是吗？

en: &238 Is that really the reason?
&3965 You'll be in danger if you go back.
&3966 Well. Someone else is. Technically.
zh: &3966 嗯。严格来说，是别人有危险。

en: &239 You're not making any sense.
&240 Is there... another reason you want me to stay?
zh: &240 是不是……还有别的原因想让我留下？

en: &3967 I'm having a nice time.
&241 Really? I'm being such a damn downer.
&242 Moaning about another girl. You don't want to listen to that.
zh: &242 一直在抱怨另一个女孩。你不想听这些的。

en: &3968 Let's talk about something else, then.
&243 Change of subject? Hm.
&244 Okay. How about we talk about... you?
&3969 I'm still here, aren't I?
&245 Yeah. You are.
&246 Last time, you couldn't get out of here fast enough. But now...
zh: &246 上次你恨不得马上离开。但现在……

en: &247 Tell me about yourself, Fia Quinn.
zh: &247 跟我说说你自己吧，菲娅·奎因。

en: &3970 I'm the one who brought her up. Made you think of her.
zh: &3970 是我提起她的。让你想起了她。

en: &248 Hm. I was already thinking of her, but I guess TALKING about her didn't help.
zh: &248 嗯。我本来就在想她，不过聊到她确实没帮助。

en: &249 So how about we talk about you instead?
&250 You already know a ton about me. Where I work. Who I dated. Who my great-grandmother was...
zh: &250 你已经很了解我了。我在哪儿工作。跟谁约会过。我曾祖母是谁……

en: &251 So. Make us even. Tell me about yourself.
zh: &251 所以，公平起见。跟我说说你自己。

en: &252 Your job. Your family. Your hobbies. Anything.
zh: &252 你的工作。你的家庭。你的爱好。什么都行。

en: &3971 I'm... nobody, really.
&253 Not true. For neither you or me.
zh: &253 不是的。你和我都不普通。

en: &254 Right now, we're at the top of the world.
&255 Anyone in New York looks up, they see us.
zh: &255 纽约任何人抬头，都能看到我们。

en: &256 That makes us the most important people in the city.
zh: &256 这让我们成为这座城市最重要的人。

en: &257 But you don't realize that, do you?
&258 All this... explains a few things.
zh: &258 这一切……解释了不少事情。

en: &259 So spill.
&3972 I... can't talk about my job.
&260 I can't decide if this "aura of mystery" thing you've got going on is doing it for me or not.
zh: &260 我拿不准你这副“神秘气质”到底合不合我胃口。

en: &261 But it does explain a few things.
zh: &261 但这确实解释了不少事情。

en: &262 So tell me something. Anything. Then we'll know for sure.
zh: &262 那告诉我点什么。什么都行。这样我们就清楚了。

en: &3973 I don't have any family.
&263 Oh. Jesus. I'm sorry.
&3974 Don't be. I never knew them.
zh: &3974 不用。我从来没见过他们。

en: &264 Still. It's sad.
zh: &264 即便如此，还是让人难过。

en: &265 Okay. Then... something else. Anything else.
zh: &265 好吧。那……说点别的。什么都行。

en: &3975 I don't have time for a lot of hobbies. My job keeps me busy.
zh: &3975 我没时间培养太多爱好。工作让我很忙。

en: &3976 And getting invested in things is... difficult.
zh: &3976 而且投入感情去喜欢什么……很难。

en: &266 Difficult. Why?
&3977 It just is.
&267 Hm. This explains a few things.
&268 Come on. Give me... something.
&7131 Explains what?
&269 Not yet. Come on. Try a bit harder.
zh: &269 还不到时候。来，再努力一点。

en: &270 Favorite music? Book? Work of art?
zh: &270 最喜欢的音乐？书？艺术品？

en: &3978 They keep changing.
&271 Huh? What do you mean?
&7132 Nothing. Never mind.
&272 If you mean that you can't decide on your favorite...
zh: &272 如果你是说拿不定最喜欢哪个……

en: &3979 None, none and none.
&273 I don't think that's true.
&274 I studied this stuff. You have a favorite. I can tell.
zh: &274 我研究过这些。你有最喜欢的。我看得出来。

en: &3980 I did. But it's gone now.
&275 Gone? What happened to it?
&3981 It's just gone.
&3982 I can't tell you. I wish I could.
zh: &3982 我不能告诉你。真希望我能。

en: &276 You know what? It's okay.
&277 Stuff like that can be personal. I get it.
zh: &277 这种事可能很私人。我理解。

en: &3983 If you must know, it was a painting of... me.
zh: &3983 如果你非要知道，那是一幅画……画的是我。

en: &278 Of you?
&3984 Silly, isn't it?
&279 Is that why you didn't want to tell me? Please.
zh: &279 这就是你不想告诉我的原因？拜托。

en: &280 Nothing to be ashamed of.
&281 Darn. Almost done with this.
&282 You know what?
&283 I'm sure I've seen a similar bottle of wine at a shop near my place.
zh: &283 我肯定在我家附近的商店见过一瓶类似的酒。

en: &284 You wanna... head over there? It's not far.
zh: &284 你想……去那边吗？离这儿不远。

en: &285 I promise I won't charge you 15 bucks a glass like they do here.
zh: &285 我保证不会像这里一样收你15美元一杯。

en: &3985 Are you... sure?
&286 As much as I can be sure of anything. Yeah.
zh: &286 我对任何事能有多确定，就有多确定。是的。

en: &3986 What will you charge me instead?
&287 Oh. I'm sure we can think of something.
zh: &287 哦。我相信我们能想出点什么。

en: &3987 So you're not going back to the office?
&288 Funny enough, there's something else I'd rather do.
zh: &288 说来有趣，我还有别的事更想做。

en: &289 Let me be as blatant as I can be.
&290 You. Me. My place. Take it or leave it.
zh: &290 你。我。我家。要么接受，要么拉倒。

en: &3988 Nozzo. Is this, um, allowed?
&1068 Ethically? Above my pay grade.
zh: &1068 道德上？这超出我的职权范围了。

en: &1069 But right now your priority now is to keep her from killing Hanna.
zh: &1069 但你现在首要任务是阻止她杀了汉娜。

en: &1070 So the protocol is to do whatever is necessary.
zh: &1070 所以协议要求不惜一切代价。

en: &1071 Protocol also says I enable privacy mode for when you-
zh: &1071 协议还要求我启用隐私模式，当你——

en: &3989 Yes yes. I understand.
&291 Well? This offer is good for a limited time only.
zh: &291 怎么样？这个提议只在有限时间内有效。

en: &3990 That... sounds nice.
&292 Nice? Oh honey, I've been called many things. That's never been one of them.
zh: &292 不错？哦亲爱的，我被叫过很多称呼。还从没被叫过不错。

en: &293 Let's go.
&3991 I'm... not sure.
&294 Tell you what. How about a walk? I could use the company.
zh: &294 这样吧。去散个步怎么样？我想有人陪。

en: &295 No pressure or promises. Sound good?
zh: &295 没有压力，也不做承诺。听起来好吗？

en: &3992 Sounds good.
&296 Then let's go.
&7133 This again?
&297 Again?
&7134 Er. Never mind.
&298 Look, I'll go first.
&3994 Any particular reason you want to know?
zh: &3994 你有什么特别的原因想知道吗？

en: &299 Not really. I'll go first.
&3995 You first.
&300 Okay, okay.
&301 Last thing I want to do is put you off.
zh: &301 我最不想做的就是让你扫兴。

en: &302 I'm... glad you're here.
&303 It's the weirdest thing. It's hard to explain. It's like...
zh: &303 这是最奇怪的事。很难解释。就像……

en: &304 Like I just had a really close call?
&305 Maybe you're my good luck charm.
&3996 Oh, you have no idea.
&306 Is that a threat or a promise?
&3997 I wouldn't go THAT far...
&307 Why? Just how far did you plan on going?
zh: &307 为什么？你原本打算走多远？

en: &3998 I think I may be the lucky one.
zh: &3998 我觉得我可能才是幸运的那个。

en: &308 You bet your ass you are.
&309 Well. Anyway. I promised you decent wine.
zh: &309 好吧。总之。我答应过给你好酒。

en: &310 My favorite shop is thisaway.
&311 Come on.
&4073 How long have you been standing there?
&312 Not long. I was behind the door.
zh: &312 没多久。我刚才在门后面。

en: &7148 Are you all right?
&313 I'm all good. I was just behind the door.
zh: &313 我没事。我刚才就在门后面。

en: &4074 It's... good to see you.
&314 I wasn't far. I was just behind the door.
zh: &314 我没走远。我刚才就在门后面。

en: &315 Heard voices. Couldn't understand much, but when they stopped I figured it was OK to come out.
zh: &315 听到有说话声。听不太清，但声音停了，我就想可以出来了。

en: &316 Everything IS okay, right?
&4075 Yes. Everything's okay.
&4076 Yes. The danger has passed.
&4077 Yes. It's all over.
&4078 You're safe now, Imani.
&317 "Imani." I don't know anybody who still calls me that.
zh: &317 “伊曼妮。” 我不知道还有谁这么叫我。

en: &7149 Sorry.
&318 Don't be. Truth is, I kinda like the way you say it.
zh: &318 别道歉。说实话，我挺喜欢你这么叫我的。

en: &4079 Maybe it's my accent.
&319 What accent?
&320 Hah. Your face.
&4080 I like your name.
&321 I like yours, too. Fia. Ffffia.
zh: &321 我也喜欢你的。菲娅。菲——娅。

en: &322 Okay. Now you're making it weird.
zh: &322 好吧。现在你搞得有点怪了。

en: &323 But you know what I really like?
zh: &323 但你知道我真正喜欢什么吗？

en: &324 The way you saved me. That was pretty cool.
zh: &324 你救我的方式。那挺酷的。

en: &1087 Okay, Fia. Hanna's all sorted. She...
zh: &1087 好了，菲娅。汉娜都安排好了。她……

en: &1088 Okay, Fia. I've handled the police. They...
zh: &1088 好了，菲娅。警察那边我处理好了。他们……

en: &1091 Shore leave, then? I can desync for, say... seven hours?
zh: &1091 那上岸休假？我可以脱同步，比如……七个小时？

en: &1092 I need comfirmation, Fia. Liability and all.
zh: &1092 我需要确认，菲娅。责任什么的。

en: &1093 Good enough. I'll resync in seven hours.
zh: &1093 行吧。我七小时后重新同步。

en: &1094 Er. Bye.
&4084 Good morning.
&325 Mmm. Morning.
&4085 Sleep well?
&326 There wasn't a lot of sleeping, as you might recall.
&4086 Sorry to wake you.
&327 Didn't get a lot of sleep anyway. As you might recall.
zh: &327 反正也没怎么睡。你应该记得。

en: &328 You leaving?
&4087 Yes. Sorry.
&329 What time is it?
&4088 Around seven twenty.
&330 Oh good. Ten minutes before I have to get up.
zh: &330 哦，好。还有十分钟才起床。

en: &4089 Get up? What for?
&4090 You have plans?
&4091 What's the hurry?
&331 The daily grind. Gotta get to the office.
&4092 Your office. In the World Trade Center.
zh: &4092 你的办公室。在世贸中心。

en: &332 That's the one. Need to hit the R train by 8 or I'll never get a seat.
zh: &332 就是那个。得在8点前赶上R线，否则永远没座位。

en: &333 But for now... *yawn*
&4093 Maybe... you could stay in?
&334 Stay in?
&4094 Maybe you could... take the day off?
&335 The day off?
&4095 Maybe you could... spend the day with me instead?
&336 Spend the day with you? Hm..
&337 Tempting. I really wish I could, but New York rent doesn't pay itself.
zh: &337 很诱人。我真希望可以，但纽约的房租不会自己付。

en: &338 You wanna meet up after work? Windows on the World again?
zh: &338 下班后见面吗？还是“世界之窗餐厅”？

en: &4097 Sure. That sounds...
&7150 Sure.
&339 Cool. It's a date.
&340 You can make some coffee if you want it.
zh: &340 想喝咖啡的话可以自己煮。

en: &341 Or just make me some. I won't say no.
zh: &341 或者给我煮一杯。我不会拒绝。

en: Em's apartment
&3801 Imani was targeted instead of Yvonne? How did that happen?
zh: &3801 伊曼妮成了目标，而不是伊冯娜？怎么会这样？

en: &1033 I don't know. There's nothing in the archive about Imani at all.
zh: &1033 我不知道。档案里完全没有伊曼妮的记录。

en: &3802 Does this name "Tanner" mean anything to you?
zh: &3802 “坦纳”这个名字对你有意义吗？

en: &1034 It's a pretty common name. It's been in use since the 12th century.
zh: &1034 很常见的名字。12世纪就有人用了。

en: &3803 Let me rephrase. Does it mean anything relevant to you?
zh: &3803 我换个问法。对你来说有什么相关的意义吗？

en: &1035 Oh. No. Sorry.
&3804 How could there be NO entry for Imani at all?
zh: &3804 怎么可能完全没有伊曼妮的记录？

en: &3805 It's impossible to exist in this day and age and not leave any kind of evidence.
zh: &3805 在这个时代生活不可能不留下任何痕迹。

en: &1036 I agree. There's nothing. Not even a social security number.
zh: &1036 我同意。什么都没有。连社保号都没有。

en: &1037 I think her whole file may have been redacted.
zh: &1037 我觉得她的整个档案可能被涂黑了。

en: &3806 Redacted? But that requires HUGE clearance, doesn't it?
zh: &3806 涂黑？但那需要极高的权限，不是吗？

en: &1038 More than we have, I'll say that much.
zh: &1038 比我们拥有的权限高得多，我只能这么说。

en: &3807 So many questions. So few answers. Going to go look for some.
zh: &3807 问题这么多。答案这么少。我要去找找答案。

en: &3434 Do you remember me?
&72 Hm. No. Sorry.
&73 Normally I'm good with faces, but it's been...
zh: &73 通常我很会记人脸，但已经……

en: &74 Well, you know.
&3435 I'm here to pick up Hanna Tanaka.
&75 Who?
&3436 A prisoner of yours. She was scheduled to be released today.
zh: &3436 你们的一名囚犯。她原定今天获释。

en: &76 Doesn't ring a bell. You sure you got the right place?
zh: &76 没印象。你确定没找错地方？

en: &3437 I am sure, yes.
&77 Sorry. Nobody's scheduled to be released today, as far as I know.
zh: &77 抱歉。据我所知，今天没有人获释。

en: &3438 You arrested Hanna yourself. Two months ago?
zh: &3438 是你亲手逮捕汉娜的。两个月前？

en: &78 Two months ago. Jesus.
&79 You might as well say last century.
&3439 You must remember her. Grey-haired Asian woman?
zh: &3439 你肯定记得她。灰头发的亚裔女人？

en: &3907 She punched you in the face outside the Village Eye?
zh: &3907 她在《村眼》外面打了你的脸？

en: &80 She did what at where now?
&4125 I was a witness. You had quite a nasty shiner.
zh: &4125 我是目击者。你当时眼睛青得厉害。

en: &81 I'm pretty sure I'd remember something like that.
zh: &81 我敢肯定这种事我会记得。

en: &82 You're probably confusing me with someone else.
zh: &82 你大概是把我跟别人搞混了。

en: &3442 If you're the desk officer, why are you out here?
zh: &3442 如果你是前台警官，为什么在外面？

en: &83 Someone's gotta pick this stuff up. Major pain, these things.
zh: &83 总得有人来拿这些东西。这些东西真麻烦。

en: &84 Damn it. Sorry. I shouldn't say that.
zh: &84 该死。抱歉。我不该这么说。

en: &85 Jesus. This is the last thing I should be complaining about.
zh: &85 天哪。这是我最不该抱怨的事。

en: &3443 The flowers are... a pain?
&86 Just forget I said that, okay?
&87 The world's gone crazy. I get it.
&88 Everyone's looking to us for answers. Problem is, we don't got any.
zh: &88 大家都指望我们给出答案。问题是，我们没有答案。

en: &89 We can't make all this go away, but we can accept some damn flowers.
zh: &89 我们没法让这一切消失，但我们可以收下这些该死的花。

en: &90 So that's what we'll do.
&91 Sorry. Don't mean to dump this on a total stranger.
zh: &91 抱歉。我不是有意跟一个完全陌生的人倒苦水。

en: &92 It's been... well, I don't gotta say, do I?
zh: &92 最近一直……唉，不用我说，对吧？

en: &7120 It's all right.
&3444 Are you sure you don't know Hanna Tanaka?
zh: &3444 你确定你不认识汉娜·田中吗？

en: &93 Pretty sure. Never heard that name before.
zh: &93 很确定。从没听过这个名字。

en: &94 Not personally, no. But I know the name.
zh: &94 私下不认识，但我知道这个名字。

en: &95 Just another one of our own who died that day.
zh: &95 只是又一个那天牺牲的我们自己人。

en: &3445 Was Hanna a first responder?
&96 No. Nothing like that.
&97 Tanner was murdered. Early that morning.
zh: &97 坦纳是被谋杀的。那天一大早。

en: &98 Not the only one killed in the line of duty that day, but she was the first.
zh: &98 不是那天唯一因公殉职的，但她是第一个。

en: &99 I guess you could say she beat the rush?
zh: &99 我猜你可以说她抢了个先？

en: Vicki has no filter.
&100 Jesus. Fucking hell. Sorry.
&101 Making jokes is all I can do sometimes.
zh: &101 有时候我只能开开玩笑。

en: &3446 Hanna Tanner was murdered? How? By who?
zh: &3446 汉娜·坦纳是被谋杀的？怎么？被谁？

en: &102 Can't say much. Things were a little... busy around that time. You can imagine why.
zh: &102 不能多说。那阵子事情有点……忙乱。你能想象为什么。

en: &103 I didn't hear about it till weeks later. By then the killer was in jail.
zh: &103 我几周后才听说。那时凶手已经进监狱了。

en: &104 Justice served. Scales balanced. Thin blue line remains unbroken. Yadda yadda.
zh: &104 正义得到伸张。天平平衡。蓝色防线坚不可摧。诸如此类。

en: &105 That's all I can say.
&3447 Do you know another Hanna Tanaka? An officer, like yourself?
zh: &3447 你认识另一个汉娜·田中吗？一个警官，像你一样？

en: &106 Like I said, I never heard of that name before.
zh: &106 我说过了，我从没听过这个名字。

en: &107 Er. You're gonna have to be a bit more specific than that.
zh: &107 呃。你得说得更具体一点。

en: &3448 Could I go inside and ask the desk officer?
zh: &3448 我能进去问问前台警官吗？

en: &108 The desk officer would be me.
&109 And like I said, we don't have anyone named Hanna Tanaka locked up here.
zh: &109 而且我说过了，我们这里没有关押叫汉娜·田中的人。

en: &3449 Can you tell me anything else about Hanna's murder? Anything at all?
zh: &3449 关于汉娜被谋杀的事，你还能告诉我什么吗？任何事都行？

en: &110 Gotta say. Usually it's US asking the questions.
zh: &110 不得不说。通常是我们问问题。

en: &111 Why are you so interested anyway? You think they got the wrong guy?
zh: &111 你为什么这么感兴趣？你觉得他们抓错人了？

en: &3450 I... have no idea. Forget I asked.
&112 Probably best for both of us if I do.
zh: &112 我最好还是忘了。对我们俩都好。

en: &3451 Do you have an Imani Nash here?
zh: &3451 你们这里有个叫伊曼妮·纳什的人吗？

en: &3452 Do you have an Imani Quentin here?
zh: &3452 你们这里有个叫伊曼妮·昆廷的人吗？

en: &3453 Do you have an Imani Finley here?
zh: &3453 你们这里有个叫伊曼妮·芬利的人吗？

en: &113 Now why on earth would you want to speak to her?
zh: &113 你究竟为什么要找她谈？

en: &3454 So she IS here?
&114 Okay. I'm trying to be nice, with everything that's going on. But enough is enough.
zh: &114 好吧。考虑到现在发生的一切，我一直尽量客气。但适可而止吧。

en: &115 Who are you? Who do you work for? And what do you want?
zh: &115 你是谁？你为谁工作？你想要什么？

en: &3455 I'm a friend of Imani's.
&116 And you're just visiting now?
&3456 I'm a friend of Hanna's.
&3457 I just want to find out what happened.
zh: &3457 我只想弄清楚发生了什么。

en: &117 We KNOW what happened.
&118 Something smells fishy.
&3458 Please. If you could just let me speak to her...
zh: &3458 拜托。如果你能让我跟她谈谈……

en: &119 You really want to rock the boat? Now?
&120 *Sigh* Damn it. Knew you vultures couldn't stay away forever.
zh: &120 *叹气* 该死。就知道你们这些秃鹫不会永远不出现。

en: &121 Fine. Show me your press badge and I'll call ahead to tell 'em your coming.
zh: &121 行。给我看看你的记者证，我就打电话通知他们你要来。

en: &3459 Sorry. Press badge?
&122 Yeah. You ARE with the press, right?
&123 I assume that's why you're asking all these questions?
zh: &123 我想这就是你问这些问题的原因？

en: &3460 Yes. Press. That's what I am.
&502 Good.
&3461 Er. No. I'm not press EXACTLY...
&124 Either you are or you aren't.
&3462 It doesn't matter if I'm press or not.
&125 For a prisoner like this? You bet your ass it does.
zh: &125 对这样的囚犯？你他妈说对了，当然重要。

en: &126 So show me your pass or stop wasting my time.
zh: &126 所以给我看你的证件，别浪费我时间。

en: &3464 Thank you officer. I'll be off now.
&129 Sure. See you around.
&130 Oh. Hey, a bit of advice?
&131 This is not a good time to be asking about cop killers.
zh: &131 现在不是打听杀警察的人的时候。

en: &132 The city's in love with us right now. We may not deserve it. Hell, I know for a fact we don't.
zh: &132 现在全城都爱我们。我们可能不配。见鬼，我知道我们确实不配。

en: &133 But... it is what it is.
&3465 I understand. Thank you.
&3522 Are you sure we've got the right prison?
zh: &3522 你确定我们找对监狱了吗？

en: &973 Manhattan Detention Complex. It says so right here.
zh: &973 曼哈顿拘留中心。这里写着呢。

en: &974 And besides. You saw her there yourself.
zh: &974 而且。你自己在那儿见过她。

en: &3523 Maybe she was transferred?
&975 If she was, there's no record of it.
zh: &975 如果被转移了，也没有任何记录。

en: &3524 Did something happen to her while she was in prison?
zh: &3524 她在监狱里出了什么事吗？

en: &3525 A fight? Or a heart attack? Anything?
zh: &3525 打架？还是心脏病？任何事？

en: &976 If anything happened, there'd be a record of it.
zh: &976 如果出了什么事，会有记录的。

en: &977 In fact, there's no record of her doing anything at all.
zh: &977 事实上，她什么记录都没有。

en: &3526 Is that normal?
&978 Even model prisoners get SOMETHING written about them. If only to say they were model prisoners.
zh: &978 即使是模范囚犯也会有些记录。哪怕只是说他们是模范囚犯。

en: &3527 What about her PFE? Can you track that?
&979 Been trying that since you got there.
zh: &979 你到那儿之后我一直在试。

en: &980 It's, um, gone.
&3528 Gone?
&981 That's what I said. Gone.
zh: &981 我就是这个意思。不见了。

en: &3529 Great. It's Joe Anderson all over again.
zh: &3529 好极了。又跟乔·安德森一样。

en: &982 No. Doctor Anderson only REMOVED his PFE. He didn't disable it. It still gave off a signal.
zh: &982 不。安德森医生只是摘掉了他的PFE。他没有让它失效。它仍然会发出信号。

en: &983 This one is just... gone. No signal at all. At least, not in your current when.
zh: &983 这个就是……不见了。完全没有信号。至少，在你当前的年代没有。

en: &3530 Not in my current when? So her PFE is still active back when I left her?
zh: &3530 不在我当前的年代？所以她的PFE在我离开她的那个年代仍然有效？

en: &984 Yeah. Behind a prison cell. For all the good that does us.
zh: &984 对。在监狱牢房后面。对我们来说一点用都没有。

en: &3531 So... any ideas?
&985 I'm pulling up the specs for the PFE. Maybe that'll tell us what could have caused this.
zh: &985 我在调取PFE的规格参数。也许能告诉我们是什么导致了这种情况。

en: &3532 And me?
&986 Until these ripples stabilize, I can't trust any of my data readings. But you've got eyes on the ground, as it were.
zh: &986 在这些涟漪稳定下来之前，我无法相信任何数据读数。但可以说，你就是我在现场的眼睛。

en: &3533 So you need me to look around. See if there are any other changes?
zh: &3533 所以你需要我四处看看。看看有没有其他变化？

en: &987 Yeah. Anything that can shed light on what's going on.
zh: &987 对。任何能说明当前状况的事情。

en: &3534 Okay. Keep in touch, Noz.
&988 We'll figure this out, Fia. I promise.
zh: &988 我们会弄清楚的，菲娅。我保证。

en: &1 Either you are or you aren't. If you want to work here, you gotta be straightforward.
zh: &1 你要么是，要么不是。如果你想在这里工作，就得直截了当。

en: &2 Not that it matters. The code's changed.
zh: &2 不过没关系。密码已经改了。

en: &3535 No. I don't work here.
&3 Just visiting, huh?
&4 No wonder they changed the code. Everyone handed that thing out like it was candy.
zh: &4 难怪他们改了密码。每个人都像发糖果一样把那个东西发出去。

en: &5 Dig the hat, by the way. Didn't Rachel wear that in last week's episode?
zh: &5 顺便说一句，帽子不错。上周那集里瑞秋戴的不就是这顶吗？

en: &6 Anyway. Misery loves company, so...
&7 If you'd like some of either, I'm here.
zh: &7 如果你想找点同病或者相怜，我就在这儿。

en: &3536 Why did they change the code?
&8 The boss has been obsessed with security ever since... well, you know.
zh: &8 老板对安全一直很执着，自从……嗯，你知道的。

en: &9 Took me forever to memorize the last one, too.
zh: &9 我花了很久才记住上一个密码。

en: &3537 So you work here? At the Village Eye?
zh: &3537 所以你在这里工作？在《村眼》？

en: &10 Only for a year or two, but this industry has a way of turning you into a grizzled vet fast.
zh: &10 只干了一两年，但这个行业很快就能把你变成老油条。

en: &11 Wait. No. Sorry. I'm supposed to be POSITIVE.
zh: &11 等等。不。抱歉。我应该积极一点。

en: &12 It's awesome! SO chill working here.
zh: &12 这里棒极了！在这里工作超级轻松。

en: &13 Everyone treats each other GREAT! You totally won't have any grey hairs after just six months.
zh: &13 大家都对彼此好极了！你干六个月绝对不会长白头发。

en: &14 There.
&15 Nobody can accuse me of not being a team player.
zh: &15 没人能说我没有团队精神。

en: &3538 Can anyone let us inside?
&16 Tried calling. Nobody's in.
&17 Most of the staff is freelance, and the full-timers rarely stumble in before noon.
zh: &17 大部分员工是自由职业者，全职员工很少在中午前晃进来。

en: &18 Lucky us.
&3539 Dion. Your... husband?
&19 EX-husband. And you know him?
&20 Who?
&3541 I believe you knew her as "Em?"
zh: &3541 我想你认识她时，她叫“埃姆”？

en: &21 Oh. HER.
&3542 ...Hanna. Hanna Tanaka?
&22 You know that name too?
&23 For such a big city, it can be really small sometimes.
zh: &23 这么大的城市，有时候也真小。

en: &24 Seems smaller than ever, now.
zh: &24 现在看起来比以往更小了。

en: &3543 About Dion...
&3544 Could we talk about about Dion Lozzotti?
zh: &3544 我们能谈谈迪翁·洛佐蒂吗？

en: &25 You know him too?
&26 Look. I'd REALLY prefer not talking about him?
&27 I treated him badly, I know. But I gotta be me.
zh: &27 我对他不好，我知道。但我得做我自己。

en: &28 But if you see him, tell him...
zh: &28 不过如果你见到他，告诉他……

en: &29 Oh never mind. He won't believe it anyway.
&3545 About Em...
&3546 Do you mind talking about Imani Finley?
zh: &3546 你介意谈谈伊曼妮·芬利吗？

en: &3547 Do you mind talking about Imani Nash?
zh: &3547 你介意谈谈伊曼妮·纳什吗？

en: &3548 Do you mind talking about Imani Quentin?
zh: &3548 你介意谈谈伊曼妮·昆廷吗？

en: &3549 You might know her as "Em."
zh: &3549 你可能认识她时，她叫“埃姆”。

en: &30 Jesus. You know her too?
&31 What exactly do you know?
&3550 I know you were, well, involved.
zh: &3550 我知道你们，呃，有过一段。

en: &32 Well, we all make mistakes.
&3551 Mistakes?
&33 Look. You're new here. You can't start asking questions like this until you've at least been through the door.
zh: &33 听着，你初来乍到。至少得先过了那道门，才能问这种问题。

en: &34 Can we drop it?
&3552 About Hanna...
&3553 I am looking into a police officer named Hanna Tanaka.
zh: &3553 我在调查一位名叫汉娜·田中的警官。

en: &35 You knew Hanna too?
&3554 Sort of, yes.
&36 Is this... official? Or personal?
&7121 Does it matter?
&37 Maybe it doesn't. Can't say much either way.
zh: &37 也许不重要。反正我也说不了什么。

en: &38 Hanna died on September 11th.
&39 There's nothing else that needs to be said.
&3555 Hanna... died?
&40 You didn't know?
&41 Shit. Sorry. I...
&42 Sorry. To tell you like this. That sucks. I'm sorry.
zh: &42 抱歉。这样告诉你。太糟了。我很遗憾。

en: &43 Jesus, Yvonne. Stop apologizing like it's your fault.
zh: &43 天哪，伊冯娜。别道歉了，又不是你的错。

en: &3556 What was Hanna doing there? She wasn't supposed to be.
zh: &3556 汉娜当时在那里做什么？她本不该出现在那里。

en: &3557 Never mind. Doesn't matter.
&3558 Do you remember where you were that night?
zh: &3558 你还记得那天晚上你在哪里吗？

en: &46 Home. Heard about it on the radio.
zh: &46 在家。从收音机里听到的。

en: &47 So I went outside, looked downtown, and... well.
zh: &47 于是我走到外面，望向市中心，然后……唉。

en: &48 You know the first thing that came into my head when I saw them?
zh: &48 你知道我看到它们时，脑子里冒出的第一个念头是什么吗？

en: &49 That it looked like two giant lit cigarettes.
zh: &49 看起来像两根巨大的点燃的香烟。

en: I couldn't describe them any other way.
zh: 我没法用别的说法来形容它们。

en: &50 Haven't picked up a smoke since.
zh: &50 从那以后我就再没抽过烟。

en: &3559 I'm sorry. You misunderstand. Do you remember where you were the night BEFORE?
zh: &3559 抱歉，你误会了。你还记得前一天晚上你在哪里吗？

en: &51 The night before? Why?
zh: &51 前一天晚上？为什么问这个？

en: &3560 You didn't have any plans that got changed? Or receive any mysterious phone calls telling you not to go somewhere?
zh: &3560 你有没有什么计划被改变了？或者接到过什么神秘电话，叫你别去某个地方？

en: &52 What a question. No. Nothing like that.
zh: &52 这问题真怪。没有。没那种事。

en: &53 Just a normal night. Met a girl for drinks. Got home around 2 am. Why?
zh: &53 就是个平常的夜晚。跟一个女孩喝了点酒。凌晨两点左右到家。怎么了？

en: &3561 So you had drinks with Em after all?
zh: &3561 所以你还是跟埃姆喝了酒？

en: &54 Hell no. Thank god for that.
&55 Look. I can't talk about this.
&56 Number one, I'm not allowed. And two, it's getting kind of personal.
zh: &56 第一，我不被允许。第二，这有点涉及隐私了。

en: &57 So... stop, please?
&58 Should it?
&3562 Don't know. Never mind.
&3563 Did you know that Hanna used a false name?
zh: &3563 你知道汉娜用了假名吗？

en: &59 For her job? Yeah, she mentioned it.
&60 Don't remember what it was. Why?
zh: &60 不记得是什么了。怎么了？

en: &3564 No reason. Never mind.
&3565 Hanna Tanaka was murdered.
&61 Yeah, I know.
&3636 You told me she died in the 9/11 attacks.
zh: &3636 你告诉过我她死于9·11袭击。

en: &62 No. I said she died on September 11th.
zh: &62 不。我说的是她死于9月11日。

en: &63 How'd you find out about that, anyway?
zh: &63 话说回来，你是怎么发现的？

en: &64 Everyone from my editor to the commissioner to the mayor threatened me with all sorts of sanctions if I said a word.
zh: &64 从我的编辑到局长再到市长，每个人都威胁我，要是我说出去一个字，就给我各种处分。

en: &3637 Can you tell me anything about Winera?
zh: &3637 你能告诉我关于维内拉的事吗？

en: &3638 Are you sure? Weren't you looking into it?
zh: &3638 你确定？你不是在调查吗？

en: &66 I said no.
&67 Leave it.
&68 Sure. Sure. See you around.
&69 Oh. I'm Yvonne, by the way.
zh: &69 哦，顺便说一句，我是伊冯娜。

en: &3640 Fia Qui....
&989 Yeah, I have no idea.
&990 Keep talking to her. Maybe she'll spill something.
zh: &990 继续跟她聊。也许她会说漏嘴。

en: &4231 Wait. Did you say Yvonne?
&70 Yeah?
&3673 You aren't Yvonne Lozzotti, by any chance?
zh: &3673 你该不会就是伊冯娜·洛佐蒂吧？

en: &71 Not for much longer.
&72 Wait. How do you know that name?
zh: &72 等等。你怎么知道这个名字？

en: &3674 Oh. I heard it from...
Yvonne
&73 Sure. Sure.
&7123 I have my ways.
&74 Yeah, cute.
&75 Do these "ways" involve a company called Winera of USA?
zh: &75 你的这些“办法”，是不是跟一家叫美国维内拉的公司有关？

en: &3725 Indirectly, yes.
&3726 I'm looking into Winera.
&76 And Hanna's murder is related?
zh: &76 那汉娜的谋杀案也有关联？

en: &3727 I believe so.
&3728 I just want to know what happened.
zh: &3728 我只想知道发生了什么。

en: &3729 Hanna. Winera. All of it.
zh: &3729 汉娜。维内拉。所有这一切。

en: &77 Wait. Winera is connected?
&78 I knew it. I frigging KNEW it.
zh: &78 我就知道。我他妈就知道。

en: &79 Okay. I'm not allowed to talk about that. But they didn't say I couldn't listen.
zh: &79 好吧。我不被允许谈论那件事。但他们没说我不能听。

en: &80 So. Tell me what you know.
zh: &80 所以，告诉我你知道些什么。

en: &3730 I know that Em worked in the Winera office.
zh: &3730 我知道埃姆在维内拉的办公室工作。

en: &81 Yeah. I thought she was a dead end. Claimed to know nothing.
zh: &81 是啊。我以为她是个死胡同。声称什么都不知道。

en: &82 Pegged her for a pretty face to make the place look legit.
zh: &82 我把她当成一个花瓶，用来让那地方看起来合法。

en: &83 I thought she was harmless. I thought wrong.
zh: &83 我以为她人畜无害。我想错了。

en: &3731 Hanna was taking bribe money.
&84 *Sigh*
&85 I knew as much. There wasn't any other reason to be on Winera's payroll.
zh: &85 我早就知道了。没有别的理由会出现在维内拉的工资单上。

en: &86 I asked her about it. She didn't confirm it, but didn't exactly deny it either.
zh: &86 我问过她这件事。她没有确认，但也没有否认。

en: &87 She begged me to leave it alone. Said it was dangerous.
zh: &87 她求我别管了。说那很危险。

en: &88 I thought she meant dangerous for ME.
