&4759 I wanted to do one thing. Just one thing. For myself.
zh: &4759 我想做一件事。就一件。为我自己。

en: &8054 *cough*
&4760 No. Not for myself.
&4761 For someone else.
&1381 I'll get an ambulance.
&1382 There are already several on their way.
zh: &1382 已经有好几辆在路上了。

en: &1383 I'll just flag one of them down.
&4762 Tried that. Doesn't work.
&4763 Sorry, Noz.
&1384 I don't get it, Fia. Why is she so important?
zh: &1384 我不明白，菲娅。她为什么这么重要？

en: &1385 You barely know her.
&4764 I WANTED to know her.
&4765 To give us both the chance.
&4766 She deserves that. We deserve that.
&1386 Was she worth losing your life over?
&4767 I didn't plan on dying when coming here.
zh: &4767 我来这里的时候没打算死。

en: &4768 It just kinda... *cough*.
&4769 Happened.
&1387 I... I don't know what to do here, Fia.
zh: &1387 我……我不知道该怎么办，菲娅。

en: &4770 Turn off my PFE.
&1388 What? But the rewinds...
&4771 Will stop. I know.
&4772 But it's okay.
&4773 I checked the archive. Imani lives.
zh: &4773 我查过档案了。伊曼妮活着。

en: &4774 Knowing that? It's okay. It's all okay.
zh: &4774 知道吗？没关系。一切都没关系。

en: &1389 If the rewinds stop, you die.
zh: &1389 如果回溯停止，你就会死。

en: &4775 I'll die anyway.
&1390 So we'll try again.
&4776 We've tried everything.
&1391 I won't do this. You can't ask me to do this.
zh: &1391 我不会这么做。你不能要求我这么做。

en: &4778 You're the only one who CAN do this.
zh: &4778 你是唯一能做到这件事的人。

en: &8055 Please.
&1392 We'll find another way. There's always another way.
zh: &1392 我们会找到别的办法。总会有别的办法。

en: &4779 We've tried them all.
&4780 Nothing works.
&4781 Trust me.
&1393 I can't, Fia.
&1394 I can't watch you die.
&4782 Then don't watch.
&8056 Please.
&1396 I'll go back and stop you.
&4783 You do and I'll never forgive you.
zh: &4783 你敢这么做，我永远不会原谅你。

en: &1397 I can live with that.
&4784 I'll come back and try again the first chance I get.
zh: &4784 我会一有机会就回来再试。

en: &4785 You know I will.
&1398 You can't know for sure if Imani will live.
zh: &1398 你无法确定伊曼妮会不会活下来。

en: &4786 Don't tell me you...
&8057 *cough*
&4787 ...are doubting the archive?
&1399 No! But another chrono-shift can take her away again.
zh: &1399 不！但另一次时空改写可能再次夺走她。

en: &4789 I know! This could all be for nothing!
zh: &4789 我知道！这一切可能都白费了！

en: &4788 Isn't that amazing?
&4790 Think of all the people we met. All through history.
zh: &4790 想想我们遇到的所有人。贯穿历史。

en: &4791 All following their dreams. Following their hearts.
zh: &4791 全都追随自己的梦想。追随自己的内心。

en: &4792 None of them knew if it would work out. None of THEM knew the future.
zh: &4792 他们中没有人知道会不会成功。他们中没有人知道未来。

en: &4793 But it didn't stop them from trying anyway.
zh: &4793 但这并没有阻止他们去尝试。

en: &4794 What makes us...
&8058 *cough*
&4795 ...so special?
&1401 Okay. OKAY.
&4796 Thank you, Nozzo.
&4797 It's been... incredible.
&6102 Yeah.
&4798 And for what it's worth?
&8052 *cough*
That's a wrap! Sally's final thoughts.
&6104 Nothing.
&237 Really.
&6105 Yeah.
&238 These paintings have a colorful history.
zh: &238 这些画作的历史可谓丰富多彩。

en: &239 We still don't know the name of the brave woman who sacrificed her life to rescue them. Her reasons will always remain a mystery.
zh: &239 我们至今仍不知道那位牺牲自己生命拯救它们的勇敢女性的名字。她的动机将永远是个谜。

en: &240 All we can do now is appreciate what she saved. And try to imagine what she saw.
zh: &240 我们现在能做的，就是珍惜她所拯救的一切。并试着想象她当时看到了什么。

en: &241 Do you really feel nothing?
zh: &241 你真的什么感觉都没有吗？

en: &1403 Was she happy?
&242 Sorry?
&1404 Fia. Was she happy?
&244 So you know.
&1405 That she faked her death? Yeah.
&1406 Fia always was a terrible liar.
zh: &1406 菲娅从来都不擅长撒谎。

en: &245 Hah! Isn't that the truth?
&246 It was her biggest regret, lying to you.
zh: &246 她最大的遗憾，就是对你撒了谎。

en: &247 If she realized that you knew all along...
zh: &247 如果她知道你一直都知道……

en: &248 Well, no point in dwelling.
&1407 So was she happy?
&249 Yes. We both were.
&250 As much as anyone can be.
zh: &250 在任何人所能及的范围内。

en: &1408 Thanks. That's all I wanted to know.
zh: &1408 谢谢。我想知道的就这些。

Breakdown Boys Gang[Dates of operation: 1852 - 1875 (estimated)[[Led by the mobster known as Eddie the Bear, the Breakdown Boys rose to become one of New York's most feared criminal organizations. As the kings of Manhattan's seaports, the "boys" raked in huge profits running brothels, protection rackets, drug rings and even murder-for-hire operations.[[
zh: 破坏男孩帮[活动时间：1852 - 1875（估计）[[由被称为“熊埃迪”的黑帮头目领导，破坏男孩帮崛起为纽约最令人恐惧的犯罪组织之一。作为曼哈顿海港的霸主，这些“男孩”通过经营妓院、收取保护费、贩毒甚至雇凶杀人赚取了巨额利润。[[

en: The identity of Eddie the Bear is still unknown, but it is estimated he died in the mid 1870s. Infighting over who should replace him led to the gang's power and influence weakening until the gang disappeared from the historical record by 1875.[[

"Ringcraft Review" interview transcript[April 23, 1921[-----------
Franklin Harrow: What would you say was the biggest highlight for you?
zh: 富兰克林·哈罗：您认为对您来说最大的亮点是什么？

en: Brian Mason: Jeeze, kid. EVERY time I stepped into that ring was a highlight to me. The cheers, the adrenaline... the rush of victory. Once you got a taste of that, you spend the rest of your life chasing it.
zh: 布赖恩·梅森：天哪，孩子。我每次踏入那个拳击台都是亮点。欢呼声、肾上腺素……胜利的冲动。一旦尝过那种滋味，你就会用余生去追逐它。

en: Franklin Harrow: Indeed, your first year was marked by victory after victory. You even made it to the championship match.
zh: 富兰克林·哈罗：确实，您的第一年以一场又一场的胜利为标志。您甚至打进了冠军赛。

en: Brian Mason: That was 50 years ago. Couldn't quite seal the deal. But that's okay.
zh: 布赖恩·梅森：那是50年前的事了。没能最终拿下。但没关系。

en: Franklin Harrow: Do you agree with the critics who said you were too predictable?
zh: 富兰克林·哈罗：您同意那些批评您太容易预测的说法吗？

en: Brian Mason: Maybe a little, but who cares? I boxed MY way, with all my heart and soul. Could I have switched things up? Sure. But in the heat of the match, I stuck to what I knew best. Didn't make me a winner, but it made me happy.
zh: 布赖恩·梅森：也许有一点，但谁在乎呢？我以我的方式打拳，全心全意。我本可以改变打法吗？当然。但在比赛白热化的时候，我坚持了我最擅长的。这没让我成为赢家，但让我快乐。

en: Franklin Harrow: That's a wonderful perspective. Thank you for sharing your story with us, Mr. Mason.
zh: 富兰克林·哈罗：这是一个很棒的观点。梅森先生，感谢您与我们分享您的故事。

en: Brian Mason: Thank you for keeping our history alive, son. Remember, it's not always about how many fights you win, but how you fight them that counts.
zh: 布赖恩·梅森：谢谢你让我们的历史保持鲜活，孩子。记住，重要的并不总是你赢了多少场比赛，而是你如何去打。

OBITUARY[[Evelyn Sherman passed away in the village of Jibhi on March 3, 2022, at the age of 70.[[Evelyn's early life was defined by sports of all kinds, and by the age of 22 she had become one of the era's most renowned stuntwomen. Her daring feats in films span the high-speed car chases of 1973's "Steel Siren" and the iconic rooftop jump of 1976's "Valkyrie Justice". en: By the mid-1980s, injuries accumulated during her stunt career forced her to retire. Most knew her as a quiet soul, often tending to her beloved garden and staying away from the spotlight; but Evelyn's appetite for adventure never waned. She turned her attention to exploring uncharted jungles and forests, discovering rare plant and animal species. Her many discoveries include the glintfrog, the amerwing prowler, and the peruvian fernstrider.[[
zh: 到 20 世纪 80 年代中期，特技生涯中积累的伤病迫使她退休。大多数人认为她是一个安静的人，经常照料她心爱的花园，远离聚光灯；但伊芙琳的冒险欲望从未消退。她将注意力转向探索未知的丛林和森林，发现了珍稀动植物物种。她的众多发现包括闪光蛙、美洲翼潜行者和秘鲁蕨行者。[[

en: On an expedition to the Himalayas, she selflessly saved two of her fellow travelers from a dangerous fall, carrying them several dozen miles to safety. Tragically, she contracted pneumonia and died a week later.[[
zh: 在一次前往喜马拉雅山的探险中，她无私地救了两名同伴，使他们免于危险坠落，并背着他们走了几十英里到达安全地带。不幸的是，她感染了肺炎，一周后去世。[[

en: She finished her life as she lived it: fearless, demanding perfection, and living out her passion for the unknown. She will be greatly missed, but not soon forgotten.
zh: 她以自己生活的方式结束了生命：无畏、追求完美，并活出了对未知的热情。人们将深深怀念她，但不会很快忘记。

Synthesis and Application of Quanmexlin for Neutralizing MorphaBite Poison
zh: 宽美克斯林的合成及其在解莫法比特毒中的应用

en: Quanmexlin is the only known antidote to MorphaBite, a poison that causes fatal solidification of stomach acid within 30 minutes. The synthesis of Quanmexlin involves the following steps:
zh: 宽美克斯林是已知唯一能解莫法比特毒的药物，该毒会在30分钟内导致胃酸致命性凝固。宽美克斯林的合成包括以下步骤：

en: 1. Extract a blood sample infected with MorphaBite. Expose this sample to Quansonic particles for several minutes to induce necessary changes.
zh: 1. 提取一份感染了莫法比特毒的血液样本。将该样本暴露于量声粒子数分钟，以诱导必要的变化。

en: 2. Mix equal parts sodium nitrate and buformin to create the base compound.
zh: 2. 将等量的硝酸钠和丁双胍混合，制成基础化合物。

en: 3. Inject the base compound into any type of young flora, such as a tree sapling or plant. This mixture will alter chemically as the plant grows.
zh: 3. 将基础化合物注入任何类型的幼小植物中，例如树苗或植株。随着植物生长，该混合物会发生化学变化。

en: 4. Allow the plant to mature for at least one decade. During this phytofusion period, the plant's biological processes will modify the mixture.
zh: 4. 让植物成熟至少十年。在此植物融合期间，植物的生物过程会改变混合物。

en: 5. Harvest the buds or leaves of the mature plant. When consumed, these plant parts will neutralize the MorphaBite poison effectively.
zh: 5. 收获成熟植物的芽或叶。食用这些植物部分将有效中和莫法比特毒。

en: This detailed process ensures the antidote's potency, providing a crucial countermeasure to MorphaBite's lethal effects.
zh: 这一详细过程确保了解毒剂的效力，为莫法比特的致命效果提供了关键对策。

en: &4931 Right. Blood sample. Sodium nitrate. Buformin. Phytofusion.
zh: &4931 对。血样。硝酸钠。丁双胍。植物融合。

en: &4932 All in less than thirty minutes.
zh: &4932 全部在不到三十分钟内完成。

en: Welcome to ChronoZen, where time travel is not just a service but a responsibility.[[In this manual, we'll guide you through the rules, regulations, and intricacies of navigating the temporal landscape. Please read carefully to ensure a smooth journey through time.
zh: 欢迎来到 ChronoZen，在这里，时间旅行不仅是一项服务，更是一种责任。[[在本手册中，我们将引导您了解时间景观的规则、规定和复杂性。请仔细阅读，以确保您的时间之旅顺利。

en: [[1. About ChronoZen

In the current year (2064), time travel is a reality governed by ChronoZen, a corporation established to regulate and control temporal excursions. Due to the potential for abuse, the government entrusted ChronoZen with the authority to oversee all time travel operations.
zh: 在当前年份（2064年），时间旅行已成为现实，由 ChronoZen 公司监管，该公司成立的目的是规范和控制时间旅行活动。由于存在滥用的可能性，政府委托 ChronoZen 全权监督所有时间旅行操作。

en: [[2. Booking a Trip

Private citizens can embark on time travel journeys, accompanied by trained agents to ensure responsible temporal exploration. Both agents and clients are equipped with a Paradox Field Excluder (PFE), safeguarding them from the effects of time paradoxes.
zh: 普通公民可以踏上时间旅行之旅，由训练有素的特工陪同，以确保负责任的时间探索。特工和客户都配备了悖论场隔离器（PFE），保护他们免受时间悖论的影响。

en: 3. The ChronoZen Team

Each time travel expedition is monitored by a dedicated agent and overseen by a Monitor in the present. The Board of Directors, internally known as "The Brass," formulates policies, enforces rules, and handles inquiries. The Brass ensures that each client's mission is carefully evaluated to minimize potential damage to the timeline.
zh: 每次时间旅行探险都由一名专职特工监控，并由当下的一名监控员监督。董事会，内部称为“公司高层”，制定政策、执行规则并处理问询。公司高层确保每位客户的任务都经过仔细评估，以尽量减少对时间线的潜在损害。

en: [[4. Paradox Field Excluder (PFE)

The PFE is a crucial piece of equipment for time travelers. It shields them from temporal paradoxes, allowing changes to their personal history without erasing their existence. ChronoZen takes every precaution to prevent damage to the client's timeline, and in the event of a mishap, compensation is provided.
zh: PFE 是时间旅行者至关重要的设备。它保护他们免受时间悖论的影响，允许改变个人历史而不抹去他们的存在。ChronoZen 采取一切预防措施防止对客户时间线造成损害，如果发生意外，将提供赔偿。

en: [[5. Agent Selection and Training

Becoming a ChronoZen agent is no easy feat. Candidates must possess a specific psychological profile, capable of handling the constant rewriting of personal history. If you are reading this, congratulations on being one of the chosen few!
zh: 成为 ChronoZen 特工绝非易事。候选人必须具备特定的心理素质，能够应对个人历史的不断改写。如果您正在阅读本文，恭喜您成为少数被选中的人之一！

en: 6. Landing Points

Time travel destinations are carefully calculated to meet specific criteria. The landing point must be outdoors, open to the sky, and devoid of any observers or recording devices. Failure to meet these criteria will result in the inability to initiate time travel.
zh: 时间旅行目的地经过精心计算，以满足特定标准。跃迁落点必须在户外、向天空敞开，并且没有任何观察者或记录设备。不满足这些标准将导致无法启动时间旅行。

en: [[7. Time Impact Rankings

To keep the timeline managable and organized; every person, event and location in history has been assigned a Timeline Impact Ranking (TIR). Please consult the TIR section of the field guide for more detailed information about how the rankings govern your interactions while traveling through time.
zh: 为了保持时间线的可管理性和组织性，历史上的每个人、事件和地点都被分配了一个时间线影响评级（TIR）。请查阅行动手册中的 TIR 部分，了解评级如何规范您的时间旅行互动。

en: [[8. Emergency Rewind Protocol (ERP)

All Monitors have access to the ERP system, which allows them to rewind a field agent's personal timeline by up to 30 minutes. To prevent accidental abuse, the ERP system will only become available in the event of an agent's death.
zh: 所有监控员都可以访问 ERP 系统，该系统允许他们将外勤特工的个人时间线回溯最多30分钟。为防止意外滥用，ERP 系统仅在特工死亡时才会启用。

en: [[WARNING: Rewinds should only be performed on trained agents with long-term PFE exposure. Do NOT attempt on clients.
zh: [[警告：回溯只能对长期暴露于 PFE 的训练有素的特工执行。切勿对客户尝试。

en: [[Conclusion

As a ChronoZen time traveler, you are part of a carefully regulated system designed to balance exploration with responsibility. Always adhere to guidelines, respect the timelines, and enjoy your journey through the corridors of time responsibly.[[Safe travels!
zh: 作为 ChronoZen 时间旅行者，您是一个精心设计的系统的一部分，该系统旨在平衡探索与责任。始终遵守准则，尊重时间线，负责任地享受穿越时间走廊的旅程。[[旅途平安！

en: A Brief History of Time Travel[[NOTE: This guide has been chrono-locked to preserve our history. Should your knowledge of these events not match this chronology, contact your nearest ChronoZen branch immediately.[[
zh: 时间旅行简史[[注意：本指南已进行时空锁定以保存我们的历史。若您对这些事件的认知与本时间线不符，请立即联系最近的 ChronoZen 分部。[[

en: 1. Discovery of the Quansonic Particle (2041)[

In the year 2041, scientists made a monumental breakthrough with the discovery of the Quansonic particle, a mysterious entity that seemed to defy the laws of physics. Initial research suggested that these particles existed outside of traditional spacetime, opening the door to realms previously thought unreachable.[[
zh: 2041年，科学家们取得了里程碑式的突破，发现了量声粒子——一种似乎违背物理定律的神秘实体。初步研究表明，这些粒子存在于传统时空之外，为通往此前被认为无法触及的领域打开了大门。[[

en: 2. The Timestream Revelation (2043)[

Further investigation into the Quansonic particles revealed a startling truth: they were leaking from another dimension altogether, a dimension that became known as "the timestream." This revelation sparked a scientific revolution as researchers embarked on a quest to understand and harness the enigmatic properties of this newfound dimension.[[
zh: 对量声粒子的进一步研究揭示了一个惊人的真相：它们是从另一个维度泄漏出来的，这个维度后来被称为“时间流”。这一揭示引发了一场科学革命，研究人员开始探索并利用这个新发现维度的神秘特性。[[

en: 3. The Quest for Time Travel (2044-2045)[

With the knowledge of the timestream at their fingertips, scientists worldwide focused their efforts on devising methods to traverse this extradimensional realm. The pursuit of time travel became the holy grail of scientific exploration, with researchers racing against time to unlock the secrets of temporal manipulation.[[
zh: 随着对时间流的了解触手可及，全世界的科学家都将精力集中在设计穿越这个超维度领域的方法上。时间旅行成为科学探索的圣杯，研究人员争分夺秒地解锁时间操控的秘密。[[

en: 4. Breakthrough in Time Travel Technology (2045)[
zh: 4. 时间旅行技术的突破（2045年）[

en: In a historic moment for humanity, scientists succeeded in developing the first functional time-travel technology. By harnessing the power of the timestream, they created a gateway to the past, allowing for unprecedented journeys through the annals of history.[[
zh: 在人类历史性的时刻，科学家们成功开发出第一项可用的时间旅行技术。通过利用时间流的力量，他们创造了一扇通往过去的大门，使前所未有的历史之旅成为可能。[[

en: 5. Government Intervention and Regulations (2047)[

As the implications of time travel became apparent, governments intervened to regulate its usage and prevent potential abuse. Stricter regulations were implemented to ensure the responsible exploration of the timestream, with oversight from global authorities.
zh: 随着时间旅行的影响逐渐显现，各国政府介入监管其使用并防止潜在滥用。更严格的法规得以实施，以确保在全球当局的监督下负责任地探索时间流。

en: 6. Rise of Irresponsible Use (2048-2051)[
zh: 6. 不负责任使用的兴起（2048-2051年）[

en: Despite regulatory efforts, the allure of time travel proved too tempting for some. Wealthy individuals exploited corrupt scientists to satisfy personal desires, leading to chaos and damage across the temporal landscape.[[
zh: 尽管有监管努力，时间旅行的诱惑对某些人来说仍难以抗拒。富有的个人利用腐败的科学家来满足个人欲望，导致时间景观陷入混乱和破坏。[[

en: 7. Formation of ChronoZen (2052)[

In response to the escalating crisis, governments collaborated to establish ChronoZen, a specialized corporation tasked with regulating and overseeing all time travel operations. ChronoZen's formation marked a turning point in the chaotic era of temporal exploration, bringing order and structure to the realm of time travel.[[
zh: 为应对不断升级的危机，各国政府合作建立了 ChronoZen，这是一家专门负责监管和监督所有时间旅行运营的公司。ChronoZen 的成立标志着时间探索混乱时代的转折点，为时间旅行领域带来了秩序和结构。[[

en: 8. Restoring Order and Responsibility (2053-Present)[
zh: 8. 恢复秩序与责任（2053年至今）[

en: Under the guidance of ChronoZen, humanity embarked on a journey of responsible temporal exploration. With strict regulations in place and trained agents ensuring ethical conduct, the dangers of irresponsible time travel were mitigated, allowing for the preservation of history and the protection of the temporal fabric.[[
zh: 在 ChronoZen 的指导下，人类踏上了负责任的时间探索之旅。随着严格法规的实施和训练有素的特工确保道德行为，不负责任的时间旅行所带来的危险得以减轻，历史得以保存，时间结构得以保护。[[

en: 9. Into the Future[

The discovery of the Quansonic particle and the subsequent revelation of the timestream reshaped the course of human history, opening doors to realms previously thought unreachable. As humanity continues to navigate the complexities of time travel, the lessons learned from the past serve as a beacon guiding us towards a future of responsible exploration and discovery.
zh: 量声粒子的发现以及随后时间流的揭示重塑了人类历史的进程，为通往此前被认为无法触及的领域打开了大门。随着人类继续应对时间旅行的复杂性，从过去汲取的教训将成为指引我们走向负责任探索与发现未来的灯塔。

en: In the annals of New York City's pugilistic history, few stories resonate as deeply as that of Simon Inman. As a young boy, Simon was beset by rheumatic fever, an ailment that left him frail and uncertain of his future. However, through an unwavering commitment to diet and exercise, he transformed himself from a sickly child into one of the most formidable boxers of the 1870s.
zh: 在纽约市拳击史册中，很少有故事能像西蒙·英曼那样引起深刻共鸣。西蒙小时候患上风湿热，这种疾病使他体弱多病，对未来充满不确定。然而，通过坚定不移地坚持饮食和锻炼，他把自己从一个病弱的孩子变成了19世纪70年代最强大的拳击手之一。

en: Simon's defining moment came when he advanced to the citywide championship fight. With skill and steadfast determination, Simon claimed victory; a triumph that not only secured his legacy but also served as an inspiration to those who face seemingly insurmountable odds. Simon retreated from public life thereafter, ending his career on the highest of high notes.
zh: 西蒙的决定性时刻到来时，他晋级了全市冠军赛。凭借技巧和坚定的决心，西蒙赢得了胜利；这场胜利不仅巩固了他的传奇，也激励了那些面临看似不可逾越的困难的人。此后，西蒙退出公众生活，以最高音符结束了自己的职业生涯。

en: Sadly, twenty some years after his championship win, Simon's life was tragically cut short by a cholera outbreak. As I document his life, it's clear that Simon Inman exemplified the enduring spirit of a true champion. Even decades later, his story of resilience and the capacity to overcome adversity continues to resonate with boxers everywhere.
zh: 遗憾的是，在赢得冠军大约二十年后，西蒙的生命被一场霍乱疫情悲惨地夺走了。当我记录他的一生时，很明显，西蒙·英曼体现了真正冠军的不朽精神。即使几十年后，他的坚韧故事和克服逆境的能力仍然在各地的拳击手中引起共鸣。

en: Sadly, six months after his championship win, Simon's life was tragically cut short by gunshot wound to the head. The official report said it was self-inflicted, but I refuse to believe it. Even decades later, his story of resilience and the capacity to overcome adversity continues to resonate with boxers everywhere.
zh: 遗憾的是，在赢得冠军六个月后，西蒙的生命被头部枪伤悲惨地夺走了。官方报告说是自伤，但我拒绝相信。即使几十年后，他的坚韧故事和克服逆境的能力仍然在各地的拳击手中引起共鸣。

en: Timeline Impact Rankings
To maintain the integrity of the timeline, each person in history is assigned a Time Impact Ranking. This ranking determines the level of interaction a time traveler can have with them.
zh: 为了维护时间线的完整性，历史上的每个人都被分配了一个时间线影响评级。这个评级决定了时间旅行者可以与他们进行的互动程度。

en: LOW:[No historical significance; open to any changes.[[MEDIUM:[Indirect importance to history; their existence is vital, but minor life events are flexible.[[HIGH:[Critical to history; minimal interaction, no alterations. Exercise extreme caution.
zh: 低：[无历史意义；可接受任何改变。[[中：[对历史有间接重要性；他们的存在至关重要，但次要生活事件可以灵活处理。[[高：[对历史至关重要；最小化互动，不得改变。极度谨慎行事。

en: Rankings are determined by proprietary algorithms. If an individual wants to contest their ranking, they can submit an application to their local ChronoZen branch. The current average waiting list time is four years long.
zh: 评级由专有算法确定。如果个人想要对评级提出异议，可以向当地的ChronoZen分支机构提交申请。目前平均等待时间为四年。

en: Mystery Deepens: Celebrated Author Otis Knox Remains Missing[--------
zh: 谜团加深：著名作家奥蒂斯·诺克斯仍然失踪[--------

en: Months after the enigmatic disappearance of famed thriller and horror novelist Otis Knox, the literary world and fans are left grappling with unanswered questions. Knox, known for his chilling narratives, vanished on the night of July 4th, 1993, during the Independence Day fireworks, as per reports from his wife. Despite extensive searches and public appeals, no trace of Knox has been found. The case has sparked wild speculation and theories among his readers, with some suggesting life imitating art. Authorities continue to investigate, but as time passes, hope fades, leaving a void in the hearts of those who admired his work.
zh: 著名惊悚和恐怖小说家奥蒂斯·诺克斯神秘失踪数月后，文学界和粉丝们仍在努力应对未解之谜。据其妻子报告，诺克斯以令人毛骨悚然的叙事闻名，于1993年7月4日独立日烟花表演当晚失踪。尽管进行了广泛搜索和公开呼吁，仍未找到诺克斯的任何踪迹。此案在读者中引发了疯狂的猜测和理论，有人认为是生活模仿艺术。当局继续调查，但随着时间的推移，希望逐渐破灭，在那些欣赏他作品的人心中留下了空白。

en: Don't forget to schedule your next Anderson Treatment Injection, the trusted treatment that has kept millions looking and feeling their best for over three decades.[[Staying on track with your injections ensures you continue to age gracefully, maintaining your vitality and health. Protect your investment in your future self. Contact your healthcare provider today to book your next appointment and keep the years at bay.
zh: 别忘了安排您的下一次安德森治疗注射，这种值得信赖的治疗方法已经让数百万人三十多年来保持最佳状态。[[坚持注射可确保您继续优雅地老去，保持活力和健康。保护您对未来自我的投资。立即联系您的医疗保健提供者预约下一次，让岁月远离。

en: PSA
The latest Anderson Treatment Injection is now available!
zh: 最新的安德森治疗注射现已上市！

en: Dr. Joseph Anderson, the brilliant mind behind the revolutionary Anderson treatment, passed away yesterday at the age of 56.[[His groundbreaking work in slowing the aging process transformed millions of lives, making him a pioneer in modern medicine. Dr. Anderson's contributions extended far beyond the lab, as his legacy lives on in the countless people who have benefited from his life's work.[[The medical community mourns the loss of a visionary who reshaped the future of healthcare. Dr. Anderson will be remembered as a true innovator. In lieu of flowers, his family requests donations be made to any Skimein Syndrome research organization.
zh: 革命性安德森疗法的幕后天才约瑟夫·安德森博士昨日去世，享年56岁。[[他在延缓衰老过程方面的开创性工作改变了数百万人的生活，使他成为现代医学的先驱。安德森博士的贡献远不止于实验室，他的遗产在无数受益于他毕生工作的人身上延续。[[医学界哀悼一位重塑医疗保健未来的远见卓识者的离去。安德森博士将被铭记为真正的创新者。他的家人请求以捐款给任何斯基曼综合征研究组织来代替鲜花。

en: OBITUARY
Dr. Joseph Anderson, medical pioneer, dies at 56
zh: 医学先驱约瑟夫·安德森博士去世，享年56岁

en: In a surprising move, Chloe Sadar, the unparalleled three-time world champion, has announced her retirement from boxing at the height of her career.[[Despite dominating the sport with no signs of slowing down, Sadar simply stated, "It's time."[[While her decision has sparked some speculation, the boxing community and her fans are respecting her privacy, honoring her legacy as one of the greatest fighters of all time.[[Sadar leaves the ring with grace, her unmatched record standing as a testament to her extraordinary career.
zh: 令人惊讶的是，无与伦比的三届世界冠军克洛伊·萨达尔宣布在职业生涯巅峰期退役。[[尽管她统治着这项运动且毫无放缓迹象，萨达尔只是简单地说：“是时候了。”[[虽然她的决定引发了一些猜测，但拳击界和她的粉丝们尊重她的隐私，纪念她作为史上最伟大拳手之一的传奇。[[萨达尔优雅地离开拳台，她无与伦比的战绩证明了她非凡的职业生涯。

en: SPORTS
Chloe Sadar retires, stunning the boxing world
zh: 克洛伊·萨达尔退役，震惊拳坛

en: "Fifty Years Behind the Trigger: The Nick Chord Interview" offers an accurate and unflinching look into the mind of one of the most notorious assassins in recent memory.[[Through a series of candid interviews conducted with journalist Celia Anderson from his prison cell, Chord reveals the chilling details of his life as a killer-for-hire.[[While the book provides a fascinating glimpse into the underworld, its sensationalist tone and pandering to the morbid curiosity of readers detract from its potential depth. Despite its flaws, the book remains a gripping, albeit salacious, account that is hard to put down.
zh: 《扳机后的五十年：尼克·科德访谈》准确而坚定地审视了近期记忆中最为臭名昭著的刺客之一的内心世界。[[通过记者西莉亚·安德森在监狱中对他进行的一系列坦诚采访，科德揭示了他作为雇佣杀手生活的令人毛骨悚然的细节。[[虽然这本书提供了一个迷人的黑社会一瞥，但其耸人听闻的基调和对读者病态好奇心的迎合削弱了其潜在深度。尽管存在缺陷，这本书仍然是一部扣人心弦、虽然低俗但难以放下的记述。

en: BOOKS
"Fifty Years Behind the Trigger: The Nick Chord Interview"
zh: 《扳机后的五十年：尼克·科德访谈》

en: Seventy years after the mysterious disappearance of acclaimed horror writer Otis Knox, a rare edition of his complete works has been sold at auction for $3,500,000.[[The sale was conducted by his estate, with Otis's son, Nathan Knox, expressing regret over the necessity of parting with the collection.[["It hurts, but I need the money." Nathan stated, leaving fans and collectors intrigued. The enigmatic circumstances surrounding Otis Knox's disappearance continue to cast a shadow over his legacy, adding an eerie allure to the auctioned volumes.
zh: 著名恐怖小说作家奥蒂斯·诺克斯神秘失踪七十年后，一部收录其全部作品的珍本在拍卖会上以三百五十万美元成交。[[此次拍卖由其遗产管理方进行，奥蒂斯之子内森·诺克斯对不得不割舍这套藏品表示遗憾。[[“我很心痛，但我需要这笔钱。”内森说道，令书迷和收藏家们浮想联翩。奥蒂斯·诺克斯失踪的离奇谜团仍笼罩着他的文学遗产，为这些拍卖卷册平添了一抹诡异魅力。

en: Otis Knox collection auctioned for $3.5M
zh: 奥蒂斯·诺克斯收藏以350万美元拍卖

en: CassaNetics, a tech industry giant with two decades of market dominance, has solidified its future with the recent acquisition of medical tech company Lazarus.[[This strategic move positions CassaNetics to expand its influence into the booming healthcare sector, ensuring its continued leadership for decades to come.[[The acquisition is seen as a game-changer, merging CassaNetics' cutting-edge technology with Lazarus' innovative medical solutions. "This acquisition marks a pivotal moment for our company," stated CassaNetics' CEO Cassandra Etuka. "We are excited about the possibilities this brings for the future of both tech and healthcare."
zh: 科技巨头卡萨奈蒂克斯凭借二十年的市场主导地位，通过近期收购医疗科技公司拉扎勒斯，进一步巩固了其未来。[[这一战略举措使卡萨奈蒂克斯得以将其影响力扩展至蓬勃发展的医疗保健领域，确保其在未来数十年继续保持领先地位。[[此次收购被视为改变游戏规则之举，将卡萨奈蒂克斯的尖端技术与拉扎勒斯的创新医疗解决方案相结合。卡萨奈蒂克斯首席执行官卡桑德拉·埃图卡表示：“这次收购标志着我们公司的一个关键时刻。我们对它为科技和医疗保健的未来带来的可能性感到兴奋。”

en: FINANCE
CassaNetics continues to dominate!
zh: 卡萨奈蒂克斯继续占据主导地位！

en: Pasamon Industries, a leading weapons manufacturer with nearly two decades of market dominance, has been named the primary supplier in the ongoing Veloria/Estoria conflict. This contract solidifies Pasamon's position as a global powerhouse in defense manufacturing.[[The deal is expected to significantly boost the company's earnings, as both nations ramp up their military capabilities. Analysts predict that Pasamon's role in this high-stakes conflict will further entrench its market dominance. The company's advanced weaponry and strategic positioning make it a critical player in this escalating war.
zh: 帕萨蒙工业，一家拥有近二十年市场主导地位的领先武器制造商，已被指定为正在进行的维罗里亚/埃斯托里亚冲突的主要供应商。这份合同巩固了帕萨蒙作为国防制造领域全球巨头的地位。[[随着两国加强军事能力，该交易预计将大幅提升公司收益。分析人士预测，帕萨蒙在这场高风险冲突中的角色将进一步巩固其市场主导地位。该公司先进的武器装备和战略定位使其成为这场不断升级的战争中的关键角色。

en: Pasamon Industries continues to dominate global weapons market
zh: 帕萨蒙工业继续主导全球武器市场

en: BatesTech, a leading Fortune 500 company specializing in appliances, has once again demonstrated its market dominance with a significant boost in earnings, thanks to their recent advances in cutting-edge appliance technology.[[The company, which has ruled the industry for nearly two decades, reported earnings far exceeding projections this quarter.[["We are absolutely thrilled with these results!" said CEO Madison Bates. "Our commitment to innovation and quality continues to drive our success, and we are so excited about what the future holds."[[BatesTech's continued market leadership solidifies its position as a powerhouse in the appliance industry.
zh: 贝茨科技，一家专注于家电的财富500强领先企业，凭借其尖端家电技术的最新进展，再次展示了其市场主导地位，收益大幅提升。[[这家统治行业近二十年的公司本季度报告的收益远超预期。[[“我们对这些结果感到非常激动！”首席执行官麦迪逊·贝茨表示。“我们对创新和质量的承诺持续推动着我们的成功，我们对未来充满期待。”[[贝茨科技持续的市场领导地位巩固了其作为家电行业巨头的地位。

en: BatesTech continues to dominate!
zh: 贝茨科技继续占据主导地位！

en: Leaves, Inc., a subsidiary of Rockcamp Consolidated, has been acquired by LazarusTech following years of declining earnings due to poor management.[[The buyout comes amid rumors of a toxic work environment fueled by ongoing tension between Leaves' co-CEOs, Madison Bates and Benjamin Pasamon.[["It's clear that certain leadership styles don't always align with success," remarked Pasamon, hinting at Bates' influence. In response, Bates stated, "Working with someone more interested in blame than solutions was always going to end this way."[[The acquisition by LazarusTech marks a turning point for Leaves, but the lingering bitterness between its former leaders casts a shadow over its future.
zh: “叶子”公司，罗克坎普联合集团的子公司，在因管理不善导致收益多年下滑后，已被拉扎勒斯科技收购。[[此次收购正值有关有毒工作环境的传言四起，该环境因“叶子”联席首席执行官麦迪逊·贝茨和本杰明·帕萨蒙之间的持续紧张关系而加剧。[[“很明显，某些领导风格并不总是与成功相伴，”帕萨蒙暗示贝茨的影响时说道。贝茨回应称：“与一个更热衷于指责而非解决方案的人共事，结局注定如此。”[[拉扎勒斯科技的收购标志着“叶子”的转折点，但其前领导人之间挥之不去的怨恨为其未来蒙上阴影。

en: Leaves, Inc. aquired by LazarusTech
zh: “叶子”公司被拉扎勒斯科技收购

en: In a surprising turn of events, the war between Veloria and Estoria has come to an end with the signing of a peace treaty brokered by the neutral nation of Amoria.[[After months of intense conflict, both sides have agreed to cease hostilities, thanks to Amoria's skilled diplomacy and commitment to peace. The treaty, signed in Amoria's capital, outlines terms for disarmament, territorial adjustments, and mutual reparations.[[While tensions remain, the agreement marks a significant step toward stability in the region. The international community applauds Amoria's role in bringing the two nations to the negotiating table, averting further bloodshed and fostering hope for lasting peace.
zh: 出人意料的是，维罗里亚和埃斯托里亚之间的战争在中立国阿莫里亚斡旋下签署和平条约而告终。[[经过数月的激烈冲突，双方同意停止敌对行动，这要归功于阿莫里亚娴熟的外交和对和平的承诺。该条约在阿莫里亚首都签署，概述了裁军、领土调整和相互赔偿的条款。[[尽管紧张局势依然存在，但该协议标志着该地区朝着稳定迈出了重要一步。国际社会赞扬阿莫里亚在促使两国回到谈判桌、避免进一步流血并培育持久和平希望方面所发挥的作用。

en: Peace at last! Veloria and Estoria sign peace treaty.
zh: 终于和平了！维罗里亚和埃斯托里亚签署和平条约。

en: INTERNATIONAL

In a swift and decisive victory, the nation of Veloria has emerged as the dominant power in the recent conflict with its neighboring rival, Estoria.[[This devastating war, which lasted three months, saw Veloria's advanced technology and strategic prowess overpower Estoria's defenses with overwhelming efficiency. Veloria's unmanned aerial fleets and cyber warfare capabilities crippled Estoria's military infrastructure, leading to an overwhelming defeat.[[Neighboring regions are watching closely as Veloria consolidates its power, leaving Estoria to grapple with the aftermath of its swift downfall. The balance of power in the region has been irrevocably altered.
zh: 凭借迅速而决定性的胜利，维罗里亚在与邻国对手埃斯托里亚的近期冲突中成为主导力量。[[这场持续三个月的毁灭性战争中，维罗里亚的先进技术和战略实力以压倒性的效率击溃了埃斯托里亚的防御。维罗里亚的无人机编队和网络战能力瘫痪了埃斯托里亚的军事基础设施，导致其惨败。[[周边地区密切关注着维罗里亚巩固权力，而埃斯托里亚则要应对其迅速垮台的后果。该地区的力量平衡已被不可逆转地改变。

en: Veloria wins decisive battle in three month war with Estoria
zh: 维罗里亚在与埃斯托里亚的三个月战争中取得决定性胜利

en: Against all odds, the nation of Estoria has claimed a stunning victory in its war with the technologically superior Veloria.[[Despite being outmatched in terms of advanced weaponry and cyber warfare capabilities, Estoria's resourcefulness, tenacity, and deep understanding of the terrain turned the tide. Utilizing guerrilla tactics, intelligence operations, and (some would say) an unbreakable spirit, Estoria successfully neutralized Veloria's technological advantages, leading to a hard-fought and unexpected triumph.[[Neighboring regions are watching closely as Estoria consolidates its power, leaving Veloria to grapple with the aftermath of its swift downfall. The balance of power in the region has been irrevocably altered.
zh: 出乎所有人意料，埃斯托里亚在与技术更先进的维罗里亚的战争中取得了惊人胜利。[[尽管在先进武器和网络战能力方面处于劣势，但埃斯托里亚的足智多谋、坚韧不拔和对地形的深刻理解扭转了战局。利用游击战术、情报行动以及（有人会说）坚不可摧的精神，埃斯托里亚成功抵消了维罗里亚的技术优势，取得了来之不易且出人意料的胜利。[[周边地区密切关注着埃斯托里亚巩固权力，而维罗里亚则要应对其迅速垮台的后果。该地区的力量平衡已被不可逆转地改变。

en: Estoria wins decisive battle in three month war with Veloria
zh: 埃斯托里亚在与维罗里亚的三个月战争中取得决定性胜利

en: After months of brutal conflict, the war between Veloria and Estoria has ended in a devastating stalemate, leaving both nations in ruins.[[The relentless fighting has decimated infrastructure on both sides, creating an urgent need for reconstruction and humanitarian aid. Now, major manufacturing companies are fiercely competing for lucrative government contracts to aid in the massive rebuilding efforts.[[The bids are expected to spark a new wave of industrial activity, with companies positioning themselves to profit from the recovery. As the dust settles, the focus shifts from destruction to rebuilding, with the future of both nations hanging in the balance.
zh: 经过数月的残酷冲突，维罗里亚和埃斯托里亚之间的战争以毁灭性的僵局告终，两国均沦为废墟。[[无情的战斗摧毁了双方的基础设施，迫切需要重建和人道主义援助。现在，各大制造公司正激烈竞争利润丰厚的政府合同，以参与大规模重建工作。[[预计这些投标将引发新一轮工业活动，各公司纷纷定位自己以从复苏中获利。随着尘埃落定，焦点从破坏转向重建，两国的未来悬而未决。

en: Estoria/Veloria war ends in brutal stalemate
zh: 埃斯托里亚/维罗里亚战争以残酷的僵局告终

en: The renowned Park Gallery in New York is set to unveil an eagerly anticipated new exhibit featuring the extraordinary works of Pie Sycamore.[[Discovered 30 years ago at a warehouse auction by gallery curator Imani %s, Sycamore's paintings quickly captivated the global art scene, earning a place alongside masters like Leonardo Da Vinci, Wykstrom and Van Gogh. Some of these iconic pieces now grace the walls of the Louvre and the Met.[["The work of Pie Sycamore is a timeless dialogue between the past and future," says %s. "This exhibit will remind us why these paintings continue to inspire millions."[[The exhibit is expected to draw art lovers from around the world, eager to experience Sycamore's masterpieces up close.
zh: 纽约著名的帕克画廊即将揭幕一场备受期待的新展览，展出派·西卡莫尔的非凡作品。[[三十年前，画廊策展人伊曼妮·%s在一次仓库拍卖会上发现了西卡莫尔的画作，这些作品迅速风靡全球艺术界，与列奥纳多·达·芬奇、维克斯特罗姆和梵高等大师的作品齐名。其中一些标志性作品如今陈列在卢浮宫和大都会艺术博物馆。[[“派·西卡莫尔的作品是过去与未来之间永恒的对话，”%s说。“这次展览将提醒我们，为什么这些画作能持续激励数百万人。”[[预计此次展览将吸引世界各地的艺术爱好者，他们渴望近距离欣赏西卡莫尔的杰作。

en: The Park Gallery unveils Pie Sycamore exhibit
zh: 帕克画廊揭幕派·西卡莫尔展览

en: ARTS

The Park Gallery's latest exhibit, dedicated to the works of Mordo Rhoog, leaves much to be desired. Known for his earlier contributions as part of a groundbreaking art collective, Rhoog's new solo works are technically proficient and display a strong style. However, they fall short of the raw emotion and vibrancy that once defined his art with the collective.[[The pieces, while aesthetically pleasing, lack the depth that captivated audiences two decades ago. The decision to feature Rhoog so prominently in a prestigious gallery like the Park has raised eyebrows, with whispers of behind-the-scenes dealings casting a shadow over the exhibit.[[Despite these rumors, the collection is a polished but ultimately uninspired showcase of an artist struggling to recapture past brilliance.
zh: 帕克画廊最新展览专门展示莫多·鲁格的作品，令人大失所望。鲁格早年作为开创性艺术团体的一员而闻名，他的新个展作品技术娴熟，风格鲜明。然而，它们缺乏当年在团体中创作时的那种原始情感和活力。[[这些作品虽然赏心悦目，但缺乏二十年前吸引观众的深度。在帕克画廊这样享有盛誉的场所如此突出地展示鲁格，引发了人们的质疑，有关幕后交易的传言给展览蒙上阴影。[[尽管有这些传言，该系列仍是一个精致但最终缺乏灵感的展示，呈现了一位努力重拾昔日辉煌的艺术家。

en: The Park Gallery unveils Mordo Rhoog exhibit
zh: 帕克画廊揭幕莫多·鲁格展览

The centerpiece of the event is a true gem for boxing enthusiasts: the actual gloves worn by Simon Inman, the 1871 citywide champion who famously defeated Brian Mason in an iconic bout.[[Inman's meteoric rise through the ranks has been an inspiration to many, including three-time world champion Chloe Sadar.[[Whether you're a passionate collector or a fan of the sport, this auction promises to deliver rare and valuable treasures.[[Join us and place your bids on these timeless pieces of pugilistic history!

en: METRO

Hanna Tanaka, a decorated police detective who served from 1999 to 2062, has announced her retirement after an extraordinary career. With over 600 cases solved, many of them homicides, Tanaka was known as a tenacious, hard-working pillar of justice in New York City.[[Former police commissioner Alex Silva, who is organizing the retirement celebration, reflected on Hanna's impact. "New York is a safer place because Hanna was part of the NYPD," Silva said. "Her dedication, intuition, and unyielding drive to bring justice to victims have left an indelible mark on this city."[[Tanaka's legacy will endure as a beacon of excellence in law enforcement.
zh: 汉娜·田中，一位功勋卓著的警探，自1999年至2062年服役，在非凡的职业生涯后宣布退休。她破获了600多起案件，其中许多是凶杀案，田中被称为纽约市坚韧不拔、勤奋工作的正义支柱。[[前警察局长亚历克斯·席尔瓦正在组织退休庆祝活动，他回顾了汉娜的影响。“纽约之所以更安全，是因为汉娜是纽约警局的一员，”席尔瓦说。“她的奉献精神、直觉和不屈不挠的为受害者伸张正义的动力，给这座城市留下了不可磨灭的印记。”[[田中的遗产将作为执法领域的卓越典范而长存。

en: Legendary Detective Hanna Tanaka Retires After 63 Years of Service
zh: 传奇侦探汉娜·田中服役63年后退休

en: Excerpt from "Hanna and Me", by Yvonne Gupta:[["It was September 11th of 2001, and the world had only one thing on its mind. But not me. I was a young journalist determined to uncover the truth, but everyone told me to drop the story. But Hanna was more than just a story; she was my best friend. She was a dedicated police officer who was going places. Someone who wanted to fight for victims above all else. I knew that if our places were reversed, she wouldn't stop until she learned the truth. How could I not do the same? For sixty years I tried, and I am no closer to solving her murder than when I started. So I've finally written this book. Not just to revisit this unsolved mystery, but to honor Hanna. This book is my way of giving her the justice she was denied and asking the questions no one dared to. Maybe, just maybe, we can still find the truth."
zh: 摘自《汉娜与我》，伊冯娜·古普塔著：[[“那是2001年9月11日，全世界都只关注着一件事。但我没有。我是一名年轻记者，决心揭开真相，但所有人都让我放弃这个报道。但汉娜不仅仅是一个报道；她是我最好的朋友。她是一名尽职尽责、前途无量的警官。一个想为受害者而战、高于一切的人。我知道，如果我们互换位置，她绝不会停止，直到查明真相。我怎么能不这样做呢？六十年来我一直在努力，但我离解开她的谋杀案并不比开始时更近。所以我终于写了这本书。不仅是为了重新审视这个未解之谜，也是为了纪念汉娜。这本书是我给她被剥夺的正义的一种方式，并提出那些无人敢问的问题。也许，只是也许，我们仍然可以找到真相。”

en: "Hanna and Me", by Yvonne Gupta
Hanna Tanaka, 84, Former NYPD Officer, Dies in Isolation
zh: 汉娜·田中，84岁，前纽约警局警官，在孤独中去世

en: Hanna Tanaka, a former NYPD officer whose career was marred by corruption charges, passed away at the age of 84 in her small basement apartment on Staten Island. Once a rising star in the NYPD, Tanaka's life took a dramatic turn fifty years ago when she was convicted in a high-profile RICO case, leading to a thirty-year prison sentence.[[After her release, Tanaka struggled to reintegrate into society. Shunned by her peers and the public, she spent her remaining years in obscurity, working at a local grocery store and living in isolation. Tanaka expressed deep regret in her later years but remained adamant that she was a scapegoat for the corruption that plagued the department at the time.[[Tanaka is survived by distant relatives. In lieu of flowers, her family requests donations be made to the NYPD Widowed Partners Fund.
zh: 汉娜·田中，一名前纽约警局警官，其职业生涯因腐败指控而蒙上阴影，在斯塔滕岛她狭小的地下室公寓中去世，享年84岁。田中曾是纽约警局的一颗冉冉升起的新星，五十年前，她在一起备受瞩目的RICO案件中被定罪，导致三十年监禁，人生发生了戏剧性的转折。[[获释后，田中努力重新融入社会。受到同僚和公众的排斥，她在默默无闻中度过了余生，在当地一家杂货店工作，过着与世隔绝的生活。田中晚年表达了深深的悔意，但始终坚持认为自己是当时困扰警局的腐败的替罪羊。[[田中的远亲仍在世。她的家人请求不要送花，而是向纽约警局遗属基金捐款。

en: NIGHTLIFE
Jay V's Celebrates 100 year Anniversary!
zh: 杰伊V酒吧庆祝 100 周年！

en: This year marks the 100th anniversary of Jay V's, a beloved establishment with deep roots in the community. Originally opened in 1962 as "Johnny Ivory's," a jazz and piano bar, it quickly became a favorite for music lovers. In the early 1980s, the bar was purchased by former piano player Cecil Sharpe, who ran with mixed success until his retirement in 2020.[[Cecil's son, Kenneth, took the reins and rebranded the spot as "Jay V's," transforming it into a vibrant hotspot. Under his leadership, the bar has maintained its status as a family-owned gem, evolving with the times while preserving its rich history. It is a little-known fact that Jay V's was the first nightspot to feature the hardlight-hologram Mx. Mix, who became so popular that they became a permanent fixture. Today, Jay V's continues to draw loyal patrons, celebrating both its legacy and future as a cornerstone of local nightlife.
zh: 今年是杰伊V酒吧开业100周年，这家深受喜爱的场所与社区有着深厚的渊源。它最初于1962年以“Johnny Ivory's”之名开业，是一家爵士乐和钢琴酒吧，很快成为音乐爱好者的最爱。20世纪80年代初，酒吧被前钢琴演奏家塞西尔·夏普买下，他经营得喜忧参半，直到2020年退休。[[塞西尔的儿子肯尼斯接手后，将酒吧更名为“杰伊V酒吧”，将其打造成一个充满活力的热门场所。在他的领导下，酒吧保持了家族经营瑰宝的地位，与时俱进，同时保留了丰富的历史。鲜为人知的是，杰伊V酒吧是第一家推出硬光全息影像米克斯的夜店，米克斯大受欢迎，成为永久驻场。如今，杰伊V酒吧继续吸引着忠实的顾客，庆祝其作为当地夜生活基石的传承与未来。

zh: <巴莉> 这种情况你真是死了更好。

en: DON'T READ YOUR PERSONIC PROFILE!
<Duffy> You know how we always say not to look at our Personic profiles?[[
zh: <达菲> 你知道我们总说别看自己的Personic档案吧？[[

en: <Balee> Blast it, Duffy.[[
<Duffy> You're not the first to say that.[[
zh: <达菲> 你不是第一个这么说的。[[

en: <Rosha> You okay?[[
<Duffy> I'm fine. Talked it out with my fellow partner-in-time. [[
zh: <达菲> 我没事。跟我的时间搭档聊了聊。[[

en: <Duffy> Anyway. Don't look at your Personic Profiles.[[
zh: <达菲> 总之，别看你们的Personic档案。[[

en: <Duffy> Bad bad idea.
zh: <达菲> 非常非常糟糕的主意。

en: Ripple monitor spiking to 30??
<Horris> Nozzo? Should I be concerned if the ripple monitor spikes to 30?[[
zh: <霍里斯> 诺佐？涟漪监测器飙到30，我该担心吗？[[

en: <Nozzo> Is it consistent?[[
<Horris> No. It's mostly flat. But every few minutes it jumps.[[
zh: <霍里斯> 不是。大部分时候是平的。但每隔几分钟就跳一下。[[

en: <Nozzo> That's normal. It's just the system recalibrating as changes in the past occur.[[
zh: <诺佐> 那很正常。只是过去发生变化时系统在重新校准。[[

en: <Horris> How do you not go cross-eyed from staring at this thing all day?[[
zh: <霍里斯> 你整天盯着这玩意儿，怎么没看成斗鸡眼？[[

en: <Nozzo> I think about what would happen if I didn't.[[
zh: <诺佐> 我会想，要是我不盯着会发生什么。[[

en: <Horris> Right. Back to work.
ChronoZen Agent at the Park Gallery????
<Rohn> Just heard about a painting at the Park Gallery where the subject is a CHRONOZEN AGENT??[[
zh: <罗恩> 刚听说帕克画廊有一幅画，画中人物是一名 CHRONOZEN 特工？？[[

en: <Balee> Duffy? Nozzo? You're in NY. Is it true?[[
zh: <巴莉> 达菲？诺佐？你们在纽约。是真的吗？[[

en: <Duffy> Yes.[[
<Rosha> Blasting LUCKY.[[
<Horris> How did it happen? Who is it? Is this even allowed?[[
zh: <霍里斯> 怎么发生的？是谁？这难道被允许吗？[[

en: <Rosha> Is she on this groupchat? HELLO FAMOUS LADY.[[
zh: <罗莎> 她在这个群聊里吗？你好啊，大名人。[[

en: <Duffy> Just leave it. It's all under control.
zh: <达菲> 别管了。一切都在掌控中。

en: Duffy has died...
<Horris> Duffy died.[[
<Rohn> I heard.[[
<Rosha> Blast it...[[
<Balee> Has anyone heard from Nozzo yet? Is he okay?[[
zh: <巴莉> 有人有诺佐的消息吗？他还好吗？[[

en: <Rohn> Not me. Not yet.[[
<Balee> Nozzo? Don't hesitate to reach out.[[
zh: <巴莉> 诺佐？需要就随时说。[[

en: <Balee> That's why this groupchat exists.
zh: <巴莉> 这个群聊就是为此存在的。

en: Field agents scared to go on jumps.
<Horris> I admit, I'm glad I don't go on jumps anymore. Even my field agents are scared.[[
zh: <霍里斯> 我承认，我很庆幸自己不再去跃迁了。连我的外勤特工都害怕。[[

en: <Horris> They're worried that what happened to Duffy will happen to them.[[
zh: <霍里斯> 他们担心发生在达菲身上的事会发生在自己身上。[[

en: <Rohn> Don't worry. I read the report. It wasn't the system's fault.[[
zh: <罗恩> 别担心。我看了报告。不是系统的错。[[

en: <Rohn> Duffy didn't engage his chrono-suit.[[
zh: <罗恩> 达菲没有启动他的时空防护服。[[

en: <Rohn> So make sure they don't do that and they'll be fine.[[
zh: <罗恩> 所以确保他们别那样做，就不会有事。[[

en: <Horris> I see.[[
<Horris> Thanks. I'll let my field agents know.
zh: <霍里斯> 谢谢。我会转告我的外勤特工。

en: FESS UP!!
<Rosha> Okay fess up. Which one of you shifted BatesTech out of existence?[[
zh: <罗莎> 好吧，老实交代。你们谁把贝茨科技从存在中抹掉了？[[

en: <Rosha> I just bought a top-of-the-line BT crystalline display cube for streaming films, and now it was never even made. [[
zh: <罗莎> 我刚买了个顶级的 BT 晶体显示立方体用来放电影，结果现在它根本没被造出来过。[[

en: <Balee> I assume the New York office? That's where BatesTech was based.[[
zh: <巴莉> 我猜是纽约办公室？贝茨科技总部就在那儿。[[

en: <Rosha> Who's the agent there?[[
<Balee> That was Duffy's beat.[[
<Rosha> Oh.[[
<Rosha> Never mind. [[
<Rosha> I'll read my Otis Knox collection again instead.
zh: <罗莎> 我还是再去读一遍我的奥蒂斯·诺克斯合集吧。

en: It's back!
<Rosha> Good news! My BatesTech display cube is back![[
zh: <罗莎> 好消息！我的贝茨科技显示立方体回来了！[[

en: <Rosha> Bad news. It's called a "LeavesCube" now. And the quality is TERRIBLE. [[
zh: <罗莎> 坏消息。它现在叫“叶立方”了。而且质量糟透了。[[

en: <Balee> The lesson is to never buy anything that isn't chrono-locked.[[
zh: <巴莉> 教训就是，永远别买没有时空锁定的东西。[[

en: <Balee> Less disappointment that way.[[
<Rosha> I hope I never get that jaded.[[
zh: <罗莎> 我希望我永远不会变得那么麻木。[[

en: <Balee> Give it time.
Energy drainage from NY?
<Horris> Nozzo? We picked up some enormous energy drainage from your branch.[[
zh: <霍里斯> 诺佐？我们监测到你们分部出现了巨大的能量流失。[[

en: <Horris> It's stabilized now, but is everything okay over there?[[
zh: <霍里斯> 现在已经稳定了，但你们那边一切还好吗？[[

en: <Horris> Has anyone heard from Nozzo?[[
zh: <霍里斯> 有人听到诺佐的消息吗？[[

en: <Rohn> If anything bad happened to him, the brass would tell us.[[
zh: <罗恩> 如果他出了什么事，公司高层会告诉我们的。[[

en: <Balee> Correct. He'll touch base if and when he's ready.[[
zh: <巴莉> 没错。等他准备好了，自然会联系我们。[[

en: <Balee> Just leave him be.
Wanna meet up?
<Rosha> I have a few days off next week. I'd like to visit some of you.[[
zh: <罗莎> 我下周有几天假。想去看看你们中的一些人。[[

en: <Horris> That would be nice, but I'm booked solid next week.[[
zh: <霍里斯> 那挺好的，但我下周已经排满了。[[

en: <Rosha> Balee?[[
<Balee> Same.[[
<Rosha> Rohn?[[
<Rohn> If you want to risk a chrono-shift while flying on a plane, sure.[[
zh: <罗恩> 如果你愿意冒着坐飞机时发生时空改写的风险，那当然可以。[[

en: <Rosha> Sigh. Nevermind. Maybe I'll watch "The River Wall" again.
zh: <罗莎> 唉。算了。也许我会再看一遍《河墙》。

en: Park Gallery chrono-shifted again
zh: 帕克画廊又发生时空改写了

en: <Rohn> I heard the painting at the Park Gallery has chrono-shifted again.[[
zh: <罗恩> 我听说帕克画廊的那幅画又时空改写了。[[

en: <Horris> Oh well. Easy come; easy go. [[
zh: <霍里斯> 哦，好吧。来得容易去得也快。[[

en: <Rosha> Did anyone ever find out who it was?[[
zh: <罗莎> 有人查出是谁干的吗？[[

en: <Balee> No. And it doesn't matter. [[
zh: <巴莉> 没有。而且也不重要。[[

en: <Rosha> I guess it doesn't.
Chrono-locked book?
<Horris> Can anyone recommend a good chrono-locked book?[[
zh: <霍里斯> 谁能推荐一本好的时空锁定书？[[

en: <Horris> Been trying to read this Nick Chord biography but it keeps chrono-shifting.[[
zh: <霍里斯> 我一直在读这本尼克·科德的传记，但它老是时空改写。[[

en: <Rosha> Ever read Otis Knox? His whole collection is chrono-locked. I've owned it for years.[[
zh: <罗莎> 读过奥蒂斯·诺克斯吗？他的整个作品集都是时空锁定的。我收藏好多年了。[[

en: <Horris> No I haven't. I'll give them a whirl. Thanks.
zh: <霍里斯> 没读过。我去试试看。谢谢。

en: Bored.
<Rosha> Just finished a job. Bored. Anyone go anywhen fun?[[
zh: <罗莎> 刚完成一个任务。无聊。有人去过什么有趣的时代吗？[[

en: <Rohn> I thought it was your day off?[[
zh: <罗恩> 我还以为你今天休息？[[

en: <Rosha> It was. Decided to take a shift anyway. Not much going on.[[
zh: <罗莎> 本来是。但决定还是接个任务。反正也没什么事。[[

en: <Balee> I get it.
A solidly-built man sits behind the desk without a care in the world.
zh: 一个体格结实的男人坐在桌子后面，一副无忧无虑的样子。

en: Mx. Mix is a hard-light hologram programmed with two hundred years worth of cocktail recipes.
zh: 米克斯先生是一个硬光全息影像，编程输入了两百年的鸡尾酒配方。

en: She is leafing through what seems to be a film script. She must moonlight as an actress.
zh: 她正在翻阅一份看起来像是电影剧本的东西。她一定在兼职当演员。

en: It's been a long time since you were served by an actual human in a restaurant.
zh: 你已经很久没有在餐厅里被真正的人类服务过了。

en: Lisa waits by the door. Every cell in her body is radiating relief.
zh: 丽莎在门边等着。她全身的每个细胞都散发着如释重负的气息。

en: A flustered young woman is huddled over the door, trying to pick the lock.
zh: 一个慌乱的年轻女子蜷缩在门边，试图撬锁。

en: She is bent over the computer keyboard, typing furiously.
zh: 她俯身在电脑键盘上，疯狂地打字。

en: A handsome young man is chatting with Mx. Mix.
zh: 一个英俊的年轻人正在和米克斯先生聊天。

en: A local law enforcement officer. You think they were called "bobbies" in this when.
zh: 一名当地执法人员。你觉得在这个时代他们被称为“巡警”。

en: The expression on Mitchell Santina's face is not a happy one.
zh: 米切尔·桑蒂纳脸上的表情可不怎么高兴。

en: Out like a light.
Your client, Joe Anderson. He paid a lot of money for a trip into the past. It's your job to make sure he gets his money's worth.
zh: 你的客户，乔·安德森。他花了一大笔钱进行时间旅行。你的工作就是确保他物有所值。

en: This elderly woman scribbles furiously at her desk, pausing every few seconds to glance appraisingly at the young man.
zh: 这位老妇人在桌前奋笔疾书，每隔几秒就停下来，用审视的目光瞥一眼那个年轻人。

en: The shop owner examines the diamond with a critical and practiced eye.
zh: 店主用挑剔而老练的眼光检查着钻石。

en: Danny's eyes shift rapidly as he tries to find some way out of this.
zh: 丹尼的眼睛快速转动，试图找到摆脱困境的办法。

en: From the look of them, they have no plans to come up for air anytime soon.
zh: 从他们的样子来看，他们短期内不打算停下来喘口气。

en: If they are aware of the carnage around them, they give no sign.
zh: 如果他们意识到周围的惨状，他们也没有表现出来。

en: Her legs look wobbly, but she maintains a firm grip on both her weapon and her whiskey bottle.
zh: 她的腿看起来在发抖，但她仍然紧紧抓着武器和威士忌酒瓶。

en: She is looking at Arthur with stars in her eyes.
zh: 她满眼星星地望着亚瑟。

en: Her eyes dart impatiently towards the front door.
zh: 她的眼睛不耐烦地瞟向前门。

en: Liz holds her weapon lazily. It's as if she's carried one all her life.
zh: 莉兹懒洋洋地握着武器，仿佛她一辈子都带着枪。

en: You've seen that look of single-minded focus once before; on the face of her Uncle Eddie while chopping fish.
zh: 你以前见过那种专注的神情；在她叔叔埃迪切鱼的时候。

en: Paula's old eyes stare at you, desperate for your approval.
zh: 葆拉苍老的眼睛盯着你，渴望得到你的认可。

en: He looks up at the stage with stars in his eyes. Totally enraptured.
zh: 他满眼星星地望着舞台，完全陶醉其中。

en: His eyes remain locked on Liz's face. The man looks spellbound.
zh: 他的眼睛一直盯着莉兹的脸。这个男人看起来被迷住了。

en: Arthur's eyes twinkle with amusement. This is all a game to him.
zh: 亚瑟的眼睛闪烁着愉悦的光芒。对他来说，这一切都只是一场游戏。

en: His eyes dart impatiently towards the Sycamore painting.
zh: 他的眼睛不耐烦地瞟向那幅西卡莫尔画作。

en: The bartender nervously wipes an already clean glass. His eyes stare longingly at the exit.
zh: 酒保紧张地擦着一只已经干净的玻璃杯，眼睛渴望地盯着出口。

en: This young man pummels the bag with strong, well-practiced blows.
zh: 这个年轻人用有力而熟练的拳法击打着沙袋。

en: Brian lies unconscious on the floor. He snores softly.
zh: 布赖恩昏迷不醒地躺在地板上，轻轻地打着鼾。

en: Brian has obviously had several drinks already.
zh: 布赖恩显然已经喝了好几杯了。

en: Simon stares at the ruins. His expression unreadable.
zh: 西蒙凝视着废墟，表情难以捉摸。

en: Simon's body lies motionless on the ground.
zh: 西蒙的身体一动不动地躺在地上。

en: Simon jabs the air with with mechanical precision. His face is a mask of pure determination.
zh: 西蒙以机械般的精准刺向空气，脸上满是坚定的神情。

en: This young girl watches Simon, her face alternating between frustration and pride.
zh: 这个小女孩看着西蒙，脸上的表情在沮丧和骄傲之间交替。

en: Young Paula is trapped underneath a fallen tree. She is unconscious but alive. For now.
zh: 年轻的葆拉被困在一棵倒下的树下。她失去了知觉，但还活着。暂时如此。

en: Paula is sitting on the chopping block and scribbling in her sketchbook; completely unaware of how drastically her timeline has changed.
zh: 葆拉坐在砧板上，在素描本上涂鸦；完全不知道她的时间线已经发生了多么巨大的变化。

en: Clara watches the pub - and Brian Mason - with a sharp and careful eye.
zh: 克拉拉用敏锐而谨慎的目光注视着酒吧——还有布赖恩·梅森。

en: The barmaid surveys her domain with a casual but watchful eye.
zh: 酒吧女招待用随意但警惕的目光巡视着她的领地。

en: The food seller shucks oyster after oyster without even looking down once.
zh: 食品摊贩一个接一个地剥着牡蛎，甚至一次都没有低头看。

en: Jackson Grant looks as if life has pushed him into that chair and he has no plans on getting up anytime soon.
zh: 杰克逊·格兰特看起来像是被生活推到了那把椅子上，而且短期内不打算起来。

en: This fish monger is incredibly large. He slices through his wares like a machine.
zh: 这个鱼贩子身材极其高大，像机器一样切着鱼。

en: Eddie Inman stands over Simon's body. His expression unreadable.
zh: 埃迪·英曼站在西蒙的尸体旁，表情难以捉摸。

en: Sam continues to scan his card. If he feels any frustration, he isn't showing any.
zh: 萨姆继续扫描他的卡。如果他感到沮丧，他也没有表现出来。

en: A pleasant-looking man stands in front of the panel.
zh: 一个和蔼可亲的男人站在面板前。

en: Sam is chatting quietly with Benji. He seems happy for the company.
zh: 萨姆正在和本吉轻声聊天。他似乎很高兴有人陪伴。

en: Sam is lounging on the bench, leisurely eating his sandwich. Hopefully he finishes before you need to leave. You don't want to have to find a new jumping off point.
zh: 萨姆懒洋洋地坐在长椅上，悠闲地吃着三明治。希望他在你需要离开之前吃完。你不想再找一个新的跃迁点。

en: Sam is leisurely eating his sandwich, completely unaware of the problem he is causing you.
zh: 萨姆正悠闲地吃着三明治，完全没有意识到他给你带来的麻烦。

en: Sam's eyes are half-glazed over. He is struggling to pay attention.
zh: 萨姆的眼神有些呆滞，他正努力集中注意力。

en: Madison in presentation-mode is a living embodiment of focus. Her eyes never once break from the streamcam on the far wall.
zh: 演示模式下的麦迪逊是专注的化身。她的眼睛从未离开过远处墙上的流媒体摄像头。

en: Madison Bates shifts a bit from foot to foot. She is clearly not comfortable with being idle.
zh: 麦迪逊·贝茨双脚交替着微微挪动。她显然不习惯闲着。

en: Madison's outfit is covered in beetroot dressing. She futilely struggles to wipe it off.
zh: 麦迪逊的衣服上沾满了甜菜根沙拉酱。她徒劳地试图擦掉。

en: She is out like a light.
Madison meditates on the bench, breathing slowly and carefully.
zh: 麦迪逊在长椅上冥想，呼吸缓慢而平稳。

en: The young Benjamin Pasamon regards the room with half-closed eyes, smiling as if he just thought of a funny joke.
zh: 年轻的本杰明·帕萨蒙半闭着眼睛打量着房间，脸上带着微笑，仿佛刚想到了一个有趣的笑话。

en: Benjamin Pasamon struggles to keep his composure. He's clearly quite taken with Sam Deane.
zh: 本杰明·帕萨蒙努力保持镇定。他显然对萨姆·迪恩很有好感。

en: This bottle-shaped drone buzzes happily in its charging dock.
zh: 这个瓶形无人机在充电座上欢快地嗡嗡作响。

en: This bottle-shaped drone lies on its side, completely inert.
zh: 这个瓶形无人机侧躺着，完全不动了。

en: The dressing-dispenser drone bobs up and down happily. You hear liquid faintly swishing inside.
zh: 调料分配无人机欢快地上下浮动。你能听到里面液体轻轻晃动的声音。

en: The dressing-dispenser is sitting peacefully on its charging dock.
zh: 调料分配器安静地停在充电座上。

en: A small decal on the back reads "Un-1"
zh: 背面有一张小贴纸，写着“Un-1”

en: Cassie is talking intently into an earpiece.
zh: 卡西正对着耳机专注地说话。

en: A fresh-faced officer is furiously writing in a ticket book.
zh: 一名面容稚嫩的警官正飞快地在罚单本上写着什么。

en: The young officer is gathering the assorted gifts that have been scattered around the steps. She grunts occasionally.
zh: 年轻的警官正在收拾散落在台阶上的各种礼物。她不时发出哼声。

en: The young officer is grimacing and nursing her black eye.
zh: 年轻的警官龇牙咧嘴，护着自己被打青的眼睛。

en: This young woman is intently reading a newspaper.
zh: 这个年轻女子正专注地读着一份报纸。

en: Yvonne Lozzotti. Why she's here - and how she's still alive - is anyone's guess.
zh: 伊冯娜·洛佐蒂。她为何在这里——以及她怎么还活着——没人知道。

en: Em is gazing thoughtfully out the window. If she notices your presence, she gives no sign.
zh: 埃姆若有所思地凝视着窗外。就算她注意到了你的存在，也没有任何表示。

en: Her gaze draws you in. It's difficult to look anywhere else.
zh: 她的目光吸引着你，让你难以看向别处。

en: Blissfully asleep for the next twelve hours. Enough time to avoid what's coming.
zh: 接下来十二个小时都会沉睡不醒。有足够的时间避开即将发生的事。

en: History says Nick killed most of his victims with a gun, but there's a solid chance it was his smell.
zh: 历史上说尼克的大部分受害者死于枪击，但很有可能是被他的气味熏死的。

en: He is intently focused on his work. Lost in his own world.
zh: 他全神贯注于自己的工作，沉浸在自己的世界里。

en: This man gazes at the ocean, lost in thought.
zh: 这个男人凝视着大海，陷入沉思。

en: Liam watches the fireworks, completely enraptured.
zh: 利亚姆看着烟花，完全入了迷。

en: A late middle-aged woman is working in the neighboring garden.
zh: 一位五十多岁的女人在旁边的花园里干活。

en: You really don't want to do this.
A solitary pigeon pokes at something invisible on the sidewalk.
zh: 一只孤零零的鸽子在人行道上啄着什么看不见的东西。

en: A scattering of pigeons peck at the ground.
A pigeon flits in and out of view, hoping the next visit will result in crumbs from Minna's stall.
zh: 一只鸽子在视野中飞来飞去，希望下次来的时候能从明娜的摊位上得到些面包屑。

en: A pigeon. A universal constant in any era of New York history.
