zh: &34 你费那么大劲帮丽莎。试过跟她谈谈了吗？

en: &43 So. Lisa and young Andy used to meet up on the roof of the chemistry building.
zh: &43 这么说，丽莎和小安迪以前常在化学楼的楼顶见面。

en: &35 It's a good a place to check out as any. Nostalgia is a powerful force.
zh: &35 那是个值得去看看的地方。怀旧的力量很强大。

en: &84 Surely you don't need my help this soon.
zh: &84 你肯定不需要这么快就找我帮忙。

en: &1696 Maybe try moving beyond the landing point? You're not going to get much done from here.
zh: &1696 也许试着离开跃迁落点走走？待在这里可做不成什么事。

en: &2561 So about this gate...
&2562 Maybe I wouldn't, if the brass could vet these landing points more carefully.
zh: &2562 要是公司高层能更仔细地审查这些跃迁落点，也许我就不用这样了。

en: &509 Didn't you have a similar situation recently?
zh: &509 你最近不是遇到过类似的情况吗？

en: &6000 How did you deal with it then?
&2564 Any idea where we should go first?
zh: &2564 知道我们该先去哪儿吗？

en: &510 Well we don't know where Simon Inman lived, but we do know where he fought.
zh: &510 我们不知道西蒙·英曼住哪儿，但知道他在哪儿打过拳。

en: &2568 Right. It was in the newspaper. Ida's Gym, right?
zh: &2568 对。报纸上登过。艾达拳馆，对吧？

en: &551 That's right. You should already have the address.
zh: &551 没错。你应该已经有地址了。

en: &2569 Always thinking ahead, aren't you?
&552 I mean... that's literally my job?
zh: &552 我是说……这本来就是我的工作？

en: &553 Anyway, get moving. I'll be here.
zh: &553 总之，动起来吧。我就在这儿。

en: &3206 Have you tried talking to that woman at the desk? She seems to know what's going on.
zh: &3206 你试过跟前台那个女的谈谈吗？她好像知道是怎么回事。

en: &1697 Have you tried talking to that guy over there?
zh: &1697 你试过跟那边那个家伙谈谈吗？

en: &1698 It's as good a start as any.
&3207 I don't think Ida has told us everything. Have you tried talking to her?
zh: &3207 我觉得艾达没把一切都告诉我们。你试过跟她谈谈吗？

en: &2570 Tight-lipped bunch, these boxers. Acting as if Simon never fought here.
zh: &2570 这些拳手嘴真严。表现得好像西蒙从没在这儿打过拳似的。

en: &807 Don't you have proof that he did?
zh: &807 你不是有他打过的证据吗？

en: &6039 Yeah.
&813 Well maybe you should, you know, use it.
&2571 So Simon used to work at an Oyster Stand. Think it's worth checking out?
zh: &2571 所以西蒙以前在牡蛎摊工作过。你觉得值得去看看吗？

en: &814 As leads go, we've followed worse.
zh: &814 作为线索，我们追过更糟的。

en: &839 Have you spoken to the food stall owner yet?
zh: &839 你跟小吃摊老板谈过了吗？

en: &2572 Just about to.
&6044 Minna said Simon used to drink here. Try asking around.
zh: &6044 明娜说西蒙以前常在这里喝酒。试着问问周围的人。

en: &840 Didn't Minna say that Simon used to drink at the Barking Dog? You probably should head there.
zh: &840 明娜不是说过西蒙以前常在“吠犬”喝酒吗？你也许该去那里。

en: &6107 Any advice on how not to die?
zh: &6107 有什么不死的方法建议吗？

en: &512 The Emergency Rewind takes you back maybe 10-20 minutes at most.
zh: &512 紧急回溯最多把你带回大约10到20分钟前。

en: &513 That makes events predictable. What happens in one loop will happen in another.
zh: &513 这让事件变得可预测。一个循环里发生的事，在另一个循环里也会发生。

en: &514 So all you need to do is... nudge things a little.
zh: &514 所以你只需要……稍微推一把。

en: &155 Where do you think Simon might be?
zh: &155 你觉得西蒙可能在哪里？

en: &1055 You could try him at home. The Inman residence still exists in your current when.
zh: &1055 你可以去他家试试。英曼家的住所在你当前的时代仍然存在。

en: &2 My call would be to head there.
&6109 I think it's a good call.
&1056 There's no residence listed in the archive, but I'm sure someone must know where he lives.
zh: &1056 档案里没有列出住所，但我肯定有人知道他住在哪里。

en: &1057 Ask around, maybe?
&515 You know as much as I do, Fia. You should try and get information from someone else.
zh: &515 你知道的和我一样多，菲娅。你应该试着从别人那里获取信息。

en: &267 Ever hear of this Breakdown Boys gang?
zh: &267 听说过这个“破坏男孩”帮派吗？

en: &516 In that when, every square block of New York had its own gang.
zh: &516 在那个时代，纽约每个街区都有自己的帮派。

en: &581 I'd suggest looking in the archive.
&6110 Any ideas on getting that fish monger to talk?
zh: &6110 有什么办法能让那个鱼贩开口吗？

en: &3 I could beat him up. Somehow I'm sure he deserves it.
zh: &3 我可以揍他一顿。不知怎的，我确信他活该。

en: &670 I would recommend... not trying that.
&671 My suggestion? Go back there when he's not around.
zh: &671 我的建议？趁他不在的时候再去那里。

en: &920 Hmmm.
&6111 It's too blasting dark to see anything!
zh: &6111 太他妈黑了，什么都看不见！

en: &841 You know that ChronoZen never lets an agent go into the field unprepared.
zh: &841 你知道 ChronoZen 从不会让特工毫无准备地进入现场。

en: &842 I'm sure you must have something that can be useful?
zh: &842 我肯定你有什么能派上用场的东西？

en: &6112 That photo in the fish monger's flat. Any idea who that family could be?
zh: &6112 鱼贩公寓里的那张照片。你知道那家人可能是谁吗？

en: &843 No, but I'm sure there must be something in the archive. Something we can compare it to.
zh: &843 不知道，但我肯定档案里一定有东西。有我们可以拿来对比的。

en: &2497 That fishmonger is obviously connected to the Inman family in some way.
zh: &2497 那个鱼贩显然跟英曼家有什么关联。

en: &6045 Have you tried asking another Inman? Seems like the most obvious way to find out.
zh: &6045 你试过问另一个英曼家的人吗？这似乎是最直接的查法。

en: &268 So. That fishmonger's name is Eddie and he is Simon and Paula's uncle.
zh: &268 那么，那个鱼贩叫埃迪，是西蒙和葆拉的叔叔。

en: &269 Good to know, but I'm not sure how useful it is.
zh: &269 知道是好事，但我不确定这有多大用。

en: &742 Have you spoken to everyone involved? I'm sure Eddie has something to say about his nephew.
zh: &742 你跟所有相关的人都谈过了吗？我肯定埃迪对他侄子有话说。

en: &271 Blast it. Where did Eddie Inman run off to?
zh: &271 该死。埃迪·英曼跑到哪儿去了？

en: &891 He said he was going after Simon. Didn't you leave his body at the ruins of his old house?
zh: &891 他说他去找西蒙了。你不是把他的尸体留在他老房子的废墟了吗？

en: &272 You're right. I should probably check there.
zh: &272 你说得对。我可能该去那里看看。

en: &1032 Hm. You didn't get the chance to look around the fish market, did you?
zh: &1032 嗯。你没机会在鱼市四处看看吧？

en: &273 With Eddie Inman waving that cleaver around? No I did not.
zh: &273 埃迪·英曼在那儿挥着切肉刀？没有，我没看成。

en: &1058 Well, he's left that area. Now's your chance.
zh: &1058 嗯，他已经离开那片区域了。现在正是时候。

en: &1120 Hm. Didn't Simon say he was heading to the gym?
zh: &1120 嗯。西蒙不是说他要去健身房吗？

en: &1295 Since he's no longer at home, maybe now is a good chance to look around.
zh: &1295 既然他已经不在家了，现在也许正是四处看看的好机会。

en: &274 Paula is somewhere in that forest, but I can't find my way around.
zh: &274 葆拉就在那片森林里，但我找不到路。

en: &1533 Hm. This is just a hunch, but I think you have all the information you need.
zh: &1533 嗯。这只是直觉，但我觉得你已经掌握了所有需要的信息。

en: &6042 Did you take a look at that sketchbook? Or that note from Paula's doll?
zh: &6042 你看过那个速写本了吗？或者葆拉娃娃里的那张纸条？

en: &275 I assume it's... okay to save her?
zh: &275 我想……救她是没问题的吧？

en: &1683 Prediction models say yes. Any potential ripples are limited to people with a Medium ranking or lower.
zh: &1683 预测模型显示没问题。任何潜在的涟漪都仅限于中等级别或更低的人。

en: &276 Right. Good. Now I just have to figure out HOW.
zh: &276 好。很好。现在我得想办法怎么救。

en: &1684 You have plenty of tools at your disposal, Fia. Try using one of them.
zh: &1684 你手头有很多工具，菲娅。试试用其中一个。

en: &277 Well. We saved Paula. Not sure what we should do now.
zh: &277 好了。我们救了葆拉。不知道现在该做什么。

en: &1685 We changed history, Fia. Surely a number of things have changed.
zh: &1685 我们改变了历史，菲娅。肯定有很多事情都变了。

en: &1686 My suggestion? Revisit everywhere and everyone in October.
zh: &1686 我的建议？十月份把每个地方、每个人都重新拜访一遍。

en: &278 A secret compartment in Eddie Inman's flat. Clever.
zh: &278 埃迪·英曼公寓里的暗格。真聪明。

en: &280 A shame that ledger wasn't in it.
&1687 Are you sure? Did you check both whens?
zh: &1687 你确定？两个年代都查过了吗？

en: &281 According to the ledger, Eddie Inman paid large sums of money to Ida's Gym.
zh: &281 根据账本，埃迪·英曼向艾达的健身房支付了大笔款项。

en: &282 Think we should speak to her about that?
zh: &282 我们是不是该找她谈谈这件事？

en: &1688 I mean, yes? But try and be diplomatic.
zh: &1688 我是说，应该？但尽量委婉一点。

en: &8065 Naturally.
&283 Brian was not happy to learn that Ida was working with gangs.
zh: &283 布赖恩得知艾达和帮派合作后很不高兴。

en: &1689 A shame he didn't know about that six months earlier when it could've done some good.
zh: &1689 可惜他六个月前不知道这件事，那时候本来还能起点作用。

en: &284 Hm. A shame indeed.
&5303 Brian Mason sure stormed off, didn't he?
zh: &5303 布赖恩·梅森气冲冲地走了，对吧？

en: &5304 Where d'you think he went?
&3208 Have you tried following him?
&285 I can't land a blasting finger on that Brian Mason!
zh: &285 我一根手指都碰不到那个布赖恩·梅森！

en: &1690 You can't beat him, Fia. He's a trained fighter. You're not.
zh: &1690 你打不过他，菲娅。他是受过训练的拳手。你不是。

en: &286 So what do you suggest?
&1691 The archive says that Brian was too predictable when fighting. Which is why he never progressed far in the sport.
zh: &1691 档案说布赖恩打斗时太容易被预判。所以他在这个项目上一直没什么进步。

en: &1692 If his opponents could predict his moves, surelu a time traveler can?
zh: &1692 如果他的对手都能预判他的动作，时间旅行者肯定也能吧？

en: &1693 You can't beat him, but maybe you can outlast him.
zh: &1693 你打不过他，但也许能拖垮他。

en: &287 I suppose I should go see how Brian and Simon are getting on.
zh: &287 我想我该去看看布赖恩和西蒙怎么样了。

en: &1694 They're probably both at Ida's Gym by now.
zh: &1694 他们现在可能都在艾达的健身房。

en: &288 Copy that. Heading over.
&1695 YES. Check on Chloe and Simon. And hurry.
zh: &1695 对。去看看克洛伊和西蒙。快点。

en: &44 Any thoughts, Noz?
&36 Have you tried... talking to the client?
&37 She has all the details.
&45 I think we've hit a dead end.
zh: &45 我觉得我们走进死胡同了。

en: &46 This shop owner doesn't know anything.
zh: &46 这个店主什么都不知道。

en: &38 I'm surprised. That photo is solid proof!
zh: &38 我很惊讶。那张照片是铁证！

en: &48 This shop owner is being very... stubborn.
&39 It's the 1920s. Almost everyone was for sale.
zh: &39 这是1920年代。几乎人人都能被收买。

en: &40 I'm sure you can find a way to grease the wheels.
zh: &40 我相信你能找到打通关节的办法。

en: &49 Any ideas where to find this Jackson Grant?
zh: &49 知道去哪里找这个杰克逊·格兰特吗？

en: &41 What does the Historical Archive say?
&42 You... HAVE checked the archive, right?
&50 Are we sure this is Precursor Syndrome?
zh: &50 我们确定这是前兆综合征吗？

en: &43 We can't take the chance. Bring her back to the landing point.
zh: &43 我们不能冒险。把她带回跃迁落点。

en: &44 Like, now.
&70 Any thoughts right now?
&62 Not at the moment.
&51 I can't believe I agreed to this nonsense.
zh: &51 真不敢相信我居然同意了这种荒唐事。

en: &52 I need to get that police officer away from Grant's building. Any ideas?
zh: &52 我得把那个警察从格兰特的大楼前引开。有什么主意吗？

en: &45 Not offhand. Did you check the archive?
zh: &45 一时想不出来。你查过档案了吗？

en: &1856 Aiding and abetting the theft of a police car. That's one off the bucket list.
zh: &1856 协助并教唆盗窃警车。人生清单又完成一项。

en: &8061 I wonder where it ended up?
zh: &8061 不知道它最后怎么样了？

en: &6043 Officer Mitchell's police record is public information. If you really want to know, I'd check the archive.
zh: &6043 米切尔警官的警务记录是公开信息。如果你真想知道，我建议查档案。

en: &55 Arthur and Liz are... certainly fond of each other.
zh: &55 亚瑟和莉兹……确实很恩爱。

en: &56 I feel like I need a bucket of water.
&48 Whatever gets the job done.
&57 They ran off. AGAIN.
&49 Why aren't you going after them?
&58 I was just about to do that.
&59 Are ALL police officers of this era so trigger happy?
zh: &59 这个年代的所有警察都这么爱开枪吗？

en: &50 Corruption was rampant. And the crime rate sky-high.
zh: &50 腐败猖獗。犯罪率也高得吓人。

en: &60 Even still.
&61 I feel like I can reach the man. If I can just find the right words.
zh: &61 我觉得我能说动他。只要找到合适的措辞。

en: &62 Arthur and Liz could be anywhere.
zh: &62 亚瑟和莉兹可能在任何地方。

en: &51 Did you search the area around the car crash site?
zh: &51 你搜过车祸现场周围了吗？

en: &52 They must have left some kind of clue behind.
zh: &52 他们肯定留下了某种线索。

en: &63 Any ideas?
&53 This is just a feeling, but I don't think Jackson Grant has told us everything?
zh: &53 只是感觉，但我觉得杰克逊·格兰特没有把一切都告诉我们。

en: &64 He's not exactly forthcoming. He's too concerned about his daughter.
zh: &64 他不太愿意开口。他太担心女儿了。

en: &54 Hm. It's hard to blame him.
&55 If you could set his mind at ease, maybe he'd be more amenable.
zh: &55 如果你能让他安心，也许他会更配合。

en: &65 What was that password? "Mad Baddy sent me?"
zh: &65 那个密码是什么来着？“疯巴迪派我来的？”

en: &56 "Blue Maddy Sent Me."
&66 Right. Heading over.
&67 I need to get that woman off the stage.
zh: &67 我得把那个女人从台上弄下来。

en: &57 Sounds like her voice is being filtered through a standard microphone.
zh: &57 听起来她的声音像是经过标准麦克风过滤的。

en: &58 I'd suggest finding a way to disable it.
zh: &58 我建议想办法把它关掉。

en: &59 Have you tried talking to the Camron couple again?
zh: &59 你试过再跟卡姆伦夫妇谈谈吗？

en: &69 Finally. I know where to find Pie Sycamore.
zh: &69 终于。我知道去哪儿找派·西卡莫尔了。

en: &60 I know. Imani is on the edge of her seat.
zh: &60 我知道。伊曼妮正坐立不安呢。

en: &61 You'd better head over there.
&3209 Only to GET A MOVE ON.
&71 Any tips on how to rob a jewelry store, Noz?
zh: &71 诺佐，抢劫珠宝店有什么诀窍吗？

en: &63 Er. Not in my usual area of expertise.
zh: &63 呃。这可不是我通常擅长的领域。

en: &64 But if you must... I'd suggest getting that gun away from the shop owner.
zh: &64 但如果你非干不可……我建议先把枪从店主手里弄走。

en: &65 Preferably BEFORE he knows you're there to rob him.
zh: &65 最好是在他知道你是来抢劫的之前。

en: &6046 Look at them. Just standing there. Minutes away from death and they don't even know it.
zh: &6046 看看他们。就那么站着。离死亡只有几分钟了，他们却浑然不知。

en: &1059 Which they never will, because you're going to stop it. Right?
zh: &1059 他们永远不会知道，因为你会阻止这一切。对吧？

en: &6047 Working on it, Noz.
&72 How do we get that blasted safe open without getting shot?
zh: &72 我们怎么才能打开那个该死的保险箱又不挨枪子儿？

en: &66 You have the LITERAL benefit of hindsight, Fia.
zh: &66 菲娅，你可是有实实在在的事后之明。

en: &67 Danny knows the full combination. Liz seems to know part of it.
zh: &67 丹尼知道完整的密码。莉兹好像知道一部分。

en: &68 Watch them very carefully. See what you can learn.
zh: &68 仔细观察他们。看你能发现什么。

en: &69 There has to be a way to put it all together.
zh: &69 一定有办法把线索拼起来。

en: &73 How many guns are there in this era anyway?
zh: &73 这个年代到底有多少枪啊？

en: &70 The crime rate was sky-high and the police force was famously corrupt.
zh: &70 犯罪率极高，警察腐败也是出了名的。

en: &844 So... lots?
&75 Think Pie Sycamore is finished with the painting by now?
zh: &75 你觉得派·西卡莫尔画完了吗？

en: &71 Couldn't hurt to check.
&1699 All out, I'm afraid. Have you checked the archive for anything new?
zh: &1699 恐怕都用完了。你查过档案里有没有新东西吗？

en: &289 That Sam fellow honestly believes his temp agency is on the level.
zh: &289 那个叫萨姆的家伙真以为他的临时工中介是正经的。

en: &290 We know better, but how can we convince him of that?
zh: &290 我们知道真相，可怎么才能让他相信呢？

en: &1700 Hm. We both know what a terrible liar you are, so you need to confront him with the truth.
zh: &1700 嗯。我们都知道你撒谎有多蹩脚，所以你得拿真相跟他当面对质。

en: &1701 There's got to be a contradiction somewhere. One that makes it obvious.
zh: &1701 肯定有自相矛盾的地方。一个显而易见的矛盾。

en: &291 Right. I'll try and find one.
&1702 Have you tried using the keycard?
zh: &1702 你试过用那张钥匙卡吗？

en: &292 I think that Sam fellow established quite well that it doesn't work.
zh: &292 我觉得那个萨姆已经充分证明了它没用。

en: &1703 Anything's worth a try. Within reason.
zh: &1703 只要合理，什么都值得一试。

en: &1704 Cassie told you to go speak to Madison. So you probably should do that.
zh: &1704 卡西让你去找麦迪逊谈谈。所以你大概该去。

en: &1705 We need to get a closer look at that drone.
zh: &1705 我们得凑近看看那架无人机。

en: &1706 The drone just has a broken wire. I'm sure you can find a replacement somewhere around here.
zh: &1706 无人机只是断了一根线。我肯定你能在这附近找到替换的。

en: &1707 Everyone thinks you're an office temp. Maybe you should start acting like one?
zh: &1707 大家都以为你是办公室临时工。也许你该表现得像一点？

en: &293 And how do I do that?
&1708 To start with, see if anyone needs any help.
zh: &1708 首先，看看有没有人需要帮助。

en: &1709 Hm. There was an interesting-looking machine in the workshop. It's probably worth checking out.
zh: &1709 嗯。车间里有台机器看起来挺有意思。值得去看看。

en: &294 Any idea what this "PasaGel" is supposed to do?
zh: &294 你知道这个“帕萨凝胶”是干什么用的吗？

en: &1710 No. If it's registered under any patents, it's not under that name.
zh: &1710 不知道。如果它注册过专利，也不是用这个名字。

en: &1711 Maybe try asking its creator? Where's the young Mr. Pasamon?
zh: &1711 也许该问问它的发明者？年轻的帕萨蒙先生在哪？

en: &295 This "PasaGel" can be rigged to explode if key words are spoken...
zh: &295 这个“帕萨凝胶”可以在说出关键词时被引爆……

en: &1712 Don't even think about it.
&296 Not ME! I'm thinking, maybe, someone else could say them.
zh: &296 不是我！我是想，也许可以让别人来说。

en: &297 Or close approximations, at least.
&1713 Hm. It could work.
&299 Everything is set. I just need to stand back.
zh: &299 都准备好了。我只需要退后。

en: &408 I hope this works.
&409 Mission complete, Noz?
&1714 Mission complete. Head back to the landing point.
zh: &1714 任务完成。返回跃迁落点。

en: &1715 Heading inside would be a good starting point.
&410 Ugh. What do I do with this trash, Nozzo?
zh: &410 呃。这垃圾我该怎么处理，诺佐？

en: &1716 Didn't Benji Pasamon say to throw it away in the break room?
zh: &1716 本吉·帕萨蒙不是说过扔到休息室吗？

en: &1717 There is probably a trash bin in there.
zh: &1717 那里面应该有个垃圾桶。

en: &411 That trash lid isn't coming off no matter what I do!
zh: &411 那个垃圾桶盖怎么都打不开！

en: &1718 Hm. It may be some kind of locking mechanism.
zh: &1718 嗯。可能是某种锁定装置。

en: &412 For a trash bin?
&1719 Why not? There must be a button or switch or something. Look around.
zh: &1719 为什么不行？肯定有按钮或开关之类的。找找看。

en: &413 Looks like that that explosion knocked something loose.
zh: &413 看来那场爆炸把什么东西震松了。

en: &1720 Well, don't let me stop you.
&414 Thank blasting god. The trash chute was under the bin.
zh: &414 谢天谢地。垃圾通道就在垃圾桶下面。

en: &1721 Great. Maybe you should, you know, use it?
zh: &1721 太好了。也许你该，你知道，用它？

en: &415 I suppose I should answer the door.
&1722 Yes, I suppose you should.
&437 I need a hiding place. Somewhere I can both open that door and not be seen by, er, me.
zh: &437 我需要一个藏身之处。一个既能打开那扇门，又不会被，呃，我自己看到的地方。

en: &1723 We know it's here, because you technically will have already found it.
zh: &1723 我们知道它就在这，因为严格来说你已经找到过它了。

en: &438 So. Landing point?
&1724 Landing point.
&449 Wasn't there an office manager around here? Cassie something?
zh: &449 这附近不是有个办公室经理吗？叫卡西什么的？

en: &3211 She's right over there, Fia.
&1725 I think she went into downstairs offices.
zh: &1725 我想她去了楼下的办公室。

en: &451 If we're going to help Madison, we need to cover up those stains on her outfit.
zh: &451 如果我们要帮麦迪逊，就得遮住她衣服上的污渍。

en: &452 Maybe a coat, or a sweater...
zh: &452 也许一件外套，或者毛衣……

en: &1726 There's a closed locker in the break room. Maybe something in there can help.
zh: &1726 休息室里有个锁着的储物柜。也许里面有什么能帮上忙。

en: &453 This coat should do nicely. But how can I get it to Madison? I don't have access to the vertical farm.
zh: &453 这件外套应该不错。但我怎么把它交给麦迪逊？我没有进入垂直农场的权限。

en: &1727 Hm. In that case, we'll need someone - or something - that does.
zh: &1727 嗯。那样的话，我们需要一个——或者一样——能做到的人或东西。

en: &454 I can't believe we pulled that off.
zh: &454 真不敢相信我们居然成功了。

en: &1728 Let's not stick around longer than we have to. Get back to the landing point.
zh: &1728 别在这里多待。回到跃迁落点去。

en: &1729 Other than that this is a bad idea? Maybe head inside.
zh: &1729 除了说这是个坏主意之外？也许该进去看看。

en: &455 I suppose I should follow Benji, then?
zh: &455 那我应该跟着本吉，对吧？

en: &1730 If that's what you think is best.
&456 Benji said he needed a magnet from the break room.
zh: &456 本吉说需要从休息室拿一块磁铁。

en: &1731 Better go get it, then.
&505 Blast it. I have to hide!
&1732 I knew this was a bad idea.
zh: &1732 我就知道这是个坏主意。

en: &506 Help first. Recriminations later!
&1733 Fine. Maybe the trash bin? It looks open in this when.
zh: &1733 好吧。也许垃圾桶？在这个年代它看起来是开着的。

en: &507 What are my options, Nozzo?
&1734 Avoid your previous selves. That's priority one, two and three.
zh: &1734 避开过去的你们自己。这是第一、第二、第三优先。

en: &1735 How about leaving? Leaving would be good.
zh: &1735 离开怎么样？离开会很好。

en: &508 Madison is in a deep meditative state. Maybe we can exploit that.
zh: &508 麦迪逊正处于深度冥想状态。也许我们可以利用这一点。

en: &509 Adjust her environment so she'll fall asleep. Make her miss the presentation.
zh: &509 调整她的环境让她睡着。让她错过演示。

en: &510 Think that's a good idea?
&6031 Sure.
&511 There has to be a way to get Benji to skip the presentation.
zh: &511 一定有办法让本吉跳过演示。

en: &1736 You could try talking to him. You're good at convincing people.
zh: &1736 你可以试着跟他谈谈。你很擅长说服人。

en: &1737 I mean, obviously.
&513 I guess Cassie is still unsure about whether to give the presentation.
zh: &513 我猜卡西还在犹豫要不要做演示。

en: &1738 Let's find her and get out of here.
zh: &1738 我们找到她然后离开这里。

en: &514 So what do you think, Noz?
&8059 I dunno Fia. Have you tried the archive?
zh: &8059 我不知道，菲娅。你试过档案库了吗？

en: &1517 Our problem exists in the future. The archive won't exactly help me now, will it?
zh: &1517 我们的问题存在于未来。档案库现在帮不了我，对吧？

en: &1520 Well, you're not going to solve anything by hanging around the landing point.
zh: &1520 嗯，你在跃迁落点附近晃悠也解决不了任何问题。

en: &1529 So get a move on.
&8066 Right you are, Noz.
&8072 Hm. What about Cassie's office? She's left the facility. Now's a good time to snoop around.
zh: &8072 嗯。卡西的办公室怎么样？她已经离开设施了。现在是四处窥探的好时机。

en: &8067 Good plan, Noz. I'll check that out right now.
zh: &8067 好计划，诺佐。我马上去看看。

en: &1951 Well, Fia. I sent you that video. What more do you need?
zh: &1951 嗯，菲娅。我发了那个视频给你。你还需要什么？

en: &1952 I don't know. That's why I'm asking you.
zh: &1952 我不知道。所以我才问你。

en: &1953 Maybe there's something in the video? Something that exists in both my when and yours?
zh: &1953 也许视频里有什么？既存在于我的年代也存在于你的年代的东西？

en: &1954 I have no idea. I don't really exist.
zh: &1954 我不知道。我并不真正存在。

en: &1956 That weapon in Cassie's drawer. Do you think it looks familiar?
zh: &1956 卡西抽屉里的那件武器。你觉得它看起来眼熟吗？

en: &1957 Maybe it does?
&1958 Maybe you should watch that video I sent you again.
zh: &1958 也许你该再看一遍我发给你的视频。

en: &1959 On it, Noz.
&1960 I think that I'm about to be shot by a man wearing the ugliest shoes I've ever seen.
zh: &1960 我觉得我快要被一个穿着我这辈子见过最丑鞋子的男人开枪打死了。

en: &1961 I will try to save you from that indignity.
zh: &1961 我会尽力让你免于那种屈辱。

en: &1962 But wait, haven't we seen those shoes somewhere else before?
zh: &1962 等等，我们之前是不是在别处见过那双鞋？

en: &1963 You tell me. I'm not really here.
zh: &1963 你告诉我。我又不真的在这里。

en: &8073 I think you're wasting time. Everything is ready. Tune in and watch the show.
zh: &8073 我觉得你在浪费时间。一切都准备好了。调好频道看戏吧。

en: &115 She's just... staring, Nozzo.
&845 She lived through the towers falling. You didn't.
zh: &845 她亲身经历过双子塔倒塌。你没有。

en: &846 Just be patient. Talk to her when she seems ready.
zh: &846 耐心点。等她看起来准备好了再跟她谈。

en: &135 How do we get down from here?
&847 There SHOULD be a fire escape, assuming I chose the right point in time.
zh: &847 应该有个消防梯，前提是我选对了时间点。

en: &136 Yeah. I see it.
&848 Well then.
&138 So... what do we do?
&849 The client has the details. I suggest you talk to her.
zh: &849 客户知道细节。我建议你跟她谈谈。

en: &139 To Nick Chord's then?
&850 The client is waiting.
&140 There must be SOMETHING I can do to make sure we have the right man. Or the wrong one.
zh: &140 我肯定能做点什么来确认我们找对了人。或者找错了。

en: &141 Maybe get authorization so I can stun him?
zh: &141 也许能拿到授权，让我把他击晕？

en: &851 Even if we could, the stun effect only lasts a half-hour.
zh: &851 就算可以，击晕效果也只能持续半小时。

en: &852 We need to find something that's guaranteed to knock him out for significantly longer.
zh: &852 我们得找到能保证让他昏迷更长时间的东西。

en: &142 Are there any ripples? Anything at all?
zh: &142 有没有什么涟漪？任何动静？

en: &853 Nothing above marginal. Almost impossible to pinpoint what is causing them unless I scour the archive.
zh: &853 没有超出边际的。除非我翻遍档案，否则几乎不可能确定是什么引起的。

en: &143 Hopefully I can save you the trouble. There must be SOMETHING that's changed. Something obvious.
zh: &143 希望我能省掉你的麻烦。肯定有什么东西变了。很明显的东西。

en: &854 It's possible. I'll keep searching in the meantime.
zh: &854 有可能。我同时继续搜索。

en: &144 To Jane Street, then?
&855 The client's waiting.
&145 Fancy a bit of breaking and entering?
&856 No cameras or security systems that I can detect from my end.
zh: &856 从我这边检测不到任何摄像头或安保系统。

en: &146 Is that a yes?
&857 I'm just stating facts.
&147 Yvonne isn't home. Any idea where she could be?
zh: &147 伊冯娜不在家。知道她可能在哪儿吗？

en: &858 We don't know a lot about her yet. Have you looked her up in the archive?
zh: &858 我们目前对她了解不多。你在档案里查过她吗？

en: &162 Not yet. I'll give that a go.
&163 Any ideas on where to find Yvonne?
zh: &163 知道去哪儿找伊冯娜吗？

en: &1061 Have you been to the Village Eye yet?
&860 It's where Yvonne worked. There might be some kind of clue there.
zh: &860 那是伊冯娜工作过的地方。那里可能有什么线索。

en: &859 I think you may have left the Village Eye area a bit too quickly.
zh: &859 我觉得你可能离开《村眼》那片区域太快了。

en: &164 A shame we can't crack that keypad code at the Village Eye. Any ideas?
zh: &164 真遗憾我们解不开村眼社的键盘密码。有什么想法吗？

en: &861 Nothing in the archive about that brand of keypad lock. No universal reset codes or anything.
zh: &861 档案里没有那个牌子的键盘锁资料。没有通用重置码之类的。

en: &862 Maybe check the Lozzotti's home again? Yvonne might have left some kind of clue.
zh: &862 也许再去洛佐蒂家看看？伊冯娜可能留下了什么线索。

en: &3215 What was that name on the Lozzotti's answering machine? "Winera"?
zh: &3215 洛佐蒂家答录机上那个名字是什么来着？“Winera”？

en: &3216 Did you try looking it up in the archive? It may be worth checking out.
zh: &3216 你试过在档案里查它吗？可能值得查一下。

en: &863 I know I always say to check the archive, but... did you check the archive? Is there anyone we haven't looked into yet?
zh: &863 我知道我总说查档案，但……你查档案了吗？还有谁我们没调查过？

en: &864 What about that note you found in the Lozzotti's trash?
zh: &864 你在洛佐蒂家垃圾桶里找到的那张纸条呢？

en: &865 I get the feeling we have access to everything we need. We just need to put it together.
zh: &865 我感觉我们需要的线索都有了，只是得把它们串起来。

en: &165 Nothing in the Village Eye. What a waste of time.
zh: &165 村眼社里什么都没有。真是浪费时间。

en: &866 Are you sure you investigated everything? What about Yvonne's email?
zh: &866 你确定所有东西都调查过了？伊冯娜的邮件呢？

en: &867 Hanna. The Tombs. White Street. GO.
zh: &867 汉娜。坟墓监狱。白街。快去。

en: &187 Copy that.
&424 How're those ripples looking? Any word on Hanna's release date?
zh: &424 涟漪怎么样了？有汉娜释放日期的消息吗？

en: &868 Not yet. It's still in flux. The arresting officer hasn't made a decision yet.
zh: &868 还没有。还在变动中。逮捕她的警官还没做决定。

en: &806 What now?
&869 Get to the landing point. I've created a tunnel that should take you to the day of Ms. Tanaka's release. Two months from your current when.
zh: &869 去跃迁落点。我建了一条隧道，应该能把你送到田中女士获释那天。从你当前年代算起两个月后。

en: &1042 Sorry Noz. Bit distracted by all the... everything. What should I be doing?
zh: &1042 抱歉，诺佐。被这些……所有事弄得有点分心。我该做什么？

en: &870 Ms. Tanaka is getting released this morning. She's still at The Tombs.
zh: &870 田中女士今天早上获释。她还在坟墓监狱。

en: &871 Collect her, come home, and we can let the legal department handle the rest.
zh: &871 接上她，回家，剩下的交给法务部处理。

en: &1045 Any ideas on where to begin?
&872 Hmm. The Lozzotti's home is vacant in your current when, so there's no point going there. Maybe the Village Eye?
zh: &872 嗯。洛佐蒂家在你当前年代是空的，所以去那里没有意义。也许去村眼社？

en: &1046 Any ideas, Noz?
&873 Thinking. Let's take a walk. Clear our heads.
zh: &873 正在想。我们走走吧。清醒一下头脑。

en: &1206 Are you feeling that, Nozzo?
&874 Feeling what?
&1239 Felt like a Chrono-shift. Something's changing.
zh: &1239 感觉像一次时空改写。有什么在改变。

en: &875 Hm. Must be too marginal for me to feel it on my end. Check everything around you. Carefully.
zh: &875 嗯。可能太微弱了，我这边感觉不到。仔细检查你周围的一切。

en: &876 We have a new lead. The name "Tanner."
zh: &876 我们有新线索了。名字叫“坦纳”。

en: &877 Maybe... ask people about it?
&1240 A press pass. Where can I get a press pass?
zh: &1240 记者证。我在哪里能弄到记者证？

en: &878 Hm. There weren't any lying around the Village Eye back in September. Maybe in November?
zh: &878 嗯。九月份村眼社周围没有。也许十一月份有？

en: &1278 They changed the keypad code.
&879 You figured it out once. Maybe Yvonne has an idea?
zh: &879 你之前解开过一次。也许伊冯娜有主意？

en: &880 You spent all that time unlocking the Village Eye door. You probably should, you know, see what's inside?
zh: &880 你花了那么多时间打开村眼社的门。也许你应该，你知道，进去看看？

en: &1331 I have a press pass. Think this can get me in to see Imani?
zh: &1331 我有记者证。你觉得这能让我进去见伊曼妮吗？

en: &881 Only one way to find out.
&1374 Think Imani is still at Windows on the World?
zh: &1374 你觉得伊曼妮还在世界之窗餐厅吗？

en: &882 Most likely. Better hurry over there, just in case.
zh: &882 很可能。最好赶紧过去，以防万一。

en: &883 Not at the moment. Sorry.
&1739 Leaving the landing point would be a good start.
zh: &1739 离开跃迁落点会是个好的开始。

en: &8074 There's still nobody here.
&1740 Just... wait for a bit. Find somewhere unobtrusive.
zh: &1740 就……再等等。找个不显眼的地方。

en: &2369 I admit, Noz. I'm at a bit of a loss.
zh: &2369 我承认，诺佐。我有点不知所措。

en: &1741 History doesn't lie. It can only be misread.
zh: &1741 历史不会说谎。只会被误读。

en: &1742 That article I sent you proves Otis Knox was at the bookshop.
zh: &1742 我发给你的那篇文章证明奥蒂斯·诺克斯当时在书店。

en: &2370 Are you absolutely sure about that?
&1743 If you see anything in the article that says otherwise, let me know.
zh: &1743 如果你在文章里看到任何相反的内容，告诉我。

en: &2371 This Adam Cole. Do you know where we can find him?
zh: &2371 这个亚当·科尔。你知道我们在哪儿能找到他吗？

en: &1744 Didn't the archive give you an address? Maybe you should, you know, go there.
zh: &1744 档案库没给你地址吗？也许你应该，你知道的，去那里。

en: &1745 You haven't even turned on that computer at Adam Cole's address.
zh: &1745 你甚至还没打开亚当·科尔地址上的那台电脑。

en: &1746 I'd strongly suggest starting there.
zh: &1746 我强烈建议从那里开始。

en: &1747 Did you look at all the files on Adam Cole's computer? I'm not sure if you did.
zh: &1747 你看了亚当·科尔电脑上的所有文件了吗？我不确定你看了。

en: &5305 Is it just me, or do those trivia questions on Adam Cole's computer seem... strange.
zh: &5305 只有我觉得亚当·科尔电脑上的那些小问题……很奇怪吗？

en: &1748 Strange as in they are asking questions about things that shouldn't exist yet?
zh: &1748 奇怪是指它们在问一些还不应该存在的东西？

en: &1749 Let's not jump to any conclusions. The protocols are clear on this stuff.
zh: &1749 我们别急着下结论。协议对这类事情有明确规定。

en: &1750 It's all in the Field Manual if you need a refresher.
zh: &1750 如果你需要复习，都在《行动手册》里。

en: &6233 I will keep that in mind.
&1751 Did you search Adam Cole's place fully? There may be something you missed.
zh: &1751 你彻底搜查亚当·科尔的住处了吗？可能有什么你漏掉了。

en: &2551 Winning that trivia game revealed some kind of scanner, but I have no idea what to do with it.
zh: &2551 赢了那个问答游戏后露出了某种扫描仪，但我完全不知道该怎么用。

en: &1752 We may have reached the limit of what we can do on our own. Try asking around. Maybe someone knows something.
zh: &1752 我们可能已经达到了仅凭自己能做的极限。试着四处打听一下。也许有人知道些什么。

en: &1753 But be discreet! High timeline ranking, and all.
zh: &1753 但要谨慎！时间线排名很高，诸如此类。

en: &1754 Honestly? I think we have all the information we're going to get. We just need to put it all together.
zh: &1754 说实话？我觉得我们能得到的信息都得到了。我们只需要把它们拼凑起来。

en: &2674 I still have no idea where to find Otis Knox.
zh: &2674 我还是不知道去哪儿找奥蒂斯·诺克斯。

en: &1755 I don't think you searched that basement room fully. There has to be something we missed.
zh: &1755 我觉得你没有彻底搜查那个地下室房间。肯定有什么我们漏掉了。

en: &2681 Otis and Marla are definitely hiding something.
zh: &2681 奥蒂斯和玛拉肯定在隐瞒什么。

en: &1756 No doubt. But they aren't going to talk.
zh: &1756 毫无疑问。但他们不会开口的。

en: &1757 But maybe someone close to them will.
zh: &1757 但也许他们身边的人会。

en: &2682 Any idea on when Otis's "epiphany" could've taken place?
zh: &2682 知道奥蒂斯的“顿悟”可能发生在什么时候吗？

en: &1758 Did you try looking Otis Knox up in the archive yet?
zh: &1758 你试过在档案库里查奥蒂斯·诺克斯了吗？

en: &1759 That could give us a clue to part of it.
zh: &1759 那可能会给我们提供部分线索。

en: &1760 Hm. Did you look around the Knox's residence? Maybe a photo or something?
zh: &1760 嗯。你查看过诺克斯家的住所吗？也许有照片什么的？

en: &1761 Hm. Did you look around the Knox's residence? Maybe a document or something?
zh: &1761 嗯。你查看过诺克斯家的住所吗？也许有文件什么的？

en: &2683 What hotel did Liam say Marla was staying at?
zh: &2683 利亚姆说玛拉住的是哪家酒店？

en: &1762 The Commonwealth.
&2684 Right. That was it.
&2833 Marla must have used a false name when checking in. Any idea what that could be?
zh: &2833 玛拉入住时肯定用了假名。知道可能是什么吗？

en: &1763 None, I'm afraid. Maybe there's something at the Knox's residence that could help?
zh: &1763 恐怕不知道。也许诺克斯家有什么能帮上忙的？

en: &1764 The hotel room where Marla was staying. That's the only lead we have.
zh: &1764 玛拉住过的酒店房间。那是我们唯一的线索。

en: &2834 So. How delicate should I be with Otis? Considering his Timeline Ranking?
zh: &2834 那么。我对奥蒂斯应该多小心？考虑到他的时间线排名？

en: &6087 If you're doing this, you need to know how to make the cure.
zh: &6087 如果你要这么做，你得知道怎么制作解药。

&6089 You... HAVE read it, haven't you?
&2836 I'm a little distracted right now!
&6090 Fine. No hurry. It's not like you're dying or anything.

zh: &1767 好。先说最重要的。你需要一份自己的血样。

zh: &1768 根据档案，玛拉·诺克斯是注册护士。也许他们家里有什么东西？

en: &1769 You're holding that empty syringe. You should probably use it.
zh: &1769 你拿着那支空注射器。你应该用上它。

en: &1770 The formula requires that the blood sample be flooded with quansonic waves.
zh: &1770 配方要求血样被量声波充分照射。

en: &2837 The generator in the basement. Got it.
zh: &2837 地下室里的发电机。明白了。

en: &1771 It's against my better judgement Fia, but if you're determined...
zh: &1771 这违背我的判断，菲娅，但如果你下定决心……

en: &2838 I am. Stand by.
&1772 Maybe talk to someone who uses one of those things?

en: &1773 We need to get that sodium nitrate away from Evelyn.
zh: &1773 我们得把硝酸钠从伊芙琳那里拿走。

en: &1774 Maybe... distract her? Call her away somehow?
zh: &1774 也许……引开她？想办法把她叫走？

en: &2839 You really think she'd fall for something like that?
zh: &2839 你真觉得她会中那种招？

en: &1775 I don't know. I'm just spitballing.
zh: &1775 我不知道。我只是随口说说。

en: &1776 Raid Evelyn Sherman's shed while she's not looking. Quick!
zh: &1776 趁伊芙琳·谢尔曼不注意，搜刮她的小屋。快！

en: &1777 Mix that sodium nitrate with your blood sample. Quick.
zh: &1777 把硝酸钠和你的血样混合。快。

en: &1778 Before the Morophabite poison takes over.
zh: &1778 趁莫罗法比特毒还没完全发作。

en: &1779 How carefully did you search the Knox residence in 1977?
zh: &1779 你在1977年搜查诺克斯家时有多仔细？

en: &1780 There may be something we missed. Something that can help us.
zh: &1780 也许我们漏掉了什么。能帮上忙的东西。

en: &1781 Seems liks Otis Knox was diabetic. The original, I mean.
zh: &1781 看来奥蒂斯·诺克斯有糖尿病。我是说原版那位。

en: &1782 If we can find him, maybe we can find the buformin we need.
zh: &1782 如果我们能找到他，也许就能找到我们需要的丁双胍。

en: &1783 Mix that buformin with your blood sample. Quick.
zh: &1783 把丁双胍和你的血样混合。快。

en: &1784 You have the chemical solution you need for the cure, but you still need to put it through the phytofusion process.
zh: &1784 你有了制作解药所需的化学溶液，但还需要让它经过植物融合过程。

en: &1785 You need a sapling. Or any young plant. Something that can grow the next decade or so undisurbed.
zh: &1785 你需要一棵树苗。或者任何幼小植物。能在未来十年左右不受干扰地生长的东西。

en: &1786 There has to be one around somewhere.
&1787 I'd suggest checking to see if the phytofusion process worked.
zh: &1787 我建议检查一下植物融合过程是否成功。

&6091 Only one way to find out.

&2 You want an autograph? Could be worth something one day!

&3 What is it now?
&78 Art? Liz?
&1 Hey. You mind? You got want you wanted. We're having a moment here.

en: The barrel is empty, but smells strongly of rum.

en: Barred windows for a bar's windows.
zh: 酒吧的窗户装了铁栅栏。

en: The only exit to the street.
A large crate.
&1891 Nozzo? We're here.
&484 Okay. I've created a direct tunnel from your current when to six months previous.
zh: &484 好的。我已经从你当前所在年代创建了一条直达六个月前的隧道。

en: &1892 Direct? We don't need to come back home first?
zh: &1892 直达？我们不用先回家吗？

en: &485 A six month tunnel is quicker and cheaper than one that spans almost two hundred years.
zh: &485 六个月的隧道比跨越近两百年的隧道更快、更省钱。

en: &486 You're already most of the way there. No need to start over.
zh: &486 你们已经走完大半程了，没必要从头再来。

en: &1893 You're the expert, Noz. Ready, Chloe?
zh: &1893 你是专家，诺佐。准备好了吗，克洛伊？

en: &446 Yes. Absolutely.
Chloe's face is a mask of determination.
Five Points[October 7, 1871[3:34 PM
&1894 Timefall successful, Noz.
&487 All clear?
&1895 As clear as the air in this era can be. Go ahead and send her through.
zh: &1895 和这个年代的空气一样正常。让她过来吧。

en: &447 Woah. That was wild!
&1442 Are you all right?
&448 Yeah. Just finding my feet.
Laila Lakhani as Chloe
zh: 莱拉·拉卡尼 饰 克洛伊

en: &449 What a weird feeling. Like falling... but I wasn't falling DOWN?
zh: &449 好奇怪的感觉。像在坠落……但我不是往下掉？

en: Chloe keeps fiddling with her hands. She can't hide how nervous she is.
zh: 克洛伊不停地摆弄双手，掩饰不住紧张。

en: &1896 Oh blast it. Not again.
&1897 Nozzo! We really need to start vetting these landing points.
zh: &1897 诺佐！我们真得好好审查这些跃迁落点了。

en: &488 Sorry.
&1898 Locked from the outside. Again. And no keyhole on this side either.
zh: &1898 从外面锁上了。又是这样。而且这边也没有钥匙孔。

en: &1899 Again.
The emphasis bunny.
Creating this mission - Part 1
zh: 创作这个任务——第一部分

en: Creating this mission - Part 2
zh: 创作这个任务——第二部分

en: Clear as the air in the era.
zh: 和这个年代的空气一样正常。

en: This always happens!
&5302 It's half rotted. It would collapse if I tried standing on it.
zh: &5302 已经烂了一半，站上去会塌。

en: &5301 That's too heavy for me to lift.
Very useful for swearing.
Don't let perfect be the enemy of done.
zh: 别让完美成为完成的敌人。

en: Another outfit for Fia?
The Coney Island boardwalk beckons.
&3075 Timefall successful.
&5056 Going local again now.
zh: &5056 现在再次转为本地模式。

en: &5057 Hm. Same outfit as before?
&1673 I didn't have time to program in the specs for anything new.
&1674 But most 1990s fashions were inspired by the 1970s. You'll fit right in.
zh: &1674 但1990年代的大多数时尚都受1970年代启发。你会很合群。

en: &5058 You've got nothing else on file?
&1675 Nothing aside from the white polyester disco suit that I once generated for Duffy.
zh: &1675 除了我曾经为达菲生成的那套白色涤纶迪斯科套装，什么都没有。

en: &5059 Tempting. But no. Definitely not.
&5060 But if I need to infiltrate a dance hall, I'll let you know.
zh: &5060 但如果我需要潜入舞厅，我会告诉你。

en: &1676 I'll keep it prepped. Standing by.
Payphone
Doors
Beachgoer
Smoker
Radio listener
A man scans the horizon for ships. For what reason, you have no idea.
zh: 一个男人扫视地平线寻找船只。至于原因，你毫无头绪。

en: You can't hear what's on this fellow's radio, but he seems to be enjoying it.
zh: 你听不到这家伙收音机里在播什么，但他似乎很享受。

en: This exhausted-looking woman is fixated on her cigarette and little else.
zh: 这个看起来疲惫不堪的女人只专注于她的香烟，其他什么都不关心。

en: The beach is covered in trash and debris. Definitely the off-season.
zh: 海滩上满是垃圾和碎片。绝对是淡季。

en: A rust-covered payphone. It obviously doesn't get much use.
zh: 一部生锈的付费电话。显然很少被使用。

en: The shop beyond the glass looks empty and dark.
zh: 玻璃后面的商店看起来空荡荡、黑漆漆的。

en: This leads back the way you came.
&5061 I shouldn't waste my time with this any longer.
zh: &5061 我不该再在这上面浪费时间了。

en: &5221 That pay phone seems broken, but perhaps I could make use of this telephone directory...
zh: &5221 那部付费电话似乎坏了，但也许我可以利用这本电话簿……

en: &5222 Who should I look up?
&5223 Nobody seems to be in. The store must not be open yet.
zh: &5223 似乎没人在。商店肯定还没开门。

en: &5335 I shouldn't bother the locals unless necessary.
zh: &5335 除非必要，我不该打扰当地人。

en: Sapling
Yard
Window
This small sampling looks recently planted.
zh: 这个小样本看起来是最近种的。

en: A small tree sapling is starting to grow here.
zh: 一棵小树苗开始在这里生长。

en: A door leads to the Knox's home.
The way back to the boardwalk.
A number of fresh pumpkins surround the house. They look freshly carved.
zh: 房子周围有许多新鲜的南瓜。它们看起来是刚雕刻的。

en: The neighbor's yard contains only grass in this when.
zh: 在这个年代，邻居的院子里只有草。

en: The curtains are drawn and you can't see inside.
zh: 窗帘拉上了，你看不到里面。

en: Sounding like a person.
Otis Box.
&5224 Nobody's home.
&2164 The door is locked.
&5225 I shouldn't uproot it.
&4539 I fail to see what injecting it with an empty syringe will do.
zh: &4539 我看不出用空注射器给它注射会有什么用。

en: &4540 The formula is incomplete. Injecting the sapling now would just be a waste.
zh: &4540 配方还不完整。现在给树苗注射只会浪费。

en: &4541 There we go, little sapling.
&4542 Let nature do its thing.
zh: &4542 让大自然发挥它的作用吧。

en: &5226 Why waste the effort? I already have a key.
zh: &5226 何必费这个劲？我已经有钥匙了。

en: &2109 I already unlocked the door.
&5227 Good thing the Knox family never changed their locks in fifteen years.
zh: &5227 还好诺克斯家十五年都没换过锁。

en: Elevator
Book
Bell
Smoking man
Reading woman
A man casually leans against the wall of the lobby. A faint smell of cannabis surrounds him.
zh: 一个男人随意地靠在大堂的墙上。他身上飘来淡淡的大麻味。

en: A local woman is reading on the couch. Fortunately, she's not paying much attention to you.
zh: 一位本地女士正坐在沙发上读书。幸好，她没怎么注意你。

en: Sally runs out of brain.
An archway leads to the exit of the hotel.
zh: 一道拱门通向酒店出口。

en: A large elevator graces the far wall.
zh: 一部大电梯装点着远处的墙壁。

en: The desk is mostly empty aside from a well-thumbed sign-in book.
zh: 桌子基本空着，只有一本被翻旧了的签到簿。

en: A brass bell lies temptingly on the unattended service desk.
zh: 一个黄铜铃铛诱人地躺在无人值守的服务台上。

en: Hotel lobby
&4543 I'm not searching each room one by one.
zh: &4543 我可不会一间一间地搜。

en: &5228 I'll just take a quick look...
&5229 No need. I already know Marla's room number.
zh: &5229 没必要。我已经知道玛拉的房间号了。

en: &5230 Tempting, but it's probably best that I remain unobserved for now.
zh: &5230 很诱人，但眼下最好还是别让人注意到我。

en: &5340 That man is as high as the Lunar space station. I doubt talking to him would yield anything useful.
zh: &5340 那家伙嗨得跟月球空间站一样高。跟他说话估计也问不出什么有用的。

en: &5336 I see no reason to bother her.
zh: &5336 我看不出有什么理由去打扰她。

en: Body
The room's light switch is attached to this wall.
zh: 房间的电灯开关装在这面墙上。

en: This eye-melting curtain is thankfully closed.
zh: 这刺眼的窗帘幸好拉上了。

en: The way out of this cramped room.
zh: 离开这个狭小房间的出口。

en: You can see a light switch faintly in the gloom.
zh: 昏暗中你隐约看见一个电灯开关。

en: You can faintly see a curtain in the gloom.
zh: 昏暗中你隐约看见一面窗帘。

en: The way out of this dark room.
zh: 离开这个黑暗房间的出口。

en: Sally "The Genius" Beaumont.
A shoe pokes out from behind the bed.
Is that blood?
This television is either broken or is receiving poor reception.
zh: 这台电视要么坏了，要么信号很差。

en: A cut backstory detail.
zh: 一段被删减的背景故事细节。

en: They covered this in acting school.
&5106 I'd rather leave them on.
Hotel room
&5062 Oh. Good god.
&5063 Is that...
&1677 Running comparison scan...
&1678 Impossible.
&1679 That's Otis Knox.
&5231 I'd better leave those curtains closed. I'm not exactly supposed to be here.
zh: &5231 我最好让窗帘关着。我本不该出现在这里。

en: &5232 I wouldn't know how to begin fixing that.
zh: &5232 我不知道该怎么修那个。

en: Phone
Typewriter
The coffee's kicking in.
A rotary telephone? How utterly prehistoric.
zh: 旋转拨号电话？真是老掉牙了。

en: The exit from the Knox house. And its smell.
zh: 诺克斯家的出口。还有那股气味。

en: A trash bin stands near the exit.
zh: 出口旁放着一个垃圾桶。

en: A well-used typewriter. It smells faintly of fresh ink.
zh: 一台用得很旧的打字机。隐约有股新鲜油墨味。

en: The floor is covered with a collection empty bottles, crumbled-up paper and cigarette butts.
zh: 地板上散落着空瓶子、揉皱的纸团和烟头。

en: Whoever the subjects of these photos are, you have no idea.
zh: 这些照片里的人是谁，你毫无头绪。

en: &4550 Silubin?
&1292 A medicine commonly used for diabetes. It was discontinued in the late 70s.
zh: &1292 一种常用的糖尿病药物。70年代末停产了。

en: &4551 So Otis Knox was diabetic?
zh: &4551 所以奥蒂斯·诺克斯有糖尿病？

en: &1293 It appears so.
&4552 Silubin wouldn't happen to contain buformin, would it?
zh: &4552 西鲁宾里不会正好含有丁双胍吧？

en: &1680 It's the primary ingredient. Are there any pills left in the bottle?
zh: &1680 那是主要成分。瓶子里还有药片吗？

en: &4553 Blast it. No.
&260 Nice, huh?
&261 Fia? How are you even STANDING?
&262 Your stomach lining must feel like razor blades by now.
zh: &262 你的胃黏膜现在肯定像刀片一样。

en: &1833 Fia? Fia, Come in.
&1834 Blast it. It can't end like this.
&1835 Come on. Don't freak out. THINK.
&1836 You've got this all under control!
The many versions of this ending.
I wasn't expecting a compliment!
Edwyn celebrates/mourns his final lines.
zh: 埃德温庆祝/哀悼他最后的台词。

en: The truth comes out!
You need to get to Fia before the brass discovers she's gone rogue.

zh: &369 以西卡莫尔的标准？那只是零钱。

en: &2006 Do you recognize this one, Imani?
&370 "Land over Wave." People waited in line for two hours to see that at the Met last year.
zh: &370 《浪上之地》。去年在大都会博物馆，人们排了两个小时队去看它。

en: &2007 It's just... hanging on the wall right now. A bit precariously, to be honest.
zh: &2007 它现在……就挂在墙上。说实话，挂得有点悬。

en: &371 Good god. Don't touch it!
&372 Don't take a breath unless you have to!
&2008 I'll do my best.
&2009 That curtain is too thick and heavy to move on my own.
zh: &2009 那窗帘太厚太重，我一个人挪不动。

en: &2010 If that painting is what we think it will be, I'd better not touch it.
zh: &2010 如果那幅画是我们想的那幅，我最好别碰。

en: &2011 Fits perfectly.
&4334 Whatever goes in here, none of the multitool attachments will fit.
zh: &4334 不管这里放什么，多功能工具上的附件都不合适。

en: &2012 Hm. It looks like yellow lines intersecting... trees? It is difficult to tell.
zh: &2012 嗯。看起来像是黄色线条与……树木相交？很难分辨。

en: &373 That would be "Gridiron: Series 1".
&374 There's been a lot of debate on what that title means.
zh: &374 关于这个标题的含义一直有很多争论。

en: &375 You... don't want to open up THAT can of worms. Trust me.
zh: &375 你……不会想打开那个潘多拉魔盒的。相信我。

en: &2013 This one looks like three human faces, peering out of the darkness.
zh: &2013 这幅看起来像是三张人脸，从黑暗中向外窥视。

en: &376 Not Sycamore's most popular, but one of my personal favorites. It's simply called "Missing You."
zh: &376 不是西卡莫尔最受欢迎的作品，但却是我的个人最爱之一。它就叫《想念你》。

en: &377 I've always wondered why.
&378 Yes. Not one of Sycamore's best. It's called "Hair Study."
zh: &378 是的。不是西卡莫尔最好的作品。它叫《头发研究》。

en: &2014 Hair study?
&379 Painting hair is hard, Fia. Or so I've been told.
zh: &379 画头发很难，菲娅。至少别人是这么告诉我的。

en: &380 Sycamore obviously felt the need to practice.
zh: &380 西卡莫尔显然觉得需要练习。

en: &2015 A rendering of Manhattan, painted in shades of pink?
zh: &2015 一幅曼哈顿的渲染图，用粉色色调画的？

en: &381 "Life of Rue." Evocative isn't it? The city looks like an ugly bruise.
zh: &381 《悔恨人生》。很能唤起情感，不是吗？这座城市看起来像一块丑陋的淤青。

en: &382 I can never tell if it makes me feel terribly sad or terribly angry when I look at it.
zh: &382 我永远说不清看到它时，是让我感到极度悲伤还是极度愤怒。

en: &383 But that's the point, isn't it? It can be both things.
zh: &383 但这就是重点，不是吗？它可以同时是两者。

en: &2016 I can't make heads or tails of this one.
&384 That would be "Gridiron: Series 2"
&385 We assume it was a rejected attempt. It's very lacking when compared to series 1 and 3.
zh: &385 我们推测这是一次被否定的尝试。与系列一和系列三相比，它非常欠缺。

en: &2017 So it's not any good?
&386 I didn't say that. I've seen people stare at it for hours. Books have been written about it.
zh: &386 我没那么说。我见过有人盯着它看几个小时。关于它的书都有人写过。

en: &387 Art is what you make of it.
&2018 This one looks to be a series of geometric shapes over a human figure.
zh: &2018 这幅看起来像是一系列几何图形覆盖在一个人物上。

en: &388 That's the third in the "Gridiron" series. Not one of Sycamore's best, if I'm honest.
zh: &388 那是《网格》系列的第三幅。说实话，不是西卡莫尔最好的作品。

en: &2019 This one appears to be a tree with yellow leaves.
zh: &2019 这幅看起来像是一棵长着黄色叶子的树。

en: &389 Hm. That exact painting is hanging in my exhibit, but the leaves are PINK.
zh: &389 嗯。那幅画就挂在我的展览里，但叶子是粉色的。

en: &390 Sycamore must have painted over them.
zh: &390 西卡莫尔一定是后来在它们上面重新画过。

en: &391 Or rather, WILL paint over them.
zh: &391 或者更确切地说，将来会重新画。

en: &392 Whichever.
Upstairs
Alcove
Foreground1
Railing
Screen2
Screen3
Sphere
Pulse
&526 And timefall in 3... 2... 1...
&527 Timefall successful.
&528 Powering down.
&529 Welcome back, Fia.
&146 Hey! It's about time you two finished.
&147 Who wants drinks?
&148 Okay. What's wrong?
&679 ...may leave you slightly disoriented, but your vitals are more than adequate. You should be fine.
zh: &679 ……可能会让你有点晕，但你的生命体征完全没问题。你会没事的。

en: &680 And here's Fia.
&481 Oh. Hey.
&482 Fia Quinn, right?
&1902 Yes. That's me.
&483 I'm Chloe Sadar. I'm your 6 o'clock?
zh: &483 我是克洛伊·萨达尔。我是你约的六点？

en: &484 Assuming that even means anything to someone like you.
zh: &484 如果这对你这种人来说还有意义的话。

en: Introducing Chloe.
&2867 Did Chloe leave already?
&681 Yeah. Timejumping back and forth as many times as she did, PLUS winning a boxing match?
zh: &681 是啊。来回时空跃迁那么多次，还赢了一场拳击赛？

en: &682 I'm surprised she didn't fall asleep when she arrived.
zh: &682 她到了居然没睡着，我都惊讶。

en: &2868 Yeah. I can relate.
&2869 So. Jay V's? Duffy's already there.
zh: &2869 那么，去杰伊V酒吧？达菲已经在那儿了。

en: &683 Gonna have to say no, I'm afraid. Need to prep for the jumps scheduled for tomorrow.
zh: &683 恐怕得说不行了。得为明天安排的跃迁做准备。

en: &2870 Don't work TOO hard, Noz.
&684 As long as you promise not to have too much fun tonight.
zh: &684 只要你保证今晚别玩得太疯。

en: &2871 No promises.
&2872 See you tomorrow.
&134 Do you have any idea what it's like? Working for someone with no vision? No IMAGINATION?
zh: &134 你知道那是什么感觉吗？给一个没有远见、没有想象力的人干活？

en: &685 FIA! Hi!
&686 This is Benjamin Pasamon. Head researcher at BatesTech.
zh: &686 这位是本杰明·帕萨蒙。贝茨科技的首席研究员。

en: &135 Urg. That name. Should've been "Pasamon Industries."
zh: &135 呃。这名字。本该叫“帕萨蒙工业”的。

en: &136 But now it will! Right?
&687 That's what we're here for.
&2873 Hi, Noz.
&688 I just informed Mr. Pasamon that you're done.
zh: &688 我刚通知帕萨蒙先生你们完成了。

en: &689 He should be here any-
&137 So you did it??
&138 Your partner here says that you did it.
zh: &138 你这位搭档说你们成功了。

en: &5999 We did it.
&140 So fill me in, man! What did I create? What's the world like now?
zh: &140 快告诉我，老兄！我创造了什么？现在世界是什么样？

en: &690 Wouldn't you rather go and find out yourself?
&691 Once you leave this facility, your memories will start to integrate with the new timeline.
zh: &691 一旦你离开这个设施，你的记忆就会开始与新时间线整合。

en: &141 I read the tech journals. I know that the process can take weeks.
zh: &141 我读过科技期刊。我知道这个过程可能要几周。

en: &142 So don't keep me in suspense! Tell me.
zh: &142 所以别吊我胃口了！告诉我。

en: &692 Well... you become CEO like you wanted.
&143 Aaand?
&693 There's, um, no record of Pasamon Industries filing any patents.
zh: &693 呃，档案里没有帕萨蒙工业申请过任何专利的记录。

en: &144 No patents? But I had so many ideas. That can't be right.
zh: &144 没有专利？但我有那么多点子。这不可能。

en: &694 I'm sorry. That's what the archive says.
zh: &694 抱歉。档案上是这么写的。

en: &145 But we're still in business, right? We must have produced SOMETHING.
zh: &145 但我们还在营业，对吧？我们肯定生产过什么东西。

en: &695 You're right, but I can't access that information from here. Sorry.
zh: &695 你说得对，但我在这里查不到那些信息。抱歉。

en: &146 Huh. Must be something top secret.
&147 Something so incredible that nobody can know about it!
&401 Right?
&696 Sure.
&148 Okay then!
&149 Thank you both. I'm off to see what's what!
zh: &149 谢谢你们。我去看看怎么回事！

en: &2875 Another day, another satisfied client.
zh: &2875 又一天，又一个满意的客户。

en: &697 You okay, Fia? You look beat.
zh: &697 你还好吗，菲娅？你看起来累坏了。

en: &160 Do you have any idea what that's like?
zh: &160 你知道那是什么感觉吗？

en: &161 Working for someone who squanders every opportunity?
zh: &161 为一个浪费每个机会的人工作？

en: &162 Who lets every juicy grape wither on the vine?
zh: &162 让每一颗多汁的葡萄在藤上枯萎？

en: &2876 Yeah. Back and unscathed.
&2877 Where's Madison Bates?
&699 She took one look at her new bank balance and took off.
zh: &699 她看了一眼新的银行余额就走了。

en: &2878 Not a word of thanks. Figures.
zh: &2878 连句谢谢都没有。意料之中。

en: &2879 But I'm not going to let that bother me.
zh: &2879 但我不会让这事影响我。

en: &2880 I feel like celebrating. Jay V's? My treat?
zh: &2880 我想庆祝一下。去杰伊V酒吧？我请客？

en: &2881 To successfully avoiding my past self and completing the mission to boot.
zh: &2881 为成功避开过去的自己，还顺便完成了任务。

en: &2882 Chrovergence shmovergence.
&700 I'm glad one of us is happy. There are fifty ways this could've gone wrong.
zh: &700 我很高兴我们中有人开心。这事有五十种可能出错的方式。

en: &2883 But it didn't. And now the whole agency will know it.
zh: &2883 但它没有。现在整个机构都会知道了。

en: &701 Wait. What?
&702 Fia. Chrovergence missions are heavily classified and the reports are redacted within an inch of their lives.
zh: &702 菲娅。时空汇聚任务是高度机密的，报告会被删改得面目全非。

en: &703 Heck, we probably shouldn't even be talking about it now.
zh: &703 见鬼，我们现在可能都不该谈论它。

en: &2884 You mean, nobody will know about it?
&704 No. Aside from whoever reads and redacts the report.
zh: &704 对。除了阅读和删改报告的人。

en: &2885 And that's all?
&705 Why? Is it important?
&2886 I just thought...
&2887 No. It's not important.
&706 You just achieved something incredible, Fia. Aren't you happy with that?
zh: &706 你刚刚取得了不可思议的成就，菲娅。你难道不高兴吗？

en: &2888 Sure. Elated. Over the moon.
zh: &2888 当然。欣喜若狂。高兴得上了天。

en: &707 So... Jay V's?
&2889 I forgot. I have somewhere to be.
zh: &2889 我忘了。我有个地方要去。

en: &2890 I'll see you tomorrow.
&152 ...you imagine what it was like, working under a team THAT dysfunctional?
zh: &152 ……你能想象在那么一个功能失调的团队手下干活是什么滋味吗？

en: &153 Our executive decision process was based on who threw the biggest tantrum!
zh: &153 我们的执行决策过程就是看谁闹得最凶！

en: &6026 Welcome back, F...
&708 Oh BLAST IT.
&709 Sorry Fia. No time to explain.
zh: &709 抱歉，菲娅。没时间解释了。

en: &1 Nozzo? What are you do...
&710 Can we skip to the part where you shoot me? I really can't sit through this argument again.
zh: &710 我们能不能直接跳到你要开枪打我的部分？这场争论我真的听不下去了。

en: &150 Not until you put things back!
&151 Pasamon Industries meant something. The world's much worse off without it.
zh: &151 帕萨蒙工业曾经意义非凡。没有它，世界会糟糕得多。

en: &163 Sorry if I'm not all MELANCHOLY for a timeline with more weapons in them.
zh: &163 抱歉，我可不会为了一条武器更多的时间线而伤感。

en: &152 Without me in charge, do you know who built those weapons instead?
zh: &152 没有我掌舵，你知道后来是谁造了那些武器吗？

en: &153 Lazarus. Their weapons caused much more death, much more destruction.
zh: &153 拉撒路。他们的武器造成了更多的死亡，更多的破坏。

en: &154 So yes, the world would be much better off.
zh: &154 所以没错，世界会好得多。

en: &164 You think BatesTech didn't mean anything?
zh: &164 你觉得贝茨科技就毫无意义吗？

en: &165 I poured my heart and soul into making us a brand to be reckoned with.
zh: &165 我倾注了全部心血，把我们打造成了一个不容小觑的品牌。

en: &166 I was proud of that.
&167 And if you weren't so damn CAPRICIOUS, you would've been proud of it too.
zh: &167 要不是你那么该死的反复无常，你也会为此骄傲的。

en: &155 Proud of being held back at every turn?
&168 Held back? Do you know how many of your messes I had to clean up? In all three timelines?
zh: &168 受制？你知道我替你收拾了多少烂摊子吗？在全部三条时间线里？

en: &156 That's just it. Science is about experimentation. It's supposed to be messy!
zh: &156 问题就在这儿。科学就是实验。本来就该是乱糟糟的！

en: &157 I tried to explain that to you, BUT OH NO!
zh: &157 我试着跟你解释过，但哦不！

en: *Beeeeeep*
&158 Everything I did had to go through a dozen focus testing groups.
zh: &158 我做的每件事都得经过十几个焦点测试小组。

en: &169 You think I would leave the branding to you? How old are those shoes you're wearing? Twenty years?
zh: &169 你以为我会把品牌交给你？你脚上那双鞋穿了多久了？二十年？

en: &159 No older than that gun you're holding. That ancient thing probably picked up all sorts of malware. I bet it doesn't even shoot.
zh: &159 不比你手里那把枪老。那个老古董八成染上了各种恶意软件。我打赌它根本射不出子弹。

en: &170 Enough of this! Fire up that machine and put me back in charge.
zh: &170 够了！启动那台机器，把我放回负责人的位置。

en: &160 No! Touch that machine and I'll fire.
zh: &160 不行！敢碰那台机器我就开枪。

en: &711 And here we go...
&712 Okay. That's new.
&171 Wow Benji. You've always been a living embarressment.
zh: &171 哇哦，本吉。你一直就是个行走的尴尬。

en: &172 Now. You. Give me my company back.
zh: &172 现在。你。把我的公司还给我。

en: &713 I can't do that, Ms. Bates.
&173 Gah. I'm DONE!
&161 Hah. Always knew that piece of junk would blow up in her face.
zh: &161 哈。早就知道那堆破烂会在她脸上炸开。

en: &162 So. Hop to it. Put me back in charge.
zh: &162 所以。赶紧的。把我放回负责人的位置。

en: &1568 I can't do that, Mr. Pasamon. Like I keep telling you.
zh: &1568 我做不到，帕萨蒙先生。就像我一直跟你说的。

en: &163 Blah. Blah. Blah. Rules can be BROKEN.
zh: &163 废话。废话。废话。规则就是用来打破的。

en: &1569 Not these.
&164 Oh whatever. I'll just find someone else who will.
zh: &164 哦，随便吧。我会找别人来做。

en: &715 She did it!
&716 Oh thank God. She did it.
&717 Fia? You read me?
&2891 Loud and clear, Noz.
&2892 You have no idea how good it is to hear your voice.
zh: &2892 你不知道听到你的声音有多好。

en: &2893 Chrono-suit is engaged. Can I come home now?
zh: &2893 时空防护服已启动。我现在能回家了吗？

en: &718 Confirmed. Stand by...
&6016 And timefall in 3... 2... 1...
&2894 Wow. What a mess.
&2895 Are they...
&719 They're alive.
&720 Which isn't fair, if you think about it. They killed me at least thirty times!
zh: &720 仔细想想，这可不公平。他们杀了我至少三十次！

en: &2896 Stings, doesn't it?
&721 Like a hundred wasps to the brain.
zh: &721 就像一百只黄蜂蜇进大脑。

en: &722 I think...
&2897 Yeah?
&723 I think I am going to phone the police.
&724 Then you and I are going to Jay V's.
zh: &724 然后你和我去杰伊V酒吧。

en: &1205 Unless... you have somewhere else to be?
zh: &1205 除非……你还有别的地方要去？

en: &4335 No. Not this time.
&1206 Good. Then let's go. And don't let me order soda this time.
zh: &1206 好。那我们走吧。这次别让我点苏打水。

en: &2898 Nozzo. Is that...
&725 That's Duffy. Yeah.
&7037 How did this happen?
&1570 Like I said. He didn't engage his chrono-suit. Not even a cranial shield.
zh: &1570 就像我说的。他没有启动时空防护服。连颅骨护盾都没有。

en: &726 The timestream energy fried him to a crisp.
zh: &726 时间流能量把他炸成了焦炭。

en: &727 When he landed... he was like this.
zh: &727 他落地时……就已经这样了。

en: &507 I've researched everything I need to know about this creep. I don't need a babysitter.
zh: &507 我已经研究过关于这个变态的一切了。我不需要保姆。

en: &1207 Well, speak of the devil...
&3624 I've been called a devil more than enough recently, thank you.
zh: &3624 最近我被叫魔鬼的次数已经够多了，谢谢。

en: &3625 Never mind. Long story.
&1208 Fia. This is Hanna Tanaka.
&508 DETECTIVE Hanna Tanaka. I'm not retired yet.
zh: &508 是田中警探。我还没退休呢。

en: &3626 Pleasure to meet you.
&510 You look tired. Are you sure you're up for this?
zh: &510 你看起来很累。你确定你准备好了吗？

en: &35 But I thought... I mean, what the hell am I paying all this money for?
zh: &35 但我以为……我的意思是，我花这么多钱到底是为了什么？

en: &1571 You were told several times during the review process. This shouldn't be a surprise.
zh: &1571 在审查过程中已经多次告诉过你了。这不应该是个意外。

en: &36 Okay. I get it. It's just...
&37 There's no way you can make an exception?
&1572 What you're asking for is a nostalgia trip. What you applied for is something entirely different.
zh: &1572 你要求的是怀旧之旅。而你申请的是完全不同的东西。

en: &1573 It requires...
&1574 Oh hello, Fia.
&1575 I was just explaining to our client that because of the specifics involved, he won't be joining you on the jump.
zh: &1575 我刚才正在向我们的客户解释，由于涉及的具体情况，他不会和你一起进行时空跃迁。

en: &4336 Specifics involved?
&1576 Let's start from the top. Nathan, this is Fia Quinn.
zh: &1576 让我们从头开始。内森，这位是菲娅·奎因。

en: &38 Nathan Knox.
&39 And before you ask, yes there is a relation.
zh: &39 在你问之前，是的，确实有亲戚关系。

en: &40 Otis Knox was my father.
zh: &40 奥蒂斯·诺克斯是我的父亲。

en: &6050 Mr. Knox?
&50 Yeah? Is she finished already?
&6051 Not quite. I wanted to ask you about Adam Cole.
zh: &6051 还没有。我想问你关于亚当·科尔的事。

en: &51 My step-father? Why?
&6052 We... just want to fill in some gaps.
zh: &6052 我们……只是想填补一些空白。

en: &52 But he has nothing to do with what happened. Does he?
zh: &52 但他和发生的事情毫无关系。不是吗？

en: &53 He didn't even meet my mother until a year after.
zh: &53 他甚至在一年后才认识我母亲。

en: &54 Honestly, I barely knew the guy.
zh: &54 老实说，我几乎不认识那个人。

en: &55 So why bring him into this?
zh: &55 那为什么要把他扯进来？

en: &6053 Well. It's hard to know how to put this, but...
zh: &6053 嗯。我不知道该怎么开口，但是……

en: &8045 Nozzo? How long till the fireworks are finished?
zh: &8045 诺佐？烟花还要多久结束？

en: &1577 Any second now. After that, do... whatever you need to do.
zh: &1577 随时都会结束。之后，做……你需要做的任何事。

en: &4337 It's done.
&1210 Already?
&4338 I said it's done.
&4339 Can I come home now?
&1211 Is your-chrono suit engaged?
zh: &1211 你的时空防护服启动了吗？

en: &4340 Yes. Yes. Confirmed. Home, please?
zh: &4340 是的。是的。确认。回家，好吗？

en: &1212 Sure, Fia. Er. Stand by.
&6093 And timefall in 3... 2... 1...
&6094 Um. Welcome back.
&1578 Are you... okay?
&4970 Never better.
&1213 I'm sorry you had to do that, Fia.
zh: &1213 很抱歉你不得不那样做，菲娅。

en: &4341 Yeah. Well. Can't fight protocol.
&1214 Do you want to go grab a drink? Talk about it?
zh: &1214 你想去喝一杯吗？聊聊这件事？

en: &1215 Or go to the Park Gallery, even?
zh: &1215 或者去帕克画廊，怎么样？

en: &4342 I think I'd rather call it a night.
&1216 Right. Right. Of course.
&1217 This was... a lot.
&6095 I'm gonna petition the brass to give us some time off. I don't care how backlogged we are.

zh: 这个男人公然抽着一根传统香烟，毫无畏惧。在这个年代司空见惯，但在你自己的时代却是丑闻。

en: Large, ornate doors lead into the Granted Gems jewelry store.
zh: 华丽的大门通向“格兰特珠宝”店。

en: Back to the gridlike streets of 1920s Manhattan.
zh: 回到1920年代曼哈顿的网格状街道。

en: Gleaming displays of shiny baubles almost blind you.
zh: 闪闪发光的廉价饰品展示几乎让你眼花缭乱。

en: Is fine good enough?
I made myself dizzy!
You cannot pin this on me.
zh: 你不能把这事赖在我头上。

en: Been waiting two years!
I'm probably flirting.
Shut up, already!
&393 Well. This is the place.
&394 I was half-expecting to get the stink-eye from everyone on the street, but I was just ignored. At least for now.
zh: &394 我原本还担心街上每个人都会对我白眼，结果根本没人理我。至少现在是这样。

en: &2054 Didn't Nozzo offer you holographic feature alteration?
zh: &2054 诺佐不是给你提供了全息外貌调整吗？

en: &2055 Many clients want to avoid being recognized in the past. Or avoid dealing with... complications.
zh: &2055 很多客户想避免在过去被认出来。或者避免处理……麻烦。

en: &544 I did, but she declined.
&395 I've never been anyone but myself. Not going to change that now.
zh: &395 我从来都只做我自己。现在也不打算改变。

en: &396 I'll deal with any... "complications" if and when they arise.
zh: &396 如果出现什么……“麻烦”，我会应对的。

en: &397 Shall we go in?
Imani's eyes keep shifting toward the entrance, as if willing you to go in.
zh: 伊曼妮的目光不断瞟向入口，仿佛在催你进去。

en: Imani is happily absorbing the sights and sounds around her.
zh: 伊曼妮正愉快地沉浸于周围的景象和声音中。

en: &398 Pearls before SWINE.
&399 I'm going to ban that uncultured socket from my gallery.
zh: &399 我要把那个没教养的家伙从我画廊里封杀。

en: &400 Is he still alive in our present?
zh: &400 他在我们的现在时代还活着吗？

en: &2056 150 years from now? It's doubtful.
&401 Blast it. Maybe I'll do it anyway.
zh: &401 可恶。也许我还是要这么做。

en: &402 That'll show him.
If Imani is frustrated by what just happened, she is hiding it well.
zh: 如果伊曼妮对刚才发生的事感到沮丧，她掩饰得很好。

en: &157 Hey. You okay? You look like you're about to pull a Daniel Boone.
zh: &157 嘿。你没事吧？你看起来像是要学丹尼尔·布恩一样。

en: &2059 These shoes... are not... made for running.
zh: &2059 这双鞋……不是……用来跑步的。

en: &2060 But I made it. There they are. Alive.
zh: &2060 但我做到了。他们就在那里。活着。

en: Jackson was too nice to rob!
zh: 杰克逊人太好了，不能抢！

en: &158 What did I tell you? Smooth, quick and easy.
zh: &158 我怎么跟你说的？顺利、迅速又轻松。

en: &2062 Yes. That was indeed all of those things.
&152 Hate to rob and run, but we've gotta vamoose.
zh: &152 不想抢完就跑，但我们得赶紧溜了。

en: &153 We gotta car stashed around the block. You need a lift somewhere?
zh: &153 我们在街区那边藏了辆车。需要送你一程吗？

en: &159 We can split the loot on the way.
&2063 No. Keep it all. I'll be fine.
&154 She for real?
&160 Hey, I ain't looking a gift horse in the mouth.
zh: &160 嘿，我可不会对白来的东西挑三拣四。

en: &2064 Do you... want me to pass on a word to anyone? Your father or mother?
zh: &2064 你……想让我给谁带句话吗？你父亲或母亲？

en: &155 Nah. I'll talk to him when I'm good and ready.
zh: &155 不用。等我准备好了，我会自己跟他说。

en: &161 You can tell my ma I'll be thinking of her. I'll write her soon.
zh: &161 你可以告诉我妈，我会想她的。我很快会给她写信。

en: &2065 I'll do that. Good luck to you both, Mr. and Mrs. Camron.
zh: &2065 我会的。祝你们好运，卡姆伦先生和太太。

en: &156 Huh. That won't work anymore, will it?
zh: &156 哈。那以后就不管用了，对吧？

en: &162 You mean our name? Yeah, you're right.
zh: &162 你是说我们的姓？是啊，你说得对。

en: &163 We need to think of a new one. Right now.
zh: &163 我们得想个新的。现在就想。

en: &157 Any ideas?
Granted Jewelers
&2066 No. Nothing for it. I have to see this through.
zh: &2066 不。没办法。我必须把这件事做完。

en: &2067 Or rather, see THEM through.
&2068 I should leave this area as soon as possible.
zh: &2068 我应该尽快离开这个区域。

en: &2069 The transfer system won't work from inside a prison cell.
zh: &2069 转移系统在监狱牢房里无法工作。

en: &403 Don't bring me back in there, Agent Quinn.
zh: &403 别把我带回那里，奎因特工。

en: &404 If you do, I may do something that'll cost me my security deposit.
zh: &404 如果你那么做，我可能会做出让我损失押金的事。

en: &158 Yeah. Danny knows me. He'd catch wise if I was snooping around.
zh: &158 是啊。丹尼认识我。我要是到处打探，他会察觉的。

en: &2070 That's definitely the spot where the photo was taken.
zh: &2070 那肯定就是照片拍摄的地方。

en: &2071 So we came to the right place, at least.
zh: &2071 所以至少我们来对了地方。

en: You cannot pin this on me!
zh: 你不能把这事赖在我头上！

en: &3365 I'll let him smoke in peace.
Counter
Thermostat
To back room

Display

zh: 柜台上放着一台（对这个时代来说）顶级的显微镜。

en: Maximum Fia!
Talking back.
Sounds like a threat.
What is my real voice?
Which is the British one?
Can't take it back.
Alex Ross as Danny.
zh: 亚历克斯·罗斯 饰 丹尼。

en: This large, ornate exit leads back to the street.
zh: 这扇华丽的大门通向街道。

en: Why couldn't have Nozzo given you an outfit like this one?
zh: 为什么诺佐没给你一套这样的衣服？

en: A primitive temperature control device is embedded in this wall.
zh: 墙上嵌着一个原始的温控装置。

en: A dazzling display of colorful gemstones.
zh: 令人眼花缭乱的彩色宝石展示。

en: A hall leads to a back room.
zh: 一条走廊通向后面的房间。

en: Danny's abandoned jacket hangs on a hook.
zh: 丹尼遗弃的夹克挂在钩子上。

en: A clunky thermostat is embedded on the wall.
zh: 墙上嵌着一个笨重的恒温器。

en: Shop clerk
&405 Oh. Blast it.
&92 Huh?
&4975 Sorry. Nothing.
&2072 Remember to subvocalize.
&406 Right. Sorry.
&407 Blast it on TOAST.
&408 You seeing this?
&2073 I do. The painting's not here.
zh: &2073 我看到了。那幅画不在这里。

en: &409 But it was here. The picture PROVES it was here.
zh: &409 但它之前在这里。照片证明它之前在这里。

en: &2074 It proves it was here once. Or will be one day.
zh: &2074 这证明它曾经在这里。或者将来某一天会在这里。

en: &2075 The question is... which is it?
Her eyes keep scanning the walls, looking for the missing painting.
zh: 她的眼睛不停地扫视墙壁，寻找那幅失踪的画。

en: &93 Hello. Can I... help... you?
&165 No. But we'd like to help ourselves to your whole store.
zh: &165 不。但我们想把你的整个店都拿走。

en: &94 Jesus!
&159 Open the counter. Now!
&95 Okay! Okay! I just...
&96 ...need to get the key out of my jacket.
zh: &96 ……需要从我的夹克里拿出钥匙。

en: &2076 I am starting to get really sick of being shot in the head.
zh: &2076 我真的开始厌倦被爆头了。

en: &2077 Leaving now would not be a good idea.
zh: &2077 现在离开可不是个好主意。

en: &4357 I should retrieve Liz's ring, first.
zh: &4357 我应该先取回莉兹的戒指。

en: &97 Phew. Working in August ain't for the faint of heart.
zh: &97 呼。八月份工作可不是闹着玩的。

en: &2078 It's funny to think of these as being so valuable, isn't it?
zh: &2078 想到这些东西这么值钱，真有意思，不是吗？

en: &545 You mean because we can fabricate any clothing and accessories we want?
zh: &545 你是说因为我们可以制造任何想要的服装和配饰？

en: &546 You'd be surprised. There's a niche market for those wanting "authentic clothing experiences."
zh: &546 你会惊讶的。有一群小众市场的人想要“真实的服装体验”。

en: &547 Sartorialists, they call themselves. Chrono-shifts don't seem to get rid of them.
zh: &547 他们自称“服装主义者”。时空改写似乎也摆脱不了他们。

en: &2079 I suppose some things transcend timelines.
zh: &2079 我想有些东西是超越时间线的。

en: &548 And thank heaven for that.
&2080 I have little interest in those.
&2081 I am ill-equipped to rob this store on my own.
zh: &2081 我装备不足，没法独自抢劫这家店。

en: &2082 The Camrons don't seem interested in these jewels any longer. I need to help them with the safe before it's too late.
zh: &2082 卡姆伦一家似乎对这些珠宝不再感兴趣了。我得趁还来得及，帮他们打开保险箱。

en: &98 Well, good news.
&99 Looks like your groom-to-be paid around 700 for that ring, assuming he didn't get ripped off.
zh: &99 看来你的准新郎为那枚戒指花了大约700块，假设他没被宰的话。

en: &2083 Ah. Thank you. What a relief.
zh: &2083 啊。谢谢。真是松了一口气。

en: &100 Here's your ring back.
&6040 Cheers.
&101 And if things don't work out, just let me know. I'll buy it from you.
zh: &101 如果事情不顺利，就告诉我。我会从你那里买下它。

en: &2084 I will keep that in mind.
&2085 Not while the owner is watching.
&2086 Shifting it up twenty degrees ought to do it.
zh: &2086 把它调高二十度应该就行了。

en: &2087 May we enter your back room?
zh: &2087 我们可以进你的后屋吗？

en: &2088 I don't need to enter the back room again. We have what we need.
zh: &2088 我不需要再进后屋了。我们拿到需要的东西了。

en: &2089 A microscope? What's he doing with that?
zh: &2089 显微镜？他拿那个做什么？

en: &2090 The only item in the jacket is the Danny's pistol.
zh: &2090 夹克里唯一的东西就是丹尼的手枪。

en: &2091 I already have a weapon, so I will just leave that where it is.
zh: &2091 我已经有武器了，所以我就把它留在原处。

Can't take it back!

zh: 这个雕刻精美的地球仪上覆盖着一层薄薄的灰尘。

en: The front door leads back to 57th Street.
The clock above the fireplace is displaying the incorrect time. It emits no ticking sound.
zh: 壁炉上方的时钟显示的时间不对。它没有发出滴答声。

en: The fireplace is cold and empty.
These fireplace implements have a thin layer of dust on them.
zh: 这些壁炉用具上有一层薄薄的灰尘。

en: The books on this shelf look like they have been read thoroughly and often.
zh: 这个架子上的书看起来被经常且彻底地翻阅过。

en: A round... thing? Hangs from the ceiling. You are unclear what purpose it serves.
zh: 一个圆圆的……东西？从天花板上垂下来。你不清楚它有什么用途。

en: What did Imani call this one? "Deliverer of Innocence?"
zh: 伊曼妮管这个叫什么来着？“纯真救主？”

en: place mitch in jackson's home
zh: 把米奇放在杰克逊家里

en: What's occuring!
How English is Fia?
That's one word for it.
Only dogs can hear you.
&157 Excuse me if I don't get up. My legs aren't what they used to be.
zh: &157 请原谅我不站起来。我的腿不像以前那样了。

en: &2092 That's all right. You are Jackson Grant?
zh: &2092 没关系。你是杰克逊·格兰特吗？

en: &158 I am. And you are?
&2093 Fia Quinn. This is Imani...
zh: &2093 菲娅·奎因。这位是伊曼妮……

en: &410 Urgh.
&159 Is she quite all right?
&411 I'm FINE.
&412 It's just... do you smell anything?
&160 Nothing in particular. Why?
&413 Never mind. I'm fine.
&414 No. I'm MORE than fine. Look at that!
zh: &414 不。我好得不能再好了。看看那个！

en: &161 The painting?
&415 "Deliverer of Innocence!"
&416 Look at you. You're pristine.
&162 You are familiar with the artist?
&417 Yes. You could say that.
&418 That's why we're here.
zh: &418 这就是我们来这里的原因。

en: &163 Well. This is intriguing, I must admit.
zh: &163 嗯。我得承认，这很有意思。

en: &164 To unexpected surprises.
&165 So what can I do for you?
&166 Ah. Officer Santina. I assume that was some other officer's police car speeding away?
zh: &166 啊。桑蒂纳警官。我想那辆疾驰而去的警车是别的警官的吧？

en: &153 No. It was mine. Take a wild guess who stole it.
zh: &153 不。是我的。猜猜是谁偷的。

en: &167 Elizabeth.
&154 This is the last straw, Grant! That kid of yours is out of control!
zh: &154 我受够了，格兰特！你家那孩子失控了！

en: &168 So I am responsible for your stolen vehicle, am I?
zh: &168 所以你的车被偷是我的责任，是吗？

en: &155 What? No.
&169 Perhaps I am. Perhaps you should arrest me. Perhaps I deserve it.
zh: &169 也许我是。也许你该逮捕我。也许我活该。

en: &156 That's not what I meant.
&170 Then tell me what you DO mean.
&157 This lady here. She was involved.
&171 Is she now?
&2094 Sorry to dash off, Mr. Grant.
zh: &2094 抱歉得先走了，格兰特先生。

en: &2095 I need to see if my friend is all right.
zh: &2095 我得去看看我的朋友是否安好。

en: &172 Of course. Take care of your friends and loved ones and hold them tight, is my advice.
zh: &172 当然。照顾好你的朋友和所爱之人，紧紧拥抱他们，这是我的建议。

en: &173 You never know when they might leave you.
zh: &173 你永远不知道他们什么时候会离开你。

en: &2096 Um. Quite.
&2097 The last time I looked at a world map was ten years and several thousand chrono-adjustments ago.
zh: &2097 我上次看世界地图是在十年前，以及几千次时空校正之前。

en: &2098 Keeping track of all the changes was impossible, so I stopped bothering.
zh: &2098 要追踪所有变化是不可能的，所以我就不再费心了。

en: &2099 See no reason to start now.
&2100 Mr. Grant seems like an avid reader, although I can't judge his collection. I don't read much anymore.
zh: &2100 格兰特先生似乎是个爱读书的人，不过我没法评价他的藏书。我已经不怎么读书了。

en: &2101 The last time I read a novel, it popped out of existence just as I hit the last chapter.
zh: &2101 我上次读一本小说，就在我读到最后一章时，它突然消失了。

en: &2102 Never again.
To the intersection of tenth street and Broadway.
zh: 到第十街和百老汇的交叉口。

en: The main entrance to the Brittany Hall dormitory.
zh: 布列塔尼楼宿舍的正门。

en: The name of Brittany Hall is embossed across the transom window in a classy, subtle font.
zh: 布列塔尼楼的名字以优雅含蓄的字体压印在气窗上。

en: A fire hydrant. Joe Anderson does not appear to be hiding behind it.
zh: 一个消防栓。乔·安德森似乎没有藏在它后面。

en: One Way. You occasionally wonder what it must have been like to live in a world where time only went in one direction.
zh: 单行道。你偶尔会想，生活在一个时间只朝一个方向流动的世界里会是什么样子。

en: It's a flyer advertising Dearden's Donuts. According to this, their Toroidal Terror is "to die for". You're not sure whether that's an endorsement or not.
zh: 这是一张迪尔登甜甜圈的传单。根据传单，他们的“环形恐惧”“好吃得要命”。你不确定这是不是一种推荐。

en: There appears to be an egg sandwich in here, discarded after a single bite. Disgusting.
zh: 这里似乎有一个鸡蛋三明治，只咬了一口就被丢弃了。真恶心。

en: Having less to think about.
To cut or not to cut?
Precious about the Brittany House.
&2103 The door is locked tight.
&2104 A sign says that the building is closed for Spring Break.
zh: &2104 牌子上写着大楼春假期间关闭。

en: &2105 There must be over a hundred rooms in this place.
zh: &2105 这地方肯定有一百多个房间。

en: &2106 Time travel or not, it will take ages to search them one by one.
zh: &2106 不管能不能时间旅行，一个一个搜都要花很长时间。

en: &2107 Room 1407. Here I come.
&2108 A bit out of practice, but I got it.
zh: &2108 有点生疏了，但我做到了。

en: &181 Um. The Silver Flare is in the other direction.
zh: &181 嗯。银焰餐厅在另一个方向。

&2110 Do you have a better idea?

en: A shallow puddle has formed by the broken fire hydrant.
zh: 破损的消防栓旁形成了一个浅水坑。

en: The back window has been broken. You assume so Arthur and Liz could escape.
zh: 后窗被打破了。你猜想这样亚瑟和莉兹才能逃出去。

en: Away from the scene of the crime.
&2111 Well. This is typical, isn't it.
Car Crash

zh: &2112 车门变形得没法修了。没有撬棍打不开。

en: &2113 I can't see through the window with these two lovebirds in the way.
zh: &2113 这对小情侣挡着，我没法透过窗户看。

en: &6041 No need to look in there again.
&2114 Tempting, but the two lovebirds are in the way.
zh: &2114 很诱人，但那对情侣挡着路。

en: &5333 That only works on organic material, I'm afraid.
zh: &5333 恐怕那东西只对有机材料有效。

en: &2115 The multitool is for more delicate, detailed tasks.
zh: &2115 多功能工具是用来做更精细、更细致的活的。

zh: &2116 我想我需要更……直接的方法。

The ultimate arbiter of everything British.
zh: 一切英国事物的最终仲裁者。

en: An underrated skill.
Horatio Street heads further into the Greenwich Village neighborhood.
zh: 霍雷肖街继续延伸，深入格林威治村社区。

en: A simple wooden door leads into the Contis Cafe.
zh: 一扇简单的木门通向康蒂斯咖啡馆。

en: &7 Yeah?
&6042 I have nothing to say to that fellow.
zh: &6042 我跟那家伙没什么好说的。

zh: 一个配电箱，被螺丝紧紧固定在墙上。

en: An escape from the speakeasy. And Liz's singing.

en: April 14, 2024[East Village[5:31 PM
Pigeons!
&430 Loud and clear. You made it in one piece?

en: &3 Rough spot for a landing point, though.

en: &431 Well, it's isolated, open to the sky, and close to the client's desired goal.

en: &432 As far as the brass are concerned, it's perfect.

zh: &433 说到这个，我正要把他送过去。你最好让开。

en: &1812 Righto.
&1813 Timefall successful. I see him.
zh: &1813 时间坠落成功。我看到他了。

en: &434 How is he?
&149 Urggggg.
&1814 He's fine.
&4295 The cranial shielding did its job.
&435 You'd better go check on him.
&1815 Right. I'm secure.
&436 Okay. I'm relaying the upgrade over.
&437 Stand back. This may sting a little.

en: &1817 And you just... had this upgrade lying around?
zh: &1817 你就……把这个升级随手放在一边？

en: &439 Like I said. It's our contingency plan.
zh: &439 我说了。这是我们的应急计划。

en: &1818 So you want me to...
&1819 Leaving the client unconscious in a ditch is not technically in the rulebook, but I doubt the brass would be happy.
zh: &1819 把客户打昏丢在沟里严格来说不在规章里，但我怀疑高层不会高兴。

en: &440 No they wouldn't.
construction door is locked Nozzo

&150 Is there a problem?

zh: 点击菜单栏上的电话呼叫诺佐

en: Well that doesn't mean anything anymore.

en: &103 Fine. What do you want now?
&167 Okay, Mister. You're gonna open the safe, nice and easy.

en: &422 That's it!
&423 Agent Quinn. This is IT.

en: &428 Nobody from our time has seen this painting outside of a museum in over fifty years.

Mount Tom

en: rewind!
I should know this! Why don't I know this?

en: &172 It's okay. Just relax. Breathe.
&175 No. The second number. It's the year my MOMMA died.
zh: &175 不。第二个数字。是我妈妈去世的年份。

en: &176 What kind of person forgets a thing like that?
zh: &176 什么样的人会忘记这种事？

zh: &173 没关系。人有时候都会忘事。

zh: &177 我以后也会是那种妈妈吗？“有时候会忘事”的那种？

en: &175 So what if you are?
&176 You think we'd love you any less?
zh: &176 你觉得我们会因此少爱你一点吗？

en: &178 You... really mean that?
&177 You and me. Forever. No matter what.
zh: &177 你和我。永远。无论发生什么。

en: &178 Now here's what we're gonna do...
&179 Nice peashooter, Danno. You pick your teeth with that?
zh: &179 好一把小豆枪，丹诺。你拿它剔牙吗？

en: &179 Or use it to file your nails?
&108 Shut up!
&109 I'm gonna make a call. It can be either the cops, or the morgue.
zh: &109 我要打个电话。要么打给警察，要么打给停尸房。

en: &180 Big talk coming from behind such a little gun.
zh: &180 拿着这么小一把枪，口气倒不小。

Ida was an Inman.
A cut puzzle.
You're a pro.
You have enough hints.
Fia, come ON.
I never talk normally.

zh: 一个沙袋。表面因多年击打而磨损。

en: Ida's desk is overflowing with paperwork. You are unsure exactly why she would have so much.
zh: 艾达的办公桌上堆满了文件。你不确定她为什么会有这么多。

zh: 一条散发着赛后汗臭的健身毛巾被丢弃在长凳上。那是更纯真年代的遗物。如今你再也见不到这样的东西了。

en: &90 Hm. These two belong to you, Brian?
zh: &90 嗯。这两个人是你的人吗，布赖恩？

en: &171 No. Never seen 'em before, Miss Ida.
zh: &171 不。以前从没见过他们，艾达小姐。

en: &91 Well. If you want autographs, go someplace else.
zh: &91 好吧。想要签名的话，去别处。

zh: &92 想要门票的话，本赛季余下场次都已售罄。

en: &93 Anything else, make it quick.
Chloe seems content for the first time since you arrived. She must feel right at home in places like this.
zh: 自从你到达后，克洛伊第一次显得心满意足。她在这种地方一定感觉如鱼得水。

en: Chloe seems content, but on edge.
zh: 克洛伊显得心满意足，但又有些紧张不安。

Left!

You have enough hints!
Church

en: A cold Doctor Who vibe.
zh: 一股冷冰冰的《神秘博士》气息。

You believe this is St. Paul's. You heard about it collapsing twenty years ago. Or 170 years from this current when.
zh: 你相信这是圣保罗教堂。你听说它二十年前倒塌了。或者说，距离当前这个年代一百七十年后。

en: Chloe does her best not to wrinkle her nose.
This way lies an escape from the smell of oysters.
zh: 这条路可以逃离牡蛎的气味。

en: &107 I told you. I'll have it Wednesday.
zh: &107 我告诉过你了。我周三会拿到。

en: &326 This is getting to be a grind.
&327 Pony up with whatever you got, or I'll have to come back in an hour with friends.
zh: &327 有多少就交多少，不然我一小时后带朋友回来。

en: &108 Oh. You have friends?
&109 Sorry. Sorry. That was uncalled for. Here's what I've got. Take it or leave it.
zh: &109 抱歉。抱歉。我不该那么说。这是我所有的了。要就拿去，不要拉倒。

en: &110 I'd say you're enjoying this, but I don't think you enjoy anything these days.
zh: &110 我倒是想说你在享受这一切，但我觉得你现在对什么都提不起兴趣。

en: &328 I'll be back Wednesday for the rest.
&111 That hayseed thinks he's too high for his nut.
zh: &111 那个乡巴佬自视甚高，不知道自己几斤几两。

en: Minna's Oyster Stand
Oyster farming was INSANE.
Yer man.
Someone's already done it.
Edwyn feels the need to be sarcastic.
zh: 埃德温觉得有必要挖苦一下。

en: It's too dark to see anything down there.
zh: 下面太黑了，什么都看不见。

en: From out here, the pub looks warm and inviting.
zh: 从外面看，酒吧显得温暖又诱人。

en: The way back to the landing point.
&2920 Here we are. Back at The Barking Dog.
zh: &2920 我们到了。回到吠犬酒吧。

en: &501 On fight night.
&502 It's funny. We died here, right?
zh: &502 有意思。我们死在这里，对吧？

en: &503 Or we will die here, I guess. A lot, according to you. How many times?
zh: &503 或者我猜，我们将会死在这里。按你说的，很多次。到底多少次？

en: &2921 I didn't keep count.
&2922 I'm sure Nozzo did, but he'd say that's privileged information.
zh: &2922 诺佐肯定数了，但他会说那是机密信息。

en: &817 It is.
&504 But... what if I was meant to die here? Maybe that was my fate, and you changed it?
zh: &504 可是……如果我注定要死在这里呢？也许那就是我的命运，而你改变了它？

en: &505 What if fate took Simon instead of me?
zh: &505 如果命运带走了西蒙，而不是我呢？

en: &2923 Chloe. If fate is real then all the technology and time-flippery in the world wouldn't be able to shift it.
zh: &2923 克洛伊。如果命运是真的，那世界上所有的科技和时间把戏都无法改变它。

en: &818 Not to mention we'd be out of a job.
&2924 That as well.
&506 I guess I need to decide who's driving. Me, or fate.
zh: &506 我想我得决定谁在掌控。是我，还是命运。

en: &604 *Sigh*
&507 This just gets better and better.
&508 Simon didn't win because of his skill or ability.
zh: &508 西蒙赢不是因为他的技巧或能力。

en: &509 He won because he fought a guy who was drunk as a skunk.
zh: &509 他赢是因为他打的是个烂醉如泥的家伙。

en: &2153 Still want to save his life?
&510 He's still someone else who's dead because of me.
zh: &510 他还是另一个因我而死的人。

en: &511 I... can't carry any more.
&4362 Hmph.
&4363 This is why I prefer getting my drinks from Mx. Mix.
zh: &4363 这就是为什么我更喜欢从米克斯那里拿饮料。

en: &1533 I really wish Chloe was here to see that.
zh: &1533 真希望克洛伊能看到这一幕。

en: &1534 How're things looking, Noz? Any ripples?
zh: &1534 情况怎么样，诺佐？有涟漪吗？

en: &325 Checking.
&326 You've definitely changed... something. But the ripples haven't settled yet.
zh: &326 你肯定改变了……某些东西。但涟漪还没平息。

en: &564 Oh and speaking of changes, the tunnel to October has finally collapsed.
zh: &564 哦，说到改变，通往十月的隧道终于坍塌了。

en: &2925 Ah. Noted.
&565 I can make another, if you think it's necessary.
zh: &565 如果你觉得有必要，我可以再建一条。

en: &2926 Hold off for now. We probably should check on Simon Inman anyway.
zh: &2926 先别。我们可能还是该去看看西蒙·英曼。

en: &566 Copy that, Fia. Standing by.
&678 You okay, Fia?
&2155 That socket! He sucker-punched me!
&4364 Hold on. How did the ERP engage? Did he kill me?
zh: &4364 等等。ERP 是怎么启动的？他杀了我吗？

en: &1236 No, but the surge in your vitals was sudden enough to trigger it.
zh: &1236 没有，但你生命体征的骤升足以触发它。

en: &4365 I suppose I should be thankful.
Making this fight less gross (and thank you Olivia White).
zh: 让这场架别那么恶心（谢谢奥利维娅·怀特）。

en: &4366 Gah. What is he MADE of? Granite?
zh: &4366 呃。他是什么做的？花岗岩吗？

en: &1237 That hit caused several hairline fractures before the ERP kicked in.
zh: &1237 在 ERP 启动前，那一击已经造成了几处细微骨裂。

en: &4367 Well, I seem to be fine now. All that's cracked is my pride.
zh: &4367 嗯，我现在似乎没事了。碎掉的只有我的自尊。

en: &4368 I'll be ready this time.
&1238 You all right?
&1239 I could hear the crack of that one from here.
zh: &1239 我在这儿都能听到那一下的骨裂声。

en: &4369 Everything's ship shape. I'll get him next time.

&2946 It's... clean.

en: &116 Thanks.
&2947 There it goes again.
&2948 Er. Yes. yes that's me. Again.
&181 Right.
&2949 Noz? What is other me doing right now?
zh: &2949 诺佐？另一个我现在在干什么？

en: &743 Dry heaving into the bushes, if my records are correct.
zh: &743 如果我的记录没错，正对着灌木丛干呕。

en: &2950 You kept a record of that?
&744 Should I not have?
&2951 Forget it. And where did I go after?
&745 The door opened, and you walked inside.
&2952 Right. The door opened. All by itself.
&2953 Didn't you think that was odd?
&746 I was mostly concerned about you.
&2954 Touching. But I'm starting to see how this works now.
