en: &173 So, uh, this is it.
&174 Impressive, right?
&175 Anyway, uh...
&176 The real magic's up this way!
&208 Oh. Sorry. Didn't see you there.
zh: &208 哦。抱歉。没看见你在那儿。

en: &209 I thought I told you to head upstairs?
&2955 Heading up there now.
&210 Right. Anyway, I need to take this call.
zh: &210 行。总之，我得接这个电话。

en: &177 You ever seen a vertical farm before?
zh: &177 你以前见过垂直农场吗？

en: &2956 I can't say I have.
&178 Ah! You're in for a treat.
&179 Oh wait. One thing.
&180 System! Give Fia access to the vertical farm!
zh: &180 系统！给菲娅开放垂直农场的权限！

en: &181 There you go. You should have access now. Come on in!
zh: &181 好了。你现在应该有权限了。进来吧！

en: &2 Situations like what?
&2957 Oh blast it!
Leaves reception, 2042
&2958 There's nothing on that table I need.
zh: &2958 那张桌子上没有我需要的东西。

en: &2959 Urf. Dusty down here.
&2960 No need to go back under there.
zh: &2960 没必要再钻回那下面了。

en: &2961 A forcefield?
&1004 "Trash detected. Please dispose of trash before entering."
zh: &1004 “检测到垃圾。进入前请处理垃圾。”

en: &2962 I'd probably should do as Madison asked. I don't want to raise TOO much suspicion.
zh: &2962 我最好照麦迪逊说的做。我不想引起太多怀疑。

en: &2963 No. I need to let myself in first.
&2964 Bad idea. My former self is up there right now.
zh: &2964 坏主意。我之前的自己现在就在上面。

en: &2965 I'd prefer to avoid another melting incident.
zh: &2965 我可不想再发生一次融化事件。

en: &2966 Benji is waiting for me in the Vertical Farm. I don't want to raise any suspicion.
zh: &2966 本吉在垂直农场等我。我不想引起任何怀疑。

en: &2967 I'd better do as Benji asked. The last thing I need is for him to question what I'm doing here.
zh: &2967 我最好照本吉说的做。我最不希望的就是他质疑我在这里做什么。

en: &4976 I'd better leave Cassie to it.
zh: &4976 我最好让卡西自己处理。

en: &1005 Trash detected. Please dispose of trash in the proper bin before leaving the building.
zh: &1005 检测到垃圾。离开大楼前请将垃圾放入正确的垃圾桶。

en: &1006 Keep our city clean!
&3 What?
&2970 WHAT?
&747 Oh blast it.
&748 It's a CHROVERGENCE.
&7075 A what?
&4 A WHAT?
&819 Blast it! Fia!
&749 Activating ERP! Now!
zh: &749 启动紧急回溯协议！现在！

en: &5 I can handle it.
&6 I just need to get that door open...
&8 See?
&9 Totally handled.
&10 I know.
&750 Too close for comfort. Now get to the landing point. Quick.
zh: &750 太险了。现在去跃迁落点。快。

en: &2971 I really don't want another melting incident. I need to find a way to stay out of sight before opening that door.
zh: &2971 我真的不想再发生一次融化事件。我得在打开那扇门前找个办法躲起来。

en: &2972 No. I'm not leaving. I can do this.
&2973 Bad idea. My previous self is right outside the door.
zh: &2973 坏主意。我之前的自己就在门外。

en: &2974 Speaking of, I'd better be somewhere else quick.
zh: &2974 说到这个，我最好赶紧去别的地方。

en: &2969 My hand doesn't do anything. Probably need to use the card.
zh: &2969 我的手没反应。可能得用卡。

en: &2968 It won't open by itself. I need to use the panel to the right.
zh: &2968 它不会自己打开。我得用右边的面板。

en: &211 Um. Can I help you?
&2975 Er. No. Never mind.
&212 Right.
&2976 The door won't open.
&2977 No. I need to let myself in, first.
&182 Fia? How did...?
&213 Is... something wrong?
&183 Is something wrong?
&184 What do you THINK?
&185 I can't give the presentation like this. FIND BENJI.
zh: &185 我这样没法做演示。去找本吉。

en: &214 What the heck happened to her?
&2978 I haven't the slightest idea.
&2979 Anyway I need to duck in here for a moment.
zh: &2979 总之我得在这里躲一会儿。

en: &11 Is something wrong?
&4379 I'd better see what Mr. Pasamon wants to show me.
zh: &4379 我最好看看帕萨蒙先生想给我看什么。

en: &4977 The job's done. No need to go back in there.
zh: &4977 活儿干完了。没必要再回那里去。

en: &2980 I don't need to mess about in this place any more than I have to.
zh: &2980 我没必要在这个地方多待。

en: &2981 I need to get young Benji up to the conference room before the presentation starts.
zh: &2981 我得在演示开始前把小本吉带到会议室去。

en: &1004 Trash detected. Please dispose of trash before entering.
zh: &1004 检测到垃圾。请先处理垃圾再进入。

en: &5104 I'd better do as she asked.
&4978 I shouldn't go back in there. I don't want to accidentally wake Madison up.
zh: &4978 我不该再回那里去。我不想不小心吵醒麦迪逊。

en: &2983 This door won't open.
&5190 No point. It looks empty.
Lock
Poster
Horrific Frog
Boxing poster
Door opening
Old and rusty, but does the job.
An old combination lock holds the door in place.
zh: 一把老式密码锁把门固定着。

en: To the grid-like streets of lower Manhattan.
zh: 通往曼哈顿下城网格般的街道。

en: A weather-worn rag is tied to this sign.
zh: 一块饱经风霜的破布系在这块牌子上。

en: A worn movie poster graces this wall.
zh: 一张破旧的电影海报为这面墙增色。

en: A primitive call to arms?
An angel with a devil's tail. Your best guess it has some religious or political significance.
zh: 一个长着魔鬼尾巴的天使。你猜它可能有什么宗教或政治意义。

en: This hideous creature reminds you of a mascot that was chronoshifted out of existence. You seem to remember its cultural erasure being a crowdfunded request.
zh: 这个丑陋的生物让你想起一个被时空改写抹去的吉祥物。你似乎记得它的文化抹除是一个众筹请求。

en: Mike can't say it.
No extra charge!
Yes. Words. Thank you.
I love this is a puzzle!
How the original draft started.
zh: 最初的草稿就是这样开始的。

en: Casting Sally and Edwyn as Fia and Nozzo.
zh: 让萨莉和埃德温扮演菲娅和诺佐。

en: Why no talking portraits?
A poster for a boxing event that has already happened. You don't recall who won.
zh: 一张已经结束的拳击赛事海报。你不记得谁赢了。

en: A poster for a boxing event that has already happened. According to Joe Anderson, Hanson won.
zh: 一张已经结束的拳击赛事海报。据乔·安德森说，汉森赢了。

en: &154 *whistle*
&446 Everything okay?
&1831 I'm fine. Nobody's giving me a second look.
zh: &1831 我没事。没人多看我一眼。

en: &447 And the client?
&1832 I'll check.
Giving Nozzo a face.
City street
&2209 Nice day for a stroll, true, but wandering without a destination is against protocol.
zh: &2209 散步是好天气，没错，但没有目的地闲逛违反协议。

en: &2214 I should call Nozzo and see if he has any ideas.
zh: &2214 我应该给诺佐打个电话，看他有没有主意。

en: &8062 I should at least check on the client before wandering off.
zh: &8062 我至少应该在走开前确认一下客户的情况。

en: &1836 I've already rendezvoused with the client. No need to go back there.
zh: &1836 我已经和客户会合了。没必要再回去。

en: &1837 Can't return to the landing point yet. I need to... do what I need to do.
zh: &1837 还不能返回跃迁落点。我需要……做我该做的事。

en: &2201 The multitool is for more delicate work.
zh: &2201 多功能工具是用于更精细的工作。

en: &2202 The door is already unlocked.
&1841 THERE we go.
&1842 You getting this, Nozzo?
&453 I got it, Fia.
&1843 I fail to see how that would help.
&4296 If there's a serial number underneath, scraping it would only damage it further. I need something more delicate.
zh: &4296 如果下面有序列号，刮擦只会进一步损坏它。我需要更精细的工具。

en: &2205 It's locked with a combination, not with a key. The multitool won't do much good.
zh: &2205 它是用密码锁的，不是用钥匙。多功能工具起不了多大作用。

en: &2215 It's too dry to be of any use.
&1844 Nozzo? What's the timeline importance ranking of this old rag?
zh: &1844 诺佐？这块旧抹布的时间线重要性评级是多少？

en: &454 I think it's safe to assume... quite low.
zh: &454 我觉得可以放心地假设……相当低。

en: &1845 Hm. Let's test that, shall we?
zh: &1845 嗯。我们来验证一下，好吗？

en: &1846 So? Any ripples?
&455 No, Fia. The timeline did not change because you picked up a rag.
zh: &455 没有，菲娅。时间线不会因为你捡起一块抹布而改变。

en: &456 If there are any ripples to be concerned about, I'll ping you.
zh: &456 如果有需要担心的涟漪，我会通知你。

en: &457 So feel free to grab as much trash off the street as you want.
zh: &457 所以你想从街上捡多少垃圾都行。

en: &1847 You're too good to me, Noz.
&458 I know.
&2203 Trollgate! I remember this film. It's a classic.
zh: &2203 《巨魔之门》！我记得这部电影。是部经典。

en: &562 It hasn't come out in your when yet, so don't spoil it for anyone.
zh: &562 它在你这个年代还没上映，所以别给任何人剧透。

en: &2204 I was a kid, Noz. I imagine it's chrono-shifted into an entirely different movie by now.
zh: &2204 我当时还是个孩子，诺佐。我想它现在已经被时空改写成一部完全不同的电影了。

en: I can't say it!
Yes. Words. Thank you!
I love this is a puzzle
Casting Sally Beaumont and Edwyn Tiong as Fia and Nozzo.
zh: 由萨莉·博蒙特和埃德温·蒂翁为菲娅和诺佐配音。

en: &2783 I've never been one for watching sports. Not because I have an aversion to it, it's just hard to know who to root for when time's in regular flux.
zh: &2783 我从来不喜欢看体育比赛。不是因为反感，只是时间经常变动，很难知道该支持谁。

en: Stitching
This tightly-stitched thread looks slightly out-of-place.
zh: 这条缝得紧紧的线看起来有点格格不入。

en: A note has been secreted away inside this doll.
zh: 一张纸条被藏在这个娃娃里面。

en: &2169 I can't pull the thread out. It's too tightly woven.
zh: &2169 我没法把线抽出来。织得太紧了。

en: Boxes
Boarded up door
Fughedaboutit!
Does it count towards my daily steps?
Chloe watches over little Paula like a guardian angel.
zh: 克洛伊像守护天使一样照看着小葆拉。

en: Paula is sleeping peacefully.
The way out of the Inman abode.
None of these crates seem particularly full or heavy. Either the Inmans haven't packed yet, or they don't have much to pack.
zh: 这些板条箱看起来都不怎么满，也不怎么重。要么英曼一家还没打包，要么他们没什么可打包的。

en: Someone boarded up this door. The rest of the house must not get much use.
zh: 有人用木板封住了这扇门。房子其余部分肯定不常用。

en: If there was ever anything in this frame, it has long since been removed.
zh: 这个相框里就算曾经放过什么，也早就被拿走了。

en: This book looks well-worn and well-loved.
zh: 这本书看起来被翻得很旧，也很受喜爱。

en: &537 This house has definitely seen better days.
zh: &537 这房子肯定有过更好的日子。

en: &538 But if I knew my house was gonna get blown up in a week, I wouldn't bother fixing it up either.
zh: &538 不过如果我知道自己的房子一周后会被炸掉，我也不会费心去修。

en: &6223 There we go.
&2170 All tucked in.
&539 She gonna be okay?
&6224 Nozzo?
&554 My prediction models say she would've died of exposure if you hadn't shown up.
zh: &554 我的预测模型显示，如果你没出现，她会冻死。

en: &1254 But now? As long as she keeps warm, she should be fine.
zh: &1254 但现在呢？只要她保持暖和，应该就没事。

en: &2171 Should be? There's no way to be sure?
&555 There's no mention of a "Paula Inman" anywhere in the historical archive. So it's impossible to know one way or the other.
zh: &555 历史档案里完全没有“葆拉·英曼”的记录。所以没法知道。

en: &540 And Simon? Was this enough to change HIS fate?
zh: &540 那西蒙呢？这足以改变他的命运吗？

en: &2172 What is it? Does he live?
&556 Unknown.
&541 Unknown? What does that mean?
&557 Just that. His date of death is now recorded as "unknown".
zh: &557 就是字面意思。他的死亡日期现在记录为“未知”。

en: &2173 So we changed SOMETHING. We just don't know what.
zh: &2173 所以我们确实改变了一些事。只是不知道是什么。

en: &4380 Nozzo, can you watch over Paula while we pop forward and check?
zh: &4380 诺佐，我们往前跳一下看看情况，你能照看一下葆拉吗？

en: &1255 I can't, no. I can only see what you both see.
zh: &1255 不行。我只能看到你们俩看到的东西。

en: &542 I don't mind staying, if that's what it takes. Is that okay?
zh: &542 如果需要的话，我不介意留下来。可以吗？

en: &1256 It's technically against protocol, but... extenuating circumstances. There's wiggle room.
zh: &1256 严格来说这违反规定，但……情有可原。有回旋余地。

en: &543 I'll guard her with my life.
&3671 Hopefully it won't come to that.
Chloe the babysitter
Inman House
&4382 I should let her sleep.
Fallen Log
Chloe looks helplessly at Paula, trying to decide what to do.
zh: 克洛伊无助地看着葆拉，试图决定该怎么办。

en: Tree
The forest continues to look dark and foreboding. Not a pleasant place to die for sure.
zh: 森林依然显得黑暗而凶险。肯定不是个适合死去的地方。

en: &544 Holy Yuma. Is that Paula under there?
zh: &544 天哪，尤马。那下面难道是葆拉？

en: &545 URRG.
&546 I can't lift it! I can't even budge it! We need to go get help!
zh: &546 我抬不动！连挪都挪不动！我们得去找人帮忙！

en: &2984 There's no time. But don't worry, I think I can move it.
zh: &2984 没时间了。不过别担心，我想我能移开它。

en: &547 No offence, Quinn, but if I can't lift it then you definitely can't.
zh: &547 无意冒犯，奎因，但如果我都抬不动，你肯定也不行。

en: &2175 Chloe, can you help me move that tree?
zh: &2175 克洛伊，你能帮我移开那棵树吗？

en: &548 Er. I'm strong, but not that strong.
zh: &548 呃。我力气不小，但还没大到那种程度。

en: &549 Thank Florence. I wasn't sure that would work.
zh: &549 感谢弗洛伦丝。我还不确定那能行。

en: &2176 Paula? Are you all right?
&2177 She's alive. Let's get her back home.
zh: &2177 她还活着。我们带她回家吧。

en: &5191 There is a knife attachment, but it will take weeks to cut through that thick tree.
zh: &5191 有个刀片附件，但要砍断那棵粗树得花好几周。

en: &5192 That's not going to do the job. Come on. Think, Fia!
zh: &5192 那不管用。来吧。动动脑子，菲娅！

en: Nozzo is staring into the distance. Oblivious to your presence.
zh: 诺佐凝视着远方，对你的存在浑然不觉。

en: It's like being a voice actor.
zh: 这就像当配音演员一样。

en: Sally is not getting it.
I'm allowed to flirt now?
Ask a British person.
A reference waiting for me.
It reads: "Founded by Josephine Park, with a generous grant from the Meltzer foundation."
zh: 上面写着：“由约瑟芬·帕克创立，获梅尔策基金会慷慨资助。”

en: Glass frosted doors lead into the Park Gallery.
zh: 磨砂玻璃门通向帕克画廊。

en: Stairs descend to the street.
&2986 This is a bad idea, Fia Quinn.
zh: &2986 这是个坏主意，菲娅·奎因。

en: &2987 A terrible, stupid idea that goes against all of your training.
zh: &2987 一个糟糕、愚蠢的主意，违背了你受过的所有训练。

en: &2988 Duffy would certainly not approve.
&2989 Yeah. And Duffy had all the answers, didn't he?
zh: &2989 是啊。达菲什么都知道，对吧？

en: Park Gallery
&2990 Gah. That was blasting STUPID.
&2991 It's just a painting for God's sake.
&2992 Tomorrow it might never have existed.
zh: &2992 明天它可能就从未存在过了。

en: &6009 Hey, Fia?
&7046 What?
&762 Bad time?
&2993 No. It's fine. Sorry. It's been a day.
zh: &2993 不，没事。抱歉。今天真是够呛。

en: &2994 What's up?
&763 Well, I just met with the brass.
&764 The good news is I'm not fired.
&2996 See? I told you.
&2997 And the bad news?
&765 The bad news is that it can take several months to find a suitable replacement.
zh: &765 坏消息是，找到合适的接替者可能要花好几个月。

en: &2998 So I'll be pulling double duty until then. I figured as much.
zh: &2998 所以在那之前我得干双份活。我早料到了。

en: &766 You think you'll be up to coming in tomorrow?
zh: &766 你觉得明天能来上班吗？

en: &2999 I can come in right now, if you're up for it.
zh: &2999 如果你愿意，我现在就可以过去。

en: &767 You sure?
&4383 Yeah. Gotta keep busy, right?
zh: &4383 是啊。总得让自己忙起来，对吧？

en: &768 Okay Fia. I'll pull up the roster. See you soon.
zh: &768 好的，菲娅。我调出排班表。待会儿见。

en: &7047 Yeah. See you soon.
&432 Fia! You almost beat me here today.
zh: &432 菲娅！你今天差点比我还早到。

en: &4384 Hello, Imani.
&433 Was about to grab a coffee from the caf. You want one?
zh: &433 我正要去咖啡厅买杯咖啡。你要吗？

en: &434 Milk, no sugar. Am I right?
&435 I knew it.
&436 I'll see you inside.
&3024 I guess I've become a regular.
&3025 Still open. Good.
&3026 Focus on the job. Focus on the job.
&3027 Nozzo? Please tell me we've got another client in the wings.
zh: &3027 诺佐？告诉我还有下一个客户在等着。

en: &769 Er. Funny you should say that...
zh: &769 呃。你这么说倒提醒我了……

en: &3028 Great. Be right there.
&770 Don't you want to know who it is?
&3029 You can tell me when I get there. I'm on my way.
zh: &3029 等我到了你再告诉我。我在路上了。

en: &4979 Okay. Moment of truth.
&4980 Why am I so blasting nervous?
zh: &4980 我怎么会这么该死的紧张？

en: &4981 It's not blasting FAIR.
&4982 How could this happen again?
&4983 Check the archive, Fia. Remember your training.
zh: &4983 查档案，菲娅。记住你的训练。

en: &4984 When all else fails, check the archive.
zh: &4984 当所有办法都失败时，就去查档案。

en: &437 She passed five years ago.
&438 I miss her. I miss her every day.
zh: &438 我想她。我每天都在想她。

en: &6107 Yeah.
&1257 I wish I could understand why.
zh: &1257 我真希望我能明白为什么。

en: &1582 To risk everything she had. Everything she was. On someone she barely knew?
zh: &1582 拿她拥有的一切去冒险。拿她的一切去冒险。为了一个她几乎不认识的人？

en: &439 I wondered the same thing. To the day she died, she never had a proper answer.
zh: &439 我也想过同样的问题。直到她去世那天，她都没有一个像样的答案。

en: &440 She had her own reasons. Whatever they were, I'm grateful for them.
zh: &440 她有她自己的理由。不管是什么，我都很感激。

en: &441 I hope that one day, you'll find some of your own.
zh: &441 我希望有一天，你也能找到属于你自己的理由。

&7090 Nozzo?
&3087 Nozzo! You read?
&1011 RECORDING RECEIVED.
&3088 Blast it, Nozzo.
&3089 Not you, too.
&3090 I am going to fix this.
&7092 Somehow.
How to end this?
lezzdothis!
A helicopter interupts Edwyn's session.
zh: 一架直升机打断了埃德温的录音。

en: &307 Hey, um. So what happens if we run into... you know.
zh: &307 嘿，呃。要是我们碰到……你知道的，会怎么样？

en: &308 Myself?
&2787 Ah. We did our due diligence. Your younger self is home for spring vacation right now.
zh: &2787 啊。我们做过尽职调查了。你年轻时的自己现在正在家度春假。

en: &302 Oh. So I'm back in Maine. You know what you're doing.
zh: &302 哦。所以我回缅因州了。你心里有数。

en: &2788 We'd like to think so.
&303 Will you look at those CARS.
&304 You've probably never seen cars moving on the actual street, have you?
zh: &304 你大概从没见过汽车在真正的街道上跑吧？

en: &2789 I have. Time traveller, remember?
zh: &2789 我见过。时间旅行者，记得吗？

en: &305 Ah. Right. Of course. You've probably seen horse-drawn buggies, too.
zh: &305 啊。对。当然。你大概也见过马车。

en: &2790 On occasion.
&306 Amazing.
&4950 Nozzo, you're keeping an eye on Dr. Anderson, yeah?
zh: &4950 诺佐，你在盯着安德森博士，对吧？

en: &1534 I'm monitoring him through his PFE. He's fine. For now.
zh: &1534 我在通过他的PFE监控他。他没事。暂时。

en: &1535 But I don't think the brass will like that you're leaving him alone.
zh: &1535 但我觉得公司高层不会喜欢你把他一个人丢下。

en: &4951 Probably. But they'll like refunding his deposit even less.
zh: &4951 也许吧。但他们更不喜欢退他押金。

en: &1536 Heh. No doubt.
&1537 OK. I'll leave you to it.
&1538 Update me when you can.
&483 Tell me. Has anyone used time travel to strike it rich?
zh: &483 告诉我。有人用时间旅行发过大财吗？

en: &484 Invest in the stock market? Find some hidden treasure before it was discovered?
zh: &484 投资股市？在被发现之前找到什么隐藏宝藏？

en: &485 That kind of thing?
&2791 Tunneling into the past is expensive. Anyone who can afford it most likely has plenty of money already.
zh: &2791 穿越到过去很贵。能负担得起的人多半已经很有钱了。

en: &486 I'm here on a research grant.
&2792 It doesn't matter. All our clients are closely monitored. No exceptions.
zh: &2792 没关系。我们所有的客户都被严密监控。没有例外。

en: &487 And what if something happens?
&2793 That's why I'm here, Imani.
&488 Yeah. I'm familiar with the specs of that weapon you're carrying.
zh: &488 是啊。我熟悉你带的那把武器的规格。

en: &489 Don't worry. I'll be good.
&490 The colors. I wasn't prepared for that.
zh: &490 那些颜色。我没想到会这样。

en: &2794 Colors?
&491 The cars. The buildings. The clothes. So many colors!
zh: &491 那些车。那些楼。那些衣服。这么多颜色！

en: &492 My mind still thinks of this era in terms of black and white photographs. Isn't that strange?
zh: &492 我心里还是用黑白照片来想象这个时代。是不是很奇怪？

en: &2795 Not at all. Many others have said the same.
zh: &2795 一点也不。很多人都这么说过。

en: &493 Really? God. Am I really that basic?
zh: &493 真的？天哪。我难道真这么普通？

en: &494 Some art curator I am. Forgetting colors exist.
zh: &494 我这算什么艺术策展人。居然忘了颜色是存在的。

en: &3232 Do you know where you're going?
&4952 Looking for any trace of Liz and Arthur.
zh: &4952 寻找莉兹和亚瑟的任何踪迹。

en: &3233 They could be miles away by now.
zh: &3233 他们现在可能已经在几英里之外了。

en: &8025 *Sigh* I know.
&495 Does that happen a lot? You dying on the job?
zh: &495 这种情况经常发生吗？你在工作中死去？

en: &4953 Often enough to be grateful for the ERP.
&4954 Why? Did it bother you?
zh: &4954 为什么？这让你困扰了吗？

en: &496 Of course it upset me. Watching you die? How could it not?
zh: &496 当然让我不安。看着你死去？怎么可能不呢？

en: &4955 You didn't have to keep watching.
&497 You're only there because of me. Seems the least I could do.
zh: &497 你只是因为我才在那里。看来这是我至少能做的。

en: &4956 That's... kind of you, Imani. But not necessary.
zh: &4956 那真是……你真好，伊曼妮。但没必要。

en: &498 My choice. You're stuck with me.
zh: &498 我的选择。你甩不掉我了。

en: &4957 Well. The customer is always right.
&499 Now she gets it.
&404 God. The smell.
&405 Doesn't New York have indoor plumbing in this time?
zh: &405 这个时代的纽约没有室内管道吗？

en: &2796 They do, but it's still pretty rare. And horses don't use toilets.
zh: &2796 有，但仍然相当罕见。而且马不用厕所。

en: &406 No sanitation department?
&2797 Not for another ten years.
&407 Gross.
&2798 Sorry. Should've warned you.
&408 Nah. I'm good.
&409 Mary the Marauder smelled worse. And I went five rounds with her in 2059.
zh: &409 掠夺者玛丽闻起来更糟。2059年我和她打了五个回合。

en: &2799 Just be careful where you step.
&410 The Barking Dog. It's like it was meant to be, isn't it?
zh: &410 吠犬酒吧。就像是命中注定，不是吗？

en: &2800 How so?
&411 We landed in the alley right next to it! And Simon Inman's a regular there.
zh: &411 我们正好降落在它旁边的小巷里！而且西蒙·英曼是那里的常客。

en: &412 That can't be a coincidence.
&2801 It can.
&2802 It's only natural that a bar popular with boxers would be close to the boxing arena.
zh: &2802 拳击手常去的酒吧靠近拳击场是很自然的。

en: &2803 And we chose that landing point for exactly the same reason. To be close to the arena.
zh: &2803 我们选择那个落点也是出于同样的原因。为了靠近竞技场。

en: &413 I guess so.
&414 I still want that drink. That's definitely meant to be.
zh: &414 我还是想喝一杯。那绝对是命中注定。

en: &415 So you don't believe in fate?
&6086 Not especially. Not in my profession.
zh: &6086 不太信。在我的职业中不信。

en: &416 Hm. Because you can change anything, nothing's set in stone...
zh: &416 嗯。因为你可以改变任何事情，没有什么是板上钉钉的……

en: &6087 Once you see how many possibilities can spiral off from one seemingly tiny decision. It all just seems like chaos.
zh: &6087 一旦你看到从一个看似微小的决定中能衍生出多少可能性，一切就都像是混沌。

en: &6088 Time travel needs order. Stability. That's why ChronoZen exists.
zh: &6088 时间旅行需要秩序。稳定。这就是ChronoZen存在的原因。

en: &417 I'm not sure whether to envy you or feel sorry for you.
zh: &417 我不知道该羡慕你还是同情你。

en: &6089 The universe isn't working for me or against me. It just is.
zh: &6089 宇宙既不为我工作，也不与我作对。它只是存在。

en: &418 So there's just... stuff happening. For no reason.
zh: &418 所以就是……事情就那么发生了。毫无理由。

en: &419 That's depressing.
&6091 It's freeing. If the universe doesn't care about me, we can do what we want.
zh: &6091 这是解脱。如果宇宙不在乎我，我们就可以做自己想做的事。

en: &6092 Within the protocols and procedures established by ChronoZen, of course.
zh: &6092 当然，要在 ChronoZen 制定的协议和程序范围内。

en: &420 So these changes we keep making. Getting Simon killed. Saving him again.
zh: &420 所以我们不断做出的这些改变。让西蒙死掉。又救活他。

en: &421 Is it dangerous to keep messing around with history?
zh: &421 一直这样搅乱历史，危险吗？

en: &2805 The short answer is no. Not according to his Timeline Impact Ranking.
zh: &2805 简单来说，不危险。根据他的时间线影响评级来看。

en: &2806 It's low enough that any changes we make should have minimal ripples.
zh: &2806 评级足够低，我们做的任何改变应该只会产生最小的涟漪。

en: &422 And what does that mean?
&2807 Basically, the less impact a person or event has on history, the less impact it will have on the timeline as a whole.
zh: &2807 基本上，一个人或事件对历史的影响越小，对整个时间线的影响也就越小。

en: &2808 At least in the greater scheme of things.
zh: &2808 至少从大局来看是这样。

en: &423 Ah. The Casablanca defense.
&6093 Sorry?
&424 "The problems of little people don't add up to a hill of beans in this crazy world."
zh: &424 “小人物的问题在这个疯狂的世界里根本不算什么。”

en: &2809 Not quite the way the training manual puts it, but yes. That's exactly right.
zh: &2809 培训手册上不是这么写的，不过没错，完全正确。

en: &425 So I get why it's okay to save Simon, but...
zh: &425 所以我明白为什么救西蒙没问题，但是……

en: &426 Don't you EVER get tempted to change things? Like, really big things?
zh: &426 你就从来没有动过改变事情的念头吗？比如，真正的大事？

en: &2810 You mean like killing Hitler? Saving JFK? Stopping the Mars colony disaster?
zh: &2810 你是指像杀死希特勒？救肯尼迪？阻止火星殖民地灾难？

en: &427 Yeah. Don't tell me you've never been tempted.
zh: &427 对。别告诉我你从来没动过心。

en: &2811 Never. That was drilled into me from day one.
zh: &2811 从来没有。从第一天起这就被灌输给我了。

en: &2812 There are some events too large, too important, that the consequences of interfering could be catastrophic.
zh: &2812 有些事件太大、太重要，干涉的后果可能是灾难性的。

en: &2813 That's why the Timeline Impact Rankings were created. So we know what bits we can get away with... tweaking.
zh: &2813 这就是为什么创建了时间线影响评级。这样我们就知道哪些部分可以……微调。

en: &428 But your personal timeline gets "tweaked" constantly, right? Doesn't that get to you?
zh: &428 但你的个人时间线经常被“微调”，对吧？那不会让你受不了吗？

en: &6094 Maybe for some. Not for me. I consider it a perk.
zh: &6094 也许对某些人是这样。对我来说不是。我觉得这是福利。

en: &429 So, uh... it's safe, right?
&6095 Oh absolutely. I've never had a bad timefall.
zh: &6095 哦，绝对安全。我从来没有遇到过糟糕的时间坠落。

en: &430 No, I mean SAFE. For the world.
zh: &430 不，我是说安全。对世界而言。

en: &6096 Hah, that one's a bit above my paygrade.
zh: &6096 哈，那个问题有点超出我的工资级别了。

en: &431 Don't you ever question it? Whether it's right to change things. Whatever a client wants.
zh: &431 你就从来没质疑过吗？改变事情是否正确。不管客户想要什么。

en: &6097 You're a client, remember?
&2815 The technology exists. It will be used, one way or another.
zh: &2815 技术已经存在。不管怎样，它都会被使用。

en: &2816 At least with us, we can keep it under control.
zh: &2816 至少在我们手里，我们可以控制住它。

en: &432 So who determines these timeline impact rankings anyway?
zh: &432 那么到底是谁决定这些时间线影响评级的？

en: &2817 Good question.
&2818 All I know is that it involves algorithms on servers the size of skyscrapers.
zh: &2818 我只知道它涉及运行在摩天大楼那么大的服务器上的算法。

en: &433 Algorithms? Really?
&2819 How else could we categorize everything and everyone in history?
zh: &2819 不然我们还能怎么对历史上的一切和每个人进行分类？

en: &434 I get it. But for something so important... well, it's a bit impersonal, isn't it?
zh: &434 我明白。但对于这么重要的事情……嗯，有点不近人情，不是吗？

en: &2820 If I've learned anything, it's that history isn't personal.
zh: &2820 如果说我学到了什么，那就是历史并不关乎个人。

en: &435 I guess that depends on the history. And the person.
zh: &435 我想这取决于什么样的历史，以及什么样的人。

en: &2821 Perhaps.
&436 Minna's definitely struggling with some serious guilt.
zh: &436 明娜肯定在承受着沉重的负罪感。

en: &437 No, definitely. I know that look.
zh: &437 不，肯定是的。我认得那种表情。

en: &2823 It doesn't seem like she had much choice. I don't blame her.
zh: &2823 她似乎没有太多选择。我不怪她。

en: &438 Sometimes that makes it worse. Sometimes that makes it much worse.
zh: &438 有时候这反而更糟。有时候会糟得多。

en: &900 This frigging RAIN.
&901 They always talk about how the attack happened under a clear blue sky.
zh: &901 他们总说袭击发生在一片晴朗的蓝天下。

en: &902 They never talk about the day before.
zh: &902 他们从不说前一天的事。

en: &7137 You want us to print you out an umbrella? Or a hood?
zh: &7137 要我们给你打印一把伞吗？或者一件兜帽？

en: &903 Nah. I'm fine. Let's just keep moving.
zh: &903 不用了。我没事。我们继续走吧。

en: &904 You don't have to say it.
&7138 Say what?
&905 Coming here to save one person, when thousands more are about to die.
zh: &905 来这里救一个人，而明天还有成千上万的人要死去。

en: &906 It's selfish. I get it. I've made my peace with it.
zh: &906 这很自私。我明白。我已经想通了。

en: &7139 Selfish or not, we couldn't save any of those thousands even if we wanted to.
zh: &7139 自私与否，就算我们想，也救不了那成千上万的人。

en: &907 And do you want to?
&7140 What I want doesn't matter, Hanna.
zh: &7140 我想什么并不重要，汉娜。

en: &7141 I'm here for you. Not for me.
zh: &7141 我来这里是为了你，不是为了我自己。

en: &908 I'm curious. How many times have you been asked to save someone from the attack tomorrow?
zh: &908 我很好奇。有多少次别人请求你从明天的袭击中救人？

en: &1827 That's classified.
&909 So. A lot.
&910 You never said yes? Not once?
zh: &910 你从没答应过？一次都没有？

en: &7142 Never. If we opened up THAT door, Ground Zero would be flooded with time travelers.
zh: &7142 从来没有。如果我们打开那扇门，归零地就会被时间旅行者淹没。

en: &911 But the day BEFORE is okay?
&1828 There's a risk, but within parameters. We've taken precautions.
zh: &1828 有风险，但在参数范围内。我们采取了预防措施。

en: &912 Precautions like doubling my security deposit.
&1829 That was one of them.
So I finally did it. I finally went to Windows on the World.
zh: 所以我终于做到了。我终于去了世界之窗餐厅。

en: &7143 You never went before?
No. I always meant to. Figured I would go there one day.
zh: 没有。我一直想去。总想着有一天会去。

en: Always thought there'd be time. Until there wasn't.
zh: 总以为还有时间。直到时间没了。

en: &4305 Duffy used to take nostalgia tourists here, didn't he?
zh: &4305 达菲以前常带怀旧游客来这里，对吧？

en: &1542 All the time.
&1543 Ever since the park was sold to Seagram Corp, it's a pretty popular request.
zh: &1543 自从公园被卖给西格拉姆公司后，这就成了很受欢迎的请求。

en: &4306 He always did manage to snag the choice assignments. Perks of seniority.
zh: &4306 他总是能抢到最好的任务。资历的好处。

en: &1544 Were you... upset about that? I never realized.
zh: &1544 你……对此不高兴吗？我从没意识到。

en: &4307 Oh no. No. I never held it against him.
&4308 It's just ironic that the first time I get a job here, it's all closed down.
zh: &4308 只是很讽刺，我第一次接到这里的任务，这里却已经关闭了。

en: &1545 Probably for the best.
&4309 I know. Distractions.
&1546 Right. Standing by.
&1547 Where, exactly, are you going?
&1548 Is your plan to just wander around until you bump into Otis Knox?
zh: &1548 你的计划就是四处闲逛，直到撞见奥蒂斯·诺克斯吗？

en: &4310 No idea.
&4311 I don't have any better ideas at the moment.
zh: &4311 我目前没有更好的主意。

en: &1549 Honestly? Neither do I. All right. I'll leave you to it.
zh: &1549 说实话？我也没有。好吧，我不打扰你了。

en: &8036 Nozzo?
&6076 Yeah?
&4958 Let's say I find this Adam Cole. And let's say he DID muck around with Otis Knox's past.
zh: &4958 假设我找到这个亚当·科尔。再假设他确实篡改了奥蒂斯·诺克斯的过去。

en: &4959 What... should we do?
&1550 We deal with him. However you can.
zh: &1550 我们对付他。用你能用的任何手段。

en: &4960 Right. Right. I thought as much.
&4961 Nozzo? What about Otis Knox's high timeline impact ranking?
zh: &4961 诺佐？奥蒂斯·诺克斯的时间线影响评级很高，这怎么办？

en: &4962 If this Adam Cole altered Otis's life, and we alter ADAM'S life...
zh: &4962 如果这个亚当·科尔改变了奥蒂斯的人生，而我们又去改变亚当的人生……

en: &4963 This could alter Otis Knox's history, couldn't it? Something we should never ever do?
zh: &4963 这可能会改变奥蒂斯·诺克斯的历史，对吧？我们绝对不该做的事？

en: &4964 "The rankings must be maintained" and all?
&1552 *Sigh* Nothing's ever easy, is it?
zh: &1552 *叹气* 事情从来都不简单，对吧？

en: &1553 Figure out what happened. Only then can we decide what to do about it.
zh: &1553 先弄清楚发生了什么。然后我们才能决定怎么办。

en: &4965 One step at a time?
&1554 That's all we can do.
Ground level travel select screen!
&340 Hello? Fia? Blast it I hate this thing...
zh: &340 喂？菲娅？该死，我讨厌这东西……

en: &7165 Imani?
&341 THERE you are. Mr. Nozzarelli patched me in.
zh: &341 你在这儿啊。诺扎雷利先生帮我接进来了。

en: &342 He said you wouldn't mind?
&4966 It's fine. I've already got one pair of eyes on me at all times. One more won't matter.
zh: &4966 没事。我已经时刻被一双眼睛盯着了。再多一双也无所谓。

en: &343 Thank you. If I can't be there, at least I get to watch.
zh: &343 谢谢。虽然我去不了，至少还能看着。

en: &344 Anyway, carry on. Pretend I'm not here. Don't do anything I wouldn't.
zh: &344 总之，继续吧。就当我不在。别做我不会做的事。

en: &345 Although I won't complain if you do.
zh: &345 不过如果你做了，我也不会抱怨。

en: Click an icon above to move to a new area
zh: 点击上方图标移动到新区域

en: &439 Hey, slow down.
&1848 Sorry. I was just thinking.
&1849 We have learned quite a lot, we just lack the context to put it together.
zh: &1849 我们已经了解了很多，只是缺少把它们联系起来的背景。

en: &440 Context? What do you mean, context?
&1850 Often things don't make sense until after the fact.
zh: &1850 事情往往在事后才说得通。

en: &1851 But we are currently... before the fact.
&1852 Nozzo? This direct tunnel you created. Is it still active?
zh: &1852 诺佐？你创建的那条直达隧道。它还在运行吗？

en: &459 Yeah. It'll be stable for a few more hours. Why?
zh: &459 是的。它还能稳定几个小时。怎么了？

en: &1853 So we use the tunnel to travel forward again to October?
zh: &1853 所以我们可以用隧道再次前往十月份？

en: &460 The biggest expense was putting it together. Traversing it barely uses any power at all.
zh: &460 最大的开销是搭建它。穿越它几乎不耗电。

en: &461 So... sure. You can use the tunnel whenever you want. It won't even cost the client anything.
zh: &461 所以……当然。你随时可以用隧道。甚至不会让客户多花一分钱。

en: &441 I'd pay whatever it takes, either way.
zh: &441 无论如何，我愿意付出任何代价。

en: &462 Just head to the landing point whenever you want to go.
zh: &462 你想去的时候，直接去跃迁落点就行。

en: &442 You are thinking what I'm thinking, right?
&6098 That Paula's death in the woods was the tipping point that sent Simon on his path to destruction?
zh: &6098 葆拉死在树林里是压垮西蒙、让他走向毁灭的转折点？

en: &443 Yeah.
&6099 I do. Nozzo?
&1188 There's no record of a "Paula Inman" anywhere in the archive, but I took the liberty of plugging her into a prediction model.
zh: &1188 档案里没有任何“葆拉·英曼”的记录，但我自作主张把她输入了预测模型。

en: &1189 Gimme one second to simulate her death in April of 1871...
zh: &1189 给我一秒钟模拟她1871年4月的死亡……

en: &1190 And... yes. There's a 92% chance you're right. Barring any other factors we don't know about.
zh: &1190 而且……是的。你有 92% 的几率是对的。除非还有我们不知道的其他因素。

en: &444 Right. Good. That's something.
&445 Something to focus on, anyway.
zh: &445 至少有了可以专注的方向。

en: Explaining the world's mechanics
&2842 Gah. That socket. Should've shot him when I had the chance.
zh: &2842 啧。那个混蛋。刚才有机会就该毙了他。

en: &2843 Nozzo? What am I doing all the way back HERE?
zh: &2843 诺佐？我怎么回到这么早的时点了？

en: &672 It's as far back as the rewind protocol could send you.
zh: &672 这是回溯协议能把你送回的最早时点。

en: &673 Chloe is still alive right now. But she dies in... 3 minutes, 37 seconds.
zh: &673 克洛伊现在还没死。但她会在……3分37秒后死亡。

en: &2844 What? I'll never make it there in time!
zh: &2844 什么？我根本来不及赶到那里！

en: &674 I'll contact her. I'll help her get through it.
zh: &674 我会联系她。我会帮她撑过去。

en: &675 I don't know. I'll think of something.
&676 You just focus on getting there as fast as you can. Okay?
zh: &676 你只管尽快赶到那里。好吗？

en: &2846 Better start running.
&1857 What happened? Why didn't my weapon fire?
zh: &1857 怎么回事？我的武器为什么没开火？

en: &463 It detected Eddie Inman's timeline impact ranking.
zh: &463 它检测到了埃迪·英曼的时间线影响评级。

en: &464 It won't fire if the target is ranked "Medium" or above.
zh: &464 如果目标评级为“中”或以上，它就不会开火。

en: &1858 I used the stun setting! I wasn't going to kill him!
zh: &1858 我用的眩晕模式！我没打算杀他！

en: &1859 Fine. I won't use the kill setting next time.
zh: &1859 行。下次我不用击杀模式。

en: &465 It doesn't matter. It just locks down. Safety protocols.
zh: &465 那没用。它直接锁死了。安全协议。

en: &1860 What a terrible design flaw.
&466 Your feedback is noted...
&677 You holding up all right?
&2874 For someone who has died several times today, just dandy.
zh: &2874 对一个今天已经死了好几次的人来说，好极了。

en: &2034 And here I am again.
&2849 Just smashing, thanks.
Let's never speak of this again.
zh: 这件事我们永远别再提了。

en: &3621 Did you hear all that, Nozzo?
&1195 Yeah I heard.
&3622 Are we in the right place?
&1196 Double-checking right now.
&1197 Yeah. There it is. Hanna Tanaka. Scheduled for release on November 10th, 2001.
zh: &1197 没错。找到了。汉娜·田中。预定于2001年11月10日获释。

en: &3623 I assume you heard all that, Nozzo?
&1198 Yeah. Hanna's been paradoxed.
&6021 Blast it.
&4312 Any changes yet, Nozzo?
&1199 Unclear. The ripples haven't settled yet.
zh: &1199 还不清楚。涟漪还没平息。

en: &1200 Everything's still in flux. I'll keep monitoring.
zh: &1200 一切仍在变动中。我会继续监控。

en: &1201 Just keep her away from Hanna.
&4313 I'll... do my best.
&1202 I'm sure you will.
&368 Hey. Ever see Washington Square Park this time of night?
zh: &368 嘿。见过这个时段的华盛顿广场公园吗？

en: &369 We can cut right through. It's just over this way.
zh: &369 我们可以直接穿过去。就在这边。

en: &1555 Well. Blast it.
&4314 How is this possible?
&6047 I... have no idea.
&1556 Otis Knox's history couldn't have changed. We'd know.
zh: &1556 奥蒂斯·诺克斯的历史不可能改变。我们会知道的。

en: &1557 High-ranked person like him? Alarms would go off in every branch on the planet.
zh: &1557 像他这种高评级的人？全球每个分部的警报都会响。

en: &4315 So what should we do? Scrub the mission?
zh: &4315 那我们该怎么办？取消任务？

en: &1558 No. We're not licked yet. According to all reports, Otis went missing during the fireworks.
zh: &1558 不。我们还没输。根据所有报告，奥蒂斯是在烟花表演期间失踪的。

en: &1559 Those aren't due to start for another hour or so. We still have time.
zh: &1559 烟花还要一个小时左右才开始。我们还有时间。

en: &1560 I got the Knox's home address from Nathan.
zh: &1560 我从内森那里拿到了诺克斯家的地址。

en: &1561 Maybe he's home? If he is, standard protocols apply.
zh: &1561 也许他在家？如果在，就按标准协议行事。

en: &4316 I know. Keep my distance. Don't engage. Etcetera.
zh: &4316 我知道。保持距离。不接触。等等。

en: New Location:[Knox Residence
&4967 Sounds like Otis Knox had a real change of heart when Marla left him.
zh: &4967 听起来玛拉离开后，奥蒂斯·诺克斯真的回心转意了。

en: &4968 A real epiphany moment.
&1562 Could be. There's nothing about it in the archive.
zh: &1562 有可能。档案里没有任何相关记载。

en: &1563 Nothing much about his personal life at all, come to think of it.
zh: &1563 仔细想想，关于他私生活的记载也几乎没有。

en: &6075 I wonder...
&234 Go ahead and say it.
&4319 I wasn't going to say anything.
&235 You still can't lie worth a damn.
&236 Gonna miss that big lug.
&237 Would you believe that in the original history, Otis forced Liam to hold a book signing today?
zh: &237 你信吗，在原本的历史里，奥蒂斯今天强迫利亚姆办签售会？

en: &238 On the Fourth of July, for God's sake. At least I managed to spare him that indignity.
zh: &238 还是在七月四日，天哪。至少我让他免于那种羞辱了。

en: &239 Such a trip, that lady. Cooks an amazing roast. She says it's the herbs.
zh: &239 那位女士真有意思。烤肉做得棒极了。她说是香草的功劳。

en: &240 Giving her a signed copy of my last book was the least I could do in return.
zh: &240 送她一本我上一本书的签名版，是我能回报的最起码的事。

en: &4969 How long have I got, Nozzo?
&1564 Twenty or thirty minutes, give or take.
&1565 The landing point is five minutes away. You have time.
zh: &1565 跃迁落点离这里五分钟路程。你有时间。

en: &1566 I've got the antidote ready to go. I'll administer it as soon as you arrive.
zh: &1566 解药我已经准备好了。你一到我就给你注射。

en: &1567 Fia? You're not exactly hurrying.

zh: 一条小路通往跃迁落点。

en: A topiary sculpted into something hideous.
zh: 一丛修剪成丑陋形状的灌木。

en: You'd prefer not to look at this too closely.
The topiary is clean. So much for leaving your mark.
zh: 灌木很干净。想留下痕迹可没那么容易。

en: The evidence of your crime has returned. You avert your eyes.
zh: 你犯罪的证据又回来了。你移开视线。

en: The topiary is currently blissfully unaware of the fate that awaits it.
zh: 这丛灌木目前还浑然不知等待它的命运。

en: Your chronausea-induced leavings have returned. You feel no reason to look closely.
zh: 你因时序晕留下的呕吐物又回来了。你觉得没必要仔细看。

en: &1000 Error. Duplicate ID in use.
Enter room 60 first time after
&95 Huh?
&96 Let's try that again.
&98 Figures.
&831 Okay. Triangulating new jumping point...
zh: &831 好的。正在三角定位新的跃迁点……

en: &832 Blast it. Cameras are EVERYWHERE in 2042. Just stand by, Fia. This make take some time.
zh: &832 该死。2042年到处都是摄像头。菲娅，先等着。这可能需要一些时间。

en: &751 Fia? Are you reading me?
&752 Blast it. The chrovergence must be causing interference...
zh: &752 该死。时空汇聚一定造成了干扰……

en: &3092 No, Noz. I can hear you just fine.
&3093 I was just wondering...
&753 What?
&3094 How many agencies can claim to have completed a Chrovergence mission?
zh: &3094 有多少机构能声称完成过时空汇聚任务？

en: &754 Er, two so far, but...
&3095 Well. How'd you like to become the third?
zh: &3095 那么，你想成为第三个吗？

en: &755 You can't be serious.
&3096 Think about it, Noz.
&3097 How often do time travellers like us get to do something that will be remembered?
zh: &3097 像我们这样的时间旅行者，有多少机会能做一件会被铭记的事？

en: &3098 Like, really remembered. Not something that will disappear a few chronoshifts later?
zh: &3098 真正被铭记，而不是几次时空改写后就消失的事？

en: &756 Er. Not often at all.
&757 What brought this on?
&3099 Are you in or are you out?
zh: &3099 你到底加入还是不加入？

en: &758 You really think we can manage it?
zh: &758 你真的觉得我们能办到？

en: &3100 I just have to hide from myself, right?
zh: &3100 我只需要躲开我自己，对吧？

en: &3101 How hard could THAT be?
&759 Okay. Okay!
&760 We're doing this. We're doing a Chrovergence.
zh: &760 我们干吧。我们来一次时空汇聚。

en: &761 This is crazy. Duffy would love it.
zh: &761 这太疯狂了。达菲会喜欢的。

en: &3102 I know, Noz.
&3103 Stand by. I'm off to avoid myself.
zh: &3103 等着。我去躲开我自己了。

en: She's a loose cannon.
zh: 她是个我行我素的家伙。

en: &4402 Benjamin Pasamon. A pleasure to see you.
zh: &4402 本杰明·帕萨蒙。很高兴见到你。

en: &196 Er. Sorry?
&197 Have we met?
&4403 Not at all. I'm the temp you ordered.
zh: &4403 没有。我是你叫来的临时工。

en: &198 So Cassie went through with it, huh?
zh: &198 所以卡西还是这么做了，哈？

en: &199 Did the agency give you an access card? Sorry. I gotta check. Security and all.
zh: &199 机构给你门禁卡了吗？抱歉，我得检查一下。安全规定什么的。

en: &200 Ah! Well. Welcome to mi casa!
zh: &200 啊！好。欢迎来到我的地盘！

en: &201 Lemme show you the ropes.
&202 You just scan your card like this...
&203 ...and voila!
&4404 Amazing.
&204 Come on in. I'll give you the tour.
zh: &204 进来吧。我带你参观一下。

en: &1606 Heh. That's ironic.
&7088 What?
&1607 CassaNetics was given a high timeline impact ranking.
zh: &1607 卡萨奈蒂克斯被评了很高的时间线影响评级。

en: &7099 Really.
&1608 We couldn't change it anymore even if we wanted to.
zh: &1608 就算我们想改也改不了了。

en: &4405 Good for Cassie, I suppose.
zh: &4405 我想对卡西来说是好事。

en: &4406 Must feel nice, knowing that her legacy won't just disappear.
zh: &4406 知道她的遗产不会就这么消失，感觉一定很好。

en: &1609 Not that she'd know if it did.
zh: &1609 不过就算消失了，她也不会知道。

en: &1610 Is... something wrong?
&4407 Nothing. Almost at the landing point.
zh: &4407 没什么。快到跃迁落点了。

en: cassie loop 4 post-load
&215 Yes. Thank you. Thank you!
&216 See you soon, Mr. Rockcamp.
&217 Oh. There you are. I thought you left.
zh: &217 哦。你在这儿。我以为你走了。

en: Outside Leaves, 2042
&3107 Hm. Not sure why I expected that to work for me when it didn't work for that other fellow.
zh: &3107 嗯。不知道为什么我会指望它对我有用，明明对那个家伙都没用。

en: &3108 Nozzo, I...
&7054 Gurgh.
&3109 Oh my God.
&3111 Oh my bloody God.
&6011 You okay?
&3112 I'm fine. Just a bit...
&7055 Oh blast it.
Making vomit noises accurately.
&3113 How's that, Imani? Talk about leaving your mark...
zh: &3113 怎么样，伊曼妮？这算是留下你的印记了……

en: &792 Are you SURE you're okay?
&3114 I'm fine. Just feels like a touch of chronausea.
zh: &3114 我没事。只是有点像时序晕。

en: &793 Chronausea? That should only happen to...
zh: &793 时序晕？那应该只发生在……

en: &3115 To first year trainees. I know.
zh: &3115 一年级实习生身上。我知道。

en: &3116 You won't tell anyone, will you?
zh: &3116 你不会告诉别人的，对吧？

en: &794 I won't, but you HAVE been putting in a lot of extra work lately.
zh: &794 我不会，但你最近确实加班太多了。

en: &3117 Until Duffy's replaced, what else can we do?
zh: &3117 在达菲被替换之前，我们还能怎么办？

en: &795 I'll tell the brass to send us fewer clients. They'll understand.
zh: &795 我会告诉公司高层少派些客户给我们。他们会理解的。

en: &3118 Don't you dare.
&3119 I can handle it.
&3120 I just need to get that door open...
&3122 Totally handled.
&796 Okay. If you want to pull out, let me know. I'll be here.
zh: &796 好吧。如果你想退出，告诉我。我会在这里。

en: &7058 I know.
&3123 I admit, aborting a mission like this just RANKLES.
zh: &3123 我承认，像这样中止任务真让人恼火。

en: &3124 But rules are rules.
&5196 No. I'm done here. I should head back.
zh: &5196 不。我在这里的事做完了。我该回去了。

en: &205 Er. How did you...
&3125 Hello! Perfect timing.
&3126 Hold the door, please.
&3106 It's unresponsive.
&99 Told ya. You need a card.
zh: &99 早跟你说了。你需要一张卡。

en: &3127 I don't need to search through the bushes.
&3128 I already know what's in there. And I have no desire to touch it.
zh: &3128 我已经知道里面是什么了。而且我一点也不想碰。

en: &3129 A good example of the "Geocities Chic" style. Quite popular in this time period.
zh: &3129 “Geocities 时尚”风格的一个好例子。在这个时代相当流行。

Conveyor
presentation test

&186 Now if my nerd in shining armor here can get this drone working again...
zh: &186 现在，要是我这位身穿闪亮盔甲的呆子能让这架无人机重新动起来……

en: &206 I don't see what the big deal is, Madison.
zh: &206 我不明白这有什么大不了的，麦迪逊。

en: &207 Can't we manage with just the one?
zh: &207 我们就不能只用这一架吗？

en: You can't sell steak without sizzle, Benji.
zh: 没有咝咝声就卖不出牛排，本吉。

en: Or in this case, the salad without dressing.
zh: 或者在这个情况下，没有调料的沙拉。

en: This drone is inert and lifeless.
zh: 这架无人机毫无生气，一动不动。

en: Rhiannon is well trained.
This is so dumb and I love it.
Hard continents.
This is canon now.
I'm so glad to have contributed to this moment.
zh: 我很高兴能为这一刻做出贡献。

en: Benji looks at motor.
This hover-drone zips back and forth between the conference table and the vertical farm.
zh: 这架悬浮无人机在会议桌和垂直农场之间来回穿梭。

en: This drone lies inertly on the conference table.
zh: 这架无人机一动不动地躺在会议桌上。

en: This drone is active but idle. It hums quietly.
zh: 这架无人机处于待机状态，发出轻微的嗡嗡声。

en: The drone hovers eagerly near Madison, ready to dispense dressing.
zh: 无人机急切地在麦迪逊身边盘旋，准备分发调料。

en: A small opening has been cut out of the observation window.
zh: 观察窗上被切开了一个小口。

en: Stairs lead back down to the reception area.
zh: 楼梯向下通往前台区域。

en: Another automatic door. This one is labelled "Workshop."
zh: 另一扇自动门。这扇门上标着“工作间”。

en: A crystal-clear glass window looks out onto the vertical farm below.
zh: 一扇晶莹剔透的玻璃窗俯瞰着下方的垂直农场。

en: &187 Come on, MOVE!
&188 What's wrong with this thing?
&189 Breaking down today, of all days...
&208 Just relax, will you? The cavalry's here.
&190 Cavalry?
&191 Oh. The new temp.
&209 Her name's FIA.
&3130 Er. Yes. That's me. Word travels fast.
zh: &3130 呃。对。就是我。消息传得真快。

en: &3131 I was told to give these leaflets to you?
zh: &3131 有人叫我把这些传单给你？

en: &192 Careful! Those are still wet.
&193 Just... hold onto those for a bit, would you?
zh: &193 就……先帮我拿一会儿，行吗？

en: &210 Wow. Madison certainly did a number on this thing!
zh: &210 哇。麦迪逊可把这东西折腾得不轻！

en: &211 I don't have time to fix it. I'll just...
&212 System! Engage solo-drone program!
zh: &212 系统！启动单机无人机程序！

en: &1003 Solo drone program engaged.
zh: &1003 单机无人机程序已启动。

en: &213 Cool, right?
&214 Er... something wrong with the word cool?
zh: &214 呃……“酷”这个字有什么问题吗？

en: &101 I mean, not if you're 80.
zh: &101 我是说，如果你不是80岁的话。

en: &215 Er. Right.
&216 Anyway. My workshop's in here.
zh: &216 总之。我的工作间在这里面。

en: loop 2 complete!
&1611 Looks like you did it, Fia.
&1612 I'm watching a clip of the presentation. It chrono-shifted right in front of me.
zh: &1612 我正在看演示的片段。它就在我眼前时空改写了。

en: &1613 It appears that both Madison Bates and Benjamin Pasamon gave the presentation together.
zh: &1613 看起来麦迪逊·贝茨和本杰明·帕萨蒙是一起做的演示。

en: &4408 And they still got their funding?
&1614 Yes they did. The company is still called "Leaves" to this day.
zh: &1614 是的。那家公司至今还叫“叶子”。

en: &4409 I suppose neither of them could agree on a new name.
zh: &4409 我猜他们俩谁也没法就新名字达成一致。

en: &1615 Anyway, head back to the landing point. I'll pull you home.
zh: &1615 总之，回到跃迁落点。我拉你回家。

en: &4410 Huh. I did it.
&4411 Although you think he'd be a bit happier about it.
zh: &4411 不过你会觉得他应该更高兴一点才对。

en: Conference Room
&3136 I'd better stay put.
&1007 Warning. PasaGel prototype not permitted to leave the area. Please return it to the workshop.
zh: &1007 警告。帕萨凝胶原型不得离开该区域。请将其送回工作间。

en: &194 Leaving already? Not a good look.
zh: &194 这就要走了？可不太好看。

en: &217 Hooold on!
&218 Just stay here for now, wontcha?
&219 You'll get the grand tour soon enough!
I can't get it open.
&195 Neither can I! Not that I would know what to do if I could.
zh: &195 我也打不开！就算能打开，我也不知道该怎么办。

en: &196 Why Benji made that thing so hard to get open I'll never know.
zh: &196 本吉为什么把那东西做得那么难打开，我永远也搞不懂。

en: The coat goes backwards on the conveyor. Disappearing into the panel.
zh: 外套在传送带上向后移动，消失在面板中。

en: We see the coat behind the window, going down to the ground level of the vertical farm.
zh: 我们看到外套在窗户后面，正往垂直农场的地面层下降。

en: Cutscene: Madison is in the farm. Feeling annoyed and trying to wipe off the dressing. The coat appears into view. She is confused, but takes it and puts it on. She looks visibly relieved.
zh: 过场：麦迪逊在农场里，感到烦躁，试图擦掉酱汁。外套出现在视野中。她感到困惑，但还是接过外套穿上。她明显松了一口气。

en: Confirmation that you were successful. Madison and Benji deliver the presentation together.
zh: 确认你成功了。麦迪逊和本吉一起完成了演示。

en: The conveyor goes in reverse for a while. Then you stop it.
zh: 传送带倒转了一会儿，然后你停了下来。

en: &197 Really? Incredible.
&198 I'll be sure to tell the agency what a great job you're doing.
zh: &198 我一定会告诉公司你们干得有多出色。

en: &199 Get this thing working and I'll tell them you're worth your weight in gold.
zh: &199 把这东西修好，我会告诉他们你价值千金。

en: Puts the coat on the conveyor.
*BEEP*
&220 You might have seen vertical farms before, and you might have seen drone delivery before, BUT...
zh: &220 你可能见过垂直农场，也可能见过无人机送货，但是……

en: &221 ...we've positioned ourselves at the vanguard of the zeitgeist by... combining them!
zh: &221 ……我们通过将它们结合起来，让自己站在了时代潮流的最前沿！

en: &222 Within moments, your bespoke salad order is picked, packed and off into the wide blue yonder.
zh: &222 片刻之间，你定制的沙拉订单就被采摘、打包，然后飞向广阔的蓝天。

en: &224 Madison acts like this is so hard. This is easy.
zh: &224 麦迪逊表现得好像这很难。这很简单。

en: &225 Oh. I'm sorry. Is this boring?
&102 No, but you seem busy. Maybe I should go?
zh: &102 不，但你看起来很忙。也许我该走了？

en: &226 No! Er, I mean. You don't have to do that...

en: &798 It's my fault. I'm sorry.
&799 You were supposed to land 15 minutes after you left, but setting jump points so close together is tricky and...
zh: &799 你本该在离开后15分钟落地，但把跃迁点设得这么近很棘手，而且……

&3154 So I met myself, and I melted.

zh: &3175 我已经打算动它了，不该再多折腾。

en: &3176 I need to get rid of this trash before doing anything else. Blech.
zh: &3176 我得先把这垃圾处理掉，再干别的。呕。

en: &4994 I don't have time to mess about with that. I need to hide.
zh: &4994 我没时间瞎折腾那个。我得躲起来。

en: &3177 I don't see the point in putting anything on TOP of the bin.
zh: &3177 我觉得把东西放在垃圾桶上面没有任何意义。

en: &3178 There doesn't seem to be a way to open it with my bare hands.
zh: &3178 光靠双手好像打不开它。

en: &3179 I think I've carried enough trash for one day.
zh: &3179 我觉得今天搬的垃圾已经够多了。

zh: &3180 我记得这些老式储物柜。是声控的那种，对吧？

zh: &1263 声控密码，没错。因为显而易见的原因，它们没在市场上卖多久。

en: &4418 Right. Well, let's see...
&4419 There's nothing for me in there anymore.
zh: &4419 那里面已经没有我要的东西了。

en: &3181 That's way too small for me to fit inside.
&3182 This must be what Benji wanted.
zh: &3182 这一定就是本吉想要的东西。

zh: &3183 垃圾桶倒了，但盖子显然打不开。

en: &3184 I should focus on the chute that was underneath.
zh: &3184 我应该把注意力放在下面的滑槽上。

en: &4420 I've seen more of that trash bin than I ever want to.
zh: &4420 那个垃圾桶我已经看够了，再也不想看了。

zh: &222 好，那你正是我想找的人！

en: &223 I'm at a start-up! I know, I know. Such a throwback.
zh: &223 我在一家初创公司！我知道，我知道。太复古了。

zh: &226 信不信由你，是送餐服务。没错！

zh: &227 我知道这个请求有点过分，但你能不能跟她谈谈……

zh: 一个带正经把手的抽屉。真够古雅的。

en: An automatic door leading back to reception.
zh: 一扇自动门，通往接待处。

zh: 你不认识这幅画，但你看得出它是用“乌尔丁式”AI算法生成的。

en: You couldn't begin to understand what any of this means. Nor do you need to.
zh: 你完全搞不懂这些是什么意思。你也不需要懂。

en: &264 Oh hey.
&265 Getting too much for you out there?
&3185 Too much of something, I'll say that much.
zh: &3185 东西太多了，我只能这么说。

en: &266 Tell me about it.
&267 Feel free to use my sanctum if you need a bit of peace.
zh: &267 需要清静的话，尽管用我的密室。

en: &268 Just don't linger too long, okay?
&269 Anyway, I have to take this.
Perfect. Now do it again!
You're welcome, Cassie.
Foreground Pipes
&239 Waste not want not.
A balancing act.
An overstep for a temp.
zh: 对一个临时工来说，这有点越界了。

en: The things I have to do for this job.
zh: 为了这份工作，我不得不做的事。

en: It's always me!
Can I say jumper?
A maintenance panel. It probably controls the settings for the vertical farm.
zh: 一块维护面板。很可能控制着垂直农场的各项设置。

en: The door leading back to reception.
&240 Show some INITIATIVE.
&267 And here it is! The beating heart of Leaves: our Vertical Farm.
zh: &267 就是这里！“叶子”跳动的心脏：我们的垂直农场。

en: &268 What you're looking at isn't just plants, it's going to revolutionize food production, delivery, everything.
zh: &268 你们看到的不仅仅是植物，它将彻底改变食品生产、配送，所有一切。

en: &269 Anyway. Once we get Leaves funded, we are on the gravy train.
zh: &269 总之，一旦“叶子”拿到资金，我们就发达了。

en: &270 Then who knows what we can achieve here?
zh: &270 到那时，谁知道我们能在这里取得什么成就？

en: &271 Oh. That reminds me. I left my electro-magnet in the break area. Could you get it for me?
zh: &271 哦，这倒提醒我了。我把电磁铁落在休息区了。你能帮我拿一下吗？

en: &272 It's on the table in the middle of the room. You can't miss it.
zh: &272 就在房间中央的桌子上。你肯定能找到。

en: &273 Thanks so much!
&3186 There goes the drone.
&3187 And any moment, Madison Bates will...
&7084 Oh blast it.
&241 How did you get in here?
&242 Oh forget it. I don't care. Get out.
&243 Well? I said get out!
&3188 All clear, Noz?
&805 Both your previous selves are gone. The coast is clear.
zh: &805 你之前的两个自己都走了。安全了。

en: &3189 Well. That's a relief.
&274 Don't touch that!
&275 Sorry. We've got the settings just perfect. We don't want to tamper with perfection.
zh: &275 抱歉。我们把设置调得刚刚好。我们可不想破坏完美。

en: &244 Leave that alone, please?
&3190 Hm. Looks like all the vertical farm's systems can be controlled from here.
zh: &3190 嗯。看起来垂直农场的所有系统都能从这里控制。

en: &4421 I should leave it alone. I don't want to wake her up.
zh: &4421 我应该别去动它。我不想吵醒她。

en: Lid
Chute panel
This flat piece of metal is all that lies between you and discovery.
zh: 这块扁平金属片是你和暴露之间唯一的屏障。

en: This rag is covered in who-knows-what. No wonder it was discarded.
zh: 这块抹布沾满了不知什么东西。难怪被扔掉了。

en: You shoved the rag into the tube's opening.
zh: 你把抹布塞进了管道口。

en: This panel is held in place by four large screws.
zh: 这块面板由四颗大螺丝固定。

en: Your inability to lift your own body weight is the only thing preventing your discovery.
zh: 你无法抬起自己的体重，这是阻止你暴露的唯一原因。

en: &3191 That would be a very bad idea.
zh: &3191 那会是个非常糟糕的主意。

en: The lid is held down tight by the high-powered magnet, which is in turn held down tight by you.
zh: 盖子被强力磁铁紧紧吸住，而磁铁又被你紧紧压住。

en: URG. Doesn't move an inch.
Come ON! *Sigh* Nothing.
UUUURG.
The bin is unhurt, although I can't say the same for my foot
zh: 垃圾桶没事，但我的脚可不敢说没事。

en: Urf. The bin won't budge.
What's with this thing!
The bin is unmoved.
&2319 Ow. Hurt her hand most likely.
zh: &2319 哎哟。很可能伤到她的手了。

en: chute panel open!
&1012 INCENDIARY DEVICE DEPLOYED.
&3193 A what device?
&3194 Oh bla-
&3195 I can't open that with my bare hands.
&3196 All I see is an empty tube leading into the wall.
zh: &3196 我只看到一根空管子通进墙里。

en: The panel is now open. You can see the tube inside.
zh: 面板现在打开了。你能看到里面的管道。

en: &3198 The panel is closed tight.
An old rag is now stuffed inside the tube.
zh: 一块旧抹布现在塞在管道里。

en: &3199 It doesn't look like it opens by hand.
&5042 I'd better leave it alone.
Gun
Drawer handle
Memstick
Sally doing a Nozzo impression.
My joy is your terror.
zh: 我的快乐就是你的恐惧。

en: You don't know much about weapons, but this one looks clean and well-cared for.
zh: 你对武器了解不多，但这把看起来干净且保养得很好。

en: This looks like a W.E.G. Smart Gun. An early precursor to the weapon you now carry.
zh: 这看起来像一把W.E.G.智能枪。是你现在所持武器的早期前身。

en: A small label on this memstick reads "PU1S3B14ST virus - BE CAREFUL!"
zh: 这个记忆棒上有个小标签写着“PU1S3B14ST 病毒——小心！”

en: This sheet of paper is blank.
&3200 I already have a weapon. I see no reason to take this one.
zh: &3200 我已经有武器了。没必要拿这把。

en: Room changes: %d
Diner door
ToDorm
Oil puddle
Newspaper
Board
Air conditioner
A sign on the door reads "CLOSED FOR SPRING BREAK."
zh: 门上有个牌子写着“春假期间关闭。”

en: A small puddle of lubricant is forming under the A/C unit.
zh: 空调下面正在形成一小滩润滑油。

en: The newspaper box is empty and long-abandoned. One of print media's last gasps.
zh: 报箱空空如也，早已废弃。这是印刷媒体最后的喘息之一。

en: "Free food. Naked servers. False advertising."
zh: “免费食物。裸体服务员。虚假广告。”

en: A groaning A/C unit drips lubricant onto the sidewalk. Better watch your step.
zh: 一台呻吟的空调滴着润滑油到人行道上。最好小心脚下。

en: The door to the diner is warm and inviting.
A wrought-iron fence blocks your way into a garbage-strewn alley.
zh: 一道锻铁栅栏挡住了你进入一条垃圾遍地的小巷。

en: The busy street of Broadway leads into East Village neighborhood.
zh: 百老汇繁忙的街道通向东村社区。

en: An empty cardboard box lies abandoned on the street.
zh: 一个空纸箱被遗弃在街上。

en: Ask a British person...
What're you asking me for?
Not a British jewish thing.
What I would do with a time machine.
zh: 我会用时间机器做什么。

en: Naming Nozzo and Fia.
Lip syncing and thank you Daniel Wolf!
zh: 对口型，谢谢丹尼尔·沃尔夫！

en: &158 Um. Where are you going?
&159 The Silver Flare is right here. Are we going in or what?
zh: &159 银焰餐厅就在这儿。我们进去还是怎样？

en: &467 I'm telling you, Fia. He's still in the alley!
zh: &467 我告诉你，菲娅。他还在小巷里！

en: &1861 And I'm telling you, he's not.
&468 Well the data is showing SOMETHING there.
zh: &468 但数据显示那里有东西。

en: &469 Something that doesn't belong in that time period. So find it.
zh: &469 是不属于那个时代的东西。所以找到它。

en: &160 God. There it is. The Silver Flare.
zh: &160 天哪。就是那里。银焰餐厅。

en: &162 Jesus. Sorry.
&163 It's just a RESTAURANT. I didn't expect to...
zh: &163 这只是一家餐厅。我没想到会……

en: &1863 Don't worry. Take your time.
&164 Time, huh?
&1864 We have plenty of it. That is the benefit of time travel.
zh: &1864 我们有的是时间。这就是时间旅行的好处。

en: &165 But I don't, though. Do I?
&298 Sorry?
&166 I... was diagnosed with Skimein syndrome. Did they tell you that?
zh: &166 我……被诊断出斯基曼综合征。他们告诉过你吗？

en: &1865 Oh. I see. I'm sorry.
&1866 How long?
&167 They gave me six months. Maybe eight.
zh: &167 他们给了我六个月。也许八个月。

en: &168 That's why I wanted to see this place. One last time.
zh: &168 所以我想看看这个地方。最后一次。

en: &1867 I understand, Dr. Anderson.
&169 Dr. Anderson?
&170 Please. It's 2024. I'm 19 years old. I'm no doctor.
zh: &170 拜托。现在是2024年。我19岁。我还不是博士。

en: &171 Call me JOE.
&172 Right now? I'm just a sophomore bio-chem student.
zh: &172 现在？我只是个生物化学大二学生。

en: &300 I have my whole life ahead of me.
&173 Not to mention countless late-night study burgers from this diner.
zh: &173 更别提在这家餐厅吃过的无数个深夜学习汉堡了。

en: &174 Let's go in.
&470 Damn it. I told them our vetting process was outdated. I TOLD them.
zh: &470 该死。我告诉过他们我们的审查流程过时了。我告诉过他们。

en: &471 We should've seen this coming.
&1868 Blast it. No sign of him.
&472 I'm telling you, Fia. His PFE data says he's in the alley.
zh: &472 我告诉你，菲娅。他的PFE数据显示他在小巷里。

en: &1869 Well, your data is wrong.
&473 You know the protocols, Fia. Check anyway.
zh: &473 你知道协议的，菲娅。还是检查一下。

en: East Village
&474 Fia? Please. This is important.
&475 Just get over to the landing point. Okay?
&1870 I shouldn't enter without the client.
zh: &1870 没有客户我不应该进去。

en: &1872 There's no handle or keyhole. It must open from the other side.
zh: &1872 没有把手或钥匙孔。一定是从另一边开的。

en: &1873 I don't see how that would open the gate.
zh: &1873 我看不出那怎么能打开门。

en: New Location:[[20 St. Marks Place
&1875 Not with my bare hands, I'm not.
&1876 Now it's all mucky. Blech.
&1877 Good thing my suit is self-cleaning.
zh: &1877 幸好我的防护服能自洁。

en: &1878 This is already as oily as it's going to get.
zh: &1878 这已经油得不能再油了。

en: &5183 No need to reach all the way up there.
zh: &5183 没必要够到那么高的地方。

en: Fire escape
In a unique position to tell this story.
zh: 处于讲述这个故事的独特位置。

en: She's being sarcastic, right?
Include that in the drinking scene.
zh: 把那段加进喝酒的场景里。

en: You recognize that expression. She hasn't quite accepted where she really is. It will come, in time.
zh: 你认得那副表情。她还没完全接受自己身在何处。会接受的，只是需要时间。

en: This fire escape ladder seems to be the most efficient way off the roof.
zh: 这道消防梯似乎是离开屋顶最有效的途径。

en: The door leading into this building. Most likely locked from the inside.
zh: 通往这栋楼的门。很可能从里面锁上了。

en: For now, the towers dominate the skyline.
zh: 眼下，双子塔仍主宰着天际线。

en: Chelsea[September 10, 2001[7:04 PM
&3201 Wow. Nice choice for a landing spot.
zh: &3201 哇。跃迁落点选得真不错。

en: &835 Thanks. I had a feeling you'd like it.
zh: &835 谢谢。我就觉得你会喜欢。

en: &3202 Hm. Not bad, but it IS raining. Could you...
zh: &3202 嗯。不赖，但确实在下雨。你能不能……

en: &836 Sure. Let me adjust the settings...
&3203 Much better. Thanks.
&3204 Go on. Send her through.
&3205 Welcome to 2001, Ms. Tanaka.
&511 Sure. I'm fine.
&512 I'm always fine.
&513 So we're here?
&3206 Look behind you.
&515 Yeah. Yeah. We're here.
&516 Can't dispute evidence like that.
&517 Urgggh.
&4423 Just stand up. Nice and slow.
&518 What the hell hit me?
&4424 That's not important right now.
&4425 Do you know who I am?
&519 Huh? No. Should I?
&520 Answer my question. What am I doing here?
zh: &520 回答我的问题。我在这儿干什么？

en: &521 What the hell am I wearing?
zh: &521 我穿的到底是什么鬼东西？

en: &522 Where...
&523 Holy shit. Are those the TWIN TOWERS?
&524 I haven't seen them since...
zh: &524 我已经很久没见过它们了……

en: &525 I'm losing my mind.
&4426 It's going to be all right.
&526 All right?
&527 Nothing's been all right for a long time.
zh: &527 已经很久没有过没事了。

en: &4427 Just... brace yourself Hanna.
&4428 It will be over soon.
&4429 Well. That's done.
&4430 She get home all right, Noz?
&1264 Yeah. She's here. She's a bit... confused.
zh: &1264 嗯。她在这儿。她有点……迷糊。

en: &1265 I'm thinking she needs a cup of tea with a sedative.
zh: &1265 我觉得她需要一杯加了镇静剂的茶。

en: &1266 You good to be on your own for a few minutes?
zh: &1266 你一个人待几分钟没问题吧？

en: &4431 I'll be fine. You make sure she's taken care of.
zh: &4431 我没事。你确保她有人照顾。

en: &1267 Be back soon.
&528 So what happens now?
&1268 Well, you have two choices. Neither of them are good.
zh: &1268 你有两个选择。两个都不好。

en: &1269 First choice. We wait. Five minutes. Maybe ten.
zh: &1269 第一个选择。我们等。五分钟。也许十分钟。

en: &1270 Without a working PFE, your past will catch up to you. Or rather, your lack of it. You'll just disappear.
zh: &1270 没有正常工作的PFE，你的过去会追上你。更确切地说，是你没有过去。你会直接消失。

en: &529 I figured as much. What's the other option?
zh: &529 我猜到了。另一个选择是什么？

en: &1271 We take you home.
&530 But I don't have a home. Not anymore.
zh: &530 可我没有家。再也没有了。

en: &1272 Technically you do. If you count "prison" as home.
zh: &1272 严格来说你有。如果你把“监狱”也算作家的话。

en: &531 Prison?
&1273 What did you think was going to happen, Hanna?
&1274 It's out of my hands. I'm sorry.
zh: &1274 这已经不由我控制了。对不起。

en: &1275 The Grandfather Paradox Protocol triggered as soon as she killed her younger self.
zh: &1275 她杀死年轻自己的那一刻，祖父悖论协议就触发了。

en: &1276 The authorities were summoned. They're waiting outside. They'll take custody of you right after your Quansonic Lock procedure.
zh: &1276 当局已经被叫来了。他们就在外面等着。你的量声锁定程序一结束，他们就会接管你。

en: &532 My what?
&1277 Basically a PFE infusion. Keeps your existence and your memory intact.
zh: &1277 基本上就是注入PFE。能保住你的存在和记忆。

en: &533 So I'll remember everything? From both timelines?
zh: &533 所以我会记得一切？两条时间线的？

en: &6024 Yeah.
&534 Everything that happened. It's kept me up at night for decades.
zh: &534 发生的一切。几十年来我一直夜不能寐。

en: &535 I thought it would end. I...
&536 Can I refuse? What if I don't have the procedure?
zh: &536 我能拒绝吗？如果我不做这个程序呢？

en: &1278 You'll disappear.
&537 Jesus. What a choice.
&7146 I'm sorry, Hanna.
&538 You apologize for nothing. You hear? Nothing at all.
zh: &538 你没什么好道歉的。听到了吗？完全没有。

en: &539 I know what I did. I know why I did it. And I know it was worth it.
zh: &539 我知道我做了什么。我知道我为什么这么做。我也知道这值得。

en: &540 My life. My choice. My consequences.
zh: &540 我的人生。我的选择。我的后果。

en: &541 Jesus. Look at those towers. They just dominate the city.
zh: &541 天哪。看看那些塔。它们完全主宰了这座城市。

en: &542 They felt so ETERNAL, you know? Comforting.
zh: &542 它们感觉如此永恒，你知道吗？令人安心。

en: &918 Like... we fragile mortals could come and go, but they would still be here. Forever.
zh: &918 就像……我们这些脆弱的凡人来了又走，但它们仍会在这里。永远。

en: &543 I'd like to look at them for awhile. Could I do that?
zh: &543 我想看它们一会儿。可以吗？

en: &4433 How long do you need?
&544 Give me five minutes? Maybe ten.
zh: &544 给我五分钟？也许十分钟。

en: &4434 Sure, Hanna.
&1279 Fia? The police are still outside. I need to go deal with that.
zh: &1279 菲娅？警察还在外面。我得去处理一下。

en: &4435 Sure. I'll be fine.
&6025 Okay. Stand by, Fia. I'll be back soon.
zh: &6025 好。待命，菲娅。我很快回来。

en: &3207 I'd better check on the client. Her mind seems a bit... occupied.
zh: &3207 我最好去看看客户。她的思绪似乎有点……被占据了。

en: &3208 Do you need help getting down?
&545 I guarantee I've climbed up and down more fire escapes than you.
zh: &545 我保证我爬过的消防梯比你多。

en: &546 Outta my way. Let me go first.
&4436 It's locked from the inside. Just as well. The fire escape is less conspicuous, anyway.
zh: &4436 门从里面锁上了。也好。反正消防梯更不显眼。

en: I wouldn't do that to you, man!
zh: 我不会那样对你的，伙计！

en: Hanna Tanaka stands here, drenched by rain and over sixty years of memories.
zh: 汉娜·田中站在这里，浑身被雨水淋透，也浸透着六十多年的记忆。

en: The door to the Lozzotti's basement flat.
zh: 通往洛佐蒂家地下室公寓的门。

en: A damp Jane Street leads deeper into the Chelsea neighborhood.
zh: 潮湿的简街延伸向切尔西街区深处。

en: &547 Yeah. This is the place.
&548 They had me over every Friday for drinks.
zh: &548 他们每个周五都请我过来喝酒。

en: &3629 They?
&549 Yvonne and her husband. Dion.
&550 Amazing how it all comes flooding back, huh?
zh: &550 一切都涌回来了，真神奇，是吧？

en: &551 I know it's been six decades, but...
zh: &551 我知道已经过去六十年了，但是……

en: &3209 It still feels like yesterday?
&552 That's the thing, isn't it? It's not yesterday. It's TODAY.
zh: &552 问题就在这，不是吗？不是昨天。是今天。

en: &553 Let's see what's what.
Lozzotti house - ext
knock on lozzotti's door
&3210 Nobody's home. You think we're too late?
zh: &3210 没人在家。你觉得我们来晚了吗？

en: &554 You're asking if she's murdered already? I don't think so.
zh: &554 你是在问她是不是已经被杀了？我觉得没有。

en: &555 Autopsy put the time of death at around midnight.
zh: &555 尸检把死亡时间定在午夜左右。

en: &556 That's five hours away.
&557 There's still time to prevent it.
&3211 Still nobody home.
&3212 So. Any moral objections to using this?
zh: &3212 那么，用这个有什么道德上的顾虑吗？

en: &560 Is that an AbbotTech multitool?
zh: &560 那是 AbbotTech 的多功能工具吗？

en: &3213 Indeed it is.
&561 Yeah that should do the trick.
&562 My younger self in this time would arrest you for it, but now? Go to town.
zh: &562 这个年代年轻时的我会因此逮捕你，但现在？随便用吧。

en: Sketches
Framed photo
Phone/Answering Machine
Remote
A very specific phobia.
zh: 一种非常具体的恐惧症。

en: The Lozzotti References
Hanna looks around the small apartment. Her eyes missing nothing.
zh: 汉娜环顾这间小公寓，目光不放过任何细节。

en: A watercolor painting of three ducks by a lake.
zh: 一幅水彩画，画的是湖边三只鸭子。

en: A combination phone and answering machine. Its light is blinking, indicating new messages.
zh: 一部电话和答录机一体机。指示灯在闪烁，表示有新留言。

en: A clunky answering machine.
A photograph of two teenage girls lies within a well cared-for frame.
zh: 一张两个少女的照片，装在一个保养良好的相框里。

en: A few handdrawn sketches lie on this desk.
zh: 这张书桌上放着几幅手绘素描。

en: A small plastic trash bin.
A painting adorns this wall.
A large painting is hanging on the wall.
A small square framed painting.
Another painting hanging on the wall.
A cityscape painting has been hung on this wall.
zh: 一幅城市风景画挂在这面墙上。

en: The cover of the book says "Best Journalism Practices, Y2K edition."
zh: 书的封面上写着“最佳新闻实践，Y2K 版”。

en: An archaic remote device for operating a television.
zh: 一个老式的电视遥控器。

en: &7102 Hanna?
&563 I'm all right.
&564 Just a bit of deja vu.
&565 I was here when I heard the news.

en: &3214 The news?

zh: &3647 你能在档案里扫描这些名字，看看它们有什么共同点吗？

zh: &3650 好主意。卡片上的名字是“罗桑杰拉·布莱克威尔”。

zh: &4456 我不再需要它了。我应该把它放回原处。

&606 Shot once in the back.

zh: &611 保护犯罪现场什么的，全完了。

zh: &612 不过也无所谓了。五个小时后，整个世界都变了。

zh: &613 面对……那一切，一桩小小的凶杀案显得那么微不足道。

en: &1625 He was.

mac chime!

zh: &1635 那个男孩看起来像年轻时的内森。

en: &5001 And the one scratched over... Nozzo, is that Marla?
zh: &5001 被划掉的那个……诺佐，那是玛拉吗？

en: &1636 We can't assume anything, but most likely.
zh: &1636 我们不能妄下结论，但很可能。

&5002 I admit, my knowledge of grunge-era courtship rituals is a bit rusty, but...
zh: &5002 我承认，我对垃圾摇滚时代的求爱仪式有点生疏了，但是……

en: &5003 Scratching out the face of a person in a photograph. Typically that means you hate that person. Correct?
zh: &5003 划掉照片里一个人的脸。通常意味着你恨那个人。对吗？

en: &1637 That's the tradition, yeah.
&5004 And this Adam Cole person. He later clusters with Marla Knox. Also correct?
zh: &5004 而这个亚当·科尔，后来和玛拉·诺克斯结为伴侣。也没错吧？

en: &1638 Again, yeah.
&5005 So why did he scratch out her face?
zh: &5005 那他为什么划掉她的脸？

en: &1639 I have no idea. But I'd prefer not to speculate until we know more.
zh: &1639 我不知道。但在了解更多之前，我不想妄加猜测。

en: &5006 Understood. I'll keep digging.
&1640 Thanks Fia. I'll be here.
&5007 There's nothing else in the bin worth taking.
zh: &5007 垃圾桶里没有其他值得拿的东西了。

en: &5008 Scanning my hand did nothing.
zh: &5008 扫描我的手没有任何反应。

zh: &5210 所以这个扫描锁的钥匙是……玛拉？

en: &1831 That explains why her face was scratched out in that photo you found.
zh: &1831 这就解释了你找到的那张照片里她的脸为什么被划掉了。

en: &1832 Probably to prevent anyone else from using it.
zh: &1832 大概是为了防止别人再用它。

en: &5009 Scanning that did nothing.
zh: &5009 扫描了，但什么也没发生。

zh: 一台量声粒子发生器。比第一台问世早了将近半个世纪。

&5211 I did, yeah.
&5212 So what now? Do we abort?
zh: &5212 那现在怎么办？我们要中止任务吗？

en: &6069 No. The protocol is clear.
&6070 We can't let this lie. Anomalies like this MUST be investigated.
zh: &6070 我们不能放任不管。像这样的异常现象必须调查。

en: &5213 But if he sues us...
&6071 The brass knows what we're doing. They gave us the green light.
zh: &6071 高层知道我们在做什么。他们给我们开了绿灯。

en: &6072 Just keep treading lightly. You know the drill.
zh: &6072 继续保持低调。你知道规矩的。

en: &6073 I'll keep digging on my end. We are going to figure this out.
zh: &6073 我这边会继续深挖。我们一定会弄清楚的。

en: &5010 Nozzo! What are you doing?
&1641 Er. What? What's going on?
&5011 Never mind. It's gone now.
&1642 What happened?
&5013 I felt the timestream. It was faint, but it was there.
zh: &5013 我感觉到了时间流。很微弱，但确实存在。

en: &5014 Did you open a portal?
&1643 No! And even if I wanted to, you know you have to be outdoors for it to work.
zh: &1643 没有！而且就算我想，你也知道必须在户外才能生效。

en: &5015 Right. Of course. I...
&5016 I've just been working too hard. Must be.
zh: &5016 我只是工作太累了。一定是这样。

en: &1644 I'll keep monitoring, Fia.
Secret basement

zh: &5028 我还以为量声粒子要到2040年代才被发现？

&5029 So Adam Cole is experimenting with time travel sixty years early?
zh: &5029 所以亚当·科尔提前六十年就在实验时间旅行？

zh: &1653 不可能。如果他在做，我们会知道的。

zh: &1656 我去和内森·诺克斯谈谈。待命，菲娅。

&1288 What exactly are you trying to do?
&4517 Just making sure it's legit.
&1645 Leave the untested, unverified, timestream particle generator alone.
zh: &1645 离那台未经测试、未经证实的时间流粒子发生器远点。

en: &1646 I can't believe I even have to say that.
zh: &1646 真不敢相信我居然还得说这种话。

en: &1647 I can't believe I even have to say that. AGAIN.
zh: &1647 真不敢相信我居然还得再说一遍。

en: &3597 This thing must be able to help me. Somehow.

en: &4518 The formula said to apply Quansonic particles to a blood sample infected with MorphaBite.

zh: &5018 等等。这是不是意味着我被时空锁定了？

zh: &1648 不。只有注射器。还有里面的东西。

en: &5019 So this syringe is immune to changes in the timestream?
zh: &5019 所以这支注射器不受时间流变化影响？

en: &1649 That's right.
&5020 Which means it won't pop out of existence when I loop again?
zh: &5020 也就是说我再次循环时它不会凭空消失？

en: &1650 That's... also right.
&5021 Well.
&5022 That'll save some time, at least.

&85 Well, don't let me keep you.
take sodium nitrate.

zh: &4529 她就站在那儿，我不能翻她的东西。

en: &5215 Here goes everything.
&1289 Well?

en: &1667 Old habits die hard.
